segs.tr: wa tab-yaz''-z''u bihee wujoohunaaa id'aa as-wad-datil-abshaar
segs.en: 53.our faces whitened when skins are blackened,

segs.ar: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله
segs.tr: h'am-daan nua'-taqu bihee min aleemi naaril-laahee
segs.en: 54.a praise through which we may be released from God's painful Fire
55.and enter God's generous neighbourhood,
56.a praise by which we may jostle the angels brought nigh
57.and join the prophets, the envoys,

segs.ar: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ
segs.en: 58.in a House of Permanence that does not remove,
59.the Place of His Generosity that does not change.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
segs.en: 60.Praise belongs to God, who chose for us the good qualities of creation,
61.granted us the agreeable things of provision,

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
segs.tr: wa jaa'la lanaal-faz''eelata bil-malakati a'laa jameei'l-khal-q
segs.en: 62.and appointed for us excellence through domination over all creation;
63.every one of His creatures submits to us through His power
64.and comes to obey us through His might.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wal-h'am-du lil-lahil-ld'eee agh-laqa a'n-naa baabal-h'aajati il-laaa ilay-h
segs.en: 65.Praise belongs to God, who locked for us the gate of need except toward Him.

segs.ar: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
segs.tr: fakay-fa nut'eequ h'am-dahu? am mataa noo-ad-dee shuk-rahu? laa mataa?
segs.en: 66.So how can we praise Him? When can we thank Him? Indeed, when?

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ
segs.en: 67.Praise belongs to God, who placed within us the organs of expansion,
68.assigned for us the agents of contraction,
69.gave us to enjoy the spirits of life,
70.fixed within us the limbs of works,
71.nourished us with the agreeable things of provision,
72.freed us from need through His bounty,
73.and gave us possessions through His kindness.
74.Then He commanded us that He might test our obedience

segs.ar: وَنَهَانَا لِيَبْتَلِيَ شُكْرَنَا فَخَالَفْنَا عَنْ طَرِيْقِ أمْرِهِ
segs.tr: wa nahaanaa leeab-taleea shuk-ranaa fakhaalaf-naa a'n t'areeqi am-rih
segs.en: 75.and prohibited us that He might try our thanksgiving. So we turned against the path of His commandments
76.and mounted the backs of His warnings.

segs.tr: falam yab-tadir-naa biu'qoobatih wa lam yua'ajil-naa binaqimatih
segs.en: 77.Yet He hurried us not to His punishment,nor hastened us on to His vengeance, ,

segs.ar: بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
segs.tr: bal taan-naanaa birah'-matihee takar-rumaawa antaz'ara muraajaa'tanaa biraa-fatihee h'il-maa
segs.en: 78.No, He went slowly with us through His mercy, in generosity, and awaited our return through His clemency, in mildness.
79.Praise belongs to God, who showed us the way to repentance,

segs.ar: الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segs.tr: allatee lam nufid-haaa il-laa min faz''-lih
segs.en: 80.which we would not have won save through His bounty.
81.Had we nothing to count as His bounty

segs.tr: il-laa bihaa laqad h'asuna balaaaw-uhoo i'ndanaa
segs.en: 82.but this, His trial of us would have been good,
83.His beneficence toward us great,
84.His bounty upon us immense.

segs.ar: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ
segs.en: 85.For such was not His wont in repentance
86.with those who went before us.
87.He has lifted up from us
88."what we have not the strength to bear"(2:286) ,
89.charged us only to our capacity,
90.imposed upon us nothing but ease,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
segs.tr: wa lam yadaa' liah'adim-min-naa h'uj-jataw-wa laa u'd'-raa
segs.en: 91.and left none of us with an argument or excuse.
92.So the perisher among us is he who perishes in spite of Him
93.and the felicitous among us he who beseeches Him.

segs.ar: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
segs.tr: wal-h'am-du lil-lahee bikul-li maa h'amidahoo bihee
segs.en: 94.And praise belongs to God with all the praises of
95.His angels closest to Him,
96.His creatures most noble in His eyes,
97.and His praisers most pleasing to Him;
98.a praise that may surpass other praises
99.as our Lord surpasses all His creatures.
100.Then to Him belongs praise,
101.in place of His every favour upon us

segs.ar: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
segs.en: 102.and upon all His servants, past and still remaining,

segs.ar: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِالاشْيَآءِ
segs.tr: a'dada maaa ah'aat'a bihee i'l-muhoo min jameei'l-ash-yaaa-i
segs.en: 103.to the number of all things His knowledge encompasses,

segs.ar: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا
segs.en: 104.and in place of each of His favours,

segs.ar: أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: 105.their number doubling and redoubling always and forever, to the Day of Resurrection;
106.a praise whose bound has no utmost end,
107.whose number has no reckoning,
108.whose limit cannot be reached,
109.whose period cannot be cut off;

segs.ar: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
segs.tr: h'am-day-yakoonu wus'-latan ilaa t'aaa'tihee wa a'f-wih
segs.en: 110.a praise which will become a link to His obedience and pardon,
111.a tie to His good pleasure,
112.a means to His forgiveness,
113.a path to His Garden,
114.a protector against His vengeance,
115.a security against His wrath,
116.an aid to obeying Him,
117.a barrier against disobeying Him,

segs.ar: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
segs.tr: wa a'w-nan a'laa taa-deeati h'aq-qihee wawaz'aaa-ifih
segs.en: 118.a help in fulfilling His right and His duties;

segs.ar: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
segs.tr: h'am-daan nas-a'du bihee fis-sua'daaa-i min aw-leeaaa-ih
segs.en: 119.a praise that will make us felicitous among His felicitous friends,

segs.ar: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
segs.tr: nas'eeru bihee fee naz'-mish-shuhadaaa-i bisuyoofi aa'-daaa-ih
segs.en: 120.and bring us into the ranks of those martyred by the swords of His enemies.
121.He is a Friend, Praiseworthy!

S_2.name: 2. Blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household
S_2.nameUr: رسول اکرمؐ اور ان کی آلؑ پر درود

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-al-ḥamdu lillāhi alladhī manna ‘alaynā bi-Muḥammadin nabīyhi ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayhi wa ālihi
segs.en: Praise be to Allah, who favored us with Muhammad, His Prophet—may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family,
unlike the nations of the past and the generations that have gone before.

segs.ar: بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ،
segs.tr: bi-qudratihi allatī lā ta‘jizu ‘an shay’in wa in ‘aẓuma,
segs.en: By His power, which nothing, however great, can render helpless,

segs.ar: وَ لا يَفُوتُهَا شَيءٌ وَإنْ لَطُفَ،
segs.tr: wa lā yafūtuhā shay’un wa in laṭuf,
segs.en: and from which nothing, however subtle, can escape.
Thus, He concluded all of creation with us,

segs.ar: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ،
segs.en: and made us witnesses against those who denied,
and, by His grace, multiplied us over those who were few.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ،
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your trustee of Your revelation,
Your chosen one from Your creation,
and Your pure one from Your servants,
the leader of mercy and the guide to goodness,
and the key to blessings.
Just as he dedicated himself to Your command,
and exposed his body to harm for Your sake,

segs.tr: wa kāshafa fī ad-du‘ā’i ilayka ḥāmmatahu,
segs.en: and faced his close kin openly in calling to You,
and fought his own family for Your pleasure,

segs.tr: wa qaṭa‘a fī iḥyā’i dīnika raḥimahu,
segs.en: and severed his ties for the revival of Your religion,
and distanced those closest to him for their denial,

segs.ar: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ،
segs.en: and drew near those most distant for their response to You,
and befriended the furthest for Your sake,
and antagonized the closest for Your sake.

segs.ar: وَ أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ad’aba nafsahu fī tablīghi risālatika,
segs.en: And he tirelessly exerted himself in conveying Your message,
and wearied himself with calling to Your faith,

segs.tr: wa shaghala ha bi-an-nuṣḥi li-ahli da‘watika,
segs.en: and occupied himself with advising the people of Your call.
He migrated to a foreign land,
a place far from his homeland,

segs.tr: wa mawḍi‘i rijlihi wa masqaṭi ra’sihi,
segs.en: and the walkway of his steps, his birthplace and of his forefathers,
and the comfort of his soul,
with the intention of giving Your religion glory,
and seeking Your help against the people of disbelief in You.

segs.ar: حَتَّى ٱسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ،
segs.tr: ḥattā istatabba lahu mā ḥāwala fī a‘dā’ika,
segs.en: Until what he strove for against Your enemies was established for him,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيآئِكَ،
segs.tr: wa istatamma lahu mā dabbara fī awliyā’ika,
segs.en: and what he planned for Your friends(awliya) was completed for him.
So he rose against them, seeking victory with Your help,
and strengthening himself against his weakness with Your victory.
He raided them in the heart of their homes,
and attacked them in the midst of their settled places,

segs.ar: حَتَّى ظَهَرَ أَمْرُكَ وَعَلَتْ كَلِمَتُكَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ.
segs.tr: ḥattā ẓahara amruka wa ‘alat kalimatuka wa law kariha al-mushrikūn.
segs.en: until Your command became manifest and Your word was exalted, even though the polytheists disliked it.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ فَارْفَعْهُ بِمَا كَدَحَ فِيكَ إِلٰى الدَّرَجَةِ الْعُلْيَا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma farfa‘hu bimā kadaḥa fīka ilā ad-darajati al-‘ulyā min jannatika,
segs.en: O Allah, for his striving in Your cause, raise him to the highest rank in Your Paradise,
so that he is not equaled in station,
and not matched in rank,

segs.ar: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ.
segs.tr: wa lā yuwāziyahu ladayka malakun muqarrabun wa lā nabīyun mursal.
segs.en: and no close angel or sent prophet can be his equal in Your presence.

segs.ar: وَعَرِّفْهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَاُمَّتِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ حُسْنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ،
segs.tr: Wa ‘arrifhu fī ahlihi aṭ-ṭāhirīna wa ummatihi al-mu’minīna min ḥusni ash-shafā‘ah,
segs.en: And grant him, in the presence of his purified family and his believing nation, the best of intercession,
the most magnificent of what You have promised him.
O You who fulfill promises,
O You who are true to Your word,

segs.ar: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
segs.tr: yā mubaddila as-sayyi’āti bi-aḍ‘āfihā mina al-ḥasanāt,
segs.en: O You who exchange bad deeds for many times their like in good deeds.

segs.ar: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ.
segs.tr: innaka dhū al-faḍli al-‘aẓīmi al-jawādu al-karīm.
segs.en: Truly, You are the Possessor of immense favor, the Generous, the Bountiful.
1. Praise belongs to God who was kind to us

segs.ar: بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segs.en: 2. through Muhammad, His Prophet (God bless him and his Household)
3. to the exclusion of past communities and bygone generations,

segs.ar: بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ
segs.tr: biqud-ratihil-latee laa taa'-jizu a'n shay-iw-wa in a'z'um
segs.en: 4. displaying thereby His power, which nothing can render incapable though it be great,

segs.ar: وَ لا يَفُوتُهَا شَيءٌ وَإنْ لَطُفَ،
segs.en: 5. and nothing can escape though it be subtle.

segs.tr: fakhatama binaa a'laa jameei' man d'araa
segs.en: 6. He sealed through us all He created,

segs.ar: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ
segs.tr: wa jaa'lanaa shuhadaaa-a a'laa man jah'ad
segs.en: 7. appointed us witnesses over those who deny,

segs.tr: wa kath-tharanaa biman-nihee a'laa man qal
segs.en: 8. and increased us by His kindness over those who are few.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-mad ameenika a'laa wah'-yik
segs.en: 9. O God, bless Muhammad, entrusted by You with Your revelation,
10. distinguished by You among Your creatures,
11. devoted to You among Your servants,
12. the imam of mercy, the leader of good,
13. the key to blessing,
14. who wearied his soul for Your affairs,
15. exposed his body to detested things for Your sake,
16. showed open enmity toward his next of kin by summoning to You,
17. fought against his family for Your good pleasure,

segs.tr: wa qat'aa' feee ih'-yaaa-i deenika rah'imah
segs.en: 18. cut the ties of the womb in giving life to Your religion,
19. sent far those close because of their denial,

segs.ar: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ
segs.en: 20. brought near those far because of their response to You,
21. showed friendship to the most distant for Your sake,
22. displayed enmity toward the nearest for Your sake,

segs.ar: و أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa ad-aba naf-sahoo fee tab-leeghi risaalatik
segs.en: 23. made his soul persevere in delivering Your message,
24. tired it in summoning to Your creed,
25. busied it in counselling those worthy of Your summons,
26. migrated to the land of exile
27. and the place of remoteness from the home of his saddlebags,

segs.tr: wa mawz''ii' rij-lih wa mas-qat'i raa-sih
segs.en: 28. the walkway of his feet, the ground of his birth,

segs.ar: وَمَأْنَسِ نَفْسِهِ إِرَادَةً مِنْهُ لِإِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
segs.tr: wa maa-nasi naf-sihee iraadatam-min-hoo liia'-zaazi deenik
segs.en: 29. and the intimate abode of his soul, desiring to exalt Your religion
30. and seeking help against those who disbelieved in You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى ٱسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ
segs.tr: h'at-taa as-tatab-ba lahoo maa h'aawala feee aa'-daaa-ik
segs.en: 31. until what he attempted against Your enemies went well with him

segs.ar: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيآئِكَ
segs.tr: was-tatam-ma lahoo maa dab-bara feee aw-leeaaa-ik
segs.en: 32. and what he arranged for Your friends was accomplished.
33. He rose up against them seeking victory through Thine aid,
34. becoming strong in spite of his weakness with Your help.
35. He fought against them in the centre of their cities

segs.tr: wa hajama a'lay-him fee buh'-booh'ati qaraarihim
segs.en: 36. and attacked them in the midst of their dwellings,
37. until Your command prevailed,

segs.tr: wa a'lat kalimatuka wa law karihal-mush-rikoon
segs.en: 38. and Your word rose up, though the idolaters were averse.
39. O God, so raise him, because of his labours for Your sake,
40. to the highest degree of Your Garden,
41. that none may equal him in station,
42. none may match him in level,

segs.ar: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
segs.tr: wa laa yuwaazeehoo laday-ka malakum-muqar-raboo-wa laa nabee-yum-mur-sal
segs.en: 43. and no angel brought nigh or prophet sent out may parallel him in Your sight.
44. And inform him concerning his Household the pure
45. and his community the faithful of an excellent intercession,

segs.ar: أَجَلَّ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ يَا نَافِذَ الْعِدَةِ
segs.en: 46. greater than what You hast promised him! O Keeper of promises!

segs.ar: يَا وَافِىَ الْقَوْلِ يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
segs.tr: yaa waafeeal-qaw-l yaa mubad-dilas-say-yi-aati biz''-a'afihaa minal-h'asanaat
segs.en: 47. O Faithful to Your word! O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ
segs.en: 48. You art of bounty abounding!

S_3.name: 3. Blessings upon the Bearers of the Throne

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَحَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِينَ لا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa ḥamalatu ‘arshika alladhīna lā yafturūna min tasbīḥik,
segs.en: O Allah, and Your Throne bearers who never tire of Your glorification,
nor weary of Your sanctification,
nor feel exhausted from Your worship,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِي أَمْرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa lā yu’thirūna al-taqṣīra ‘alā al-jiddi fī amrik,
segs.en: and who do not prefer negligence over diligence in Your command,
and who are not heedless of their passionate love for You.
And Israfil, the blower of the Trumpet,

segs.ar: الشَّاخِصُ الَّذِي يَنْتَظِرُ مِنْكَ الاذْنَ وَحُلُولَ الامْرِ،
segs.tr: ash-shākhiṣu alladhī yantaẓiru minka al-idhna wa ḥulūla al-amr,
segs.en: who stands ready, awaiting Your permission and the arrival of the command,
to awaken with his blast the fallen hostages of the graves.
And Mikail, who holds high rank with You,
and a lofty place in Your obedience.
And Jibril, the trustee of Your revelation,
who is obeyed by the inhabitants of Your heavens,
and holds a firm position with You, and is brought near to You.

segs.ar: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ،
segs.tr: wa ar-Rūḥu alladhī huwa ‘alā malā’ikati al-ḥujub,
segs.en: And the Spirit who is in charge of the angels of the veils,

segs.tr: wa ar-Rūḥu alladhī huwa min amrik.
segs.en: and the Spirit who is from Your command.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عليهم وَعَلَى الْمَلاَئِكَـةِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ
segs.tr: Allāhumma faṣalli ‘alayhim wa ‘alā al-malā’ikah alladhīna min dūnihim,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon them and upon the angels below them,

segs.ar: مِنْ سُكَّـانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَهْلِ الامَانَةِ عَلَى رِسَالاَتِكَ،
segs.tr: min sukkāni samāwātika wa ahli al-amānati ‘alā risālātik,
segs.en: the inhabitants of Your heavens and those entrusted with Your messages,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ لا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دؤُوب ،
segs.tr: wa-alladhīna lā tadkhuluhum sa’matun min da’ūb,
segs.en: and those whom no weariness enters from their diligence,

segs.ar: وَلاَ إعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلاَ فُتُورٌ،
segs.tr: wa lā i‘yā’un min lughūb wa lā futūr,
segs.en: nor fatigue from exhaustion or sluggishness.
Whom desires do not distract from Your glorification,

segs.ar: وَلا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَـلاَتِ،
segs.tr: wa lā yaqṭa‘uhum ‘an ta‘ẓīmika sahwu al-ghaflāt,
segs.en: nor do the lapses of heedlessness sever them from Your magnification.

segs.ar: الْخُشَّعُ الابْصارِ فلا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ ،
segs.tr: al-khushsha‘u al-abṣāri falā yarūmūna an-naẓara ilayk,
segs.en: Whose eyes are humble, so they do not dare to look at You,

segs.ar: النَّواكِسُ الاذْقانِ الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
segs.tr: an-nawākisu al-adhqāni alladhīna qad ṭālat raghbatuhum fīmā ladayk,
segs.en: and whose chins are lowered, having a prolonged longing for what is with You.
Those who are infatuated with the remembrance of Your bounties,

segs.tr: wa al-mutawāḍi‘ūna dūna ‘aẓamatika wa jalāli kibriyā’ik,
segs.en: and those who are humbled before Your greatness and the majesty of Your might.

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إذَا نَظَرُوا إلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ:
segs.tr: wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna idhā naẓarū ilā jahannama tazfiru ‘alā ahli ma‘ṣiyatik:
segs.en: And those who say when they look at Hellfire roaring against the people of Your disobedience:
"Glory be to You! We have not worshipped You with the worship due to You."

segs.ar: فَصَـلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ،
segs.en: So send blessings upon them and upon the spiritual ones among Your angels,
and those with proximity to You,
and the bearers of the unseen to Your messengers,
and those entrusted with Your revelation,

segs.tr: wa qabā’ili al-malā’ikati alladhīna ikhtaṣaṣtahum li-nafsik,
segs.en: and the tribes of angels whom You have chosen for Yourself,

segs.tr: wa aghnaytahum ‘an aṭ-ṭa‘āmi wa ash-sharābi bi-taqdīsik,
segs.en: and made them self-sufficient from food and drink with Your sanctification,
and settled them in the innermost layers of Your heavens.

segs.ar: وَالّذينَ عَلَى أرْجَآئِهَا إذَا نَزَلَ الامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa-alladhīna ‘alā arjā’ihā idhā nazala al-amru bi-tamāmi wa‘dik,
segs.en: And those who are on the edges of the heavens when the command descends for the fulfillment of Your promise,

segs.tr: wa khuzzāni al-maṭari wa zawājiri as-saḥāb,
segs.en: and the keepers of the rain and the drivers of the clouds,

segs.ar: وَالّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ ألرُّعُوْدِ،
segs.tr: wa-alladhī bi-ṣawti zajrihi yusma‘u zajalu ar-ru‘ūd,
segs.en: and those by the sound of whose driving the roar of thunder is heard,

segs.ar: وَإذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السّحَـابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ.
segs.tr: wa idhā sabaḥat bihi ḥafīfatu as-saḥāb iltama‘at ṣawā‘iqu al-burūq.
segs.en: and when the whistling of the clouds moves with it, the lightning bolts flash.
And the escorts of snow and hail.

segs.ar: وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَر إَذَا نَزَلَ،
segs.tr: wa al-hābiṭīna ma‘a qaṭri al-maṭari idhā nazal,
segs.en: And those who descend with every raindrop,
and the maintainers of the treasuries of the winds,
and those entrusted with the mountains so that they do not move.
And those whom You have made to know the weights of the waters,

segs.ar: وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا،
segs.tr: wa kayla mā taḥwīhi lawā‘iju al-amṭāri wa ‘awālijuhā,
segs.en: and the measure of what the powerful, heavy rains hold.

segs.ar: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ إلَى أهْلِ الارْضِ
segs.tr: wa rusulika min al-malā’ikati ilā ahli al-arḍi
segs.en: And Your messengers from the angels to the people of the earth
with the disliked things of the descending calamities,
and the beloved things of ease,
and the noble, righteous scribes,
and the noble, writing guardians,
and the angel of death and his helpers,
and Munkar and Nakir,
and Rumān, the tester of the graves,
and those who circumambulate the Frequented House,
and Malik, and the keepers of Hellfire,
and Ridwan, and the gatekeepers of the Gardens,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَعْصُوْنَ اللّهَ مَا أمَرَهُمْ
segs.tr: wa-alladhīna lā ya‘ṣūna Allāha mā amarahum
segs.en: and those who do not disobey Allah in what He commands them
and do what they are commanded.

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ: سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ
segs.en: And those who say, "Peace be upon you for what you have patiently endured!
How excellent is the final abode!"

segs.ar: والزّبانيةُ الذّينَ إذَا قِيْـلَ لَهُمْ: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوْهُ
segs.tr: wa az-zabānīyatu alladhīna idhā qīla lahum: khudhūhu fa-ghullūhū
segs.en: And the Zabaniyah (guards of Hell) who, when it is said to them: "Seize him and shackle him!
Then cast him into Hellfire,"
they rush to him quickly without delay.
And those whom we have neglected to mention,
and whose place with You we do not know,
and for what matter You have entrusted them.

segs.tr: wa sukkānu al-hawā’i wa al-arḍi wa al-mā’,
segs.en: And the inhabitants of the air, the earth, and the water,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ
segs.en: and those among them who are in charge of creation, so send blessings upon them,

segs.ar: يَوْمَ تَأْتي كُلُّ نَفْس مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ،
segs.tr: yawma ta’tī kullu nafsin ma‘ahā sā’iqun wa shahīd,
segs.en: on the Day every soul comes with a driver and a witness.

segs.ar: وَصَلّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلى كَرَامَتِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa ṣalli ‘alayhim ṣalātan tazīduhum karāmatan ‘alā karāmatihim,
segs.en: And send blessings upon them, a blessing that increases their honor upon their honor,
and purity upon their purity.

segs.ar: اللّهُمَّ وَإذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa idhā ṣallayta ‘alā malā’ikatika wa rusulik,
segs.en: O Allah, and when You have sent blessings upon Your angels and Your messengers,
and conveyed our blessings to them,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَينا بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيْهِمْ
segs.tr: fa-ṣalli ‘alaynā bi-mā fataḥta lanā min ḥusni al-qawli fīhim
segs.en: then send blessings upon us, for the good words You have enabled us to say about them.
Truly, You are the Generous, the Bountiful.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَحَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِينَ لا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa h'amalatu a'r-shikal-lad'een laa yafturoona min tas-beeh'ik
segs.en: 1.O God, as for the Bearers of Your Throne, who never flag in glorifying You,
2.never become weary of calling You holy,
3.never tire of worshipping You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِي أَمْرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa yoo-thiroonat-taq-s'eera a'laal-jid-di feee am-rik
segs.en: 4.never prefer curtailment over diligence in Your command,
5.and are never heedless of passionate love for You;

segs.ar: وَإسْرافِيْلُ صَاحِبُ الصُّوْرِ، الشَّاخِصُ الَّذِي يَنْتَظِرُ
segs.en: 6.Seraphiel, the Owner of the Trumpet, fixed in his gaze, awaiting

segs.ar: مِنْكَ الاذْنَ وَحُلُولَ الامْرِ، فَيُنَبِّهُ بِالنَّفْخَةِ
segs.en: 7.Your permission and the descent of the Command, that he may arouse through the Blast

segs.ar: صَرْعى رَهَائِنِ الْقُبُورِ. وَمِيكَآئِيلُ ذُو الْجَاهِ عِنْدَكَ،
segs.tr: s'ar-a'a rahaaa-inil-quboor wa meekaaa-eelu d'ool-jaahee i'ndaka
segs.en: 8.the hostages thrown down in the graves; Michael, possessor of standing with You
9.and a raised up place in Your obedience;
10.Gabriel, entrusted with Your revelation,
11.obeyed by the inhabitants of Your heavens,
12.distinguished in Your Presence, brought nigh to You;

segs.ar: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ،
segs.en: 13.the spirit who is over the angels of the veils;
14.and the spirit who is of Your command -
15.O God! bless them and the angels below them:

segs.ar: الَّـذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّـانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
segs.tr: lad'eena min doonihim min suk-kaani samaawaatik
segs.en: 16.the residents in Your heavens,
17.those entrusted with Your messages,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ لا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دؤُوب ،
segs.en: 18.those who become not wearied by perseverance,

segs.ar: وَلاَ إعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلاَ فُتُورٌ،
segs.en: 19.or exhausted and flagged by toil,
20.whom passions distract not from glorifying You,

segs.ar: وَلا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَـلاَتِ،
segs.tr: wa laa yaq-t'au'hum a'n taa'-z'eemika sah-wl-ghafalaat
segs.en: 21.and whose magnification of You is never cut off by the inattention of heedless moments;

segs.ar: الْخُشَّعُ الابْصارِ فلا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ ،
segs.en: 22.their eyes lowered, they do not attempt to look at You;

segs.ar: النَّواكِسُ الاذْقانِ الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
segs.en: 23.their chins bowed, they have long desired what is with You;
24.unrestrained in mentioning Your boons,
25.they remain humble before Your mightiness and the majesty of Your magnificence;

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إذَا نَظَرُوا إلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ:
segs.tr: wal-lad'eena yaqooloona id'aa naz'aroo ilaa jahan-nama taz-firu a'laaa ah-li maa'-s'eeatika:
segs.en: 26.those who say when they look upon Gehenna roaring over the people who disobeyed You:
27.'Glory be to You, we have not worshipped You with the worship You deservest!'

segs.ar: فَصَـلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ،
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'lay-him wa a'laa r-raw-h'aanee-yeena mim-malaaa-ikatik
segs.en: 28.Bless them, and Your angels who are the Reposeful,

segs.ar: وَ أهْلِ الزُّلْفَةِ عِنْدَكَ، وَحُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إلى رُسُلِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ah-liz-zul-fati i'ndak wa h'um-maalil-ghay-bi ilaa rusulik
segs.en: 29.those of proximity to You, those who carry the unseen to Your messengers,

segs.ar: وَالْمُؤْتَمَنِينَ على وَحْيِكَ وَقَبائِلِ الْمَلائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ،
segs.tr: wal-moo-tamaneena a'laa wah'-yik wa qabaaa-ilil-malaaa-ikatil-lad'een akh-tas'as'-tahum linaf-sik
segs.en: 30.those entrusted with Your revelation, the tribes of angels whom You hast singled out for Yourself,
31.freed from need for food and drink by their calling You holy,
32.and made to dwell inside Your heavens' layers,

segs.ar: وَالّذينَ عَلَى أرْجَآئِهَا إذَا نَزَلَ الامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ،
segs.tr: wal-lad'eena a'laaa ar-jaaa-ihaaa id'aa nazalal-am-ru bitamaami waa'-dik
segs.en: 33.those who will stand upon the heavens' borders when the Command descends to complete Your promise,
34.the keepers of the rain, the drivers of the clouds,

segs.ar: وَالّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ ألرُّعُوْدِ،
segs.en: 35.him at whose driving's sound is heard the rolling of thunder,

segs.ar: وَإذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السّحَـابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ.
segs.tr: wa id'aa sabah'at bihee h'afeefatus-sah'aabil-tamaa't s'awaai'qul-burooq
segs.en: 36.and when the reverberating clouds swim before his driving, bolts of lightning flash;

segs.ar: وَمُشَيِّعِيْ الْثَلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ. وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَر إَذَا نَزَلَ،
segs.tr: wa mushay-yie'eth-thal-ji wal-barad wal-haabit'eena maa' qat'-ril-mat'ari id'aa nazal
segs.en: 37.the escorts of snow and hail, the descenders with the drops of rain when they fall,
38.the watchers over the treasuries of the winds,
39.those charged with the mountains lest they disappear,
40.those whom You hast taught the weights of the waters

segs.ar: وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا،
segs.tr: wa kay-la maa tah'-weehee lawaai'jul-am-t'aari wa a'waalijuhaa
segs.en: 41.and the measures contained by torrents and masses of rain;

segs.ar: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ إلَى أهْلِ الارْضِ بِمَكْرُوهِ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segs.tr: wa rusulika minal-malaaa-ikati ilaaa ah-lil-ar-z''i bimak-roohee maa yanzilu minal-balaaa
segs.en: 42.the angels who are Your messengers to the people of the earth with the disliked affliction that comes down
43.and the beloved ease; the devoted, noble scribes,

segs.ar: وَالْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ، وَمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ وَأعْوَانِهِ،
segs.en: 44.the watchers, noble writers, the angel of death and his helpers,

segs.tr: wa munkariw-wa nakeer wa roomaana fat-taanil-quboor
segs.en: 45.Munkar and Nakir, Rumaan, the tester in the graves,
46.the circlers of the Inhabited House, Malik
47.and the guardians, Ridwan and the gatekeepers of the gardens,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَعْصُوْنَ اللّهَ مَا أمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ.
segs.tr: wal-lad'eena (laa yaa'-s'oonal-laaha maaa amarahum wa yaf-a'loona maa yoo-maroon)
segs.en: 48.those who "disobey not God in What He commands them and do What they are commanded" (66:6);

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ: سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الـدّارِ.
segs.tr: wal-lad'eena yaqooloona (salaamun a'lay-kum bimaa s'abar-tum fania'-ma u'q-baad-daar)
segs.en: 49.those who say, "Peace be upon you, for that you were patient - and fair is the Ultimate Abode" (13:24);

segs.ar: والزّبانيةُ الذّينَ إذَا قِيْـلَ لَهُمْ: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوْهُ
segs.en: 50.the Zabaniya, who, when it is said to them, "take him, and fetter him,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوْهُ ابْتَدَرُوهُ سِرَاعاً وَلَمْ يُنْظِرُوهُ.
segs.en: 51.then roast him in hell" (69:30), hasten to accomplish it, nor do they give him any respite;

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ، وَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wa man aw-ham-naa d'ik-rahoo wa lam naa'-lam makaanahoo minka
segs.en: 52.him whom we have failed to mention, not knowing his place with You,

segs.ar: وَبأيِّ أمْر وَكَّلْتَهُ. وَسُكّانُ الْهَوَآءِ وَالارْضِ وَالمآءِ،
segs.tr: wa biy-yi am-riw-wak-kal-tah wa suk-kaanil-hawaaa-i wal-ar-z''i wal-maaa-i
segs.en: 53.nor with which command You hast charged him; and the residents in the air, the earth, and the water,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ
segs.en: 54.and those of them charged over the creatures; bless them

segs.ar: يَوْمَ تَأْتي كُلُّ نَفْس مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ،
segs.en: 55.on the day when "every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness" (50:21),

segs.ar: وَصَلّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلى كَرَامَتِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa s'al-li a'lay-him s'alaatan tazeeduhum karaamatan a'laa karaamatihim-
segs.en: 56.and bless them with a blessing that will add honour to their honour
57.and purity to their purity.

segs.ar: اللّهُمَّ وَإذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa id'aa s'al-lay-ta a'laa malaaa-ikatika
segs.en: 58.O God, and when You blessest Your angels and Your messengers

segs.tr: warusulika wa bal-lagh-tahum s'alaatanaa a'lay-him fas'al-li a'lay-na
segs.en: 59.and You extendest our blessings to them, bless us

segs.ar: بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيْهِمْ إنَّكَ جَوَاْدٌ كَرِيمٌ .
segs.tr: bimaa fatah'-ta lanaa min h'us-nil-qaw-li feehim- in-naka jawaadun kareem
segs.en: 60.through the good words about them which You hast opened up for us! You art Munificent, Generous.

S_4.name: 4. Blessings upon the Followers of the Messengers
S_4.nameUr: انبیاء کی تصدیق کرنے والوں پر درود

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa atbā‘u ar-rusuli wa muṣaddiqūhum
segs.en: O Allah, and the followers of the messengers and their believers,

segs.ar: مِنْ أَهْلِ الاَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَـانِدينَ لَهُمْ بِالتَّكْذِيبِ
segs.tr: min ahli al-arḍi bi-al-ghaybi ‘inda mu‘āraḍati al-mu‘ānidīna lahum bi-at-takdhīb
segs.en: from the people of the earth who believed in the unseen when those who were stubborn opposed them with denial,

segs.tr: wa al-ishtiyāqi ilā al-mursalīna bi-ḥaqā’iqi al-īmān.
segs.en: and who longed for the messengers with the truths of faith.

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ دَهْر وَزَمَان أَرْسَلْتَ فِيْهِ رَسُولاً،
segs.tr: fī kulli dahri wa zamānin arsalta fīhi rasūlan,
segs.en: in every era and time in which You sent a messenger,
and established a guide for its people,

segs.ar: مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إلَى مُحَمَّد صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ
segs.tr: min ladun Ādama ilā Muḥammadin ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayhi wa ālihi
segs.en: from Adam to Muhammad—may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family—

segs.ar: مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُـدَى، وَقَادَةِ أَهْـلِ التُّقَى
segs.tr: min a’immati al-hudā, wa qādati ahli at-tuqā
segs.en: from the imams of guidance and the leaders of the people of piety.

segs.ar: عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ، فَاذْكُرْهُمْ مِنْكَ بِمَغْفِرَة وَرِضْوَان.
segs.tr: ‘alā jamī‘ihimu as-salām, fa-adhkurhum minka bi-maghfiratin wa riḍwān.
segs.en: Peace be upon all of them. So, remember them with forgiveness and pleasure from You.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّد خَاصَّةً الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الصَّحَابَةَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa aṣḥābu Muḥammadin khāṣṣatan alladhīna aḥsanū aṣ-ṣaḥābah,
segs.en: O Allah, and the companions of Muhammad especially, who were excellent in companionship,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ أَبْلَوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-alladhīna ablaw al-balā’a al-ḥasana fī naṣrih,
segs.en: and who performed the best of trials in supporting him,

segs.tr: wa kānafūhu wa asra‘ū ilā wifādatih
segs.en: and were his allies, and rushed to his arrival,

segs.tr: wa sābaqū ilā da‘watihi wa istajābū lah
segs.en: and raced to his call and responded to him
when he made them hear the proof of his messages,

segs.ar: وَفَارَقُوا الازْوَاجَ وَالاوْلادَ فِي إظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa fāraqū al-azwāja wa al-awlāda fī iẓhāri kalimatih,
segs.en: and who separated from spouses and children to make his word manifest,

segs.ar: وَقَاتَلُوا الاباءَ وَ الابناءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نبُوَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa qātalū al-ābā’a wa al-abnā’a fī tathbīti nubūwatih,
segs.en: and who fought fathers and sons to establish his prophethood,

segs.ar: وَانْتَصَرُوا بهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى مَحبَّتِهِ
segs.tr: wa intaṣarū bihi wa man kānū munṭawīna ‘alā maḥabbatih
segs.en: and who gained victory through him, and those who were inwardly full of love for him,

segs.ar: يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra fī mawaddatih,
segs.en: hoping for a trade that will not fail in their affection for him,

segs.ar: وَالّذينَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ العَشَائِرُ إذْ تَعَلَّقُوا بِعُرْوَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-alladhīna hajarathumu al-‘ashā’iru idh ta‘allaqū bi-‘urwatih,
segs.en: and those whom their tribes abandoned when they clung to his handhold,

segs.ar: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
segs.tr: wa intafat minhumu al-qarābātu idh sakanū fī ẓilli qarābatih.
segs.en: and whom their relatives disowned when they took shelter in the shade of his kinship.

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ،
segs.tr: falā tansa lahumu Allāhumma mā tarakū laka wa fīk,
segs.en: So, O Allah, do not forget what they left for You and for Your sake,

segs.ar: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa arḍihim min riḍwānika wa bi-mā ḥāshū al-khalqa ‘alayk,
segs.en: and make them pleased with Your pleasure, and for how they gathered the creation for You,

segs.ar: وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa kānū ma‘a rasūlika du‘ātan laka ilayk,
segs.en: and were with Your messenger, callers for You to Yourself.

segs.ar: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa ashkurhum ‘alā hajrihim fīka diyāra qawmihim,
segs.en: And thank them for their migration for Your sake from the homes of their people,

segs.ar: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ،
segs.tr: wa khurūjihim min sa‘ati al-ma‘āshi ilā ḍīqih,
segs.en: and for their departure from a life of ease to one of hardship,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
segs.tr: wa man kaththarta fī i‘zāzi dīnika min maẓlūmihim.
segs.en: and for those among them who were oppressed, whom You multiplied in giving glory to Your religion.

segs.ar: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ:
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa awṣil ilā at-tābi‘īna lahum bi-iḥsānin alladhīna yaqūlūn:
segs.en: O Allah, and grant to the followers who follow them with goodness, who say:

segs.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
segs.tr: Rabbanā ighfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā alladhīna sabaqūnā bi-al-īmāni khayra jazā’ik,
segs.en: "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith," the best of Your reward,
those who sought their way,
and aimed for their direction,
and proceeded on their path,
whom no doubt turned away in their insight,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ
segs.tr: wa lam yakhtalijhum shakkun fī qafwi āthārihim
segs.en: and no hesitation troubled them in following their footsteps
and being guided by the light of their landmarks,
being their allies and supporters,
practicing their religion,
and being guided by their guidance,
agreeing with them,

segs.tr: wa lā yattahimūnahum fīmā addaw ilayhim.
segs.en: and not accusing them of anything they conveyed to them.

segs.ar: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلَى يَوْم الدِّينِ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā at-tābi‘īna min yawminā hādhā ilā yawmi ad-dīn,
segs.en: O Allah, and send blessings upon the followers from this day until the Day of Judgment,
and upon their spouses,
and upon their descendants,
and upon those among them who obeyed You,
a blessing that protects them from disobeying You,

segs.tr: wa tafsaḥu lahum fī riyāḍi jannatik,
segs.en: and expands for them in the gardens of Your Paradise,

segs.tr: wa tamna‘uhum bi-hā min kaydi ash-shayṭān,
segs.en: and by which You prevent the plot of Satan from them,

segs.ar: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ،
segs.tr: wa tu‘īnuhum bi-hā ‘alā mā ista‘ānūka ‘alayhi min birr,
segs.en: and by which You assist them in the righteousness for which they sought Your help,

segs.tr: wa taqīhim ṭawāriqa al-layli wa an-nahār
segs.en: and protect them from the calamities of the night and day,
except for a calamity that comes with goodness,

segs.ar: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: wa tab‘athuhum bi-hā ‘alā i‘tiqādi ḥusni ar-rajā’i lak,
segs.en: and by which You inspire them with the belief in a good hope in You,
and a desire for what is with You,

segs.ar: وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ
segs.tr: wa tarki an-nuhamati fīmā taḥwīhi aydī al-‘ibād
segs.en: and the abandonment of greed for what the hands of servants hold,

segs.ar: لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: li-taruddahum ilā ar-raghbati ilayka wa ar-rahbati mink,
segs.en: so that You return them to desire for You and awe of You.
And make them ascetic toward the abundance of this fleeting world,
and make them love to work for the Hereafter,
and to prepare for what is after death,

segs.ar: وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ
segs.tr: wa tuhawwina ‘alayhim kulla karbin yaḥullu bihim
segs.en: and make easy for them every anguish that befalls them
on the day souls depart from their bodies,

segs.ar: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا،
segs.tr: wa tu‘āfiyahum mimmā taqa‘u bihi al-fitnatu min maḥdhūrātihā,
segs.en: and protect them from the forbidden things that cause sedition,

segs.tr: wa kabbati an-nāri wa ṭūli al-khulūdi fīhā,
segs.en: and the fall into the fire and a long stay in it,

segs.ar: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
segs.tr: wa tuṣayyirahum ilā amnin min maqīli al-muttaqīn.
segs.en: and make them reach a safe haven, the resting place of the righteous.
1.O God, as for the followers of the messengers and those of the people

segs.ar: مِنْ أَهْلِ الاَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَـانِدينَ لَهُمْ
segs.tr: min ah-lil-ar-z''i bil-ghay-bi i'nda mua'araz''atil-mua'anideena lahum
segs.en: 2.of the earth who attested to them unseen (while the obstinate resisted them

segs.ar: بِالتَّكْذِيبِ وَالاشْتِيَاقِ إلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقائِقِ الايْمَانِ .
segs.en: 3.through crying lies) - they yearned for the emissaries through the realities of faith

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ دَهْر وَزَمَان أَرْسَلْتَ فِيْهِ رَسُولاً، وَأَقَمْتَ لاهْلِهِ دَلِيلاً،
segs.tr: fee kul-li dah-riw-wa zamaan ar-sal-ta feehee rasoolaa wa aqam-ta liah-lihee daleelaa
segs.en: 4.in every era and time in which You didst send a messenger and set up for the people a director

segs.ar: مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إلَى مُحَمَّد صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُـدَى،
segs.tr: mil-ladun aaadama ilaa muh'am-madin s'al-laal-laahoo a'lay-hee wa aaalih min a-im-matil-hudaa
segs.en: 5.from the period of Adam down to Muhammad (God bless him and his Household) from among the imams of guidance

segs.ar: وَقَادَةِ أَهْـلِ التُّقَى عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ،
segs.en: 6.and the leaders of the godfearing (upon them all be peace) -
7.remember them with forgiveness and good pleasure!

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّد خَاصَّةً الَّـذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الصَّحَابَةَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa as'-h'aabu muh'am-madin khaaas'-s'atan al-lad'eena ah'-sanoos'-s'ah'aabata
segs.en: 8.O God, and as for the Companions of Muhammad specifically, those who did well in companionship,

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ أَبْلَوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ،
segs.en: 9.who stood the good test in helping him,

segs.ar: وَكَانَفُوهُ وَأَسْرَعُوا إلَى وِفَادَتِهِ وَسَابَقُوا إلَى دَعْوَتِهِ
segs.tr: wa kaanafoohoo wa as-rau'waaa ilaa wifaadatih wa saabaqoo ilaa daa'-watihee
segs.en: 10. supported his mission, promptly advanced at his call, answered it as soon as he made them

segs.ar: واسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حجَّةَ رِسَالاَتِهِ،
segs.tr: was-tajaaboo lahoo h'ay-thu as-maa'hum h'uj-jata risaalaatih
segs.en: 11.responded to him when he made them hear his messages' argument,

segs.ar: وَفَارَقُوا الازْوَاجَ وَالاوْلادَ فِي إظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa faaraqool-az-waaja wal-aw-laada feee iz'-haari kalimatih
segs.en: 12.separated from mates and children in manifesting his word,

segs.ar: وَقَاتَلُوا الاباءَ وَ الابناءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نبُوَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa qaatalool-abaaa-a wal-ab-naaa-a fee tath-beeti nuboo-watihee
segs.en: 13.fought against fathers and sons in strengthening his prophecy,

segs.ar: وَانْتَصَرُوا بهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى
segs.tr: wa antas'aroo bih wa man kaanoo munt'aweena a'laa
segs.en: 14.and through him gained victory; those who were wrapped in

segs.ar: مَحبَّتِهِ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: mah'ab-batihee yar-joona tijaaratal-lan taboora fee mawad-datih
segs.en: 15.affection for him, "hoping for a commerce that comes not to naught" (35:29) in love for him;

segs.ar: وَالّذينَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ العَشَائِرُ إذْ تَعَلَّقُوا بِعُرْوَتِهِ،
segs.en: 16.those who were left by their clans when they clung to his handhold

segs.ar: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
segs.tr: wantafat min-humul-qaraabaatu id' sakanoo fee z'il-li qaraabatih
segs.en: 17.and denied by their kinsfolk when they rested in the shadow of his kinship;

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ،
segs.tr: falaa tansa lahumul-laahum-ma maa tarakoo laka wa feeka
segs.en: 18.forget not, O God, what they abandoned for You and in You,

segs.ar: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa ar-z''ihim mir-riz''-waanik wa bimaa h'aashool-khal-qa a'lay-k
segs.en: 19.and make them pleased with Your good pleasure for the sake of the creatures they drove to You

segs.ar: وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa kaanoo maa' rasoolika dua'atal-laka ilay-k
segs.en: 20.while they were with Your Messenger, summoners to You for You.

segs.ar: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa ash-kur-hum a'laa haj-rihim feeka deeaara qaw-mihim-
segs.en: 21.Show gratitude to them for leaving the abodes of their people for Your sake

segs.ar: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ،
segs.tr: wa khuroojihim min saa'til-maa'ashi ilaa z''eeqih
segs.en: 22.and going out from a plentiful livelihood to a narrow one,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
segs.tr: wa man kath-thar-ta feee ia'-zaazi deenika mim-maz'-loomihim-
segs.en: 23.and [show gratitude to] those of them who became objects of wrongdoing and whom You multiplied in exalting Your religion.

segs.ar: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ :
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa aw-s'il ilaat-taabie'ena lahum biih'-saaninl-lad'eena yaqooloona:
segs.en: 24.O God, and give to those who have done well in following the Companions, who say,

segs.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
segs.tr: (rab-banaa igh-fir lanaa wa liikh-waaninaal-lad'eena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaan) khay-ra jazaaa-ika
segs.en: 25."Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who went before us in faith" (59:10), Your best reward;

segs.ar: الَّذِينَ قَصَدُوا سَمْتَهُمْ، وَتَحَرَّوْا وِجْهَتَهُمْ، وَمَضَوْا عَلى شاكِلَتِهِمْ،
segs.tr: al-lad'eena qas'adoo sam-tahum wa tah'ar-raw-a wij-hatahum- wa maz''aw-a a'laa shaakilatihim-
segs.en: 26.those who went straight to the Companions' road, sought out their course, and proceeded in their manner.

segs.ar: لَمْ يَثْنِهِمْ رَيْبٌ فِي بَصِيْرَتِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ
segs.tr: lam yath-nihim ray-bun fee bas'eeratihim wa lam yakh-talij-hum shak-kun
segs.en: 27.No doubt concerning their sure insight diverted them and no uncertainty shook them

segs.ar: فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ وَالاِئْتِمَامِ بِهِدَايَةِ مَنَارِهِمْ،
segs.tr: fee qaf-wi aaathaarihim wa aal-ai-timaam bihidaayati manaarihim
segs.en: 28.from following in their tracks and being led by the guidance of their light.

segs.ar: مُكَانِفِينَ وَمُوَازِرِيْنَ لَهُمْ، يَدِيْنُونَ بِدِيْنِهِمْ، وَيَهْتَدُونَ بِهَدْيِهِمْ،
segs.tr: mukaanifeena wa muwaazireena lahum- yadeenoona bideenihim- wa yah-tadoona bihad-yihim-
segs.en: 29.As their assistants and supporters, they professed their religion, gained guidance through their guidance,

segs.ar: يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلاَ يَتَّهِمُونَهُمْ فِيمَا أدَّوْا إلَيْهِمْ.
segs.tr: yat-tafiqoona a'lay-him- wa laa yat-tahimoonahum feemaaa ad-daw-aaa ilay-him-
segs.en: 30.came to agreement with them, and never accused them in what they passed on to them.

segs.ar: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلى يَوْم الدِّينِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma was'al-li a'laat-taabie'ena mee-yaw-minaa had'aaa ilaa yaw-mid-deen
segs.en: 31.O God, and bless the Followers, from this day of ours to the Day of Doom,

segs.tr: wa a'laaa az-waajihim- wa a'laa d'ur-ree-yaatihim-
segs.en: 32.their wives, their offspring,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مِنْهُمْ صَلاْةً تَعْصِمُهُمْ بِهَامِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa a'laa man at'aaa'ka min-hum- s'alaatan taa'-s'imuhum bihaa mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segs.en: 33.and those among them who obey You, with a blessing through which You wilt preserve them from disobeying You,

segs.ar: وَتَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِي رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ، وَتَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَيْطَانِ،
segs.tr: wa taf-sahoo lahum fee reeaaz''i jan-natik wa tam-nau'hum bihaa min kay-dish-shay-t'aan
segs.en: 34.make room for them in the plots of Your Garden, defend them from the trickery of Satan,

segs.ar: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ،
segs.tr: wa tue'enuhum bihaa a'laa mas-taa'anooka a'lay-hee mim-birr
segs.en: 35.help them in the piety in which they seek help from You,

segs.ar: وَتَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إلاّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْر،
segs.tr: wa taqeehm t'awaariqal-lay-li wan-nahaari il-laa t'aariqay-yat'-ruqu bikhay-r
segs.en: 36.protect them from sudden events that come by night and day - except the events which come with good -

segs.ar: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: wa tab-a'thuhum bihaa a'laa ia'-tiqaadi h'us-nir-rajaaa-i laka
segs.en: 37.and incite them to tie firmly the knot of good hope in You,

segs.ar: وَالطَّمَعِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ
segs.tr: wat'-t'amai' feemaa i'ndak wa tar-kit-tuh-mati feemaa tah'-weeheee
segs.en: 38.desire what is with You, and refrain from ill thoughts [toward You] because of what

segs.ar: أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: ay-deel-i'baad litarud-dahum ilaar-ragh-bati ilay-ka war-rah-bati minka
segs.en: 39.the hands of Your servants' hold. Thus You mayest restore them to beseeching You and fearing You,

segs.ar: وَتُزَهِّدُهُمْ فِي سَعَةِ العَاجِلِ وَتُحَبِّبُ إلَيْهِمُ
segs.tr: wa tuzah-hidahum fee saa'til-a'ajil wa tuh'ab-biba ilay-him
segs.en: 40.induce them to renounce the plenty of the immediate, make them love to

segs.ar: الْعَمَلَ لِلاجِلِ، وَالاسْتِعْدَادَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ
segs.tr: himul-a'mala lil-aaajil walis-tia'-daada limaa baa'-dal-maw-t wa tuhaw-wina a'lay-him
segs.en: 41.work for the sake of the deferred and prepare for what comes after death, make easy for them

segs.ar: كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ يَوْمَ خُـرُوجِ الانْفُسِ مِنْ أَبْدَانِهَا
segs.tr: kul-la kar-bee-yah'il-lu bihim yaw-ma khuroojil-anfusi min ab-daanihaa
segs.en: 42.every distress that comes to them on the day when souls take leave from bodies,

segs.ar: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا،
segs.tr: wa tua'afeeahum mim-maa taqau' bihil-fit-natu mim-mah'-d'ooraatihaa
segs.en: 43.release them from that which brings about the perils of temptation
44.and being thrown down in the Fire and staying forever within it,

segs.ar: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
segs.en: 45.and take them to security, the resting place of the godfearing.

S_5.name: 5. For Himself and his Close Ones
S_5.nameUr: اپنے اور اپنے خاص لوگوں کے لیے

segs.tr: Yā man lā tanqaḍī ʿajāʾibu ʿaẓamatihi,
segs.en: O You whose greatness wonders never cease,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And shield us from disbelief in Your greatness.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa yā man lā tantahī muddata mulkihi,
segs.en: And O You whose reign never ends,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And liberate our necks from Your punishment.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa yā man lā tafnā khazāʾinu raḥmatihi,
segs.en: And O You whose treasures of mercy never perish,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,

segs.tr: Wa ajʿal lanā naṣīban fī raḥmatika.
segs.en: And grant us a share in Your mercy.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الْأَبْصَارُ،
segs.tr: Wa yā man tanqaṭiʿu dūna ruʾyatihi al-abṣāru,
segs.en: And O You in whose sight all vision ceases,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And bring us closer to You.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الْأَخْطَارُ،
segs.tr: Wa yā man taṣghuru ʿinda khaṭarihi al-akhṭāru,
segs.en: And O You before whose danger all dangers shrink,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And honor us through You.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الْأَخْبَارِ،
segs.tr: Wa yā man taẓharu ʿindahu bawāṭinu al-akhbār,
segs.en: And O You before whom all hidden truths appear,
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And do not disgrace us before You.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهَّابِينَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma aghninā ʿan hibati al-wahhābīn bihibatika,
segs.en: O Allah, enrich us without needing the gift of the generous by Your gift,
And suffice us from the loneliness caused by those who sever ties with Your connection,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نَرْغَبَ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā narghaba ilā aḥadin maʿa bazlika,
segs.en: So that we desire no one besides You despite our giving,

segs.ar: وَلَا نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ مَعَ فَضْلِكَ.
segs.tr: Wa lā nastawḥish min aḥadin maʿa faḍlika.
segs.en: And we do not feel forsaken by anyone with Your grace.

segs.tr: Allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, so send blessings on Muḥammad and his family,

segs.tr: Wa kid lanā wa lā takid ʿalaynā,
segs.en: And plan for us and do not plot against us,

segs.tr: Wa amkur lanā wa lā tamkur binā,
segs.en: And schemingly help us and do not scheme against us,

segs.tr: Wa adil lanā wa lā tudill minnā.
segs.en: And guide us and do not mislead us.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إِلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: Wa qinā minka, waḥfaẓnā bika, wa ahdinā ilayka,
segs.en: Protect us from You, guard us through You, and guide us to You,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إِنَّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمُ،
segs.tr: Wa lā tubāʿidnā ʿanka inna man taqīhi yaslamu,
segs.en: And do not distance us from You; indeed, whoever fears You is safe,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمُ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إِلَيْكَ يَغْنَمُ.
segs.tr: Wa man tahdihi yaʿlamu, wa man tuqarribuhu ilayka yaghnamu.
segs.en: And whoever You guide knows, and whoever You bring near to You profits.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muḥammad and his family,
And protect us from the calamities of time,

segs.ar: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
segs.tr: Wa sharra maṣāʾidi ash-shayṭān wa marārata ṣawlatis-sulṭān.
segs.en: And the evil traps of Satan and the bitterness of the ruler’s oppression.

segs.tr: Allāhumma innamā yaktafī al-muktafūna bi faḍli,
segs.en: O Allah, indeed, those who suffice suffice only by the grace

segs.ar: قُوَّتِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاكْفِنَا
segs.tr: Quwwatika faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi, wa akfinā,
segs.en: Of Your strength. So bless Muḥammad and his family, and suffice us,

segs.ar: وَإِنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَّتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa innamā yuʿṭī al-muʿṭūna min faḍli jiddatika,
segs.en: And indeed, those who give do so from the abundance of Your generosity,

segs.tr: Faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi wa aʿṭinā,
segs.en: So send blessings on Muḥammad and his family and grant us,

segs.tr: Wa innamā yahtadī al-muhtadūna bi nūri wajhika,
segs.en: And indeed, those who are guided are guided by the light of Your Face,

segs.tr: Faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi wa ahdinā.
segs.en: So send blessings on Muḥammad and his family and guide us.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنْ وَلَّيْتَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ خِذْلَانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka man wallayta lam yaḍurrhu khiḏlānu al-khāḏilīn,
segs.en: O Allah, surely whoever You befriend, the abandoning of the traitors harms him not,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
segs.tr: Wa man aʿṭayta lam yanquṣhu manʿu al-māniʿīn,
segs.en: And whoever You grant, the denial of the deniers decreases him not,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إِضْلَالُ الْمُضِلِّينَ.
segs.tr: Wa man hadayta lam yughwihi iḍlālu al-muḍillīn,
segs.en: And whoever You guide, the misguidance of the misleaders misleads him not.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segs.tr: Faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi, wa amnaʿnā bi ʿizzika min ʿibādika,
segs.en: So send blessings on Muḥammad and his family, and protect us by Your glory from Your servants,

segs.tr: Wa aghninā ʿan ghayrika bi irfādika,
segs.en: And enrich us besides anyone else by Your aid,

segs.tr: Wa asluk binā sabīla al-ḥaqqi bi irshādika.
segs.en: And guide us on the path of truth by Your guidance.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi wa-jʿal salāmata qulūbinā,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muḥammad and his family and make the safety of our hearts

segs.ar: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أَبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: Fī dhikri ʿaẓamatika wa farāgha abdaninā fī shukri niʿmatika,
segs.en: In the remembrance of Your greatness and the emptiness of our bodies in gratitude for Your blessings,

segs.tr: Wa inṭilāqa alsinatinā fī waṣfi minnatikā.
segs.en: And the release of our tongues in praising Your favor.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muḥammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa jʿalnā min duʿātika ad-dāʿīn ilayka,
segs.en: And make us among those who call to You,
And Your guides who lead to You,
And from Your chosen, the special ones near You,
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!
2.Bless Muhammad and his Household
3.and prevent us from deviation concerning Your mightiness!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa tantahee mud-datu mul-kih
segs.en: 4.O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!
5.Bless Muhammad and his Household
6.and release our necks from Your vengeance!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa taf-naa khazaaa-inu rah'-matih
segs.en: 7.O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!
8.Bless Muhammad and his Household
9.and appoint for us a portion of Your mercy!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man tanqat'iu' doona roo-yatihil-ab-s'aar
segs.en: 10.O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!
11.Bless Muhammad and his Household
12.and bring us close to Your nearness!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man tas'-ghuru i'nda khat'arihil-akh-t'aar
segs.en: 13.O He before whose greatness all great things are small!
14.Bless Muhammad and his Household
15.and give us honour with You!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man taz'-haru i'ndahoo bawaat'inul-akh-baar
segs.en: 16.O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!
17.Bless Muhammad and his Household
18.and expose us not before You!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
segs.en: 19.O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Your gift,
20.spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Your joining,

segs.ar: حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa nar-ghaba ilaaa ah'adim-maa' bad'-lik
segs.en: 21.that we may beseech no one along with Your free giving,

segs.ar: وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: wa laa nas-taw-h'isha min ah'adim-ma'aa faz'-lik
segs.en: 22.that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Your bounty!
23.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa kid lanaa wa laa takid a'lay-naa
segs.en: 24.scheme for us, not against us,

segs.tr: wa am-kur lanaa wa laa tam-kur binaa
segs.en: 25.devise to our benefit, not to our loss,

segs.tr: wa adil-lanaa wa laa tudil min-naa
segs.en: 26.give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!
27.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa qinaa mink wa ah'-faz'-naa bik wa ah-dinaaa ilay-k
segs.en: 28.protect us from Yourself, safeguard us through Yourself, guide us to Yourself,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ،
segs.tr: wa laa tubaai'd-naa a'nk in-na man taqihee yas-lam-
segs.en: 29.and take us not far from Yourself! he whom You protectest stays safe,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
segs.tr: wa man tah-dihee yaa'-lam- wa man tuqar-rib-hooo ilay-ka yagh-nam-
segs.en: 30.he whom You guidest knows, and he whom You bringest near Yourself takes the spoils.
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

segs.ar: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
segs.tr: wa shar-ra mas'aaa-idish-shay-t'aan wa maraarata s'aw-latis-sul-t'aan
segs.en: 33.the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!
34.O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty

segs.tr: qoo-watik fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wak-finaa
segs.en: 35.of Your strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

segs.ar: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa in-namaa yua'-t'eel-mua'-t'oona min faz''-li jidatik
segs.en: 36.The givers give only through the bounty of Your wealth,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-t'inaa
segs.en: 37.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!
38.The guided are guided only by the light of Your face,
39.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

segs.ar: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nak maw-waalay-ta lam yaz''-rur-hoo khid'-laanul-khaad'ileen
segs.en: 40.O God, he whom You befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
segs.tr: wa man aa'-t'ay-ta lam yanqus'-hoo man-u'l-maanie'en
segs.en: 41.he to whom You givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
segs.tr: wa man haday-ta lam yugh-wiheee iz''-laalul-muz''il-leen
segs.en: 42.he whom You guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa am-naa'-naa bii'z-zika min i'baadik
segs.en: 43.So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Your servants
44.through Your might, free us from need for other than You through Your support,
45.and make us travel the path of the Truth through Your right guidance!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waj-a'l- salaamata quloobinaa
segs.en: 46.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts

segs.ar: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: fee d'ik-ri a'z'amatik wa faraagha ab-daaninaa fee shuk-ri nia'-matik
segs.en: 47.into the remembrance of Your mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Your favour,
48.and the flow of our tongues into the description of Your kindness!
49.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
50.and make us one of Your summoners who summon to You,
51.Your guiders who direct to You,
52.and Your special friends whom You hast singled out!
53.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāhi alladhī khalaqa al-layla wa-n-nahāra bi-quwwatihi,
segs.en: All praise belongs to Allah, who created the night and the day by His power,
and distinguished between them by His might,

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً،
segs.tr: wa-jaʿala li-kulli wāḥidin minhumā ḥaddan maḥdūdan, wa-amadan mamdūdan,
segs.en: and made for each of them a fixed limit and an extended span,

segs.ar: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
segs.tr: yūliju kulla wāḥidin minhumā fī ṣāḥibihi,
segs.en: He makes one of them enter into the other,

segs.ar: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِيرٍ مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ،
segs.tr: wa-yūliju ṣāḥibahu fīhi bi-taqdīrin minhu li-l-ʿibād,
segs.en: and makes the other enter into it, by His decree for the servants,
in what He nourishes them with and raises them upon.

segs.ar: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segs.tr: fa-khalaqa lahumu al-layla li-yaskunū fīhi min ḥarakāti l-taʿab,
segs.en: So He created the night for them to rest in, from the movements of weariness,

segs.ar: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-nahaḍāti l-naṣab, wa-jaʿalahu libāsan li-yalbasū min rāḥatihi wa-manāmihi,
segs.en: and from the risings of exhaustion; and He made it a covering, so they may wear its comfort and its sleep,

segs.ar: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ لَھُم جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segs.tr: fa-yakūna dhālika lahum jamāman wa-quwwatan, wa-li-yanālū bihi ladhdhatan wa-shahwatan.
segs.en: so that it becomes for them rest and strength, and so they may gain through it pleasure and desire.

segs.ar: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-khalaqa lahumu l-nahāra mubṣiran li-yabtaghū fīhi min faḍlihi,
segs.en: And He created the day bright, so that they may seek in it from His bounty,

segs.ar: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-li-yatasabbabū ilā rizqihi, wa-yasraḥū fī arḍihi,
segs.en: and that they may strive for His sustenance and roam in His earth,

segs.ar: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segs.tr: ṭalaban li-mā fīhi naylu l-ʿājili min dunyāhum,
segs.en: seeking thereby what can be attained quickly from their worldly life,

segs.ar: وَدَرَكُ الْآجِلِ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذَلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأْنَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa-daraku l-ājili fī ukhrāhum. bi-kulli dhālika yuṣliḥu shaʾnahum,
segs.en: and the attainment of the Hereafter in their next life. Through all this, He sets their affairs aright,

segs.ar: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-yablū akhbārahum wa-yanẓuru kayfa hum fī awqāti ṭāʿatihi,
segs.en: and tests their deeds, and observes how they are in the times of His obedience,
and the stations of His obligations, and the places of His rulings,

segs.ar: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segs.tr: li-yajziya alladhīna asāʾū bi-mā ʿamilū wa-yajziya alladhīna aḥsanū bi-l-ḥusnā,
segs.en: so that He may recompense those who did evil with what they did, and reward those who did good with the best reward.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا فَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الْإِصْبَاحِ،
segs.tr: allāhumma fa-laka l-ḥamdu ʿalā mā falaqta lanā mina l-iṣbāḥ,
segs.en: O Allah! To You belongs all praise for what You split for us of the morning light,
and for giving us enjoyment in it of the brightness of the day,
and for showing us the paths of seeking our sustenance,
and for protecting us in it from sudden calamities.

segs.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segs.tr: aṣbaḥnā wa-aṣbaḥati l-ashyāʾu kulluhā bi-jumlatihā laka,
segs.en: We have entered the morning, and all things altogether belong to You:

segs.ar: سَمَاؤُهَا وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا،
segs.tr: samāʾuhā wa-arḍuhā wa-mā baththta fī kulli wāḥidin minhumā,
segs.en: its heavens and its earth, and whatever You have spread in each of them,
its still and its moving, its settled and its departing,

segs.ar: وَمَا عَلَا فِي الْهَوَاءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى،
segs.tr: wa-mā ʿalā fī l-hawāʾ wa-mā kanna taḥta l-tharā,
segs.en: whatever rises in the air, and whatever lies hidden beneath the soil.

segs.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ، يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ،
segs.tr: aṣbaḥnā fī qabḍatika, yaḥwīnā mulkuka wa-sulṭānuka,
segs.en: We have entered the morning within Your grasp, encompassed by Your dominion and authority,

segs.ar: وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ، وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-taḍummunā mashīyyatuka, wa-nataṣarrfu ʿan amrika, wa-nataqallabu fī tadbīrika,
segs.en: and encompassed by Your will; we move only by Your command, and we change only by Your management,

segs.ar: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ، وَلَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segs.tr: laysa lanā mina l-amri illā mā qaḍayta, wa-lā mina l-khayri illā mā aʿṭayta,
segs.en: we have no affair except what You have decreed, and no good except what You have granted.

segs.ar: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ،
segs.tr: wa-hādhā yawmun ḥādithun jadīdun, wa-huwa ʿalaynā shāhidun ʿatīdun,
segs.en: And this is a new day, and it is a present witness over us,

segs.ar: إِنْ أَحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْدٍ، وَإِنْ أَسَأْنَا فَارَقَنَا بِذَمٍّ.
segs.tr: in aḥsannā wadaʿanā bi-ḥamdin, wa-in asāʾnā fāraqanā bi-dhamm,
segs.en: if we do good, it leaves us with praise; and if we do evil, it leaves us with blame.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
Grant us good companionship with him and protect us,

segs.tr: Min sū’i mufāraqatihī bi irtikābi jarīrah,
segs.en: From the harm of parting from him by committing a sin,
Whether committing a small or large sin.

segs.ar: وَأَجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ.
segs.tr: Wa ajzil lanā fīhi mina al-ḥasanāti wa akhlinā fīhi mina as-sayyi’āt,
segs.en: And generously grant us in it good deeds and spare us from evils.

segs.ar: وَامْلَأْ لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْدًا وَشُكْرًا وَأَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَفَضْلًا وَإِحْسَانًا.
segs.tr: Wa amla’ lanā mā bayna ṭarafayhi ḥamdan wa shukran wa ajran wa dhukhran wa faḍlan wa iḥsānan,
segs.en: And fill for us between its two edges with praise, thanks, reward, treasure, bounty, and goodness.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segs.tr: Allāhumma yassir ʿalā al-kirāmi al-kātibīn ma’ūnatana,
segs.en: O Allah, ease for the noble scribes our provision,

segs.tr: Wa amla’ lanā min ḥasanātinā ṣaḥā’ifana,
segs.en: And fill our pages with our good deeds.

segs.tr: Wa lā tukhzinā ʿindahum bisū’i aʿmālinā,
segs.en: And do not disgrace us before them by our bad deeds.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظًّا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal lanā fī kulli sāʿatin min sāʿātihi ḥaẓẓan min ʿibādika,
segs.en: O Allah, make for us in every hour of its hours a share among Your servants,

segs.ar: وَنَصِيبًا مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ.
segs.tr: Wa naṣīban min shukrika wa shāhida ṣidqin min malāʾikatika,
segs.en: And a portion of Your thanks and a truthful witness from Your angels.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segs.tr: Wa iḥfaẓnā min bayni aydīnā wa min khalfina wa ʿan aymānina wa ʿan shamā’ilina,
segs.en: And protect us from before us, behind us, from our right and our left,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ نَوَاحِينَا حِفْظًا عَاصِمًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa min jamīʿi nawāḥinā ḥifẓan ʿāṣiman min maʿṣiyatika,
segs.en: And from all our directions, a protective guard from Your disobedience,

segs.tr: Hādiyān ilā ṭāʿatika mustaʿmilan li maḥabbatika,
segs.en: Guiding us to obey You and using us for Your love.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا وَلَيْلَتِنَا هَذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أَيَّامِنَا
segs.tr: Wa waffiqnā fī yawmnā hādhā wa laylatinā hādhihi wa fī jamīʿi ayyāminā,
segs.en: And grant us success on this day of ours, this night, and all our days,

segs.ar: لاِسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْرَانِ الشَّرِّ وَشُكْرِ النِّعَمِ،
segs.tr: Li istiʿmāli al-khayr wa hijrāni ash-sharr wa shukri an-niʿam,
segs.en: For practicing good, abandoning evil, and being grateful for blessings,

segs.tr: Wa itti'bāʿi as-sunan wa mujānabati al-bidaʿ,
segs.en: Following the traditions and avoiding innovations,

segs.tr: Wa al-amri bil-maʿrūf wa an-nahy ʿan al-munkar,
segs.en: Enjoining good and forbidding evil,

segs.tr: Wa ḥiyāṭati al-islām wa intiqāṣi al-bāṭil wa idhlālih,
segs.en: Protecting Islam and reducing falsehood and humiliating it,

segs.tr: Wa nuṣrati al-ḥaqq wa iʿzāzihi, wa irshādi aḍ-ḍāll,
segs.en: Supporting the truth and elevating it, and guiding the lost,

segs.tr: Wa muʿāwanati aḍ-ḍaʿīf wa idrāki l-lahīf,
segs.en: And helping the weak and reaching out to the troubled/distressed.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family,
And make it the most auspicious day we have ever pledged,
And the best companion we have accompanied,
And the best time we have lived in.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa jʿalnā min ardā man marra ʿalayhi al-laylu wa an-nahāru min jumlat khalqik,
segs.en: And make us among those most pleasing to whom the night and day pass of Your creation,

segs.tr: Wa ashkarahum limā awlayta min niʿamik,
segs.en: And the most grateful for what You have given in blessings,

segs.tr: Wa aqwamahum bimā sharaʿta min sharāʾiʿik,
segs.en: And the most upright in following Your laws,

segs.tr: Wa awqafahum ʿammā ḥadhharta min nahyik,
segs.en: And the one who restrains himself from what You have warned against forbidding.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَشْهَدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيدًا وَأُشْهِدُ سَمَاءَكَ وَأَرْضَكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī ashhaduka wa kafā bika shahīdan wa ush-hidu samāʾaka wa arḍaka,
segs.en: O Allah, I bear witness to You and enough is You as a witness, and I call upon Your sky and Your earth,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُمَا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا،
segs.tr: Wa man askantahumā min malāʾikatika wa sāʾiri khalqika fī yawmi hādhā,
segs.en: And those You have made inhabit them of Your angels and all Your creation on this day of mine,

segs.ar: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا،
segs.tr: Wa sāʿatī hādhihi, wa laylatī hādhihi, wa mustaqarrī hādhā,
segs.en: And this hour of mine, this night of mine, and this resting place of mine,

segs.ar: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي
segs.tr: Annī ash-hadu annaka anta allāhu alladhī
segs.en: That I bear witness that You are Allah who

segs.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِالْقِسْطِ،
segs.tr: Lā ilāha illā anta qā’imun bil-qisṭ,
segs.en: There is no deity but You, established in justice,
Just in judgment, compassionate to the servants,
Master of the kingdom, merciful to creation,

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيَّرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluka wa khīyaratuka min khalqik,
segs.en: And that Muḥammad is Your servant and messenger and Your chosen among Your creation,

segs.ar: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأَدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بِالنُّصْحِ لِأُمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segs.tr: Hammaltahu risālataka fa addāhā wa amartahu bin-nuṣḥ li ummatihi fa naṣaḥa lahā,
segs.en: You entrusted him with Your message, and he delivered it and commanded earnest advice for his nation, so he advised them well.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi akthara mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥadin min khalqik,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family more than You have sent blessings on anyone of Your creation,

segs.ar: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa ātih ʿannā afḍala mā ātayta aḥadan min ʿibādik,
segs.en: And grant him on our behalf the best of what You have given any of Your servants,

segs.ar: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأَكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ.
segs.tr: Wa ajzih ʿannā afḍala wa akrama mā jazayta aḥadan min anbiyā’ika ʿan ummatih,
segs.en: And reward him on our behalf the best and most generous of what You rewarded any of Your prophets for his nation.

segs.ar: إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَافِرِ لِلْعَظِيمِ،
segs.tr: Inna ka anta al-mannān bi al-jasīm al-ghāfir lil-ʿaẓīm,
segs.en: Indeed, You are the Benefactor, the Great, the Forgiver of the Great sins,

segs.tr: Wa anta arḥamu min kulli raḥīm,
segs.en: And You are more Merciful than all who show mercy,

segs.tr: Fa ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: So send blessings on Muḥammad and his family,
The pure, the clean, the good, the most noble.

segs.ar: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segs.en: 1.Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength,
2.set them apart through His power,

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
segs.tr: wa jaa'la likul-li waah'idim-minhumaa h'ad-dam-mah'-doodaw-wa amadam-mam-doodaa
segs.en: 3.and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

segs.ar: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
segs.en: 4.He makes each of the two enter into its companion,

segs.ar: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
segs.tr: wa yooliju s'aah'ibahoo feeh bitaq-deerim-min-hoo lil-i'baadi
segs.en: 5.and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants

segs.tr: feemaa yagh-d'oohum bihee wa yunshi-uhum a'lay-h
segs.en: 6.in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

segs.ar: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segs.tr: fakhalaqa lahumul-lay-l leeas-kunoo feehee min h'arakaatit-taa'bi
segs.en: 7.He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements

segs.ar: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segs.tr: wa nahaz''aatin-nas'ab wa jaa'lahoo libaasal-leeal-basoo mir-raah'atihee wamanaamihee
segs.en: 8.and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep,

segs.ar: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segs.tr: fayakoona d'alika lahum jamaamaw-waqoo-wah wa leeanaaloo bihee lad'-d'ataw-washah-wah
segs.en: 9.that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

segs.ar: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segs.tr: wa khalaqa lahumun-nahaara mub-s'ira leeab-taghoo feehee min faz''-lih
