segs.en: 10.He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12)

segs.ar: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segs.tr: wa leeatasab-baboo ilaa riz-qih wa yas-rah'oo feee ar-z''ih
segs.en: 11.find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth,

segs.ar: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segs.en: 12.searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world

segs.ar: وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa darakul-aaajili feee ukh-raahum- bikul-li d'alika yus'-lihoo shaa-nahum-
segs.en: 13.and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

segs.ar: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ،
segs.tr: wa yab-looo akh-baarahum- wa yanz'uru kay-fa hum feee aw-qaati t'aaa'tih
segs.en: 14.tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him,

segs.tr: wa manaazili furooz''ih wa mawaaqii' ah'-kaamih
segs.en: 15.the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances,

segs.ar: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segs.tr: (leeaj-zeeal-lad'eena asaaa-oo bimaa a'miloo wa yaj-zeeal-lad'eena ah'-sanoo bil-h'us-naa)
segs.en: 16.that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma falakal-h'am-du a'laa maa falaq-ta lanaa minal-is'-baah'
segs.en: 17.O God, to You belongs praise for the sky You hast split into dawn for us,
18.giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime,
19.showing us sought-after nourishments,
20.and protecting us from the striking of blights.

segs.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segs.tr: as'-bah'-naa wa as'-bah'atil-ash-yaaa-u kul-luhaa bijum-latihaa lak
segs.en: 21.In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for You,

segs.tr: samaaaw-uhaa wa ar-z''uhaa wa maa bathath-ta
segs.en: 22.the heaven and the earth and what You hast scattered

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ
segs.tr: fee kul-li waah'idim-min-humaa saakinuhoo wa mutah'ar-rikuh wa muqeemuhoo
segs.en: 23.in each, the still and the moving, the resident

segs.ar: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
segs.tr: wa shaakhis'uh wa maa a'laa fil-hawaaa-i wa maa kan-na tah'-tath-tharaa
segs.en: 24.and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.
25.We rise in the morning in Your grasp:

segs.tr: yah'-weenaa mul-kuka wa sul-t'aanuk wa taz''um-munaa mashee-yatuk
segs.en: 26.Your kingdom and authority contain us and Your will embraces us.

segs.ar: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segs.tr: wa natas'ar-rafu a'n am-rik wa nataqal-labu fee tad-beerik
segs.en: 27.We move about by Your command and turn this way and that through Your governing.

segs.ar: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
segs.tr: lay-sa lanaa minal-am-ri il-laa maa qaz''ay-t
segs.en: 28.We own nothing of the affair except what You hast decreed

segs.ar: وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segs.tr: wa laa minal-khay-ri il-laa maaa aa'-t'ay-t
segs.en: 29.and nothing of the good except what You hast given.

segs.ar: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
segs.tr: wa had'aa yaw-mun h'aadithun jadeed wa huwa a'lay-naa shaahidun a'teed
segs.en: 30.This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

segs.ar: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
segs.tr: in ah'-san-naa wad-daa'naa bih'am-d wa in asaa-naa faaraqanaa bid'am
segs.en: 31.If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.
32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
33.provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us
34.against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed
35.or committing a sin, whether small or great!

segs.ar: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
segs.tr: wa aj-zil-lanaa feehee minal-h'asanaat wa akh-linaa feehee minas-say-yi-aat
segs.en: 36.Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

segs.ar: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
segs.tr: wa am-laa lanaa maa beena t'arafay-hee h'am-daw-washuk-raa wa aj-raw-wa d'ukh-raa wa faz''-law-wa ih'-saanaa
segs.en: 37.and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segs.en: 38.O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers,

segs.tr: wa am-laa lanaa min h'asanaatinaa s'ah'aaa-ifanaa
segs.en: 39.fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

segs.tr: wa laa tukh-zinaa i'ndahum bisooo-i aa'-maalinaa
segs.en: 40.and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma aj-a'l-lanaa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'atih h'az'-z'am-min i'baadik
segs.en: 41.O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Your servants,

segs.ar: وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa nas'eebam-min shuk-rik wa shaahida s'id-qim-mim-malaaa-ikatik
segs.en: 42.a portion of giving thanks to You, and a truthful witness among Your angels!
43.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segs.tr: wa ah'-faz'-naa mim-bay-ni ay-deenaa? wa min khal-finaa wa a'n ay-maaninaa? wa a'n shamaaa-ilinaa
segs.en: 44.and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands

segs.ar: وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa min jameei' nawaah'eenaa h'if-z'aa a'as'imam-mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segs.en: 45.and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying You,
46.guide to obeying You, and be employed for Your love!
47.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا
segs.tr: wa waf-fiq-naa fee yaw-minaa had'aa wa lay-latinaa had'ihi? wa fee jameei' ay-yaaminaa
segs.en: 48.and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days,

segs.ar: لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ
segs.en: 49.to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours,
50.follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,
51.enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved,

segs.tr: wa h'eeaat'atil-is-laam wa antiqaas'il-baat'ili wa id'-laalih
segs.en: 52.defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it,

segs.tr: wa nus'-ratil-h'aq-qi wa ia'-zaazih wa ir-shaadiz''-z''aaal
segs.en: 53.help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided,
54.assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!
55.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
56.and make this the most fortunate day we have known,
57.the most excellent companion we have accompanied,
58.and the best time in which we have lingered!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: waj-a'l-naa min ar-z''aa mam-mar-ra a'lay-hil-lay-lu wan-nahaaru min jum-lati khal-qik
segs.en: 59.Place us among the most satisfied of all Your creatures whom night and day have passed by,
60.the most thankful of them for the favours You hast done,

segs.tr: wa aq-wamahum bimaa sharaa'-ta min sharaaa-ii'k
segs.en: 61.the firmest of them in the laws You hast set down in the Shari'a,
62.and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which You hast cautioned!

segs.ar: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee ush-hiduka wa kafaa bika shaheedaa wa ush-hidu samaaa-aka wa ar-z''aka
segs.en: 63.O God, I call You to witness - and You art sufficient witness - and I call Your heaven and Your earth to witness

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ،
segs.tr: wa man as-kantahumaa mim-malaaa-ikatika wa saaa-iri khal-qik fee yaw-mee had'aa
segs.en: 64.and Your angels and Your other creatures who inhabit them in this my day,

segs.ar: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ،
segs.tr: wa saaa'tee had'ih? wa lay-latee had'ih wa mus-taqar-ree had'aa
segs.en: 65.this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place,

segs.ar: أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
segs.en: 66.that I bear witness that You art God,

segs.ar: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ،
segs.en: 67.other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice,
68.Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207),
69."Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures,

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
segs.tr: wa an-na muh'am-madan a'b-duka warasooluk wa kheearatuka min khal-qik
segs.en: 70.and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger, Your chosen from among Your creatures.

segs.ar: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segs.tr: h'am-mal-tahoo risaalataka faad-daahaa wa amar-tahoo bin-nus'-hee lium-matihee fanas'ah'a lahaa
segs.en: 71.You didst charge him with Your message and he delivered it; You didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih ak-thara maa s'al-lay-ta a'laaa ah'adim-min khal-qik
segs.en: 72.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than You hast blessed any of Your creatures!

segs.ar: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segs.tr: wa aaatihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala maaa aaatay-ta ah'adam-min i'baadik
segs.en: 73.Give him for our sake the best You hast given any of Your servants,

segs.ar: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
segs.tr: wa aj-zihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala wa ak-rama maa jazay-ta ah'adam-min ambeeaaa-ika a'n um-matih
segs.en: 74.and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than You hast repaid any of Your prophets on behalf of his community!

segs.ar: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ،
segs.tr: in-nak antal-man-naanu bil-jaseem wa al-ghaafiru lil-a'z'eem
segs.en: 75.You art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great,

segs.tr: wa anta ar-h'amu min kul-li rah'eem
segs.en: 76.and You art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!
77.So bless Muhammad and his Household,
78.the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ،
segs.tr: ya man tuḥallu bihi ʿuqadu l-makārih,
segs.en: O You by Whom the knots of difficulties are undone,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segs.tr: wa ya man yufthaʾu bihi ḥaddu l-shadāʾid,
segs.en: And O You by Whom the extremes of hardships are removed,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إِلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ،
segs.tr: wa ya man yultamasu minhu al-makhraju ilā rawḥi l-faraj,
segs.en: And O You from Whom a way to relief is sought,
The difficulties have yielded to Your power,
And the means have been facilitated by Your kindness,
And by Your power, the decree proceeds,
And all things move according to Your will,
So by Your command, they act without speaking,
And by Your will, they are restrained without Your prohibition,
You are the one called upon for important matters,
And You are the refuge in calamities,

segs.ar: لَا يَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا دَفَعْتَ،
segs.tr: lā yandafiʿu minhā illā mā dafaʿta,
segs.en: Nothing is removed from them except by Your removal,

segs.ar: وَلَا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا كَشَفْتَ،
segs.tr: wa lā yankashifu minhā illā mā kashfta,
segs.en: Nothing is revealed from them except what You unveil,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ،
segs.tr: wa qad nazala bī yā rabbi mā qad takaʾadaniyya thiqluhu,
segs.en: Indeed, O Lord, what has befallen me is almost unbearable,

segs.ar: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ،
segs.tr: wa allamma bī mā qad bahazani ḥamluhu,
segs.en: And the burden of it has caused me pain,
So bless Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-iftaḥ lī yā rabbi bāba al-faraj bi-ṭawlik,
segs.en: And open for me, O Lord, the door of relief by Your power,
And break from me the power of distress by Your strength,
And grant me good perception in what I complain of,
And let me taste the sweetness of good deeds in what I ask,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً،
segs.tr: wa-hab lī min ladunka raḥmatan wa-farajan hanīʾan,
segs.en: And grant me from You mercy and a joyful relief,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً،
segs.tr: wa-jʿal lī min ʿindik makhrajan wa-ḥiyyan,
segs.en: And make for me from You a way out and guidance,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِي بِالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-lā tashghalnī bil-ihtimām ʿan taʿāhudi furūḍika wa-istiʿmāli sunnatika,
segs.en: And do not occupy me with concern away from fulfilling Your obligations and following Your Sunnah,

segs.ar: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً،
segs.tr: fa-qad ḍiqqtu limā nazala bī yā rabbi dharʿan,
segs.en: Indeed, I am constrained by what has befallen me, O Lord,

segs.ar: وَامْتَلَأْتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً،
segs.tr: wa-imtalātu bi-ḥamli mā ḥadatha ʿalayya hamman,
segs.en: And I am filled with the burden of what has occurred to me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-anta al-qādiru ʿalā kashfi mā munītu bihi,
segs.en: And You are capable of removing what I am afflicted with,
And of averting what has befallen me,

segs.ar: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذَلِكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: fa-ifʿal bī dhālika wa-in lam astawjibhu minka,
segs.en: So do this for me even if I have not deserved it from You,
O Possessor of the Great Throne."

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
segs.en: 1.O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segs.en: 2.O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yul-tamasu min-hul-makh-raju ilaa raw-h'il-faraj
segs.en: 3.O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!
4.Intractable affairs yield to Your power,
5.means are made ready by Your gentleness,
6.the decree goes into effect through Your power,
7.and all things proceed according to Your desire.
8.By Your desire they follow Your command without Your word
9.and by Your will they obey Your bans without Your prohibition.
10.You art the supplicated in worries
11.and the place of flight in misfortunes;

segs.tr: laa yandafiu' min-haaa il-laa maa dafaa'-t
segs.en: 12.none of them is repelled unless You repellest,

segs.ar: وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
segs.tr: wa laa yankashifu min-haaa il-laa maa kashaf-ta
segs.en: 13.and none is removed unless You removest.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ،
segs.tr: wa qad nazala bee yaa rab-bi maa qad t-takaa-adanee thiq-luh
segs.en: 14.Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me

segs.ar: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
segs.tr: wa alam-ma bee maa qad bahaz'anee h'am-luh
segs.en: 15.and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.
16.Through Your power You hast brought it down upon me
17.and through Your authority You hast turned it toward me.
18.None can send away what You hast brought,
19.none can deflect what You hast turned,
20.none can open what You hast closed,
21.none can close what You hast opened,
22.none can make easy what You hast made difficult,
23.none can help him whom You hast abandoned.
24.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ،
segs.tr: wa af-tah' lee yaa rab-bi baabal-faraji bit'aw-lik
segs.en: 25.open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Your graciousness,
26.break from me the authority of worry by Your strength,
27.confer the beauty of Your gaze upon my complaint,
28.let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً
segs.tr: wa hab lee mil-ladunka rah'-mataw-wa farajan hanee-aa
segs.en: 29.give me from Yourself mercy and wholesome relief,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
segs.en: 30.and appoint for me from Yourself a quick way out!

segs.ar: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa tash-ghal-nee biiah-timaami a'n taa'ahudi furooz''ik was-tia'-maali sun-natik
segs.en: 31.Distract me not through worry from observing Your obligations and acting in accordance with Your prescriptions.

segs.ar: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ،
segs.tr: faqad z''iq-tu limaa nazala bee yaa rab-bi d'ar-a'a
segs.en: 32.My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me,

segs.ar: وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ،
segs.tr: wa am-talaa-tu bih'am-li maa h'adatha a'lay-ya ham-maa
segs.en: 33.and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me,

segs.ar: وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ ،
segs.tr: wa antal-qaadiru a'laa kash-fi maa muneetu bih
segs.en: 34.while You hast power to remove what has afflicted me
35.and to repel that into which I have fallen.

segs.ar: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ،
segs.tr: faf-a'l bee d'alika wa il-lam as-taw-jib-hoo mink
segs.en: 36.So do that for me though I merit it not from You,
37.O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَانِ الْحِرْصِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhū bika min hayajāni al-ḥirṣi
segs.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the fervor of greed

segs.ar: وَسَوْرَةِ الْغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وَضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ
segs.tr: Wa sawrati al-ghaḍabi wa ghalabati al-ḥasadi wa ḍa‘fi aṣ-ṣabri
segs.en: And the surge of anger, the dominance of envy, and the weakness of patience

segs.tr: Wa qillati al-qanā‘ati wa shakāsati al-khuluqi
segs.en: And the lack of contentment, and the harshness of character

segs.tr: Wa ilḥāḥi ash-shahwati wa malakati al-ḥamiyyati
segs.en: And the insistence of desire, and the habit of zeal

segs.tr: Wa mutāba‘ati al-hawā wa mukhālafati al-hudā
segs.en: And following whims, and opposing guidance

segs.tr: Wa sinati al-ghaflati wa ta‘āṭi al-kulfati
segs.en: And the slumber of heedlessness, and undertaking burdens

segs.ar: وَإِيثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالْإِصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأْثَمِ
segs.tr: Wa īthāri al-bāṭili ‘alā al-ḥaqqi wa al-iṣrāri ‘alā al-ma’thami
segs.en: And preferring falsehood over truth, and persisting in sin

segs.tr: Wa istiṣghāri al-ma‘ṣiyati wa istikthāri aṭ-ṭā‘ati
segs.en: And belittling disobedience, and exaggerating obedience

segs.tr: Wa mubāhāti al-mukthirīna wa al-izrā’i bil-muqillīna
segs.en: And vying with the wealthy, and showing contempt to the poor

segs.tr: Wa sū’i al-wilāyati liman taḥta aydīnā
segs.en: And poor guardianship over those under our care

segs.ar: وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا
segs.tr: Wa tarki ash-shukri limani aṣṭana‘a al-‘ārifata ‘indanā
segs.en: And neglecting gratitude to those who showed kindness to us

segs.ar: أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِمًا أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفًا
segs.tr: Aw an na‘ḍuda ẓāliman aw nakhdhula malhūfan
segs.en: Or supporting an oppressor, or abandoning the distressed

segs.ar: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقٍّ
segs.tr: Aw narūma mā laysa lanā biḥaqqin
segs.en: Or seeking what is not rightfully ours

segs.ar: أَوْ نَقُولَ فِي الْعِلْمِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ
segs.en: Or speaking about knowledge without knowledge

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَدٍ
segs.tr: Wa na‘ūdhū bika an nantawiya ‘alā ghishshi aḥadin
segs.en: And we seek refuge in You from harboring deceit against anyone

segs.ar: وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا
segs.tr: Wa an nu‘jaba bi-a‘mālinā wa namudda fī āmālinā
segs.en: And from being pleased with our deeds, and prolonging our hopes

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ
segs.tr: Wa na‘ūdhū bika min sū’i as-sarīrati wa iḥtiqāri aṣ-ṣaghīrati
segs.en: And we seek refuge in You from evil intentions and belittling small sins
And from Satan gaining control over us

segs.ar: أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَا الزَّمَانُ أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ
segs.tr: Aw yankubanā az-zamānu aw yatahaḍḍamanā as-sulṭānu
segs.en: Or from time afflicting us, or the ruler oppressing us

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الْإِسْرَافِ وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَافِ
segs.tr: Wa na‘ūdhū bika min tanāwuli al-isrāfi wa min fiqdāni al-kafāfi
segs.en: And we seek refuge in You from indulging in excess and lacking sufficiency

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَى الْأَكْفَاءِ
segs.tr: Wa na‘ūdhū bika min shamātati al-a‘dā’i wa mina al-faqri ilā al-akfā’i
segs.en: And from the gloating of enemies and poverty among peers

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مَعِيشَةٍ فِي شِدَّةٍ وَمَيْتَةٍ عَلَى غَيْرِ عُدَّةٍ
segs.tr: Wa min ma‘īshatin fī shiddatin wa maytatin ‘alā ghayri ‘uddatin
segs.en: And from a life of hardship and a death without preparation

segs.tr: Wa na‘ūdhū bika mina al-ḥasrati al-‘uẓmā
segs.en: And we seek refuge in You from the greatest regret

segs.ar: وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوءِ الْمَآبِ
segs.tr: Wa al-muṣībati al-kubrā wa ashqā ash-shaqā’i wa sū’i al-ma’ābi
segs.en: And the greatest calamity, the worst misery, and a bad end

segs.tr: Wa ḥirmāni ath-thawābi wa ḥulūli al-‘iqābi
segs.en: And deprivation of reward and the onset of punishment
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa a‘idhni min kulli dhālika biraḥmatika
segs.en: And protect me from all of this by Your mercy
And all the believing men and believing women
O Most Merciful of the merciful

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَـانِ الْحِرْصِ ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee au'wd'u bika min- hayajaanil-h'ir-s'
segs.en: 1.O God, I seek refuge in You from the agitation of craving,

segs.ar: وَسَوْرَةِ الغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ
segs.tr: wa saw-ratil-ghaz''ab wa ghalabatil-h'asad wa z''aa'-fis'-s'ab-r
segs.en: 2.the violence of wrath, the domination of envy, the frailty of patience,
3.the lack of contentment, surliness of character,
4.urgency of passion, the disposition to vehemence,
5.following caprice, opposing guidance,
6.the sleep of heedlessness, undertaking the toilsome,

segs.ar: وَإيْثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالإصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأثَمِ ،
segs.en: 7.preferring falsehood over truth, persisting in sin,
8.making little of disobedience, making much of obedience,
9.Vying with the wealthy, showing contempt tothe poor,
10.guarding badly over those in our hands,

segs.ar: وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا ،
segs.en: 11.failing to thank those who have done good to us,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِماً ، أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفاً ،
segs.tr: aw an-naa'-z''uda z'aalimaa aw nakh-d'ula mal-hoofaa
segs.en: 12.aiding a wrongdoer, abandoning someone troubled,

segs.ar: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقّ،
segs.tr: aw narooma maa lay-sa lanaa bih'aqqan
segs.en: 13.wanting what is not rightfully ours,

segs.ar: أَوْ نَقُولَ فِي الْعِلْمِْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْم
segs.en: 14.and speaking about knowledge without knowing.

segs.ar: وَنَعُـوذُ بِـكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَد ،
segs.tr: wa nau'wd'u bika an-nant'aweea a'laa ghish-shi ah'ad
segs.en: 15.We seek refuge in You from harbouring dishonesty toward anyone,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا ، وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا ،
segs.tr: wa an-nua'-jiba bia'-maalinaa wa namud-da feee aaamaalinaa
segs.en: 16.being pleased with our works, and stretching out our expectations.

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ ، وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ ،
segs.tr: wa nau'wd'u bika min sooo-is-sareerah wa ah'-tiqaaris'-s'agheerah
segs.en: 17.We seek refuge in You from ill-mindedness, looking down on the small,
18.Satan's gaining mastery over us,

segs.ar: أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَـا الزَّمَانُ ، أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ.
segs.en: 19.time's afflicting us, and the sovereign's oppressing us.

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الإسْرَافِ ، وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَـافِ
segs.tr: wa nau'wd'u bika min tanaawulil-is-raaf wa min fiq-daanil-kafaaf
segs.en: 20.We seek refuge in You from acting with prodigality and not having sufficiency.

segs.ar: وَنَعُوذُ بِـكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إلَى الاَكْفَاءِ
segs.tr: wa nau'wd'u bika min shamaatatil-aa'-daaa-i wa minal-faq-ri ilaal-ak-faaa-i
segs.en: 21.We seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, indigent need for equals,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مَعِيشَة فِي شِدَّة وَمَيْتَة عَلَى غَيْـرِ عُدَّة.
segs.tr: wa mim-mae'eshatin fee shid-dah wa meetatin a'laa ghay-ri u'd-dah
segs.en: 22.living in hardship, and dying without readiness.
23.We seek refuge in You from the most dreadful remorse,

segs.ar: وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى ، وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَآءِ وَسُوءِ المآبِ ،
segs.en: 24.the greatest affliction, the most wretched wretchedness, the evil end to the journey,
25.the deprivation of reward, and the advent of punishment.
26.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.tr: wa ai'd'-nee min kul-li d'alika birah'-matika
segs.en: 27.and through Your mercy, give to me refuge from all of that,
28.and to all the faithful, both men and women!
29.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa ṣayyirnā ilā maḥbūbika mina at-tawbati
segs.en: And lead us to Your beloved repentance
And remove us from Your disliked persistence in sin

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ وَمَتَى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ نَقْصَيْنِ فِي دِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيَا
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa matā waqafnā bayna naqṣayni fī dīnin Aw dunyā
segs.en: O Allah, whenever we stand between two shortcomings in religion Or worldly matters,
let the shortcoming fall on what perishes fastest

segs.tr: Wa aj‘ali at-tawbata fī aṭwalihimā baqā’an
segs.en: And make repentance endure in what lasts longest

segs.ar: وَإِذَا هَمَمْنَا بِهَمَّيْنِ يُرْضِيكَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنَّا
segs.tr: Wa idhā hammamnā bi-hammayni yurḍīka aḥaduhumā ‘annā
segs.en: And when we intend two matters, one pleasing You about us
And the other angering You against us

segs.ar: فَمِلْ بِنَا إِلَى مَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنَّا
segs.tr: Fa mil binā ilā mā yurḍīka ‘annā
segs.en: Incline us toward what pleases You about us
And weaken our strength in what angers You against us

segs.ar: وَلَا تُخَلِّ فِي ذَلِكَ بَيْنَ نُفُوسِنَا وَاخْتِيَارِهَا
segs.tr: Wa lā tukhallī fī dhālika bayna nufūsinā wa ikhtiyārihā
segs.en: And do not leave it to our souls and their choices

segs.ar: فَإِنَّهَا مُخْتَارَةٌ لِلْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا مَا وَفَّقْتَ
segs.tr: Fa innahā mukhtāratun lil-bāṭili illā mā waffaqta
segs.en: For they choose falsehood unless You grant success
Inclined to evil unless You show mercy

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa innaka mina aḍ-ḍa‘fi khalaqtanā
segs.en: O Allah, You created us from weakness
And built us upon frailty
And began us from a despised fluid

segs.tr: Fa lā ḥawla lanā illā bi-quwwatika
segs.en: So we have no power except through Your strength

segs.tr: Wa lā quwwata lanā illā bi-‘awnika
segs.en: And no strength except through Your help

segs.tr: Fa ayyidnā bi-tawfīqika wa saddidnā bi-tasdīdika
segs.en: So support us with Your guidance and direct us with Your direction

segs.ar: وَأَعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ
segs.tr: Wa a‘mi abṣāra qulūbinā ‘ammā khālafa maḥabbataka
segs.en: And blind the sights of our hearts to what opposes Your love

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْءٍ مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوذًا فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā taj‘al lishay’in min jawāriḥinā nufūdhan fī ma‘ṣiyatika
segs.en: And let none of our limbs find way to Your disobedience

segs.tr: Allāhumma fa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, so send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa aj‘al hamasāti qulūbinā wa ḥarakāti a‘ḍā’inā
segs.en: And make the whispers of our hearts and movements of our limbs

segs.tr: Wa lamaḥāti a‘yuninā wa lahajāti alsinatinā
segs.en: And the glances of our eyes and utterances of our tongues
Be among the causes of Your reward

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَاءَكَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā tafūtanā ḥasanatun nastaḥiqqu bihā jazā’aka
segs.en: So no good deed passes us by which earns Your reward

segs.ar: وَلَا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئَةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā tabqā lanā sayyi’atun nastaḥjibu bihā ‘iqābaka
segs.en: And no evil deed remains for us that deserves Your punishment
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.make us go to the repentance that You lovest
3.and make us leave the persistence that You hatest!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَتَى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ نَقْصَيْنِ فِي دِين
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wamataa waqaf-naa bay-na naq-s'ay-ni fee deenin
segs.en: 4.O God, when we halt before two decreases, in religion

segs.ar: أَوْ دُنْيَا فَأَوْقِعِ النَّقْصَ بِأَسْرَعِهِمَا فَنَاءً ،
segs.en: 5.or in this world, let the decrease fall upon that which passes quickly
6.and relent in that which lasts the longer!

segs.ar: وَإذَا هَمَمْنَا بِهَمَّيْنِ يُرْضِيكَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنَّا
segs.tr: wa id'aa hamam-naa biham-may-ni yur-z''eeka ah'aduhumaa annaa
segs.en: 7.When we set out after two concerns, one of which makes You pleased with us
8.and the other of which displeases You,

segs.ar: فَمِلْ بِنَا إلَى مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنَّا ،
segs.tr: famil binaaa ilaa maa yur-z''eeka a'n-naa
segs.en: 9.incline us toward that which makes You pleased

segs.tr: wa aw-hin qoo-watanaa a'm-maa yus-khit'uka a'lay-naa
segs.en: 10.and weaken our strength in that which displeases You!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُخَلِّ فِي ذلِكَ بَيْنَ نُفُوسِنَا وَاخْتِيَارِهَا
segs.tr: wa laa tukhal-li fee d'alika bay-na nufoosinaa wa akh-teeaarihaa
segs.en: 11.Leave not our souls alone to choose in that,

segs.ar: فَإنَّهَا مُخْتَارَةٌ لِلْبَاطِلِ إلاَّ مَا وَفَّقْتَ أَمَّارَةٌ بالسُّوءِ إلاّ مَا رَحِمْتَ
segs.tr: fa in-nahaa mukh-taaratul-lil-baat'ili il-laa maa waf-faq-t am-maaratum-bis-sooo il-laa maa rah'im-t
segs.en: 12.for they choose falsehood except inasmuch as You givest success, and they command to evil except inasmuch as You hast mercy!
13.O God, You created us from frailty,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى الْوَهْنِ بَنَيْتَنَا ، وَمِنْ ماُءٌُِِ مَهِين ابْتَدَأتَنَا ،
segs.en: 14.built us up from feebleness, and began us from a mean water;

segs.ar: فَلاَ حَوْلَ لَنَا إلاّ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَلا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إلاّ بِعَونِِكَ ،
segs.tr: falaa h'aw-la lanaaa il-laa biqoo-watik wa laa qoo-wata lanaaa il-laa biqoo-watika
segs.en: 15.we have no force except through Your strength and no strength except through Your help.
16.So confirm us by giving us success, point us the right way by Your pointing,

segs.ar: وَأعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ
segs.tr: wa aa'-mi ab-s'aara quloobinaa a'm-maa khaalafa mah'b-batak
segs.en: 17.blind the eyes of our hearts toward everything opposed to Your love,

segs.ar: وَلا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْء مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوذاً فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l-lishay-im-min jawaarih'inaa nufood'an fee maa'-s'eeatik
segs.en: 18.and set not in any of our limbs passage to disobeying You!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
20.and assign the whisperings of our hearts, the movements of our members,

segs.ar: وَلَمَحَاتِ أَعْيُنِنَا ، وَلَهَجَاتِ ألسِنَتِنَا فِيْ مُوجِبَاتِ ثَوَابِكَ،
segs.tr: wa lamah'aati aa'-yuninaa wa lahajaati al-sinatinaa fee moojibaati thawaabik
segs.en: 21.the glances of our eyes, and the idioms of our tongues, to that which makes incumbent Your reward,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَآءَكَ ،
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa tafootanaa h'asanatun-nas-tah'iq-qu bihaa jazaaa-ak
segs.en: 22.lest a good deed slip by us, through which we might deserve Your repayment,

segs.ar: وَلا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئـةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa tab-qaa lanaa say-yi-atun-nas-taw-jibu bihaa i'qaabak
segs.en: 23.or an evil deed remain with us, by which we might merit Your punishment!

S_10.name: 10. In Seeking Asylum with Allah
S_10.nameUr: اللہ کی پناہ مانگنے کی دعا

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ تَعْفُ عَنَّا فَبِفَضْلِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma in tashaʾ taʿfu ʿannā fabifaḍlika
segs.en: O Allah, if You will, You forgive us by Your grace,
And if You will, You punish us by Your justice,
So make easy for us Your pardon by Your bounty,
And save us from Your punishment by Your forgiveness;
For we have no strength to bear Your justice,

segs.ar: وَلَا نَجَاةَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَّا دُونَ عَفْوِكَ.
segs.tr: Wa-lā najāta li-aḥadin minnā dūna ʿafwika
segs.en: And none of us can be saved without Your pardon.

segs.ar: يَا غَنِيَّ الأَغْنِيَاءِهَا، نَحْنُ عِبَادُكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
segs.tr: Yā ghanīya alaghniyāʾ, hā naḥnu ʿibāduka bayna yadayka
segs.en: O Richest of the rich, here we are, Your servants before You,

segs.ar: وَأَنَا أَفْقَرُ الفُقَرَاءِ إِلَيْكَ، فَاجْبُرْ فَاقَتَنَا بِوُسْعِكَ،
segs.tr: Waanā afqaru alfuqarāʾ ilayka, faajbur fāqatana biwusʿika
segs.en: And I am the poorest of the poor to You, so mend our poverty with Your ability,
And do not cut off our hope by withholding,

segs.ar: فَتَكُونَ قَدْ أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ،
segs.tr: Fatakūna qad ashqayta mani istasʿada bika
segs.en: So You would have made wretched one who sought happiness through You,
And deprived one who sought the bounty from You.
Then to whom shall we turn away from You,?
And where shall we go away from Your door,

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ نَحْنُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إِجَابَتَهُمْ،
segs.tr: Subḥānaka naḥnu almuḍṭarrūna alladhīna awjabta ijābatahum
segs.en: Glory be to You, we are the distressed ones whose answer You have made obligatory,

segs.ar: وَأَهْلُ السُّوءِ الَّذِينَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
segs.tr: Waahlu assūʾ alladhīna waʿadta alkashfa ʿanhum
segs.en: And the people of evil whom You promised to relieve.
And the most resembling of things to Your will,

segs.ar: وَأَوْلَى الأُمُورِ بِكَ فِي عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ،
segs.tr: Waawlā alumūri bika fī ʿaẓamatika raḥmatu mani istarḥamaka
segs.en: And the most befitting of matters for You in Your greatness is the mercy upon one who seeks it from You,
And the aid to one who seeks help from You,
So have mercy upon our supplication to You,

segs.ar: وَأَغْنِنَا إِذْ طَرَحْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
segs.tr: Waaghninā idh ṭaraḥnā anfusanā bayna yadayka
segs.en: And enrich us as we have cast ourselves before You.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شَمِتَ بِنَا إِذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma inna ashshayṭāna qad shamita binā idh shāyaʿnāhu ʿalā maʿṣiyatika
segs.en: O Allah, Satan has rejoiced over us when we sided with him in disobeying You,
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إِيَّاهُ لَكَ،
segs.tr: Walā tushmithu binā baʿda tarkinā iyyāhu laka
segs.en: And do not let him rejoice over us after we abandoned him for Your sake,
And turned our desire away from him towards You.

segs.ar: اللّهُمَّ إن تَشَأْ تعفُ عَنّا فَبِفضْلِكَ ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in tashaa taa'-fu a'n-naa fabifaz''-lik
segs.en: 1. O God, if You willest, You wilt pardon us through Your bounty

segs.ar: وَانْ تَشَأْ تُعَذِّبْنا فَبَعدْلِكَ. فَسَهِّلْ لَنَا عَفْوَكَ بِمنِّكَ ،
segs.tr: wa in tashaa tua'd'-d'ib-naa fabia'd-lik fasah-hil-lanaa a'f-waka biman-nik
segs.en: 2. and if You willest, You wilt chastise us through Your justice. So make our ways smooth to Your pardon through Your kindness

segs.ar: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ بِتَجاوُزكَ; فَإنَّهُ لاَ طاقَةَ لَنَا بَعدلِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ajir-naa min a'd'aabika bitajaawuzik fa in-nahoo laa t'aaqata lanaa bia'd-lik
segs.en: 3. and grant us sanctuary from Your chastisement through Your forbearance, for none of us has the endurance for Your justice

segs.ar: وَلاَ نجاةَ لأحَد مِنّا دُوْنَ عَفْوِكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa najaata liah'adim-min-naa doona a'f-wik
segs.en: 4. and none of us can reach deliverance without Your pardon!

segs.ar: يا غَنِيَّ الأغْنياء هَا نَحَنُ عِبادُكَ بين يدَيكَ
segs.tr: yaa ghanee-yal-agh-neeaaa-i haa nah'-nu i'baaduka bay-na yaday-k
segs.en: 5. O Richest of the rich! Here we are, Your servants, before You.

segs.ar: وَأَنَا أَفقَرُ الفْقَراء إليْكَ فَأجْبُرْ فاقَتَنا بِوُسْعِكَ ،
segs.tr: wa ana af-qarul-fuqaraaa-i ilay-k faj-bur faaqatanaa biwus-i'k
segs.en: 6. I am the neediest of the needy toward You, so redress our neediness through Your plenty

segs.ar: ولا تَقْطَعَ رَجَاءنا بِمَنْعِكَ فَتَكُوْنَ قد أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ ،
segs.tr: wa laa taq-t'aa' rajaaa-naa biman-i'k fatakoona qad ash-qay-ta mani as-tas-a'da bikِِa
segs.en: 7. and cut us not off from our hopes through Your withholding, lest You makest wretched him who seeks felicity through You
8. and deprivest him who seeks help from Your bounty!
9. Then to whom would we return after You?
10. Where would we go from Your gate?

segs.ar: سُبْحَنَكَ نَحْنُ المضْطُّرون الذّينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إجابَتَهُمْ ،
segs.en: 11. Glory be to You! We are the distressed, the response to whom You hast made incumbent,

segs.ar: وَأهْلُ السُّوْء الذّيْنَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
segs.en: 12. the people from whom You hast promised to remove the evil.
13. That thing most resembling Your will

segs.ar: وَأَوْلَى الأمُورِ بِكَ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ،
segs.tr: wa aw-laal-umoori bika fee a'z'amatik rah'-matu mani as-tar-h'amak
segs.en: 14. and that affair most worthy for You in Your mightiness is showing mercy to him who asks You for mercy

segs.ar: وَغَوْثُ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ، فَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa ghaw-thu mani as-taghaatha bik far-h'am taz''ar-rua'naaa ilay-k
segs.en: 15. and helping him who seeks help from You. So show mercy upon our pleading with You

segs.ar: وَأَغْنِنَا إذْ طَرَحْنَـا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَـدَيْكَ.
segs.tr: wa agh-ninaaa id' t'arah'-naaa anfusanaa bay-na yaday-k
segs.en: 16. and free us from need when we throw ourselves before You!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شمِتَ بِنَا إذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nash-shay-t'aana qad shamita binaaa id' shaayaa'-naahoo a'laa maa'-s'eeatak
segs.en: 17. O God, Satan will gloat over us if we follow him in disobeying You,
18. so bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَلا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إيَّاهُ لَكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa tush-mit-hoo binaa baa'-d tar-kinaaa ee-yaahoo lak
segs.en: 19. and let him not gloat over us after we have renounced him for You
20. and beseeched You against him!
O He whose remembrance is an honor for those who remember.
And O He whose gratitude is success for the thankful.
And O He whose obedience is salvation for the obedient.
Send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family.

segs.ar: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْرٍ
segs.en: And occupy our hearts with Your remembrance from all other remembrance.
And our tongues with Your thanks from all other thanks.
And our limbs with Your obedience from all other obedience.

segs.ar: فَإِنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغًا مِنْ شُغْلٍ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلَامَةٍ
segs.tr: Fa-in qaddarta lanā farāghan min shughlin fa-j‘alhu farāgha salāmah
segs.en: And if You decree for us a time free from work, then make it a time of safety.

segs.ar: لَا تُدْرِكْنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلَا تَلْحَقْنَا فِيهِ سَآمَةٌ
segs.tr: Lā tudriknā fīhi tabi‘atun wa-lā talḥaqnā fīhi sa’āmah
segs.en: In which no burden overtakes us, and no weariness afflicts us.

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَةٍ خَالِيَةٍ مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئَاتِنَا
segs.tr: Ḥattā yanṣarifa ‘annā kuttābu al-sayyi’āti bi-ṣaḥīfatin khāliyyatin min dhikri sayyi’ātinā
segs.en: Until the recorders of evil deeds depart from us with a scroll empty of any mention of our sins.

segs.ar: وَيَتَوَلَّى كُتَّابُ الْحَسَنَاتِ عَنَّا مَسْرُورِينَ بِمَا كَتَبُوا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا
segs.tr: Wa-yatawallā kuttābu al-ḥasanāti ‘annā masrūrīna bimā katabū min ḥasanātinā
segs.en: And the recorders of good deeds depart from us rejoicing in what they have written of our good deeds.

segs.ar: وَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَا
segs.tr: Wa-idhā inqaḍat ayyāmu ḥayātinā wa-taṣarramat mudadu a‘mārinā
segs.en: And when the days of our lives have ended, and the spans of our ages have passed.

segs.ar: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لَا بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إِجَابَتِهَا
segs.tr: Wa-istaḥḍaratnā da‘watuka allatī lā budda minhā wa-min ijābatihā
segs.en: And Your summons, which cannot be avoided and must be answered, has attended us.
Then send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً
segs.tr: Wa-j‘al khitāma mā tuḥṣī ‘alaynā katabatu a‘mālinā tawbatan maqbūlah
segs.en: And make the conclusion of what the scribes of our deeds record against us a repentance accepted.

segs.ar: لَا تُوقِفْنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْبٍ اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ
segs.en: Do not expose us after it to a sin we have committed.
Nor to a disobedience we have perpetrated.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْرًا سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الْأَشْهَادِ
segs.tr: Wa-lā takshif ‘annā sitran satartahu ‘alā ru’ūsi al-ashhād
segs.en: And do not uncover from us a covering You have concealed over us before witnesses.
On the day You test the reports of Your servants.

segs.ar: إِنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجِيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ
segs.tr: Innaka raḥīmun biman da‘āk, wa-mustajībun liman nādāk
segs.en: Indeed, You are Merciful to the one who calls upon You, and Responsive to the one who invokes You.
1.O He remembering whom brings honour to those who remember!
2.O He thanking whom brings triumph to those who give thanks!
3.O He obeying whom brings deliverance to those who obey!
4.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْر،
segs.tr: wa ash-ghal quloobanaa bid'ik-rika a'n kul-li d'ik-r
segs.en: 5.and divert our hearts through remembering You from every act of remembrance,

segs.tr: wa al-sinatanaa bishuk-rika a'n kul-li shuk-r
segs.en: 6.our tongues through thanking You from every act of thanksgiving,

segs.tr: wa jawaarih'anaa bit'aaa'tika a'n kul-li t'aaa'h
segs.en: 7.our limbs through obeying You from every act of obedience!

segs.ar: فَإنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغاً مِنْ شُغُل فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلاَمَة
segs.tr: faan qad-dar-ta lanaa faraagham-min shugh-lin faj-a'l-hoo faraagha salaamah
segs.en: 8.If You hast ordained for us idleness from these occupations, make it an idleness of safety,

segs.ar: لا تُدْرِكُنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلاَ تَلْحَقُنَا فِيهِ سَاَمَةٌ
segs.tr: laa tud-rikunaa feehee tabia'h wa laa tal-h'aqunaa feehee saa-mah
segs.en: 9.within which no ill consequence visits us or weariness overtakes us!

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَة خَالِيَة مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئاتِنَا
segs.tr: h'at-taa yans'arifa a'n-naa kut-taabus-say-yi-aati bis'ah'eefatin khaaleeatim-min d'ik-ri say-yi-aatinaa
segs.en: 10.Then the writers of evil deeds may depart from us with a page empty of the mention of our evil deeds,
11.and the writers of good deeds may turn away from us

segs.tr: a'n-naa mas-rooreena bimaa kataboo min h'asanaatinaa
segs.en: 12.happy with the good deeds of ours which they have written.

segs.ar: وَإذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَـا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُـدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَـا،
segs.tr: wa id'aa anqaz''at ay-yaamu h'ayaatinaa wa tas'ar-ramat mudadu aa'-maarinaa
segs.en: 13.And when the days of our life have passed by, the terms of our lifetimes have elapsed,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إجَابَتِهَا ،
segs.tr: was-tah'-z''arat-naa daa'-watukal-latee laa bud-da min-haa wamin ijaabatihaa
segs.en: 14.and Your call, which must come and be answered, summons us forth,
15.then bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا
segs.tr: waj-a'l khitaama maa tuh'-s'ee a'lay-naa katabatu aa'-maalinaa
segs.en: 16.and make the outcome of what the writers of our works count against us

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً لا تُوقِفُنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْب اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ،
segs.tr: taw-batam-maq-boolah laa tooqifunaa baa'-dahaa a'laa d'ambin aj-tarah'-naahu
segs.en: 17.an accepted repentance, which afterwards gave us no rest in a sin that we committed
18.or an act of disobedience that we performed!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْراً سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الأشْهَادِ
segs.tr: wa laa tak-shif a'n-naa sit-ran satar-tahoo a'laa ru-oosil-ash-haadi
segs.en: 19.Remove not from us any covering with which You hast covered over the heads of the witnesses
20.on the day when the records of Your servants are tried!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ .
segs.en: 21.Verily You art compassionate to him who supplicates You, the responder to him who calls upon You!

S_12.name: 12. In Confession and Repentance
S_12.nameUr: اعترافِ گناہ اور توبہ کی دعا

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلَالٌ ثَلَاثٌ
segs.tr: Allāhumma innahu yaḥjubunī ‘an mas’alatika khilālun thalāth
segs.en: O Allah, three things hold me back from asking You.
Yet one quality drives me toward it.

segs.ar: يَحْجُبُنِي أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَنْهُ
segs.en: I am held back by a command You ordered, yet I delayed.
And a prohibition You forbade me, yet I hastened toward it.

segs.ar: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِي شُكْرِهَا
segs.tr: Wa-ni‘matun an‘amta bihā ‘alayya fa-qaṣṣartu fī shukrihā
segs.en: And a blessing You bestowed upon me, yet I fell short in thanking it.

segs.ar: وَيَحْدُونِي عَلَى مَسْأَلَتِكَ تَفَضُّلُكَ عَلَى مَنْ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: Wa-yaḥdūnī ‘alā mas’alatika tafaḍḍuluka ‘alā man aqbala bi-wajhihi ilayk
segs.en: But what drives me to ask You is Your grace upon those who turn their faces toward You.
And approach You with good expectation.

segs.ar: إِذْ جَمِيعُ إِحْسَانِكَ تَفَضُّلٌ، وَإِذْ كُلُّ نِعَمِكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ
segs.tr: Idh jamī‘u iḥsānika tafaḍḍul, wa-idh kullu ni‘amika ibtida’
segs.en: For all of Your kindness is grace, and all of Your blessings are without cause.

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إِلَهِي وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ وُقُوفَ الْمُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيلِ
segs.tr: Fahā anā dhā yā ilāhī wāqifun bi-bābi ‘izzika wuqūfa al-mustaslimi al-dhalīl
segs.en: So here I am, my God, standing at the door of Your might like a submissive, humbled one.

segs.ar: وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنِّي سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيلِ
segs.tr: Wa-sā’iluka ‘alā al-ḥayā’i minnī su’āla al-bā’isi al-mu‘īl
segs.en: And asking You in shame, like the needy, destitute beggar.

segs.ar: مُقِرٌّ لَكَ بِأَنِّي لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إِحْسَانِكَ إِلَّا بِالِاقْلَاعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ
segs.tr: Muqirrul laka bi-annī lam astaslim waqt iḥsānika illā bil-iqlā‘i ‘an ‘iṣyānika
segs.en: Confessing that I did not submit during Your kindness, except by abandoning disobedience to You.

segs.ar: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِي الْحَالَاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-lam akhlu fī al-ḥālāt kullihā min imtinānika
segs.en: And in all states, I was never without Your favor.

segs.ar: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِي يَا إِلَهِي إِقْرَارِي عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ؟
segs.tr: Fahal yanfa‘unī yā ilāhī iq’rārī ‘indaka bisū’i mā ik’tasabt
segs.en: So will my confession before You of the evil I have earned benefit me?

segs.ar: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا سُخْطَكَ؟
segs.tr: Am awjabta lī fī maqāmī hādhā sukhṭak
segs.en: Or have You decreed upon me in this state Your anger?

segs.ar: أَمْ لَزِمَنِي فِي وَقْتِ دُعَائِي مَقْتُكَ؟
segs.tr: Am lazimanī fī waqt du‘ā’ī maqtuk
segs.en: Or does Your wrath cling to me when I supplicate?

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! لَا أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: Subḥānaka! Lā ay’asu minka wa-qad fataḥta lī bāba al-tawbati ilayk
segs.en: Glory be to You! I will never despair of You, for You have opened for me the door of repentance toward You.

segs.ar: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ الْمُسْتَخِفِّ بِحُرْمَةِ رَبِّهِ
segs.tr: Bal aqūlu maqāla al-‘abdi al-dhalīli al-ẓālimi linafsihi al-mustakhiffi bi-ḥurmati rabbihi
segs.en: Rather, I say the words of a lowly servant who has wronged himself, who belittled the sanctity of his Lord.

segs.ar: الَّذِي عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيَّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ
segs.tr: Alladhī ‘aẓumat dhunūbuhu fa-jallat wa-adbarat ayyāmuhu fa-wallat
segs.en: The one whose sins have become great and immense, and whose days have passed and gone.

segs.ar: حَتَّى إِذَا رَأى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
segs.tr: Ḥattā idhā ra’ā muddata al-‘amali qad inqaḍat
segs.en: Until he sees the time for deeds has ended.
And the limit of his lifespan has finished.

segs.ar: وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لَا مَحِيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ وَلاَ مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ
segs.tr: Wa-ayqana annahu lā maḥīṣa lahu minka wa-lā mahraba lahu ‘anka
segs.en: And he is certain that there is no escape for him from You, and no refuge away from You.
He comes to meet You with turning (back), and offers You sincere repentance.
So he stands before You with a pure, clean heart.
Then he calls upon You with a faint, hidden voice.

segs.ar: قَدْ تَطَأْطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنَى، وَنَكَّسَ رَأْسَهُ فَانْثَنَى
segs.tr: Qad taṭāṭa’a laka fa-inḥanā, wa-nakkasa ra’sahu fa-inthanā
segs.en: He has bowed down to You and bent low, lowering his head and folding himself.

segs.ar: قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ
segs.tr: Qad ar‘ashat khashyatuhu rijlayh, wa-gharraqat dumū‘uhu khaddayh
segs.en: His fear has made his legs tremble, and his tears have flooded his cheeks.
Calling upon You: “O Most Merciful of the merciful.”
And O most merciful to whom those seeking mercy turn.

segs.ar: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ
segs.tr: Wa-yā a‘ṭafa man aṭāfa bihi al-mustaghfirūn
segs.en: And O most compassionate to whom the seekers of forgiveness gather.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِهِ
segs.en: And O He whose pardon is greater than His punishment.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man riḍāhu awfaru min sakhaṭih
segs.en: And O He whose pleasure is more abundant than His wrath.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إِلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجاوُزِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man taḥammada ilā khalqihi bi-ḥusni al-tajāwuz
segs.en: And O He who shows gratitude to His creation through gracious forbearance.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبادَهُ قَبُولَ الإنَابَةِ ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man a'w-wada i'baadahoo qaboolal-inaabah
segs.en: O He who has accustomed His servants to the acceptance of their repeated turning!
O He who reformed their corruption through repentance

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسيرِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man raḍiya min fiʿlihim bil-yasīr
segs.en: O He who was satisfied from their deeds with little
O He who rewarded their little with much

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إجَابَةَ الدُّعاءِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ḍamina lahum ijābata ad-duʿāʾ
segs.en: O He who guaranteed for them the answering of prayer

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزاءِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man waʿadahum ʿalā nafsihi bita-faḍḍulihi ḥusna al-jazāʾ
segs.en: O He who promised them, by His grace, a good reward

segs.ar: مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ
segs.tr: Mā anā bi-aʿṣā man ʿaṣāka faghafarta lahu
segs.en: I am not more disobedient than one You forgave

segs.ar: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: Wa-mā anā bi-alwama mani iʿtadhara ilayka faqabilta minhu
segs.en: Nor am I more blameworthy than one You accepted

segs.ar: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.tr: Wa-mā anā bi-aẓlama man tāba ilayka faʿudta ʿalayhi
segs.en: Nor am I more unjust than one You forgave after repentance

segs.ar: أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِم
segs.tr: Atūbu ilayka fī maqāmī hādhā tawbata nādim
segs.en: I repent to You now with the repentance of one regretful

segs.ar: عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ مُشْفِق مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.tr: ʿAlā mā faraṭa minhu mushfiq mimmā ijtamaʿa ʿalayh
segs.en: For what has been neglected, fearful of what has gathered
With pure shame for what has occurred

segs.ar: عَالِم بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ يَتَعَاظَمُكَ
segs.tr: ʿĀlim bi-anna al-ʿafwa ʿani adh-dhanbi al-ʿaẓīm lā yataʿāẓamuka
segs.en: Knowing that pardoning the great sin does not overwhelm You

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ التَّجَاوُزَ عَنِ الإثْمِ الْجَلِيْلِ لا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ
segs.tr: Wa-anna at-tajāwuza ʿani al-ithmi al-jalīl lā yastaṣʿibuka
segs.en: And that overlooking the grave offense is not difficult for You

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجنَايَاتِ الْفَـاحِشَةِ لا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ
segs.tr: Wa-anna iḥtimāla al-janāyāti al-fāḥishati lā yatakaʾaduka
segs.en: And that bearing the outrageous crimes does not burden You

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الاسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ
segs.tr: Wa-anna aḥabba ʿibādika ilayka man taraka al-istkibāra ʿalayk
segs.en: And that Your most beloved servants are those who abandon arrogance
And avoid persistence, and cling to seeking forgiveness

segs.ar: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ
segs.tr: Wa-anā abraʾu ilayka min an astakbira
segs.en: And I disavow before You from arrogance
And I seek refuge in You from persistence in sin
And I ask forgiveness for my shortcomings

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ
segs.tr: Wa-astaʿīnu bika ʿalā mā ʿajaztu ʿanhu
segs.en: And I seek help from You in what I cannot do
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي مَا يَجبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ
segs.tr: Wa-hab lī mā yajibu ʿalayya lak
segs.en: And grant me what I owe to You
And pardon me from what I deserve from You
And protect me from what the people of evil fear
For You are full of pardon, hoped for forgiveness
Well-known for overlooking faults
There is no one else to seek for my need
And none forgives my sin except You—far be it from others

segs.ar: وَلاَ أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاّ إيَّاكَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā akhāfu ʿalā nafsī illā iyyāk
segs.en: And I fear none for my soul except You
Indeed, You are worthy of piety and forgiveness
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Fulfill my need and grant my request success
Forgive my sin, and grant safety to my soul’s fear
Indeed, You are powerful over all things

segs.ar: وَذلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segs.tr: Wa-dhālika ʿalayka yasīrun āmīn rabba al-ʿālamīn
segs.en: And that is easy for You—Amen, Lord of the worlds

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبَادَهُ قَبُولَ التَّوْبَةِ
segs.en: And O He who has accustomed His servants to accepting repentance.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ أَلْهَمَ عِبَادَهُ ذِكْرَهُ وَشُكْرَهُ
segs.en: And O He who has inspired His servants to remember and thank Him.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ لَهُمْ مَفَازًا مِمَّا اقْتَرَفُوا بِفَضْلِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ja‘ala lahum mafāzan mimmā iq’tarafū bi-faḍlih
segs.en: And O He who has made for them deliverance from what they committed, by His grace.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ سَتَرَ ذُنُوبَهُمْ عَلى رَغْمِهِمْ
segs.en: And O He who concealed their sins despite their persistence.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ جَاوَزَ خَطَايَاهُمْ عَلى كَرَمِهِ
segs.en: And O He who has overlooked their faults with His generosity.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَمْ يُؤَاخِذْهُمْ بِالْجَرَائِمِ وَالزَّلَلِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man lam yu’ākhidhhum bi-l-jarā’imi wa-z-zalal
segs.en: And O He who has not punished them for crimes and slips.
And O He to whom the fearful turn in hope.
And O He to whom those with hope seek refuge.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ صَدَقَ فِي وَعْدِهِ وَضَمِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةَ بِمَنِّهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ṣadaqa fī wa‘dih wa-ḍamina al-maghfirata bi-mannih
segs.en: And O He who is true in His promise, and who guaranteed forgiveness through His grace.
And O He who stretches out His hand with mercy.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَضْلُهُ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man wasi‘a kulla shay’in faḍluh
segs.en: And O He whose bounty has encompassed all things.
And O He whose pleasure has outstripped His wrath.
And O He whose mercy has preceded His punishment.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَعَاطَفَ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ بِإِحْسَانِهِ
segs.en: And O He who shows compassion to His servants through His kindness.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ فَتَحَ لِخَلْقِهِ بَابًا إِلَى عَفْوِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man fataḥa li-khalqihi bāban ilā ‘afwih
segs.en: And O He who has opened for His creation a door to His pardon.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ وَوَعْدُهُ الصِّدْقُ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man qāla wa-qawluhu al-ḥaqqu wa-wa‘duhu aṣ-ṣidq
segs.en: And O He who has spoken, and His word is truth, and His promise is sure.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man qāla: ud‘ūnī astajib lakum
segs.en: And O He who has said: "Call upon Me, I will answer you."

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man qāla: wa-idhā sa’alaka ‘ibādī ‘annī fa-innī qarīb
segs.en: And O He who has said: "And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near."
"I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me."

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ مَا يَفْعَلُ اللهُ بِعَذَابِكُمْ إِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ وَآمَنْتُمْ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man qāla: mā yaf‘alu -llāhu bi-‘adhābikum in shakartum wa-āmantum
segs.en: And O He who has said: "What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe?"

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ الشُّكْرَ ثَمَنًا لِزِيَادَتِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ja‘ala ash-shukra thamanan li-ziyādatih
segs.en: And O He who has made gratitude the price for His increase.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ التَّوَكُّلَ عَلَيْهِ سَبَبًا لِكِفَايَتِهِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ja‘ala at-tawakkula ‘alayhi sababan li-kifāyatih
segs.en: And O He who has made reliance upon Him the cause for sufficiency.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ طَاعَتَهُ وَوِلاَيَةَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ حِصْنًا حَصِينًا لِمَنْ دَخَلَهُ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man ja‘ala ṭā‘atahu wa-wilāyata awliyā’ihi ḥiṣnan ḥaṣīnan li-man dakhala-hu
segs.en: And O He who has made obedience to Him and loyalty to His friends a fortified fortress for whoever enters it.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَحُصِّنُ نَفْسَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَوِلاَيَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-j‘alnā mimman yaḥuṣṣinu nafsahu bi-ṭā‘atika wa-wilāyati awliyā’ika
segs.en: And make us among those who fortify themselves with Your obedience and the loyalty of Your friends.
Until You save him from Your wrath and Your displeasure.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.
And make us among those who converse with You in supplication.
And reconcile upon the truth of knowing You.
And whom the world does not distract away from You.
And whom no heedlessness diverts away from You.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And make us among those who sincerely dedicate their deeds to You.
And does not desire through it anyone but You.
Fill our hearts with obedience to You.
And do not disgrace us through disobedience to You.
And grant us the love of Your friends.
And employ us in that which You love and are pleased with.
O Allah, make the end of our deeds Your good pleasure.

segs.ar: وَاقْطَعْ أَيَّامَنَا فِي خَيْرٍ مِنْكَ وَرِضْوَانٍ
segs.tr: Wa-qṭa‘ ayyāmanā fī khayrin minka wa-riḍwān
segs.en: And conclude our days with goodness from You and satisfaction.
Surely, You have power over all things.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
And send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And fulfill my need and grant success to my request.
And forgive my sins and secure me from the fear of myself.
Indeed, You are able over all things.
And that is easy for You.
Ameen, Lord of the worlds.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلاَلٌ ثَلاثٌ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nahoo yah'-jubunee a'm-mas-alatika khilaalun thalaath wa tah'-doonee a'lay-haa khal-latoo-waah'idah
segs.en: O God, three traits have prevented me from asking Thee
and one trait has urged me on:

segs.ar: يَحْجُبُنِي أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأتُ عَنْهُ،
segs.tr: yah'-jubunee am-run amar-ta bihee faab-t'aa-tu a'n-h
segs.en: I am prevented by a command Thou hast commanded in which I have been slow,
a prohibition Thou hast prohibited toward which I have hurried,

segs.ar: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِي شُكْرِهَـا.
segs.tr: wa nia'-matun an-a'm-ta bihaa a'lay-ya faqas'-s'ar-tu fee shuk-rihaa
segs.en: and a favour through which Thou hast favoured for which I have not given sufficient thanks.
I am urged to ask Thee by Thy gratuitous bounty
upon him who turns his face toward Thee
and comes to Thee with a good opinion,
since all Thy beneficence is gratuitous bounty
and every one of Thy favours a new beginning!

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إلهِيْ وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ
segs.tr: fahaaa ana d'aa yaaa ilaahee waaqifum-bibaabi i'z-zika
segs.en: So here I am, my God, standing at the gate of Thy might,

segs.ar: وُقُوفَ المُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيْل، وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنّي
segs.en: the standing of the lowly, the surrendered, asking Thee in my shame,

segs.ar: سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيْلِ. مُقـرٌّ لَكَ بأَنّي
segs.en: the asking of the destitute, the pitiful, admitting to Thee that

segs.ar: لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إحْسَانِـكَ إلاَّ بِالاِقْلاَعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ،
segs.tr: lam as-tas-lim waq-ta ih'-saanika il-laa bil-iq-laai' a'n i's'-yaanik
segs.en: at the time of Thy beneficence I surrendered not save through abstaining from disobedience toward Thee

segs.ar: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِي الْحَالاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ.
segs.tr: wa lam akh-lu fil-h'aalaati kul-lihaa mini am-tinaanik
segs.en: and in none of my states was I ever without Thy Kindness.

segs.ar: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِي يَا إلهِي إقْرَارِي عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ؟
segs.tr: fahal yanfau'nee yaaa ilaaheee iq-raaree i'ndaka bisooo-i mak-tasab-tu ? 6- Will it profit me, my God, to admit to Thee the evil of what I have earned?

segs.ar: وَهَلْ يُنْجِيْنِي مِنْكَ اعْتِرَافِي لَكَ بِقَبِيْحِ مَا ارْتَكَبْتُ؟
segs.en: Will it save me from Thee to confess the ugliness of what I have done?

segs.ar: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا سُخْطَكَ؟
segs.tr: am aw-jab-ta lee fee maqaamee had'aa sukh-t'aka?
segs.en: Or wilt Thou impose upon me in this my stationThy displeasure?

segs.ar: أَمْ لَزِمَنِي فِي وَقْتِ دُعَائِي مَقْتُكَ؟
segs.tr: am lazimanee fee waq-ti dua'aa-ee maq-tuka?
segs.en: Will Thy hate hold fast to me in the time of my supplication?

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: sub-h'aanaka laaa ay-asu minka waqad fatah'-ta lee baabat-taw-bati ilay-k
segs.en: Glory be to Thee! I do not despair of Thee, for Thou hast opened the door of repentance toward Thyself.

segs.ar: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ
segs.en: Rather, I say, the words of a lowly servant, having wronged himself
and made light of his Lord's inviolability,

segs.ar: الَّذِي عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ
segs.tr: al-lad'ee a'z'umat d'unoobuhoo fajal-lat-wa ad-barat ay-yaamuhoo fawal-lat-
segs.en: and whose sins are dreadful, great,whose days have parted, fled,

segs.ar: حَتَّى إذَا رَأى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
segs.tr: h'at-taaa id'aa raaa mud-datal-a'mali qadi anqaz''at
segs.en: until, when he sees the term of his works expired and the limit of his lifetime reached
and knows with certainty that he has no escape from Thee,

segs.ar: وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لا مَحيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ ،وَلاَ مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ
segs.tr: wa ay-qana an-nahoo laa mah'ees'a lahoo mink wa laa mah-raba lahoo a'nk
segs.en: no place to flee from Thee, he turns his face toward Thee in repeated turning,
makes his repentance toward Thee sincere,
stands before Thee with a pure and purified heart,t
hen supplicates Thee with a feeble, quiet voice.

segs.ar: قَدْ تَطَأطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنى، وَنَكَّسَ رَأسَهُ فَانْثَنَى ،
segs.tr: qad t-tat'aa-t'aa laka fan-h'anaawa nak-kasa raa-sahoo faanthanaa
segs.en: He is bowed before Thee, bent,his head lowered, thrown down,

segs.ar: قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ ،
segs.tr: qad sr-a'shat khash-yatuhoo rij-lay-h wa ghar-raqat d-dumoou'hoo khad-day-h
segs.en: his legs shaking in fear,his tears flooding his cheeks.

segs.ar: يَدْعُوكَ بِيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ انْتَابَهُ الْمُسْتَرْحِمُونَ،
segs.tr: yad-u'wka beeaaa ar-h'amar-raah'imeen wa yaaa ar-h'ama mani antaabahul-mus-tar-h'imoon
segs.en: He supplicates Thee: O Most Merciful of the merciful!O Most Merciful of those toward whom seekers of mercy keep on turning

segs.ar: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ ،
segs.tr: wa yaaa aa'-t'afa man at'aafa bihil-mus-tagh-firoon
segs.en: O Tenderest of those around whom run seekers of forgiveness!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man a'f-wuhooo ak-tharu min-naqimatih
segs.en: O He whose pardon is greater than His vengeance!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mar-riz''aahooo aw-faru min sakhat'ih
segs.en: O He whose good pleasure is more abundant than His anger

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجاوُزِ ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man tah'am-mada ilaa khal-qihee bih'us-nit-tajaawuz
segs.en: O He who seeks His creatures' praise with excellent forbearance!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبادَهُ قَبُولَ الإنَابَةِ ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man a'w-wada i'baadahoo qaboolal-inaabah
segs.en: O He who has accustomed His servants to the acceptance of their repeated turning!

segs.tr: wa yaa mani as-tas'-lah'a faasidahum bit-taw-bah
segs.en: O He who seeks to heal their corruption through repentance!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسيرِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mar-raz''eea min fia'-lihim bil-yaseer
segs.en: O He who is pleased with the easy of their acts!

segs.tr: wa yaa man kaafaa qaleelahum bil-katheer
segs.en: O He who recompenses with the much their little!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إجَابَةَ الدُّعاءِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man z''amina lahum ijaabatad-dua'aa-i
segs.en: O He who has made himself accountable to them to respond to supplication!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزاءِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa maw-waa'dahum a'laa naf-sihee bitafaz''-z''ulihee h'us-nal-jazaaa-i
segs.en: O He who pledged Himself by His gratuitous bounty to give them excellent repayment!

segs.ar: مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ،
segs.tr: maaa ana bia'-s'aa man a's'aaka faghafar-ta lah
segs.en: I am not the most disobedient of those who have disobeyed Thee

segs.ar: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ،
segs.tr: wa maaa ana bil-wami mani aa'-tad'ara ilay-ka faqabil-ta min-h
segs.en: and whom Thou hast forgiven, nor am I the most blameworthy to offer excuses which Thou hast accepted,

segs.ar: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ ،
segs.tr: wa maaa ana biz'-lami man taaba ilay-ka fau't-ta a'lay-h
segs.en: nor am I the most wrongdoing of those who have repented to Thee, and to whom Thou hast returned

segs.ar: أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِم عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: atoobu ilay-ka fee maqaamee had'aa taw-bata naadimin a'laa maa farat'a min-h
segs.en: I repent to Thee in this my station, the repentance of one remorseful over what preceded from him

segs.ar: مُشْفِق مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ خَالِصِ الْحَيَاءِ مِمَّا وَقَعَ فِيْهِ ،
segs.tr: mush-fiqim-mim-maj-tamaa' a'lay-h khaalis'il-h'ayaaa-i mim-maa waqaa' feeh
segs.en: hastily, apprehensive of what has gathered around him, pure in shame for that into which he has fallen,

segs.ar: عَالِم بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ يَتَعـاظَمُكَ،
segs.en: knowing that pardoning great sins is nothing great for Thee.

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ التَّجَـاوُزَ عَنِ الإثْمِ الْجَلِيْلِ لا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ ،
segs.en: overlooking enormous misdeeds is not difficult for thee

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجنَايَاتِ الْفَـاحِشَةِ لا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ،
segs.en: putting up with indecent crimes does not trouble Thee,

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الاسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa an-na ah'ab-ba i'baadika ilay-ka man tarakalis-tik-baara a'lay-k
segs.en: and the most beloved of Thy servants to Thee is he who refrains from arrogance before thee
pulls aside from persistence, and holds fast to praying forgiveness!

segs.ar: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ،
segs.tr: wa ana ab-ra-u ilay-ka min sn ss-tak-bir
segs.en: I am clear before Thee of arrogance,

segs.tr: wa su'wd'u bika min sn us'ir
segs.en: I seek refuge in Thee from persistence,
I pray forgiveness from Thee for shortcomings,

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ.
segs.tr: wa as-tae'enu bika a'laa maa a'jaz-tu a'n-h
segs.en: I seek help from Thee in incapacity!
O God bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي مَا يَجبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ ،
segs.tr: wa hab lee maa yajibu a'lay-ya lak
segs.en: dispense with what is incumbent upon me toward Thee,
release me from what I merit from Thee,
and grant me sanctuary from what the evildoers fear!

segs.ar: فَإنَّكَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْعَفْوِ، مَرْجُوٌّ لِلْمَغْفِرَةِ، مَعْرُوفٌ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ ،
segs.tr: fa in-naka malee-um-bil-a'f-w mar-joo-wu lil-magh-firah maa'-roofum-bit-tajaawz
segs.en: For Thou art full of pardon, the hoped-for source of forgiveness, well known for Thy forbearance.
My need has no object but Thee,

segs.tr: wa laa lid'ambee ghaafirun ghay-ruk h'aashaak
segs.en: my sin no forgiver other than Thee - could that be possible?

segs.ar: وَلاَ أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاّ إيَّاكَ
segs.tr: wa laaa akhaafu a'laa naf-seee il-laaa ee-yaak
segs.en: I have no fear for myself except from Thee;
Thou art worthy of reverential fear, and worthy to forgive!
Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa aq-z''i h'aajatee wa anjih' t'alibatee
segs.en: grant my need,answer my request favorably,

segs.tr: wagh-fir d'ambee wa aaamin khaw-fa naf-see
segs.en: forgive my sin and give me security from fear for myself!
Thou art powerful over everything,

segs.ar: وَذلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
segs.tr: wa d'alika a'lay-ka yaseer aaameena rab-bal-a'alameen
segs.en: and that is easy for Thee.Amen, Lord of the worlds

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا مُنْتَهَى مَطْلَبِ الْحَاجَاتِ، وَيَا مَنْ عِنْدَهُ نَيْلُ الطَّلِبَاتِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma yā muntahā maṭlabi al-ḥājāt, wa-yā man ʿindahu naylu aṭ-ṭalibāt
segs.en: O Allah, O ultimate destination of needs, O One with all requests.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَبِيعُ نِعَمَهُ بِالْأَثْمَانِ، وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالِامْتِنَانِ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man lā yabīʿu niʿamahu bil-athmān, wa-yā man lā yukaddiru ʿaṭāyāhu bil-imtinān
segs.en: O He who does not sell His blessings for a price, nor spoil His gifts with obligation.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلَا يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ، وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إِلَيْهِ وَلَا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man yustaghnā bihi wa-lā yustaghnā ʿanhu, wa-yā man yurghabu ilayhi wa-lā yurghabu ʿanhu
segs.en: O He through whom sufficiency is found, and none is independent of Him; O He to whom all desire turns, and from whom none turns away.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا تُفْنِي خَزَائِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ، وَيَا مَنْ لَا تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man lā tufnī khazāʾinahu al-masāʾil, wa-yā man lā tubaddilu ḥikmatahu al-wasāʾil
segs.en: O He whose treasures are never depleted by requests, and whose wisdom is never altered by means.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ، وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
segs.tr: Wa-yā man lā tanqaṭiʿu ʿanhu ḥawāʾiju al-muḥtājīn, wa-yā man lā yuʿannīhi duʿāʾu ad-dāʿīn
segs.en: O He from whom the needs of the needy never cease, and whom the calls of the callers never burden.

segs.ar: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغِنَى عَنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
segs.tr: Tamaddaḥta bil-ghinā ʿan khalqika, wa-anta ahlu al-ghinā ʿanhum
segs.en: You have praised Yourself with independence from creation, and You are worthy of being above need of them.

segs.ar: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إِلَى الْفَقْرِ، وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: Wa-nasabtahum ilā al-faqr, wa-hum ahlu al-faqri ilayk
segs.en: And You attributed poverty to them, for they are truly in need of You.

segs.ar: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْرِ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ
segs.tr: Fa-man ḥāwala sadd khallatihi min ʿindika, wa-rāma ṣarfa al-faqri ʿan nafsihi bika
segs.en: So whoever seeks to fulfill his need through You, and desires to repel poverty from himself by You—

segs.ar: فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ فِي مَظَانِّهَا، وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
segs.tr: Faqad ṭalaba ḥājatahu fī maẓānihā, wa-atā ṭalibatahu min wajhihā
segs.en: He has indeed sought his need in its true place, and approached his request from the right path.

segs.ar: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا دُونَكَ
segs.tr: Wa-man tawajjaha bi-ḥājatihi ilā aḥadin min khalqika, aw jaʿalahu sabab nūjḥihā dūnak
segs.en: But whoever turns with his need to any of Your creation, or makes him the cause of success without You—

segs.ar: فَقَدْ تَعَرَّضَ لِلْحِرْمَانِ، وَاسْتَحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَوْتَ الْإِحْسَانِ
segs.tr: Faqad taʿarraḍa lil-ḥirmān, wa-staḥaqqa min ʿindika fawta al-iḥsān
segs.en: He has exposed himself to deprivation, and deserves from You the loss of beneficence.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إِلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَا جُهْدِي
segs.tr: Allāhumma walī ilayka ḥājatan qad qaṣṣara ʿanhā juhdī
segs.en: O Allah, I have a need with You, beyond my effort.

segs.ar: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ دُونَهَا حِيلِي، وَسَوَّلَتْ لِي نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا
segs.tr: Wa-taqaṭṭaʿat dūnahā ḥīlī, wa-sawwlat lī nafsī rafʿahā
segs.en: My means have failed me, yet my soul suggested I raise it—

segs.ar: إِلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إِلَيْكَ، وَلَا يَسْتَغْنِي فِي طَلِبَاتِهِ عَنْكَ
segs.tr: Ilā man yarfaʿu ḥawāʾijahu ilayka, wa-lā yastaghnī fī ṭalibātihi ʿanka
segs.en: To one who himself raises his needs to You, and cannot be independent of You.

segs.ar: وَهِيَ زَلَّةٌ مِنْ زَلَلِ الْخَاطِئِينَ، وَعَثْرَةٌ مِنْ عَثَرَاتِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
segs.tr: Wa-hiya zallatun min zalali al-khāṭiʾīn, wa-ʿathratun min ʿatharāti al-mudhnibīn
segs.en: And this is a slip from the slips of sinners, and a stumble from the stumbles of the guilty.

segs.ar: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي، وَنَهَضْتُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ زَلَّتِي
segs.tr: Thumma intabahtu bi-tadhkīrika lī min ghaflatī, wa-nahaḍtu bi-tawfīqika min zallatī
segs.en: Then I awoke by Your reminder from my heedlessness, and I rose by Your guidance from my slip.

segs.ar: وَرَجَعْتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْرَتِي، وَقُلْتُ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي
segs.tr: Wa-rajaʿtu wa-nakaṣtu bi-tasdīdika ʿan ʿathratī, wa-qultu subḥāna rabbī
segs.en: And I turned back, corrected by Your support from my stumble, and I said: Glory be to my Lord—

segs.ar: كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجًا، وَأَنَّى يَرْغَبُ مُعْدِمٌ إِلَى مُعْدِمٍ
segs.tr: Kayfa yasʾalu muḥtājun muḥtājan, wa-annā yarghabu muʿdimun ilā muʿdimin
segs.en: How can one in need ask another in need? How can a destitute turn to a destitute?

segs.ar: فَقَصَدْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بِالرَّغْبَةِ، وَأَوْفَدْتُ عَلَيْكَ رَجَائِي بِالثِّقَةِ بِكَ
segs.tr: Faqaṣadtu-ka yā ilāhī bir-raghbah, wa-awfadtu ʿalayka rajāʾī bith-thiqati bika
segs.en: So I turned to You, my God, with longing, and sent my hope to You with trust.

segs.ar: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرًا مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-ʿalimtu anna kathīran mā asʾaluka yasīrun fī wujdika
segs.en: And I knew that much of what I ask You is easy within Your possession.

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرًا مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِي وُسْعِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-anna khaṭīran mā astawhibuka ḥaqīrun fī wusʿika
segs.en: And that great matters I request from You are small within Your capacity.

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لَا يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَالِ أَحَدٍ
segs.tr: Wa-anna karamaka lā yaḍīqu ʿan suʾāli aḥadin
segs.en: And that Your generosity is never too narrow for anyone’s asking.

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطَايَا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَدٍ
segs.tr: Wa-anna yadaka bil-ʿaṭāyā aʿlā min kulli yadin
segs.en: And that Your hand in giving is higher than every hand.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma fa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi wa-ḥmilnī b-karamika ʿala at-tafaḍḍul
segs.en: O Allah, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and carry me through Your generosity to gracious bounty,
and do not carry me by Your justice to what I deserve.

segs.ar: فَمَا أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبٍ رَغِبَ إِلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
segs.tr: famā anā bi-awwali rāghibin raghība ilayka fa-aʿṭaytahu wa-huwa yastaḥiqqu al-manʿ
segs.en: For I am not the first of those who desired from You, whom You granted though he deserved withholding,

segs.ar: وَلا بِأَوَّلِ سَائِلٍ سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ
segs.tr: wa-lā bi-awwali sāʾilin saʾalaka fa-afḍalta ʿalayhi wa-huwa yastawjibu al-ḥirmān
segs.en: nor the first of those who asked You, to whom You bestowed while he merited deprivation.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
be responsive to my supplication, and near to my call,
merciful to my pleading, and listening to my voice.

segs.ar: وَلا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
segs.tr: wa-lā taqṭaʿ rajāʾī ʿanka wa-lā tabutta sababī minka
segs.en: Do not cut off my hope from You, nor sever my tie to You,

segs.ar: وَلا تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتِي هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إِلَى سِوَاكَ
segs.tr: wa-lā tuwajjihnī fī ḥājātī hādhihi wa-ghayrihā ilā siwāk
segs.en: nor turn me in this need of mine or others to anyone but You.
Take charge of fulfilling my request and settling my need,

segs.ar: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا
segs.tr: wa-nayli suʾlī qabla zawālī ʿan mawqifī hādhā
segs.en: and granting my desire before I depart from this place,

segs.ar: بِتَيْسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الْأُمُورِ
segs.tr: bi-taysīrika lī al-ʿasīr wa-ḥusni taqdīrika lī fī jamīʿ al-umūr
segs.en: through Your easing the difficult for me and Your excellent ordaining in all my affairs.

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لَا انْقِطَاعَ لِأَبَدِهَا
segs.tr: wa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi ṣalātan dāʾimatan nāmiyatan lā inqiṭāʿa li-abadihā
segs.en: And bless Muhammad and his Household with a lasting, ever-increasing blessing, whose eternity shall never end,

segs.ar: وَلَا مُنْتَهَى لِأَمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْنًا لِي وَسَبَبًا لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إِنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ
segs.tr: wa-lā muntahā li-amadihā wa-jʿal dhālika ʿawnan lī wa-sababan li-najāḥi ṭalibatī innaka wāsiʿun karīm
