segs.en: and whose span has no limit. Make that a support for me and a cause for the success of my request—surely You are All-Encompassing, Generous.

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segs.tr: wa-min ḥājatī yā rabbī kadhā wa-kadhā
segs.en: And of my needs, O my Lord, are such and such...
Your bounty has comforted me, and Your kindness has guided me.

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ لَا تَرُدَّنِي خَائِبًا
segs.tr: fa-asʾaluka bika wa-bimuḥammadin wa-ālihi ṣalawātuka ʿalayhim an lā taruddani khāʾiban
segs.en: So I ask You—by You, and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them)—not to send me away disappointed.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنِّي وَجَدْتُ الطَّلَبَ إِلَيْكَ جَمِيلًا
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa-innī wajadtu al-ṭalaba ilayka jamīlan
segs.en: O Allah, I found asking from You beautiful.

segs.ar: وَالتَّضَرُّعَ إِلَيْكَ نَفْعًا، وَالسُّؤَالَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ غَنِيمَةً
segs.tr: Wa-al-taḍarruʿa ilayka nafʿan, wa-al-suʾāla min faḍlika ghanīmah
segs.en: And supplication to You beneficial, and requesting from Your bounty a gain.

segs.ar: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ قِلَّةَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ إِلَيْكَ فَقْرٌ
segs.tr: Wa-raʾaytu anna qillata al-masʾalati ilayka faqrun
segs.en: And I saw that asking little from You is poverty.

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ الْكَثِيرَ فِيهَا غِنًى، فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا إِلَهِي
segs.tr: Wa-anna al-kathīra fīhā ghinan, fa-asʾaluka yā ilāhī
segs.en: And that much in it is wealth—so I ask You, O my God.

segs.ar: مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ إِعْطَاؤُهُ، وَلَا يُضِرُّكَ وَهْبُهُ
segs.tr: Mā lā yanquṣuka iʿṭāʾuhu, wa-lā yuḍirruka wahbuhu
segs.en: For what granting does not diminish You, nor does giving harm You.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ حَاجَتِي
segs.tr: Allāhumma fa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi, waqḍi ḥājati
segs.en: O Allah, so bless Muhammad and his family, and fulfill my need.

segs.ar: وَاسْمَعْ دُعَائِي، وَاسْتَجِبْ نِدَائِي، وَلَا تَخَيَّبْ رَجَائِي
segs.tr: Wasmaʿ duʿāʾī, wa-stajib nidāʾī, wa-lā tukhaayyib rajāʾī
segs.en: Hear my supplication, answer my call, and do not disappoint my hope.

segs.ar: وَكُنْ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِي وَلِيًّا وَحَافِظًا وَمُعِينًا
segs.tr: Wa-kun lī fī jamīʿi umūrī waliyyan wa-ḥāfiẓan wa-muʿīnan
segs.en: And be for me in all my affairs a Guardian, Protector, and Helper.

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً لَا انْقِطَاعَ لَهَا
segs.tr: Wa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi ṣalātan dāʾimatan lā inqiṭāʿa lahā
segs.en: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family—blessings everlasting, never ending.

segs.ar: وَلَا غَايَةَ لِأَمَدِهَا، وَلَا نِهَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
segs.tr: Wa-lā ghāyata li-amadihā, wa-lā nihāyata li-ʿadadihā
segs.en: With no limit to their duration, and no end to their number.
1.O God, O ultimate object of needs!
2.O He through whom requests are attained!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا يَبِيْعُ نِعَمَهُ بالأثْمَانِ
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yabeeu' nia'mahoo bil-ath-maan
segs.en: 3.O He whose favours are not bought by prices!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالامْتِنَانِ
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yukad-diru a't'aayaahoo biiam-tinaan
segs.en: 4.O He who does not muddy His gifts by the imposition of obligations!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلاَ يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yus-tagh-naa bihee wa laa yus-tagh-naa a'n-h
segs.en: 5.O He along with whom nothing is needed and without whom nothing can be done!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إلَيْهِ وَلا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ.
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yur-ghabu ilay-hee wa laa yur-ghabu a'n-h
segs.en: 6.O He toward whom desire is ever directed and never turned away!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا تُفنى خَزَآئِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
segs.en: 7.O He whose treasuries cannot be exhausted by demands!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ.
segs.en: 8.O He whose wisdom cannot be altered by any means!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa tanqat'iu' a'n-hoo h'awaaa-ijul-muh'-taajeen
segs.en: 9.O He from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
segs.en: 10.O He who is not distressed by the supplications of the supplicators!

segs.ar: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
segs.tr: tamad-dah'-ta bil-ghanaaa-i a'n khal-qik wa anta ah-lul-ghinaa a'n-hum-
segs.en: 11.You hast lauded Yourself for having no need for Your creatures, and it suits You to have no need for them,

segs.ar: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إلَى الفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إلَيْكَ.
segs.tr: wa nasab-tahum ilaal-faq-r wa hum ah-lul-faq-ri ilay-k
segs.en: 12.and You hast attributed to them poverty, and it suits them to be poor toward You.

segs.ar: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segs.tr: faman h'aawala sad-da khal-latihee min i'ndik
segs.en: 13.So he who strives to remedy his lack through what is with You

segs.ar: وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْر عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ
segs.tr: wa raama s'ar-fal-faq-ri a'n-naf-sihee bik faqad t'alaba h'aajatahoo
segs.en: 14.and wishes to turn poverty away from himself through You has sought his need

segs.ar: فِي مَظَانِّها وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
segs.tr: fee? maz'aaan-nihaa wa ataa t'ilabatahoo miw-waj-hihaa
segs.en: 15.in the most likely place and come to his request from the right quarter.

segs.ar: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا
segs.tr: wa man tawj-jaha bih'aajatiheee ilaaa ah'adim-min khal-qika aw jaa'lahoo sababa nuj-h'ihaa
segs.en: 16.But he who turns in his need toward one of Your creatures or assigns the cause of its being granted
17.to other than You, has exposed himself to deprivation
18.and deserves to miss Your beneficence.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَـدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَـا جُهْدِي
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa leee ilay-ka h'aajah qad qas'-s'ara a'n-haa juh-dee
segs.en: 19.O God, I have a need of You: my exertion has fallen short of it
20.and my stratagems have been cut back before reaching it.

segs.ar: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا إلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إلَيْكَ
segs.tr: wa saw-walat lee naf-see raf-a'haaa ilaa may-yar-fau' h'awaaa-ijahooo ilay-ka
segs.en: 21.My soul induced me to present it to him who presents his needs to You

segs.tr: wa laa yas-tagh-nee fee t'alibaatihee a'nka
segs.en: 22.and can do nothing without You in his requests,
23.but this is one the slips of the offenders,
24.one of the stumbles of the sinners!

segs.ar: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي
segs.tr: thum-ma antabah-tu bitad'-keerika lee min ghaf-latee
segs.en: 25.Then through Your reminding me, I was aroused from my heedlessness,
26.through Your giving success, I stood up from my slip,

segs.ar: وَ رَجَعتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْـدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْـرَتِي
segs.tr: wa rajaa'-tu wa nakas'-tu bitas-deedika a'n a'th-ratee
segs.en: 27.and through Your pointing the way, I returned and withdrew from my stumble.

segs.ar: وَقُلْتُ: سُبْحَانَ رَبّي كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجـاً
segs.tr: wa qul-tu: sub-h'aana rab-bee kay-fa yas-alu muh'-taajum-muh'-taajaa?
segs.en: 28.I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can the needy ask from the needy?

segs.tr: wa an-naa yarghabu mua'-dimun ilaa mua'-dimin?
segs.en: 29.How can the destitute beseech the destitute?
30.So I went straight to You, my God, in beseeching,

segs.tr: wa aw-fat-tu a'lay-ka rajaaa-ee bith-thiqati bik
segs.en: 31.and I sent You my hope with trust in You.

segs.ar: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ
segs.tr: wa a'lim-tu an-na katheera maaa as-aluka yaseerun fee wuj-dik
segs.en: 32.I came to know that the many I request from You are few before Your wealth,

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
segs.tr: wa an-na khat'eera maaa as-taw-hibuka h'aqeerun fee wus-i'k
segs.en: 33.the weighty I ask from You is vile before Your plenty;

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لاَ يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَال أحَد
segs.tr: wa an-na karamaka laa yaz''eequ a'n soo-aali ah'ad
segs.en: 34.Your generosity is not constrained by anyone's asking,

segs.ar: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطايا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَد.
segs.tr: wa an-na yadaka bil-a't'aayaaa aa'-laa min kul-li yad
segs.en: 35.Your hand is higher in bestowing gifts than every hand!

segs.ar: أللَهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa ah'-mil-nee bikaramika a'laat-tafaz''-z''ul
segs.en: 36.O God, so bless Muhammad and His Household, take me through their generosity to Your gratuitous bounty
37.And take me not through Your justice to what I deserve!

segs.ar: فَما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبِ رَغِبَ إلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
segs.tr: famaaa ana biw-wali raaghibir-raghiba ilay-ka faaa'-t'ay-tahoo wa huwa yas-tah'iq-qul-man-a'-
segs.en: 38.I am not the first beseecher to beseech You and You bestowed upon him while he deserved withholding,

segs.ar: وَلاَ بِأَوَّلِ سَائِل سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ.
segs.tr: wa laa biw-wali saaa-ilin saalaka faaf-z''al-ta a'lay-hee wa huwa yas-taw-jibul-h'ir-maan
segs.en: 39.nor am I the first to ask from You and Your vast bounteous toward him while he merited deprivation.
40.O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِي مُجِيباً وَمِنْ نِدائِي قَرِيباً
segs.tr: wa kul-lidua'aa-ee mujeebaa wa min-nidaaa-ee qareebaa
segs.en: 41.respond to my supplication, come near my call,

segs.tr: wa litaz''ar-rue'e raah'imaa wa lis'aw-tee saamia'a
segs.en: 42.have mercy on my pleading, listen to my voice,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنْكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
segs.tr: wa laa taq-t'aa' rajaaa-ee a'nk wa laa tabut-ta sababee mink
segs.en: 43.cut not short my hope for You, sever not my thread to You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إلى سِوَاكَ
segs.tr: wa laa tuwaj-jih-nee fee h'aajatee hd'ihee waghay-rihaaa ilaa siwaak
segs.en: 44.turn not my face in this my need, and other needs, away from You,

segs.tr: wa tawal-lanee binuj-hee t'alibatee wa qaz''aaa-i h'aajatee
segs.en: 45.attend for my sake to the fulfillment of my request, the granting of my need,

segs.ar: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا
segs.tr: wa nay-li soo-lee qab-la zawaalee a'm-maw-qifee had'aa
segs.en: 46.and the attainment of what I have asked before I leave this place

segs.ar: بِتَيسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيْرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ.
segs.tr: bitay-seerika leeal-a'seer wa h'us-ni taq-deerika lee fee jameei'l-umoor
segs.en: 47.through Your making easy for me the difficult and Your excellent ordainment for me in all affairs!

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لاَ انْقِطَاعَ لأِبَدِهَا
segs.tr: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih s'alaatan daaa-imatan-naameeah laa anqit'aaa' liabadihaa
segs.en: 48.Bless Muhammad and his Household with a permanent, ever-growing blessing, whose perpetuity has no cutting off

segs.ar: وَلا مُنْتَهَى لأِمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْناً لِيْ وَسَبَباً لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
segs.tr: wa laa muntahaa liamadihaa waj-a'l d'alika a'w-nal-lee wa sababal-linajaahee t'alibatee in-naka waasiu'n kareem
segs.en: 49.and whose term knows no limit, and make that a help to me and a cause for the granting of my request! You art Boundless, Generous!

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segs.tr: wa min h'aajatee yaa rab-bi kad'aa wakad'aa
segs.en: 50.And of my needs,my Lord, are such and such

segs.ar: وَتَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَكَ ثمّ تَسْجُـدُ وَتَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ:

segs.en: .Your bounty has comforted me and Your beneficence has shown the way,

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّـد وَآلِهِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهمْ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً.
segs.tr: faas-aluka bika wa bimuh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee s'alawaatuka a'lay-him al-laa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segs.en: .So I ask You by You and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them) that You sendest me not back in disappointment!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَاءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِينَ
segs.tr: Yā man lā yakhfā ‘alayhi anbā’u al-mutaẓallimīna
segs.en: O He whom the complaints of the oppressed are not hidden from.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ فِي قِصَصِهِمْ
segs.tr: Wa yā man lā yaḥtāju fī qiṣaṣihim
segs.en: And O He who does not need in their accounts.
To the testimonies of witnesses.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ
segs.tr: Wa yā man qarubat nuṣratuhu mina al-maẓlūmīna
segs.en: And O He whose help is near to the oppressed.

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِينَ
segs.tr: Wa yā man ba‘uda ‘awnuhu ‘ani aẓ-ẓālimīna yaaa ilaahee maa naalanee min (fulaani ibn fulaanin) mim-maa h'az'ar-ta
segs.en: And O He whose aid is far from the oppressors. O my God, how so-and-so, son of so-and-so, has harmed me in that which You hast forbidden,
And he violated against me what You prohibited.
Arrogantly in Your blessings upon him.
And deceived by Your disapproval of him.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family.
And seize my oppressor and enemy from my oppression.
With Your strength, and blunt his edge against me.
With Your power, and make him preoccupied.
With what concerns him and incapable of opposing.

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family.
And do not permit him my oppression.
And improve my aid against him.
And protect me from deeds like his.

segs.tr: Wa lā taj‘alnī fī mithli ḥālihi
segs.en: And do not place me in his state.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family.
And grant me against him a present retribution.
That serves as healing from my anger toward him.
And fulfillment of my resentment against him.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family.
And compensate me for his oppression with Your pardon.
And replace his evil deed toward me.
With Your mercy, for every harm is great.
Compared to Your displeasure, and every affliction.
Is equal with Your wrath.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَرَّهْتَ إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma fakamā karrahta ilayya an aẓlima
segs.en: O Allah, as You made oppression detestable to me.
Protect me from being oppressed.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَا أَشْكُو إِلَى أَحَدٍ سِوَاكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma lā ashkū ilā aḥadin siwāka
segs.en: O Allah, I complain to none but You.

segs.tr: Wa lā asta‘īnu biḥākimin ghayrika ḥāshāka
segs.en: Nor seek help from a judge besides You, far be it.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And connect my supplication with acceptance.
And pair my complaint with change.
O Allah, do not test me with despair.
Of Your justice, nor test him.
With security from Your disapproval.
Lest he persists in my oppression.
And denies me my right.
And make him know soon what.
You promised the oppressors.
And make me know what You promised.
For answering the distressed.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family.
And enable me to accept what You decreed.
For and against me, and make me content.
With what You took for and from me.
And guide me to that which is most upright.
And employ me in what is safest.

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa in kānati al-khiyaratu lī
segs.en: O Allah, if the best choice for me.
Lies with You in delaying my retribution.
And withholding vengeance from my oppressor.
Until the day of decision.
And gathering of adversaries.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And support me from You with a sincere intention.
And enduring patience.
And protect me from evil desires.
And the panic of the greedy.
And depict in my heart the image.
Of what You reserved for me of Your reward.
And prepared for my adversary of Your recompense.
And punishment, and make that.
A cause for my contentment with what You decreed.
And my trust in Your choice.
Amen, Lord of the worlds.
For You are the Possessor of great favor.
And You are capable of all things.

segs.ar: يَامَنْ لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَآءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِينَ
segs.en: 1.O He from whom is not concealed news of the aggrieved!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ فِي قِصَصِهِمْ إلَى شَهَادَاتِ الشَّاهِدِينَ
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yah'-taaju fee qas'as'ihim ilaa shahaadaatish-shaahideen
segs.en: 2.O He who has no need to be told about them by the witnessing of the witnesses!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ
segs.tr: wa yaa man qarubat nus'-ratuhoo minal-maz'-loomeen
segs.en: 3.O He who whose help is near to the wronged!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِينَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ
segs.tr: wa yaa mam-bau'da a'w-nuhoo a'niz'-z'aalimeen qad a'lim-ta
segs.en: 4.O He whose aid is far from the wrongdoers! You knowest,

segs.ar: يَا إلهِي مَا نالَنِي مِنْ [فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَن] مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ
segs.tr: yaaa ilaahee maa naalanee min (fulaani ibn fulaanin) mim-maa h'az'ar-ta
segs.en: 5.my God, how so-and-so, son of so-and-so, has harmed me in that which You hast forbidden,

segs.ar: وَانْتَهَكَهُ مِنّي مِمَّا حَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَطَراً فِي نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدَهُ وَاغْتِرَاراً بِنَكِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wantahakahoo min-nee mim-maa h'ajaz-ta a'lay-h bat'aran fee nia'-matika i'ndah wagh-tiraaram-binakeerika a'lay-h
segs.en: 6.and how he has violated me in that which You hast prohibited, showing thereby ingratitude toward Your favour upon him and delusion concerning what You hast denied him.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
segs.en: 7.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَخُذْ ظَالِمِي وَعَدُوِّي عَنْ ظُلْمِي بِقُوَّتِكَ
segs.tr: wa khuz'-z'aalimee wa a'doo-wee a'n z'ul-mee biqoo-watik
segs.en: 8.keep my wrongdoing enemy from wronging me through Your strength,

segs.ar: وَافْلُلْ حَدَّهُ عَنِّي بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْ لَهُ
segs.en: 9.blunt his blade toward me through Your power, and assign to him

segs.ar: شُغْلاً فِيَما يَلِيهِ وَعَجْزاً عَمَّا يُناوِيْهِ
segs.tr: shugh-lan feemaa yaleeh w a'j-zan a'm-maa yunaaweeh
segs.en: 10.a diversion in that which is close to him and the inability to reach his enemy!

segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segs.en: 11.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُسَوِّغْ لَهُ ظُلْمِي وَأَحْسِنْ عَلَيْـهِ عَوْنِي،
segs.tr: wa laa tusaw-wigh lahoo z'ul-mee wa ah'-sin a'lay-hee a'w-nee
segs.en: 12.let the wrongdoer not find it easy to wrong me, give me good help against him,

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ مِثْـلِ أَفْعَالِهِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي مِثْلِ حَالِهِ.
segs.tr: waa'-s'im-nee mim-mith-li af-a'alih wa laa taj-a'l-nee fee mith-li h'aalih
segs.en: 13.preserve me from the like of his acts, and place me not in the like of his situation!
14.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَأَعِدْنِي عَلَيْهِ عَدْوى حَاضِرَةً تَكُونُ مِنْ غَيْظِي بِهِ شِفَاءً،
segs.tr: wa ai'd-nee a'lay-hee a'd-wana h'aaz''iratan takoonu min ghay-z'ee bihee shifaaa
segs.en: 15.and assist me with an immediate assistance that will heal my rage toward him
16.and redeem my fury toward him!
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa a'w-wiz''-nee min z'ul-mihee lee a'f-wak
segs.en: 18.compensate me for his wronging me with Your pardon

segs.tr: wa ab-dil-nee bisooo-i s'aneei'hee bee rah'-matak
segs.en: 19.and replace his evil action toward me with Your mercy,
20.for every detested thing less than Your anger is slight
21.and every disaster next to Your rancour indifferent!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَـرَّهْتَ إلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ فَقِنِي مِنْ أَنْ أُظْلَمَ.
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma fakamaa kar-rah-ta ilay-ya an uz'-lama faqinee min an az'-lim
segs.en: 22.O God, just as You hast made me detest being wronged, so also protect me from doing wrong!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ أَشْكُو إلَى أَحَد سِوَاكَ،
segs.tr: sll-lahum-ma laaa ashkooo ilaaa ah'adin siwaak
segs.en: 23.O God, I complain to no one but You,

segs.tr: wa laaa as-tae'enu bih'aakimin ghay-rik h'aashaak
segs.en: 24.and I seek help from no ruler other than You - how could I?
25.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَصِلْ دُعَائِي بِالإِجَابَةِ، وَأَقْرِنْ شِكَايَتِي بِالتَّغْيِيرِ.
segs.tr: wa s'il dua'aa-ee bil-ijaabah waq-rin shikaayatee bit-tagh-yeer
segs.en: 26.join my supplication to response, and unite my complaint with change!

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لا تَفْتِنِّي بِالْقُنُوطِ مِنْ إنْصَافِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa taf-tin-nee bil-qunoot'i min ins'aafik
segs.en: 27.O God, tempt me not with despair of Your just treatment

segs.tr: wa laa taf-tin-hoo bil-am-ni min inkaarik
segs.en: 28.and tempt him not with feeling secure from Your disapproval,

segs.tr: fayus'ir-ra a'laa z'ul-mee wa yuh'aas'iranee bih'aq-qee
segs.en: 29.lest he persist in wronging me and constrain me in my rights.

segs.ar: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيْل مَا أَوْعَدْتَ الظَّالِمِينَ،
segs.en: 30.Let him soon recognize what You hast promised the wrongdoers

segs.ar: وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنْ إجَابَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ.
segs.tr: wa a'r-rif-nee maa waa't-ta min ijaabatil-muz''-t'ar-reen
segs.en: 31.and let me recognize Your promised response to the distressed!
32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقَبُولِ مَا قَضَيْتَ لِيْ وَعَليَّ،
segs.tr: wa waf-fiq-nee liqabooli maa qaz''ay-ta lee wa a'lay
segs.en: 33.give me success in accepting Your decrees for me and against me,

segs.tr: wa raz''-z''inee bimaaa akhad'-ta lee wa min-nee
segs.en: 34.make me pleased with what You takest for me and from me,

segs.ar: وَاهْـدِنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِي أَقْوَمُ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَسْلَمُ.
segs.tr: wah-dinee lil-latee heea aq-wam was-taa'-mil-nee bimaa huwa as-lam
segs.en: 35.guide me to that which is most upright and employ me in that which is safest!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كَانَتِ الْخِيَرَةُ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa in kaanatil-kheearatu lee i'ndaka
segs.en: 36.O God, if the best for me with You lies

segs.ar: فِي تَأْخِيرِ الأَخْذِ لِي وَتَرْكِ الانْتِقَامِ
segs.en: 37.in delaying the taking to task for my sake of him

segs.ar: مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ إلَى يَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ وَمَجْمَعِ الْخَصْمِ،
segs.tr: mim-man z'alamaneee ilaa yaw-mil-fas'-li wa maj-mai'l-khas'-m
segs.en: 38.who has wronged me and in refraining from vengeance toward him until the Day of Decision and the Gathering of Disputants,
39.then bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَأَيِّدْنِي مِنْكَ بِنِيَّة صَادِقَة وَصَبْر دَائِم،
segs.tr: wa ay-yid-nee minka binee-yatin s'aadiqatiw-wa s'ab-rin daaa-im
segs.en: 40.strengthen me from You with true intention and lasting patience,

segs.ar: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ سُوءِ الرَّغْبَةِ، وَهَلَعِ أَهْلِ الْحِرْصِ،
segs.tr: wa ai'd'-nee min sooo-ir-ragh-bati wa halai' ah-lil-h'ir-s'
segs.en: 41.give me refuge from evil desire and the impatience of the greedy

segs.ar: وَصَوِّرْ فِي قَلْبِي مِثَالَ مَا ادَّخَـرْتَ لِي مِنْ ثَوَابِـكَ،
segs.tr: wa s'aw-wir fee qal-bee mithaala mad-dakhar-ta lee min thawaabika
segs.en: 42.and form in my heart the image of Your reward

segs.tr: wa aa'-dat-ta likhas'-mee min jazaaa-ika wai'qaabik
segs.en: 43.which You hast stored away for me and the repayment and punishment

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ سَبَباً لِقَنَاعَتِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ ،
segs.en: 44.which You has prepared for my disputant! Make this a cause of my contentment with what You hast decreed

segs.ar: وَثِقَتِي بِمَا تَخَيَّرْتَ، آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ،
segs.tr: wa thiqatee bimaa takhay-yar-t aaameena rab-bal-a'alameen
segs.en: 45.and my trust in what You hast chosen! Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
segs.tr: in-naka d'ool-faz''-lil-a'z'eem wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segs.en: 46.You art of bounty abounding and You art powerful over everything.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلَامَةِ بَدَنِي
segs.tr: Allāhumma laka al-ḥamdu ‘alā mā lam azal atasarrafu fīhi min salāmati badanī
segs.en: O Allah, praise be to You for the health of my body that I continue to enjoy.

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِي مِنْ عِلَّةٍ فِي جَسَدِي
segs.tr: Wa laka al-ḥamdu ‘alā mā aḥdathta bī min ‘illatin fī jasadī
segs.en: And praise be to You for the illness You brought upon my body.

segs.ar: فَمَا أَدْرِي يَا إِلَهِي أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ
segs.tr: Famā adrī yā ilāhī ayyu al-ḥālayni aḥaqqu bi-ash-shukri laka
segs.en: For I know not, O my God, which of the two states is more worthy of gratitude to You,

segs.tr: Wa ayyu al-waqtayni awlā bi-al-ḥamdi laka
segs.en: and which of the two times is more deserving of praise to You:

segs.ar: أَوَقْتُ الصِّحَّةِ الَّتِي هَنَّأْتَنِي فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ
segs.tr: Awaqtu aṣ-ṣiḥḥati allatī hanna’tanī fīhā ṭayyibāti rizqika
segs.en: The time of health, in which You delighted me with the good provisions,

segs.tr: Wa nashshaṭtanī bihā li-ibtighā’i marḍātika wa faḍlika
segs.en: and energized me with it to seek Your pleasure and Your favor,

segs.ar: وَقَوَّيْتَنِي مَعَهَا عَلَى مَا وَفَّقْتَنِي لَهُ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa qawwaytanī ma‘ahā ‘alā mā waffaqtanī lahu min ṭā‘atika
segs.en: and strengthened me with it for what You enabled me to do of Your obedience?

segs.ar: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مَحَّصْتَنِي بِهَا
segs.tr: Am waqtu al-‘illati allatī maḥḥaṣtanī bihā
segs.en: Or the time of illness, by which You purified me,

segs.ar: وَالنِّعَمِ الَّتِي أَتْحَفْتَنِي بِهَا تَخْفِيفًا لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهْرِي مِنَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
segs.tr: Wa an-ni‘ami allatī atḥaftanī bihā takhfīfan limā thaqula bihi ‘alā ẓahrī mina al-khaṭī’āti
segs.en: and the blessings You bestowed upon me to lighten what weighed heavily on my back of sins,

segs.ar: وَتَطْهِيرًا لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
segs.tr: Wa taṭhīran limā anghamastu fīhi mina as-sayyi’āti
segs.en: and to purify what I indulged in of misdeeds,
and as a reminder to seek repentance,

segs.tr: Wa tadhkīran limaḥwi al-ḥawbati biqadīmi an-ni‘mati
segs.en: and a reminder to erase sins with Your longstanding grace?

segs.ar: وَفِي خِلَالِ ذَلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ مِنْ زَكِيِّ الْأَعْمَالِ
segs.tr: Wa fī khilāli dhālika mā kataba liya al-kātibāni min zakiyyi al-a‘māli
segs.en: And amidst that, what the two angels recorded for me of pure deeds,

segs.ar: مَا لَا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ وَلَا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلَا جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ
segs.tr: Mā lā qalbun fakkara fīhi wa lā lisānun naṭaqa bihi wa lā jāriḥatun takallafathu
segs.en: which no heart conceived, nor tongue uttered, nor limb undertook,

segs.ar: بَلْ إِفْضَالًا مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ وَإِحْسَانًا مِنْ صَنِيعِكَ إِلَيَّ
segs.tr: Bal ifḍālan minka ‘alayya wa iḥsānan min ṣanī‘ika ilayya
segs.en: but as a favor from You upon me, and kindness from Your doing toward me.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family,

segs.tr: Wa ḥabbib ilayya mā raḍīta lī
segs.en: and make beloved to me what You have decreed for me,

segs.tr: Wa yassir lī mā aḥlalta bī
segs.en: and ease for me what You have brought upon me,

segs.tr: Wa ṭahhirnī min danasi mā aslaftu
segs.en: and purify me from the taint of what I have committed,
and erase from me the evil of what I have sent forth.
And grant me the sweetness of well-being,
and let me taste the coolness of safety.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إِلَى عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: And make my escape from my illness to Your pardon,
and my transition from my affliction to Your forbearance,

segs.tr: Wa khalāṣī min karbī ilā rawḥika
segs.en: and my deliverance from my distress to Your relief,

segs.ar: وَسَلَامَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إِلَى فَرَجِكَ
segs.tr: Wa salāmatī min hādhihi ash-shiddati ilā farajika
segs.en: and my safety from this hardship to Your ease.

segs.ar: إِنَّكَ الْمُتَفَضِّلُ بِالْإِحْسَانِ الْمُتَطَوِّلُ بِالِامْتِنَانِ الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
segs.tr: Innaka al-mutafaḍḍilu bi-al-iḥsāni al-mutaṭawwilu bi-al-imtināni al-wahhābu al-karīmu dhū al-jalāli wa al-ikrāmi
segs.en: For You are the Benefactor with kindness, the Bountiful with grace, the Generous Giver, Possessor of majesty and honor.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلاَمَةِ بَدَنِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma lakal-h'am-du a'laa maa lam azal atas'ar-rafu feehee min salaamati badanee
segs.en: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for the good health of my body which lets me move about,

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِيْ مِنْ عِلَّة فِي جَسَـدِي.
segs.tr: wa lakal-h'am-du a'laa maaa ah'-dath-ta bee min i'l-latin fee jasadee
segs.en: 2.and to You belongs praise, for the ailments which You causest to arise in my flesh!

segs.ar: فَمَا أَدْرِي يَـا إلهِي، أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: famaaa ad-ree yaaa ilaahee ay-yul-h'aalay-ni ah'aq-qu bish-shuk-ri laka?
segs.en: 3.For I know not, my God, which of the two states deserves more my thanking You
4.and which of the two times is more worthy for my praise of You:

segs.ar: أَوَقْتُ الصِّحَةِ الَّتِي هَنَّـأْتَنِي فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ،
segs.en: 5.the time of health, within which You makest me delight in the agreeable things of Your provision,

segs.tr: wa nash-shat'-tanee bihaa liab-tighaaa-i mar-z''aatika wafaz''-lik
segs.en: 6.through which You givest me the joy to seek the means to Your good pleasure and bounty,

segs.ar: وَقَوَّيْتَنِي مَعَهَا عَلَى مَـا وَفَّقْتَنِي لَهُ مِنْ طَـاعَتِـكَ
segs.tr: wa qaw-way-tanee maa'haa a'laa maa waf-faq-tanee lahoo min t'aaa'tika?
segs.en: 7.and by which You strengthenest me for the acts of obedience which You hast given me success to accomplish;

segs.ar: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مَحَّصْتَنِي بِهَا،
segs.en: 8.or the time of illness through which You puttest me to the test
9.and bestowest upon me favours:

segs.ar: تَخْفِيفاً لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهري مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ
segs.en: 10.lightening of the offenses that weigh down my back,

segs.ar: وَتَطْهيراً لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ ،
segs.en: 11.purification of the evil deeds into which I have plunged,

segs.ar: وَتَنْبِيهاً لِتَنَاوُلِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَتَذْكِيراً لِمَحْوِ الْحَوْبَةِ بِقَدِيمِ النِّعْمَةِ،
segs.en: 12.incitement to reach for repentance, reminder of the erasure of misdeeds through ancient favour;

segs.ar: وَفِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ
segs.tr: wa fee khilaali d'alika maa kataba leeal-kaatibaani
segs.en: 13.and, through all that, what the two writers write for me:

segs.ar: مِنْ زَكِيِّ الأعْمَالِ، مَا لا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ،
segs.tr: min zaky-yil-aa'-maal maa laa qal-bun fak-kara feeh
segs.en: 14.blameless acts, which no heart had thought,

segs.ar: وَلا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلاَ جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ بَلْ إفْضَالاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: wa laa lisaanun-nat'aqa bih wa laa jaarih'atun takal-lafat-h bal if-z''aalam-minka a'lay
segs.en: 15.no tongue had uttered, and no limb had undertaken, rather, as Your bestowal of bounty upon me
16.and the beneficence of Your benefaction toward me.
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa h'ab-bib ilay-ya maa raz''eeta lee
segs.en: 18.make me love what You hast approved for me,

segs.tr: wa yas-sir lee maaa ah'-lal-ta bee
segs.en: 19.make easy for me what You hast sent down upon me,

segs.tr: wa t'ah-hir-nee min danasi maaa as-laf-t
segs.en: 20.purify me of the defilement of what I have sent ahead,
21.erase the evil of what I have done beforehand,

segs.ar: وَأَوْجِدْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْعَافِيَةِ ، وَأَذِقْنِي بَرْدَ السَّلاَمَةِ
segs.tr: wa aw-jid-nee h'alaawatal-a'afeeah wa ad'iq-nee bar-das-salaamah
segs.en: 22.let me find the sweetness of well-being, let me taste the coolness of safety,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إلَى عَفْوِكَ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l makh-rajee a'n i'l-lateee ilaa a'f-wik
segs.en: 23.and appoint for me a way out from my illness to Your pardon,

segs.tr: wa mutah'aw-walee a'n s'ar-a'teee ilaa tajaawuzik
segs.en: 24.transformation of my infirmity into Your forbearance,

segs.tr: wa khalaas'ee min kar-beee ilaa raw-h'ik
segs.en: 25.escape from my distress to Your refreshment,

segs.ar: وَسَلاَمَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إلَى فَرَجِكَ،
segs.tr: wa salaamatee min hd'ihish-shid-dati ilaa farajik
segs.en: 26.and safety from this hardship in Your relief!
27.You art gratuitously bountiful in beneficence,
28.ever gracious in kindness, the Generous, the Giver,
29.Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ،
segs.en: 1.O God, O He through whose Mercy sinners seek aid!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ إلَى ذِكْرِ إحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ،
segs.tr: wa yaa man ilaa d'ik-ri ih'-saanihee yaf-zau'l-muz''-t'ar-roon
segs.en: 2.O He to the remembrance of whose beneficence the distressed flee!
3.O He in fear of whom the offenders weep!
4.O Comfort of every lonely stranger!

segs.tr: wa yaa faraja kul-li mak-roobin ka-eeb
segs.en: 5.O Relief of all who are downcast and distressed!

segs.tr: wa yaa ghaw-tha kul-li makh-d'oolin fareed
segs.en: 6.O Aid of everyone abandoned and alone!

segs.tr: wa yaa a'z''uda kul-li muh'-taajin t'areed
segs.en: 7.O Support of every needy outcast!

segs.ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً،
segs.en: 8.You art He who "embracest everything in mercy and knowledge"! (40:7)

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق فِي نِعَمِكَ سَهْماً،
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee jaa'l-ta likul-li makh-looqin fee nia'mika sah-maa
segs.en: 9.You art He who hast appointed for each creature a share of Your favours!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ،
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee a'f-wuhooo aa'-laa min i'qaabih
segs.en: 10.You art He whose pardon is higher than His punishment!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ،
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee tas-a'a rah'-matuhooo amaama ghaz''abih
segs.en: 11.You art He whose mercy runs before His wrath!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي عَطَآؤُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ،
segs.en: 12.You art He whose bestowal is greater than His withholding!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلاَئِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي رَحمَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee at-tasaa'l-khalaaa-iqu kul-luhum fee rah'matih
segs.en: 13.You art He by whose mercy all creatures are embraced!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يَرْغَبُ فِي جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ،
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee laa yar-ghabu fee jazaaa-i man aa'-t'aah
segs.en: 14.You art He who desires no repayment by him upon whom He bestows!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يُفْرِطُ فِي عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ.
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee laa yuf-rit'u fee i'qaabi man a's'aah
segs.en: 15.You art He who does not overdo the punishment of him who disobeys You!

segs.ar: وَأَنَا يَا إلهِي عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعاءِ فَقَالَ:
segs.tr: wa ana yaaa ilaahee a'b-dukal-lad'eee amar-tahoo bid-dua'aa-i faqaala:
segs.en: 16.And I, my God, am Your servant whom You commanded to supplicate and who said:

segs.ar: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
segs.tr: lab-bay-ka wa saa'-day-k haaa ana d'aa yaa rab-bi mat'-rooh'um-bay-na yaday-k
segs.en: 17.I am at Your service and disposal! Here am I, my Lord, thrown down before You.
18.I am he whose back offenses have weighed down!
19.I am he whose lifetime sins have consumed!

segs.ar: وَأَنَا الَّذِي بِجَهْلِهِ عَصاكَ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَهْلاً مِنْهُ لِذَاكَ.
segs.tr: wa anaal-lad'ee bijah-lihee a's'aak wa lam takun ah-lam-min-hoo lid'aak
segs.en: 20.I am he who was disobedient in his ignorance, while You didst not deserve that from him!

segs.ar: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
segs.tr: hal anta yaaa ilaahee raah'imum-man daa'aka faab-ligha fid-dua'aa-i?
segs.en: 21.Wilt Thou, my God, be merciful toward him who supplicates You, that I should bring my supplication before You?

segs.ar: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِي الْبُكَاءِ
segs.en: 22.Wilt You forgive him who weeps to You that I should hurry to weep?

segs.ar: أَمْ أَنْتَ مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلاً
segs.tr: am anta mutjaawizun a'm-man a'f-fara laka wj-hahoo tad'al-lula?
segs.en: 23.Wilt You show forbearance toward him who puts his face in the dust before You in lowliness?

segs.ar: أَم أَنْتَ مُغْن مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلاً؟
segs.tr: am anta mugh-nim-man shakaaa ilay-ka faq-rahoo tawak-kulaa
segs.en: 24.Wilt You free from need him who complains to You of his indigent need with confidence?

segs.ar: إلهِي لاَ تُخيِّبْ مَنْ لا يَجدُ مُعْطِياً غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: ilaahee laa tukhay-yib mal-laa yajidu mua'-t'eean ghay-rak
segs.en: 25.My God, disappoint not him who finds no bestower other than You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لا يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa takh-d'ul mal-laa yas-tagh-nee a'nka bih'adin doonak
segs.en: 26.and abandon not him who cannot be freed from his need for You through less than You!
27.My God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ ،
segs.tr: wa laa tua'-riz'' a'n-nee waqad aq-bal-tu a'lay-k
segs.en: 28.turn not away from me when I have turned my face toward You,

segs.tr: wa laa tah'-rim-nee waqad raghib-tu ilay-k
segs.en: 29.deprive me not when 1 have besought You,

segs.ar: وَلا تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدْ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa taj-bah-nee bir-rad-di waqadi antas'ab-tu bay-na yaday-k
segs.en: 30.and slap not my brow with rejection when I have stood before You!
31.You art He who has described Himself by mercy,
32.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالعَفْوِ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segs.tr: wa antal-lad'ee sam-may-ta naf-saka bil-a'f-wi faa'-fu a'n-nee
segs.en: 33.You art He who has named Himself by pardon so pardon me!

segs.ar: قَـدْ تَرَى يَـا إلهِي فَيْضَ دَمْعِي مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ،
segs.tr: qad t-taraa yaaa ilaahee fay-z''a dam-e'e min kheefatik
segs.en: 34.You hast seen, my God, the flow of my tears in fear of You,
35.the throbbing of my heart in dread of You,
36.and the infirmity of my limbs in awe of You.

segs.ar: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ حَيَاءٌ مِنْكَ لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي,
segs.en: 37.All this from my shame before You because of my evil works!

segs.ar: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِي عَنِ الْجَارِ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa lid'alik khamada s'aw-tee a'nil-jaa-ri ilay-k
segs.en: 38.So my voice has become silent, no longer crying to You,
39.and my tongue has gone dumb, no longer whispering in prayer.

segs.ar: يَا إلهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَكَم مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَم تَفْضَحْنِي،
segs.tr: yaaa ilaahee falakal-h'am-d fakam min a'aa-ibatin satar-tahaa a'lay-ya falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segs.en: 40.My God, so to You belongs praise! How many of my flaws You hast covered over without exposing me!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذنْبِ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي،
segs.tr: wa kam min d'ambin ghat'-t'ay-tahoo a'lay-ya falam tash-har-nee
segs.en: 41.How many of my sins You hast cloaked without making me notorious!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَة أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَهَا،
segs.tr: wa kam min shaaa-ibatin al-mam-tu bihaa falam tah-tik a'n-nee sit-rahaa
segs.en: 42.How many faults I have committed, yet You didst not tear away from me their covering,
43.collar me with their detested disgrace,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْأَتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِي مِنْ جِيْرَتِي،
segs.tr: wa lam tub-di saw-aaatihaa limay-yal-tamisu maa'ayibee min jeeratee
segs.en: 44.or make their dishonour plain to those of my neighbours who search for my defects
45.and to those who envy Your favour toward me!

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِي ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنّي
segs.tr: thum-ma lam yan-hanee d'alika a'n an jaray-tu ilaa sooo-i maa a'hit-ta min-nee
segs.en: 46.But that did not prevent me from passing on to the evil that You knowest from me!

segs.ar: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّي يَا إلهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
segs.tr: faman aj-halu min-nee yaaa ilaahee birush-dihi?
segs.en: 47.So who is more ignorant than I, my God, of his own right conduct?
48.Who is more heedless than I of his own good fortune?

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّي مِنِ اسْتِصْلاَحِ نَفْسِهِ
segs.tr: waman ab-a'du min-nee mini as-tis'-laahee naf-sihi?
segs.en: 49.Who is further than I from seeking to set himself right?

segs.ar: حِيْنَ اُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segs.tr: h'eena unfiqu maaa sj-ray-ta a'lay-ya mir-riz-qika
segs.en: 50.For I spend the provision You deliverest to me
51.in the disobedience You hast prohibited to me!

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ غَوْراً فِي الْبَاطِلِ وَأَشَدُّ إقْدَاماً عَلَى السُّوءِ مِنّي
segs.tr: wa man ab-a'du ghaw-ran fil-baat'il wa ashad-du iq-daaman a'laas-sooo-i min-nee?
segs.en: 52.Who sinks more deeply into falsehood and is more intensely audacious in evil than I?

segs.ar: حِينَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ،
segs.tr: h'eena aqifu bay-na daa'-watika wa daa'-watish-shay-t'aani
segs.en: 53.For I hesitate between Your call and the call of Satan

segs.ar: فَـأتَّبعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمىً مِنّي فِيْ مَعْرِفَة بِهِ،
segs.tr: faat-tabiu' daa'-watahoo a'laa ghay-r a'mam-min-nee fee maa'-rifatim-bih
segs.en: 54.and then follow his call without being blind in my knowledge of him

segs.ar: وَلا نِسْيَان مِنْ حِفْظِي لَهُ وَأَنَا حِينَئِذ مُوقِنٌ
segs.tr: wa laa nis-yaanim-min h'if-z'ee lah wa ana h'eena-id'im-mooqinum
segs.en: 55.or forgetful in my memory of him, while I am certain

segs.ar: بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إلَى النَّارِ
segs.tr: bianna muntahaa daa'-watika ilaal-jan-nah wa muntahaa daa'-watiheee ilaan-naar
segs.en: 56.that Your call takes to the Garden and his call takes to the Fire!

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ
segs.tr: sub-h'aanaka maaa aa'-jaba maaa ash-hadu bihee
segs.en: 57.Glory be to You! How marvellous the witness I bear

segs.ar: عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُوْمِ أَمْرِي،
segs.tr: a'laa naf-see wa ua'd-diduhoo mim-mak-toomi am-ree?
segs.en: 58.against my own soul and the enumeration of my own hidden affairs!

segs.tr: wa aa'-jabu min d'alika anaatuka a'n-nee
segs.en: 59.And more marvellous than that is Your lack of haste with me,

segs.tr: wa ib-t'aaaw-uka a'm-mua'ajalatee wa lay-sa d'alika
segs.en: 60.Your slowness in attending to me! That is not because I possess

segs.ar: مِنْ كَرَمِي عَلَيْكَ بَلْ تَأَنِّياً مِنْكَ لِي،
segs.tr: min karamee a'lay-k bal taan-neeam-minka lee
segs.en: 61.honour with You, but because You waitest patiently for me
62.and art bountiful toward me
63.that I may refrain from disobedience displeasing to You
64.and abstain from evil deeds that disgrace me,

segs.ar: وَلاَِنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنّي أَحَبُّ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي،
segs.tr: wa lian-na a'f-waka a'n-neee ah'ab-bu ilay-ka min u'qoobatee
segs.en: 65.and because You lovest to pardon me more than to punish!

segs.ar: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إلهِي أكْثَرُ ذُنُوباً
segs.tr: bal ana yaaa ilaahee ak'tha-ru d'unoobaa
segs.en: 66.But I, my God, am more numerous in sins,

segs.tr: wa aq-bahoo aaathaaraa wa ash-nau' af-a'alaa
segs.en: 67.uglier in footsteps, more repulsive in acts,
68.more reckless in rushing into falsehood,
69.weaker in awakening to Your obedience,
70.and less attentive and heedful toward Your threats,
71.than that I could number for You my faults
72.or have the power to recount my sins.

segs.ar: وَإنَّمَا أُوبِّخُ بِهَذا نَفْسِي طَمَعَـاً فِي رَأْفَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa in-namaaa uwab-bikhu bihad'aa naf-see t'amaa'na fee raa-fatik
segs.en: 73.I only scold my own soul, craving Your gentleness,
74.through which the affairs of sinners are set right,

segs.ar: وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ.
segs.en: 75.and hoping for Your mercy, through which the necks of the offenders are freed.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَهَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ،
segs.en: 76.O God, this is my neck, enslaved by sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ،
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-tiq-haa bia'f-wik
segs.en: 77.so bless Muhammad and his Household and release it through Your pardon!
78.This is my back, weighed down by offenses,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ.
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa khaf-fif a'n-hoo biman-nik
segs.en: 79.so bless Muhammad and his Household and lighten it through Your kindness!

segs.ar: يَا إلهِي لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ ،
segs.tr: yaaa ilaahee law bakay-tu ilay-ka h'at-taa tas-qut'a ash-faaru a'y-nay
segs.en: 80.My God, were I to weep to You until my eyelids drop off,
81.wail until my voice wears out,

segs.tr: wa qum-tu laka h'at-taa tatanash-shara qadamaay
segs.en: 82.stand before You until my feet swell up,

segs.tr: wa rakaa'-tu laka h'at-taa yan-khalia' s'ul-bee
segs.en: 83.bow to You until my backbone is thrown out of joint,

segs.tr: wa sajat-tu laka h'at-taa tatafaq-qaa h'adaqataay
segs.en: 84.prostrate to You until my eyeballs fall out,
85.eat the dirt of the earth for my whole life,
86.drink the water of ashes till the end of my days,

segs.ar: وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
segs.tr: wa d'akar-tuka fee khilaali d'alika h'at-taa yakil-la lisaanee
segs.en: 87.mention You through all of that until my tongue fails,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِي إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ
segs.tr: thum-ma lam ar-faa' t'ar-feee ilaaa aaafaaqis-samaaa-i as-tih'-yaaa-am-minka
segs.en: 88.and not lift my glance to the sky's horizons in shame before You,

segs.ar: مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذَلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَة وَاحِـدَة مِنْ سَيِّئـاتِي،
segs.en: 89.yet would I not merit through all of that the erasing of a single one of my evil deeds!

segs.ar: وَإنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِـرُ لِي حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segs.tr: wa in kunt tagh-firu lee h'eena as-taw-jibu magh-firatak
segs.en: 90.Though You forgivest me when I merit Your forgiveness

segs.tr: wa taa'-foo a'n-nee h'eena as-tah'iq-qu a'f-wak
segs.en: 91.and pardonest me when I deserve Your pardon,

segs.ar: فَإنَّ ذَلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِب لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاق،
segs.tr: fa in-na d'alika ghay-ru waajibil-lee bis-tih'-qaaqiw
segs.en: 92.yet I have no title to that through what I deserve,
93.nor am I worthy of it through merit,

segs.ar: إذْ كَـانَ جَزَائِي مِنْكَ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ;
segs.tr: id' kaana jazaaa-ee minka feee aw-wali maa a's'ay-tukan-naar
segs.en: 94.since my repayment from You from the first that I disobeyed You is the Fire!

segs.ar: فَإنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي، فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِيْ.
segs.tr: fa in tua'd'-d'ib-nee fa anta ghay-ru z'aalimil-lee
segs.en: 95.So if You punishest me, You dost me no wrong.

segs.ar: إلهِي فَـإذْ قَـدْ تَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِسِتْـرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
segs.tr: ilaahee faad' qad-tagham-mat-tanee bisit-rika falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segs.en: 96.My God, since You hast shielded me with Your covering and not exposed me,
97.waited patiently for me through Your generosity, and not hurried me to punishment,

segs.ar: َو حَلُمْتَ عَنِّي بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّـرْ نِعْمَتَـكَ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: wa h'alum-ta a'n-nee bitafaz''-z''ulika falam tughay-yir nia'-mataka a'lay-ya
segs.en: 98.and shown me clemency through Your bounty, and not changed Your favour upon me
99.or muddied Your kindly acts toward me,

segs.ar: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِـدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِيْ.
segs.tr: far-h'am t'oola taz''ar-rue'e wa shid-data mas-kanatee wa sooo-a maw-qifee
segs.en: 100.have mercy on my drawn out pleading, my intense misery, and my evil situation!
101.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
102.protect me from acts of disobedience, employ me in obedience,
103.provide me with excellent turning back [to You], purify me through repentance,
104.strengthen me through preservation from sin, set me right through well being,
105.let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness,

segs.tr: waj-a'l-nee t'aleeqa a'f-wika wa a'teeqa rah'-matik
segs.en: 106.make me the freedman of Your pardon and the slave released by Your mercy,
107.and write for me a security from Your displeasure!

segs.ar: وَبَشِّرْنِي بِذلِكَ فِي الْعَاجِلِ دُونَ الآجِلِ بُشْرى أَعْرِفُهَا
segs.tr: wa bash-shir-nee bid'alika fil-a'ajili doonal-aaajili bush-raaa aa'-rifuhaa
segs.en: 108.Give me the good news of that in the immediate, not the deferred - a good news I recognize -
109.and make known to me therein a sign which I may clearly see!

segs.ar: إنَّ ذلِكَ لاَ يَضيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُسْعِكَ ،
segs.tr: in-na d'alik laa yaz''eequ a'lay-ka fee wus-i'k
segs.en: 110.That will not constrain You in Your plenty,
111.distress You in Your power,
112.ascend beyond Your lack of haste,

segs.ar: وَلا يَؤودُك فِي جَزِيلِ هِباتِكَ الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
segs.tr: wa laa yaw-uduka fee jazeeli hibaatikal-latee dal-lat a'lay-haaa aaayaatuk
segs.en: 113.or tire You in Your great gifts, which are pointed to by Your signs.

segs.ar: إنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَحكُمُ مَا تُرِيدُ،
segs.tr: in-naka taf-a'lu maa tashaaa- wa tah'-kumu maa tureed
segs.en: 114.Verily You dost what You wilt, You decreest what You desirest.
115."Thou art powerful over everything". (3:26)
O Allah, we seek refuge in You,

segs.ar: مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ،
segs.tr: Min nazaġāti al-shayṭāni al-rajīmi wa-kaydihi wa-makā’idihi,
segs.en: From the instigations of the accursed Satan, and his plots and traps,

segs.ar: وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa-mina al-thiqati bi-amāniyyihi wa-mawā‘īdihi wa-ghurūrihi wa-maṣā’idihi,
segs.en: And from trusting in his false hopes, promises, deceptions, and snares,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ يُطْمِعَ نَفْسَهُ فِي إِضْلَالِنَا عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Wa-an yuṭmi‘a nafsahu fī iḍlālinā ‘an ṭā‘atika,
segs.en: Or that he should desire to mislead us away from obeying You,

segs.ar: وَامْتِهَانِنَا بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ، أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا،
segs.tr: Wa-imtihānanā bi-ma‘ṣiyatika, aw an yaḥsuna ‘indanā mā ḥassana lanā,
segs.en: And disgrace us with disobedience to You, or make seem good to us what he beautified for us,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إِلَيْنَا.
segs.tr: Aw an yathqula ‘alaynā mā karraha ilaynā.
segs.en: Or make burdensome to us what he has made hateful to us.
O Allah, drive him away from us through our worship of You,
And suppress him by our persistence in Your love,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْرًا لَا يَهْتِكُهُ،
segs.tr: Wa-aj‘al baynanā wa-baynahu sitran lā yahtikuhu,
segs.en: And place between us and him a veil he cannot tear,
And a solid barrier he cannot break open.
O Allah, bless Muḥammad and his family,
And occupy him away from us with some of Your enemies,

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ،
segs.tr: Wa-‘ṣimnā min’hu bi-ḥusni ri‘āyatika, wa-kfinā khatrahū,
segs.en: And protect us from him with Your good care, and suffice us from his harm,
Turn his back to us, and cut off his tracks from us.
O Allah, bless Muḥammad and his family,
Grant us enjoyment of guidance equal to his misguidance,
And provide us with piety as an opposite to his error,

segs.ar: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا مِنَ التُّقَى خِلَافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الرَّدَى.
segs.tr: Wasluk binā mina t-tuqa khilāfa sabīlihī mina r-radā.
segs.en: And lead us in the way of piety, against his path of ruin.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلًا،
segs.tr: Allāhumma lā taj‘al lahu fī qulūbinā madkhalan,
segs.en: O Allah, do not allow him an entry into our hearts,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُوَطِّنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلًا.
segs.tr: Wa-lā tuwaṭṭinanna lahu fīmā ladaynā manzilan.
segs.en: Nor let him establish any dwelling with us.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِلٍ فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa-mā sawwala lanā min bāṭilin fa-‘arifnāhū,
segs.en: O Allah, whatever falsehood he suggests to us, make us know it,

segs.ar: وَإِذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa-idhā ‘araftanāhū faqīnākahū, wa-baṣṣirnā mā nukāyiduhū bihī,
segs.en: And once You make us know it, protect us from it, and show us how to resist him with it,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إِلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: Wa-alhimnā mā nu‘idduhū lahū, wa-ayqiẓnā ‘an sinati l-ghaflati bi-r-rukūni ilayhī,
segs.en: And inspire us with what we prepare against him, and awaken us from the slumber of heedlessness by leaning toward him,
O Allah, occupy us from him with Your remembrance,
And protect us from him through obedience to You,
And suffice us against his burden through Your help,
And make us needless of his deceit through Your support,
And grant us the triumph of forgiveness, and the adornment of spoils.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make beloved to us the companionship of the righteous,
And open for us the doors of Your obedience,
And close for us the doors of disobedience,
And make us among the people of Your obedience,
And grant us sincerity in our deeds for You,
And reliance upon You, and submission to Your command.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make us mindful of You,
And grateful to You, and praising Your blessings,
And opposing Your enemy,
And loyal to Your friends,
And grant us the greatest share and the highest fortune.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make our livelihood pleasant,
And our lives happy,
And our sustenance abundant,
And our states upright,
And our secrets concealed,
And our needs fulfilled,
And our deeds accepted,
And our sins forgiven,
And our needs granted,
And our hopes attained,
And our good ends achieved,
And our good returns reached,
And our needs fulfilled,
And grant us safety in our homelands,
And rectify our leaders,
And the governors of our affairs,
And strengthen our authority,
And grant victory to our soldiers,
And protect our borders,
And keep us safe in our lands,
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
Amen, Lord of the worlds.
O God, we seek refuge in You

segs.ar: مِنْ نَزَغَـاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ،
segs.tr: min nazaghaati shay-t'aanir-rajeem wa kay-dihee wa makaaa-idih
segs.en: from the instigations of the accursed Satan, his trickery, and his traps,

segs.ar: وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَـانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ،
segs.tr: wa minath-thiqati bimaanee-yihee wa mawaae'edih wa ghuroorihee wa mas'aaa-idih
segs.en: from trust in his false hopes, his promises, his delusions, and his snares,
and lest he should make himself crave to lead us away
from Your obedience and to degrade us through our disobeying You,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا،
segs.tr: aw ay-yah'-suna i'ndanaa maa h'as-sana lanaa
segs.en: and lest what he has shown us as beautiful be beautiful for us

segs.ar: أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إلَيْنَا.
segs.tr: aw ay-yath-qula a'lay-naa maa kar-raha ilay-naa
segs.en: and what he has shown us as detestable weigh down upon us.
O God, drive him away from us through Your worship,
throw him down through our perseverance in Your love,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْراً لاَ يَهْتِكُهُ،
segs.en: and place between him and us a covering that he cannot tear away
and a solid barrier that he cannot cut through!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
distract Satan from us with some of Your enemies,

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ،
segs.tr: waa'-s'im-naa min-hoo bih'us-ni ria'ayatik wak-finaa khat-rah
segs.en: preserve us from him through Your good guarding, spare us his treachery,

segs.tr: wa wal-linaa z'ah-rah waq-t'aa' a'n-naaa ith-rah
segs.en: turn his back toward us, and cut off from us his trace!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give us to enjoy guidance the like of his misguidance,
increase us in piety against his seduction,

segs.ar: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَـا مِنَ التُّقى خِـلافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الـرَّدى.
segs.tr: was-luk binaa minat-tuqaa khilaafa sabeelihee minar-radaa
segs.en: and make us walk in reverential fear contrary to his path of ruin!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلاً
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa taj-a'l-lahoo fee quloobinaa mad-khalaa
segs.en: O God, assign him no place of entrance into our hearts

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلاً.
segs.tr: wa laa toot'inan-na lahoo feemaa laday-naa manzilaa
segs.en: and do not allow him to make his home in that which is with us!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِل فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa maa saw-wala lanaa mim-baat'ilin faa'r-rif-naahoo
segs.en: O God, cause us to recognize the falsehood with which he tempts us,

segs.ar: وَإذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa id'aa a'r-raf-tanaahoo faqinaahu wa bas'-s'ir-naa maa nukaayiduhoo bih
segs.en: and once You hast caused us to recognize it, protect us from it! Make us see what will allow us to outwit him,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wa al-him-naa maa nui'd-duhoo lah wa ay-qiz'-naa a'n sinatil-ghaf-lati bir-rukooni ilay-h
segs.en: .inspire us with all that we can make ready for him, awaken us from the heedless slumber of relying upon him,
and help us well, through Your giving success, against him!

segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa ash-rib quloobanaaa inkaara a'malih
segs.en: O God, saturate our hearts with the rejection of his works
and be gentle to us by destroying his stratagems!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa h'aw-wil sul-t'aanahoo a'n-naa
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn his authority away from us,

segs.ar: وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا ، وادْرَأْه عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا.
segs.tr: waq-t'aa' rajaaa-ahoo min-naa wad-raa-hoo a'nil-wlooi' binaa
segs.en: cut off his hope from us, and keep him from craving for us!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: waj-a'l aaabaaa-anaa wa um-mahaatinaa wa aw-laadanaa wa ahaaleenaa
segs.en: and place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our wives,

segs.tr: wa d'aweee ar-h'aaminaa wa qaraabaatinaa wa jeeraananaa
segs.en: our siblings, our relatives, and the faithful among our neighbours,

segs.ar: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـاتِ مِنْهُ فِي حِرْز حَـارِز،
segs.tr: minal-moo-mineena wal-moo-minaati min-hoo fee h'ir-zin h'aariz
segs.en: male and female, in a sanctuary impregnable to him,

segs.ar: وَحِصْن حَافِظ ، وَكَهْف مَانِع، وَألْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَناً وَاقِيَةً،
segs.tr: wa h'is'-nin h'aafiz' wa kah-fim-maania'- wa al-bis-hum min-hoo junanaw-waaqeeah
segs.en: And a protective fortress, and a shielding cave, and clothe them with protective shields from Him.
and give them arms that will cut him down!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma waa'-mum bid'alika man- shahida laka bir-rubwbee-yah
segs.en: O God, include in that everyone who witnesses to You as Lord,
devotes himself sincerely to Your Unity,
shows enmity toward him through the reality of servanthood,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ.
segs.en: and seeks help from You against him through knowledge of the divine sciences!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ، وَافْتقْ مَا رَتَقَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma ah'-lul maa a'qad waf-tuq maa rataq
segs.en: O God, undo what he ties, unstitch what he sews up,

segs.ar: وَافسَخ مَا دَبَّرَ، وَثَبِّطْهُ إذَا عَزَمَ، وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ.
segs.tr: waf-sakh maa dab-bar wa thab-bit'-hooo id'aa a'zam wanquz'' maaa ab-ram
segs.en: dislocate what he devises, frustrate him when he makes up his mind, and destroy what he establishes!

segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wah-zim jundah wa ab-t'il kay-dah
segs.en: O God, rout his troops, nullify his trickery,
make his cave collapse, and rub his nose in the ground!
O God, place us in the ranks of his enemies
and remove us from the number of his friends,
that we obey him not when he entices us

segs.tr: wa laa nas-tajeebu lahooo id'aa daa'anaa
segs.en: and answer him not when he calls to us!
We command everyone who obeys our command to be his enemy

segs.ar: وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا.
segs.tr: wa nai'z'u a'm-mutaabaa'tihee mani at-tabaa' zaj-ranaa
segs.en: and we admonish everyone who follows our prohibition not to follow him!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madin khaatamin-nabee-yeena wa say-yidil-mur-saleena
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad the Seal of the prophets and lord of the emissaries,
and the folk of his house, the good, the pure!
Give refuge to us, our families, our brothers,

segs.ar: وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ،
segs.en: and all the faithful, male and female, from that from which we seek refuge,

segs.ar: وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
segs.tr: wa ajir-naa mim-mas-tajar-naa bika min khaw-fih
segs.en: and grant us sanctuary from that through fear of which we seek sanctuary in You!

segs.ar: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِيْنَاهُ،
segs.tr: was-maa' lanaa maa daa'w-naa bih wa a'-t'inaa maaa agh-fal-naah wah'-faz' lanaa maa naseenaah
segs.en: Hear our supplication to You, bestow upon us that of which we have been heedless, and safeguard for us what we have forgotten!
Through all this bring us into the ranks of the righteous
and the degrees of the faithful!
Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segs.en: O Allah, to You belongs all praise for the goodness of Your decree,
And for what You have averted from me of Your trials,

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَجْعَلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Falā taj‘al ḥaẓẓī min raḥmatika mā ‘ajjalta lī min ‘āfiyatika,
segs.en: So do not make my share of Your mercy what You hastened for me of well-being,

segs.ar: فَأَكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segs.tr: Fa-akūna qad shaqītu bimā aḥbabtu wa-sa‘ida ghayrī bimā karihtu,
segs.en: So that I may end up wretched through what I loved, while others are happy with what I disliked,

segs.ar: وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ،
segs.tr: Wa-in yakun mā ẓaliltu fīhi aw bitu fīhi min hādhihi al-‘āfiyah,
segs.en: And if what I spent my day or night in of this well-being,

segs.ar: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاءٍ لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ وَوِزْرٍ لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ،
segs.tr: Bayna yaday balā’in lā yanqaṭi‘u wa-wizrin lā yartafi‘u,
segs.en: Is before a trial that does not cease, and a burden that does not lift,

segs.ar: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنِّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ،
segs.tr: Faqaddim lī mā akhkharta wa-akhkhir ‘annī mā qaddamta,
segs.en: Then advance for me what You have delayed, and delay from me what You have advanced,

segs.ar: فَغَيْرُ كَثِيرٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْفَنَاءُ وَغَيْرُ قَلِيلٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْبَقَاءُ،
segs.tr: Faghayru kathīrin mā ‘āqibatuhu al-fanā’ wa-ghayru qalīlin mā ‘āqibatuhu al-baqā’,
segs.en: For what ends in perishing is not great, and what ends in lasting is not small,
And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segs.en: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your excellent accomplishment
2.and for Your trial which You hast turned away from me!

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: falaa taj-a'l h'az'-z'ee mir-rah'-matika maa a'j-jal-ta lee min a'afeeatika
segs.en: 3.But make not my share of Your mercy the well-being which You hast quickly granted to me,

segs.ar: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segs.tr: faakoona qad- shaqeetu bimaaa ah'-bab-t wa sai'da ghay-ree bimaa karih-t
segs.en: 4.lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

segs.ar: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
segs.tr: wa ee-yakum-maa z'alil-tu feeheee aw bit-tu feehee min had'ihil-a'afeeah
segs.en: 5.If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

segs.ar: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
segs.tr: bay-na yaday balaaa-il-laa yanqat'ia'- wa wiz-ril-laa yar-tafia'-
segs.en: 6.should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

segs.ar: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
segs.tr: faqad-dim lee maaa akh-khar-t wa akh-khir a'n-nee maa qad-dam-t
segs.en: 7.then set before me what You hadst set behind and set behind me what You hadst set before!
8.For that which ends in annihilation is not great
9.and that which ends in subsistence is not little.
10.And bless Muhammad and his Household!
O Allah, grant us rain,
And spread over us Your mercy with abundant rain,

segs.ar: مِنَ السَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيعِ الآفَاقِ،
segs.tr: Mina al-saḥābi al-munsāqi linabāti arḍika al-mūniqi fī jamī‘i al-āfāqi,
segs.en: From the clouds driven to nourish Your earth in all horizons,
And bless Your servants with fruitful harvests,
And revive Your lands with flourishing blossoms.
And call Your noble angels as witnesses,
With beneficial, continuous rain from You,
Its pearls widespread, a fast and swift downpour,

segs.ar: تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَاتَ، وَتَرُدُّ بِهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
segs.tr: Tuḥyī bihi mā qad māta, wa tarddu bihi mā qad fāta,
segs.en: It revives what has died, restores what has passed,

segs.tr: Wa tukhriju bihi mā huwa ātin,
segs.en: And brings forth what is coming,
And increases the sustenance abundantly,
Clouds piled, pleasing and full, in layers,
Thundering, not obscured, its drops,
And its lightning is not destructive.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مَغِيثًا مَرِيعًا مُمْرِعًا عَرِيْضًا،
segs.tr: Allāhumma usqinā ghaythan maghīthan marī‘an mumri‘an ‘arīḍan,
segs.en: O Allah, grant us rain that is life-giving, vast, and spreading,

segs.ar: وَاسِعًا غَزِيرًا تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
segs.tr: Wāsi‘an ghazīran tarddu bihi al-nahīdha wa tajburu bihi al-mahīdh,
segs.en: Abundant and copious, restoring floods and replenishing the streams.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْيًا تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرَابَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma usqinā saqyan tusīlu minhu al-ẓirāb,
segs.en: O Allah, let it flow as a river of nourishment,
Filling all reservoirs,
And cause rivers to gush forth,
And grow trees,

segs.ar: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأَسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيعِ الأَمْصَارِ،
segs.tr: Wa turkhisu bihi al-as‘āra fī jamī‘i al-amṣār,
segs.en: And make goods affordable in all lands,

segs.tr: Wa tun‘ishu bihi al-bahā’ima wa al-khalq,
segs.en: And revive animals and all creatures,

segs.tr: Wa tukmilu lanā bihi ṭayyibāti al-rizq,
segs.en: And complete for us the blessings of sustenance,
And cause our crops to grow,
And provide milk from livestock,

segs.tr: Wa tazīdunā bihi quwwatan ilā quwwatinā,
segs.en: And increase our strength.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُومًا
segs.en: O Allah, do not let its shade be harmful to us,
And do not let its coldness be destructive to us,
And do not let its fall strike us,
And do not let its water become brackish upon us.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āli Muḥammad,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.tr: Wa urzuqnā min barakāti al-samāwāti wa al-arḍ,
segs.en: And provide us from the blessings of the heavens and the earth,
Indeed, You are capable of all things.
1.O God, water us with rain,
2.unfold upon us Your mercy through Your copious rain

segs.ar: مِنَ الْسَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَـاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيـعِ الآفَاقِ،
segs.en: 3.from the driven clouds, so that Your goodly earth may grow on all horizons!
4.Show kindness to Your servants through the ripening of the fruit,
5.revive Your land through the blossoming of the flowers,
6.and let Your angels - the noble scribes - be witness
7.to a beneficial watering from You, lasting in its abundance,
8.plenty in its flow, heavy, quick, soon,

segs.ar: تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَات، وَتَرُدُّ بهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
segs.tr: tuh'-yee bihee maa qad maat wa tarud-du bihee maa qad faat
segs.en: 9.through which You revivest what has died, returnest what has vanished,

segs.tr: wa tukh-riju bihee maa huwa aaat
segs.en: 10.bringest forth what is coming,
11.and providest plentiful foods,
12.through heaped up, wholesome, productive clouds, in reverberating layers,
13.the rain's downpour not without cease,
14.the lightning's flashes not without fruit!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مَغيثَاً مَرِيعاً مُمْرِعاً عَرِيْضَاً،
segs.en: 15.O God, give us water through rain, helping, productive, fertilizing, widespread,

segs.ar: وَاسِعاً غَزِيراً تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
segs.tr: waasia'na ghazeeraa tarud-du bihin-naheez'' wa taj-buru bihil-maheez''
segs.en: 16.plentiful, abundant, bringing back the risen, restoring the broken!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْياً تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرابَ،
segs.en: 17.O God, give us water with a watering through which You wilt make the stone hills pour,
18.fill the cisterns,
19.flood the rivers,
20.make the trees grow,

segs.ar: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيع الأمْصَارِ،
segs.en: 21.bring down prices in all the lands,
22.invigorate the beasts and the creatures,
23.perfect for us the agreeable things of provision,
24.make grow for us the fields,
25.let flow for us the teats,

segs.tr: wa tazeedunaa bihee qoo-watan ilaa qoo-watinaa
segs.en: 26.and add for us strength to our strength!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa taj-a'l z'il-lahoo a'lay-naa samoomaa
segs.en: 27.O God, make not the cloud's shadow over us a burning wind,

segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l bar-dahoo a'lay-naa h'usoomaa
segs.en: 28.allow not its coldness to be cutting,

segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l s'aw-bahoo a'lay-naa rujoomaa
segs.en: 29.let not its pouring down upon us be a stoning,

segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l maaa-ahoo a'lay-naaa ujaajaa
segs.en: 30.and make not its waters for us bitter!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.en: 31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and provide us with the blessings of the heavens and the earth!
33."Thou art powerful over everything"! (3:26)
In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith,
make my certainty the most excellent certainty,

segs.ar: وَانتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّاتِ، وَبِعَمَلِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ الأَعْمَاِل
segs.tr: wantahi bi-ni-yati ila ah-san-ni-yati wa bi-a'mali ila ah-sanil-a'-mal
segs.en: and take my intention to the best of intentions, and my works to the best of works!
O Allah,
complete my intention through Your gentleness,
rectify my certainty through what is with You,
And set right what is corrupt in me through Your power!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
spare me the concerns which distract me,
employ me in that about which You will ask me tomorrow,
And let me pass my days in that for which You hast created me!

segs.tr: wa agh-nini wa aw-sia' a'lay-ya fi rizqik
segs.en: Free me from need, and expand Your provision toward me,
And tempt me not with ingratitude!

segs.tr: wa ai'z-za ni wa-la tab-tali-yani-y bil-kib-r
segs.en: Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

segs.ar: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلا تُفْسِدْ عِبِادَتِي بِالعُجْبِ
segs.tr: wa a'b-bid-ni laka wa-la tuf-sid i'bidati bil-u'j-b
segs.en: Make me worship You and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

segs.ar: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ
segs.tr: wa aj-ri lin-nasi a'la yaday-yal-khayra wa-la tam-haq-hu bil-man-n
segs.en: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!
Give me the highest moral traits
And preserve me from vainglory!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَلا تَرْفَعْنِي فِي النَّاسِ دَرَجَةً إِلا حَطَطْتَنِي عِندَ نَفْسِي مِثْلَهَا
segs.tr: wa la tar-fa'-ni fin-nasi darajatan il-la hatat-tani i'nda naf-si mith-laha
segs.en: raise me not a single degree before the people without lowering me its like in myself

segs.ar: وَلا تُحْدِثْ لِي عِزّاً ظَاهِراً إِلاَّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِندَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا
segs.tr: wa-la tuh-dith li i'z-zan zahiran il-la ah-dath-ta li dhil-latam batinatan i'nda naf-si biqadariha
segs.en: And bring about no outward exaltation for me without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.tr: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segs.ar: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدَىً صَاِلحٍ لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa mat-tia'-ni bihudan salihil-la as-tabdilu bih
segs.en: give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace,
a path of truth from which I swerve not,
And an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

segs.ar: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِي بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عُمْرِي مَرْتَعاً لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ، قَبْلَ أَن يَّسْبِقَ مَقْتُكَ إِلَيَّ، أَوْ يَسْتَحْكِمَ غَضَبُكَ عَلَيَّ
segs.tr: wa a'mmir-ni ma kana u'm-ri bidhlatan fi ta'tika fa-idha kana u'm-ri mar-ta'al-lish-shaytani faq-bizni ilayka qab-la ayyasbiqa maq-tuka ilay-ya aw yas-tah-kima ghazabuka a'lay-ya
segs.en: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying You, but if my life should become a pasture for Satan, seize me to Yourself before Your hatred overtakes me or Your wrath against be becomes firm!
O Allah,

segs.ar: لا تَدَعْ خِصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إِلاَّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا
segs.tr: la tada' khas-latan tua'abu min-ni il-la as-lah-taha
segs.en: deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless You settest it right,

segs.ar: وَلا عَائِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إِلاَّ حَسَّنتَهَا،
segs.tr: wa-la a'a-ibatan uan-nabu biha il-la has-santaha
segs.en: no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless You makest it beautiful,

segs.ar: وَلا أُكْرُومَةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إِلاَّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا
segs.tr: wa-la uk-rumatan fi-ya naqisatan il-la at-mam-taha
segs.en: And no deficient noble trait, unless You completest it!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.tr: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segs.ar: وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بُغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَانَ الْمَحَبَّةَ
segs.en: and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love,
the envy of the people of insolence with affection,
the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,
the enmity of those close with friendship,
the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion,
the abandonment of relatives with help,
the attachment of flatterers with love set right,
the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness,

segs.ar: وَمِن مَّرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمنَةَ
segs.en: And the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَل لِّي يَداً عَلى مَن ظَلَمَنِي،
segs.en: appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me,
a tongue against him who disputes with me,
And a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَن كَايَدَنِي،
segs.tr: wa hab li mak-ran a'la man kayadani
segs.en: Give me guile against him who schemes against me,
power over him who oppresses me,
refutation of him who reviles me,
And safety from him who threatens me!
Grant me success to obey him who points me straight
And follow him who guides me right!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and point me straight to
resist him who is dishonest toward me without counsel,
repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion,
reward him who deprives me with free giving,
recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

segs.ar: وَأُخَاِلفَ مَنْ اغْتَابَنِي إِلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ،
segs.en: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention,
give thanks for good,
And shut my eyes to evil!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
adorn me with the adornment of the righteous,
And clothe me in the ornaments of the god-fearing, through:
spreading justice,
restraining rage,
quenching the flame of hate,
bringing together the people of separation,
correcting discord,
spreading about good behavior,
covering faults,
mildness of temper,
lowering the wing,
beauty of conduct,
gravity of bearing,
agreeableness in comportment,
precedence in reaching excellence,
preferring bounteousness,
refraining from condemnation,
bestowing bounty on the undeserving,
speaking the truth, though it be painful,

segs.ar: وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِن كَثُرَ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segs.tr: was-tiq-lalil-khayri wa in kathura min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segs.en: making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much,

segs.ar: وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الْشَّرِ وَإِن قلَّ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segs.tr: was-tik-tharish-shari wa in ql-la min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segs.en: And making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!
Perfect this for me through
lasting obedience,
holding fast to the community,

segs.ar: وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ، وَمُسْتَعْمِلِي الرَّأْيِ الْمُخْتَرَعِ
segs.en: And rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إِذَا كَبِرْتُ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l aw-sa' rizqika a'lay-ya idha kabir-tu
segs.en: appoint for me Your widest provision in my old age

segs.tr: wa aq-wa qu-watika fi-ya idha nasib-tu
segs.en: And Your strongest strength when I am exhausted,
And try me not with laziness in worship of You,
blindness toward Your path,
undertaking what opposes love for You,
joining with him who has separated himself from You,
And separating from him who has joined himself to You!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَصُولُ بِكَ عِندَ الضَّرُورَةِ،
segs.en: O Allah, make me leap to You in times of distress,
ask from You in needs,
And plead to You in misery!

segs.ar: وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالإِسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إِذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ،
segs.en: Tempt me not to seek help from other than You when I am distressed,

segs.ar: وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤَاِل غَيْرِكَ إِذَا افْتَقَرْتُ،
segs.en: to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor,

segs.ar: وَلا بِالتَّضَرُّعِ إِلَى مَن دُونِكَ إِذَارَهِبْتُ
segs.tr: wa-la bit-tazar-rui' ila man dunaka idharahib-tu
segs.en: or to plead with someone less than You when I fear,

segs.tr: fas-tahiq-qu bidhlika khidhlanaka wa man-a'ka wa ia'-razak
segs.en: for then I would deserve Your abandonment, Your withholding, and Your turning away,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي منِ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَدِذِكْراً لِعَظَمَتِكَ، وَتَفَكُّراً فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَتَدْبِيراً عَلَى عَدُوِّكَ،
segs.tr: allahummaj-a'l ma yul-qish-shaytanu fi raw-e'e mint-taman-ni wat-tazan-ni wal-hasadidhik-ral-li-a'zamatika wa tafak-kuran fi qud-ratika wa tad-biran a'la a'du-wika
segs.en: O Allah, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart a remembrance of Your mightiness, a reflection upon Your power, and a devising against Your enemy!

segs.ar: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِى مِن لَّفْظَةِ فُحْشٍ أَوْ هَجْرٍ أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْضٍ أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِلٍ أَوِ اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِنٍ غَائِبٍ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِرٍ أَوْ مَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ،
