segs.tr: wa ma aj-ra a'la li-sani mil-laf-zati fuh-shin aw haj-rin aw shat-mi i'r-zin aw shahadati batilin awigh-tiyabi mu-minin gha-ibin aw sab-bi hazirin aw ma ash-baha dhalika
segs.en: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue - the indecent or ugly words, the maligning of good repute, the false witness, the speaking ill of an absent man of faith, or the reviling of one present, and all things similar—
a speech in praise of You,
a pursual of eulogizing You,
an excursion in magnifying You,
a thanksgiving for Your favour,
an acknowledgment of Your beneficence,
And an enumeration of Your kindness!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَلا أُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنتَ مُطِيقٌ لِّلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي
segs.tr: wa-la uzlaman-na wa anta mutiqul-lid-daf-i' a'n-ni
segs.en: let me not be wronged, while You canst repel from me,

segs.ar: وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي
segs.tr: wa-la azliman-na wa antal-qadiru a'lil-qab-zi min-ni
segs.en: let me not do wrong, while You are powerful over holding me back,

segs.tr: wa-la azil-lan-na wa qad am-kanat-ka hidayati
segs.en: let me not be misguided, while You are able to guide me,

segs.tr: wa-la af-taqiran-na wa min i'ndika wus-e'e
segs.en: let me not be poor, while with You is my plenty,

segs.tr: wa-la at-ghayan-na wa min i'ndika wuj-di
segs.en: let me not be insolent, while from You comes my wealth!
O Allah,
I come to Your forgiveness,
I go straight to Your pardon,
I yearn for Your forbearance,
And I trust in Your bounty,

segs.ar: وَلَيْسَ عِندِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segs.tr: wa laysa i'ndi ma yujibu li magh-firatak
segs.en: but there is nothing with me to make me warrant but Your forgiveness,

segs.ar: وَلا فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ
segs.tr: wa-la fi a'mali ma as-tahiq-qu bihi a'f-wak
segs.en: nothing in my works to make me merit but Your pardon,

segs.ar: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ
segs.tr: wa ma li ba'-da an hakam-tu a'la naf-si il-la fazluka
segs.en: And nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Your bounty,
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
O Allah, bestow Your bounty upon me!
make my speech be guidance,
inspire me with reverential fear,
give me success in that which is most pure,
And employ me in what is most pleasing to You!
O Allah, let me tread the most exemplary path

segs.tr: waj-a'l-ni a'la mil-latika amutu wa ah-ya
segs.en: And make me live and die in Your creed!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give me to enjoy moderation,
make me into one of the people of right behavior,
the proofs of right conduct,
And the servants of righteousness,
And provide me with triumph at the place of Return
And safety from the Ambush!
O Allah,

segs.ar: خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُخَلِّصُهَا
segs.en: take to Yourself from my soul what will purify it

segs.ar: وَأَبْقِ لِنَفْسِي مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُصْلِحُهَا،
segs.tr: wa ab-qi linaf-si min-naf-si ma yus-lihuha
segs.en: And leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right,
for my soul will perish unless You preservest it!
O Allah,
You are my stores when I sorrow,
You are my recourse when I am deprived,
from You I seek aid when troubled
and with You is a substitute for everything gone by,
a correction for everything corrupted,
a change from everything You is approvest.
So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction,
wealth before asking,
right conduct before misguidance;
suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants,
give me security on the Day of Return,
And grant me excellent right guidance!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
repel from me through Your gentleness,
feed me through Your favour,
set me right through Your generosity,
heal me through Your benefaction,
shade me in Your shelter,
wrap me in Your good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي إِذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأُمُورُ لأَهْدَاهَا،
segs.en: And give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me,
the purest of works when works seem similar,
and the most pleasing to You of creeds when creeds conflict!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
crown me with sufficiency,
place in me excellent guardianship
give me to guide correctly ,
tempt me not with plenty,
grant me excellent ease,
make not my life toil and trouble,
And refuse not my supplication in rejection,
for I make none rival to You
And I supplicate none with You as equal!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
hold me back from prodigality,
fortify my provision against ruin,
increase my possessions through blessing them,

segs.ar: وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا أُنفِقُ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: wa asib bi sabilal-hidayati lil-bir-ri fima unfiqu minh
segs.en: And set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
And spare me the burden of earning,
provide for me without reckoning,
lest I be distracted from Your worship through seeking
And carry the load of earning's ill results!
O Allah,
bestow upon me what I seek through Your power
And grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Your might!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
save my face through ease,
And demean not my dignity through neediness,
lest I seek provision from those whom You hast provided
And ask for bestowal from the worst of Your creatures!
And Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me
afflicted with blaming him who held back from me,

segs.ar: وَأَنتَ مِن دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإِعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ
segs.tr: wa anta min dunihim wali-yul-ia'-ta-i wal-man-i'
segs.en: While You— not they— art patron of giving and holding back
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
And provide me with soundness in worship,
detachment in renunciation,
knowledge put into action,
And abstinence in measure!
O Allah, seal my term with Your pardon,

segs.tr: wa haq-qiq fi raja-i rah-matika amali
segs.en: verify my expectation in hoping for thy mercy,

segs.tr: wa sah-hil ila bulughi rizaka subuli
segs.en: smooth my paths to reach Your good pleasure,

segs.tr: wa has-sin fi jamii' ah-wali a'mali
segs.en: And make my works good in all my states!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
Incite me to remember You in times of heedlessness,
employ me in Your obedience in days of disregard,

segs.ar: وَانْهَجْ لِي إِلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبِيلاً سَهْلَةً
segs.tr: wan-haj li ila mahab-batika sabilan sah-lah
segs.en: open a smooth road for me to Your love,

segs.ar: أَكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
segs.en: And complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ وَأَنتَ مُصَلٍّ عَلى أَحَدٍ بَعْدَهُ
segs.tr: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-lihi ka-af-zali ma sal-layta a'la ahadim min khal-qika qab-lahu wa anta musal-lin a'la ahadim-ba'-dah
segs.en: O Allah, and bless Muhammad and his Household the best You hast blessed any of Your creatures before him and wilt bless any of them after him,

segs.ar: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
segs.tr: wa a-tina fid-dunya hasanataw-wa fil-a-khirati hasanah
segs.en: And give to us in this world good, and in the next world good,
And protect me through Your mercy from the chastisement of the Fire!

segs.ar: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيٍْء قَدِيرٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ
segs.tr: in-naka a'la kul-li shay-in qadiruw-wahua a'ilayka yasir
segs.en: You are powerful over everything, and that is easy for You!
O Allah, O Sufficer of the solitary and weak
And Protector from the feared matter
My sins have isolated me, so I have no companion

segs.ar: وَضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ فَلَا مُؤَيِّدَ لِي
segs.tr: Wa ḍa‘uftu ‘an ghaḍabika falā mu’ayyida lī
segs.en: I am weak against Your anger, with no supporter for me

segs.ar: وَأَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ فَلَا مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي
segs.tr: Wa ashaftu ‘alā khawfi liqā’ika falā musakkina liraw‘atī
segs.en: I face the fear of meeting You, with no calmer for my dread

segs.tr: Wa man yu’minunī minka wa anta akhaftanī
segs.en: Who can secure me from You when You have frightened me?

segs.tr: Wa man yusā‘idunī wa anta afradtanī
segs.en: Who can aid me when You have left me alone?

segs.tr: Wa man yuqawwīnī wa anta aḍ‘aftanī
segs.en: Who can strengthen me when You have weakened me?

segs.ar: لَا يُجِيرُ يَا إِلَهِي إِلَّا رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوبٍ
segs.tr: Lā yujīru yā ilāhī illā rabbun ‘alā marbūbin
segs.en: None grants refuge, O my God, but a Lord over His servant

segs.ar: وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ إِلَّا غَالِبٌ عَلَى مَغْلُوبٍ
segs.tr: Wa lā yu’minu illā ghālibun ‘alā maghlūbin
segs.en: None secures but a Victor over the vanquished

segs.ar: وَلَا يُعِينُ إِلَّا طَالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوبٍ
segs.tr: Wa lā yu‘īnu illā ṭālibun ‘alā maṭlūbin
segs.en: None aids but a Seeker over the sought

segs.ar: وَبِيَدِكَ يَا إِلَهِي جَمِيعُ ذَلِكَ السَّبَبِ
segs.tr: Wa biyadika yā ilāhī jamī‘u dhālika as-sababi
segs.en: In Your hand, O my God, is the cause of all this
And to You is the escape and refuge
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa ajir harabī wa anjiḥ maṭlabī
segs.en: Grant me refuge and fulfill my request

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ إِنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيمَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka in ṣarafta ‘annī wajhaka al-karīma
segs.en: O Allah, if You turn Your noble face away from me
Or withhold Your immense favor from me

segs.ar: أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّي سَبَبَكَ
segs.tr: Aw ḥaẓarta ‘alayya rizqaka aw qaṭa‘ta ‘annī sababaka
segs.en: Or deny me Your provision or cut off Your means

segs.ar: لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيلَ إِلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمَلِي غَيْرَكَ
segs.tr: Lam ajidi as-sabīla ilā shay’in min amalī ghayraka
segs.en: I will find no way to any of my hopes except through You

segs.ar: وَلَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُونَةِ سِوَاكَ
segs.tr: Wa lam aqdir ‘alā mā ‘indaka bima‘ūnati siwāka
segs.en: Nor can I attain what is with You except by Your aid

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ
segs.tr: Fa innī ‘abduka wa fī qabḍatika nāṣiyatī biyadika
segs.en: For I am Your servant, my forelock is in Your grasp
I have no command alongside Your command

segs.ar: مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
segs.en: Your judgment upon me is executed, Your decree is just

segs.ar: وَلَا قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْخُرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā quwwata lī ‘alā al-khurūji min sulṭānika
segs.en: I have no strength to escape Your authority
Nor can I surpass Your power

segs.ar: وَلَا أَسْتَمِيلُ هَوَاكَ وَلَا أَبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā astamīlu hawāka wa lā ablughu riḍāka
segs.en: Nor win Your favor, nor attain Your pleasure

segs.ar: وَلَا أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إِلَّا بِطَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā anālu mā ‘indaka illā biṭā‘atika
segs.en: Nor obtain what is with You except through Your obedience
And by the grace of Your mercy

segs.ar: إِلَهِي أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَمْسَيْتُ عَبْدًا دَاخِرًا لَكَ
segs.tr: Ilāhī aṣbaḥtu wa amsaytu ‘abdan dākhiran laka
segs.en: My God, I have become and remain a humbled servant to You

segs.ar: لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا بِكَ
segs.tr: Lā amliku linafsī naf‘an wa lā ḍarran illā bika
segs.en: I possess no benefit or harm for myself except through You
I bear witness to this against myself

segs.tr: Wa a‘tarifu biḍa‘fi quwwatī wa qillati ḥīlatī
segs.en: And I confess my weakness of strength and scarcity of means
So fulfill for me what You promised me
And complete for me what You have granted me
For I am Your poor, submissive servant
The weak, the blind, the humbled
The lowly, the despised, the needy
The fearful, the one seeking refuge
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي نَاسِيًا لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي
segs.tr: Wa lā taj‘alnī nāsiyan lidhikrika fīmā awlaytanī
segs.en: And do not make me forgetful of Your remembrance in what You grant me

segs.tr: Wa lā ghāfilan li-iḥsānika fīmā ablaytanī
segs.en: Nor heedless of Your kindness in what You test me with

segs.ar: وَلَا آيِسًا مِنْ إِجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإِنْ أَبْطَأَتْ عَنِّي
segs.tr: Wa lā āyisan min ijābatika lī wa in abṭa’at ‘annī
segs.en: Nor despairing of Your response to me, even if it is delayed
In ease or hardship
Or difficulty or comfort
Or well-being or trial
Or misery or blessings
Or prosperity or adversity
Or poverty or wealth
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa aj‘al thanā’ī ‘alayka wa madḥī iyyāka
segs.en: And make my praise for You and my extolling of You

segs.tr: Wa ḥamdī laka fī kulli ḥālātī
segs.en: And my gratitude to You in all my states

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā afraḥa bimā ātaytanī mina ad-dunyā
segs.en: So I do not rejoice in what You give me of this world

segs.ar: وَلَا أَحْزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا
segs.tr: Wa lā aḥzana ‘alā mā mana‘tanī fīhā
segs.en: Nor grieve over what You withhold from it
And instill in my heart Your piety

segs.tr: Wa ista‘mil badanī fīmā taqbaluhu minnī
segs.en: And employ my body in what You accept from me
And occupy my soul with Your obedience
From all that comes to me

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا أُحِبَّ شَيْئًا مِنْ سُخْطِكَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā uḥibba shay’an min sukhṭika
segs.en: So I do not love anything of Your displeasure

segs.tr: Wa lā askhaṭa shay’an min riḍāka
segs.en: Nor be displeased with anything of Your pleasure
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And empty my heart for Your love
And occupy it with Your remembrance

segs.tr: Wa an‘ashhu bikhawfika wa bil-wajali minka
segs.en: And revive it with Your fear and awe of You
And strengthen it with longing for You
And incline it toward Your obedience

segs.ar: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: Wa ajri bihi fī aḥabbi as-subuli ilayka
segs.en: And guide it on the most beloved paths to You
And humble it with desire for what is with You
All the days of my life

segs.tr: Wa aj‘al taqwāka mina ad-dunyā zādī
segs.en: And make Your piety my provision from this world
And to Your mercy my journey
And in Your pleasure my entry
And make Your paradise my abode

segs.tr: Wa hab lī quwwatan aḥtamilu bihā
segs.en: And grant me strength to bear
All of Your pleasure
And make my flight to You
And my desire for what is with You

segs.ar: وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرَارِ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: Wa albis qalbī al-waḥshata min shirāri khalqika
segs.en: And clothe my heart with alienation from the wicked of Your creation
And grant me intimacy with You
And with Your friends and the people of Your obedience

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِفَاجِرٍ وَلَا كَافِرٍ عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً
segs.tr: Wa lā taj‘al lifājirin wa lā kāfirin ‘alayya minnatan
segs.en: And do not let a sinner or disbeliever have favor over me
Nor let them have a hand over me
Nor let me have need of them
Rather, make my heart’s tranquility
And my soul’s intimacy and sufficiency

segs.tr: Wa kifāyatī bika wa bikhiyāri khalqika
segs.en: And my contentment with You and the best of Your creation
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And make me a companion to them
And make me a supporter for them
And favor me with longing for You

segs.tr: Wa bil-‘amali laka bimā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā
segs.en: And with working for You in what You love and are pleased with
Indeed, You are capable of all things
And that is easy for You

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِيَ الْفَرْدِ الضَعِيْفِ، وَوَاقِيَ الامْرِ الْمَخُوْفِ،
segs.en: 1.O God, O Sufficer of the isolated and weak and Protector against terrifying affairs!
2.Offenses have isolated me, so there is none to be my companion.

segs.ar: وَضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ; فَلاَ مُؤَيِّدَ لِي،
segs.tr: wa z''au'f-tu a'n ghaz''abika falaa moo-ay-yida lee
segs.en: 3.I am too weak for Your wrath and there is none to strengthen me.

segs.ar: وَأَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ; فَلاَ مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي،
segs.tr: wa ash-raf-tu a'laa khaw-fi liqaaa-ika falaa musak-kina liraw-a'tee
segs.en: 4.I have approached the terror of meeting You and there is none to still my fear.

segs.tr: wa may-yoo-minunee minka wa anta akhaf-tanee?
segs.en: 5.Who can make me secure from You when You hast filled me with terror?
6.Who can come to my aid when You hast isolated me?
7.Who can strengthen me when You hast weakened me?

segs.ar: لاَ يُجيرُ يا إلهي إلاّ رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوب،
segs.tr: laa yujeeru yaaa ilaaheee il-laa rab-bun a'laa mar-boob
segs.en: 8.None can grant sanctuary to a vassal, my God, but a lord,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُؤْمِنُ إلاّ غالِبٌ عَلَى مَغْلُوب،
segs.tr: wa laa yoo-minu il-laa ghaalibun a'laa magh-loob
segs.en: 9.none can give security to one dominated but a dominator,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُعِينُ إِلاّ طالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوب،
segs.tr: wa laa yue'enu il-laa t'aalibun a'laa mat'-loob
segs.en: 10.none can aid him from whom demands are made but a demander.

segs.ar: وَبِيَـدِكَ يَـاَ إلهِي جَمِيعُ ذلِكَ السَّبَبِ، وَإلَيْكَ الْمَفَرُّ وَالْمَهْربُ.
segs.tr: wa beeadika yaaa ilaahee jameeu' d'alikas-sabab wa ilay-kal-mafar-ru wal-mah-rab
segs.en: 11.In Your hand, my God, is the thread of all that, in You the place of escape and flight,
12.so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa ajir harabee wa anjih' mat'-labee
segs.en: 13.give sanctuary to me in my flight, and grant my request!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ إنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيْمَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-naka in s'araf-ta a'n-nee waj-hakal-kareem
segs.en: 14.O God, if You shouldst turn Your generous face away from me,
15.withhold from me Your immense bounty,

segs.ar: أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّي سَبَبَـكَ
segs.tr: aw h'az'ar-ta a'lay-ya riz-qak aw qat'aa'-ta a'n-nee sababak
segs.en: 16.forbid me Your provision, or cut off from me Your thread,

segs.ar: لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيـلَ إلَى شَيْء مِنْ أَمَلِي غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: lam ajidis-sabeela ilaa shay-im-min amalee ghay-rak
segs.en: 17.I will find no way to anything of my hope other than You

segs.ar: وَلَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُونَةِ سِوَاكَ; فَإنِّي عَبْدُكَ،
segs.tr: wa lam aq-dir a'laa maa i'ndaka bimau'wnati siwaak fa in-nee a'b-duka
segs.en: 18.nor be given power over what is with You through another's aid, for I am Your servant

segs.ar: وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، لاَ أَمْرَ لِي مَعَ أَمْرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa fee qab-z''atik naas'eeatee beeadik laaa am-ra lee maa' am-rik
segs.en: 19.and in Your grasp; my forelock is in Your hand. I have no command along with Your command.

segs.ar: مَاض فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ،
segs.tr: maaz''in fee-ya h'uk-muk a'd-lun fee-ya qaz''aaaw-uk
segs.en: 20.'Accomplished is Your judgement of me, just Your decree for me!'

segs.ar: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْخُـرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِـكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa qoo-wata lee a'laal-khurooji min sul-t'aanik
segs.en: 21.I have not the strength to emerge from Your authority
22.nor am I able to step outside Your power.

segs.ar: وَلاَ أَسْتَـمِيلُ هَوَاكَ، وَلاَ أبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ،
segs.tr: wa laaa as-tameelu hawaak wa laaa ab-lughu riz''aak
segs.en: 23.I cannot win Your inclination, arrive at Your good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَلاَ أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إلاَّ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَبِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa laaa anaalu maa i'ndaka il-laa bit'aaa'tika wabifaz''-li rah'-matik
segs.en: 24.or attain what is with You except through obeying You and through the bounty of Your mercy.

segs.ar: إلهِي أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَمْسَيْتُ عَبْداً دَاخِراً لَكَ،
segs.tr: ilaaheee as'-bah'-tu wa am-say-tu a'b-dana daakhiral-lak
segs.en: 25.O God, I rise in the morning and enter into evening as Your lowly slave.

segs.ar: لا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً إلاَّ بِكَ
segs.tr: laaa am-liku linaf-see naf-a'w-wa laa z''ar-ran il-laa bik
segs.en: 26.I own no profit and loss for myself except through You.

segs.ar: أَشْهَدُ بِذَلِكَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَأَعْتَـرِفُ بِضَعْفِ قُـوَّتِي وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
segs.tr: ash-hadu bid'alika a'laa naf-see wa aa'-tarifu biz''aa'-fi qoo-watee wa qil-lati h'eelatee
segs.en: 27.I witness to that over myself and I confess to the frailty of my strength and the paucity of my stratagems.

segs.ar: فَأَنْجزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي، وَتَمِّمْ لِي مَا آتَيْتَنِي;
segs.tr: fa anjiz lee maa waa't-tanee wa tam-mim lee maaa aaatay-tanee
segs.en: 28.So accomplish what You hast promised me and complete for me what You hast given me,
29.for I am Your slave, miserable, abased, frail,

segs.ar: الضَّـرِيـرُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمَهِينُ الْفَقِيرُ الْخَائِفُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ.
segs.en: 30.distressed, vile, despised, poor, fearful, and seeking sanctuary!
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي نَاسِيَاً لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي،
segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l-nee naaseeal-lid'ik-rika feemaaa aw-lay-tanee
segs.en: 32.and let me not forget to remember You in what You hast done for me,
33.be heedless of Your beneficence in Your trying me,

segs.ar: وَلا آيسَاً مِنْ إجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإنْ أَبْطَأتَ عَنِّي
segs.tr: wa laaa aaayisam-min ijaabatika lee wa in ab-t'aat a'n-nee fee
segs.en: 34.or despair of Your response to me, though it keep me waiting,

segs.ar: فِي سَرَّاءَ كُنْتُ أَوْ ضَرَّاءَ، أَوْ شِدَّة أَوْ رَخَاء،
segs.tr: sar-raaa-a kuntu aw z''ar-raaa wa shid-datin aw rakhaaa-
segs.en: 35.whether I be in prosperity or adversity, hardship or ease,

segs.ar: أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ بَلاء، أَوْ بُؤْس أَوْ نَعْمَاءَ،
segs.tr: aw a'afeeatin aw balaaa- aw boo-sin aw naa'-maaa-
segs.en: 36.well-being or affliction, misery or comfort,

segs.ar: أَوْ جِدَة أَوْ لأوَاءَ، أَوْ فَقْر أَوْ غِنىً.
segs.tr: aw jidatin aw laa-waaa-a aw faq-rin aw ghinana
segs.en: 37.wealth or distress, poverty or riches!
38.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: waj-a'l thanaaa-ee a'lay-ka wa mad-h'eee ee-yaaka
segs.en: 39.make me laud You, extol You,

segs.tr: wa h'am-dee laka fee kul-li h'aalaatee h'at-taa
segs.en: 40.and praise You in all my states

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا،
segs.en: 41.so that I rejoice not over what You givest me of this world

segs.ar: وَلاَ أَحْـزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا،
segs.tr: wa laaa ah'-zana a'laa maa manaa'-tanee feehaa
segs.en: 42.nor sorrow over that of it which You withholdest from me!
43.Impart reverential fear of You to my heart,
44.employ my body in that which You acceptest from me,

segs.ar: وَاشْغَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ نَفْسِي عَنْ كُلِّ مَايَرِدُ عَلَىَّ
segs.tr: wa ash-ghal bit'aaa'tika naf-see a'n kul-li maa yaridu a'lay-ya
segs.en: 45.and divert my soul through obedience to You from all that enters upon me,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ اُحِبَّ شَيْئَاً مِنْ سُخْطِكَ،
segs.en: 46.so that I love nothing that displeases You
47.and become displeased at nothing that pleases You!
48.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa far-righ qal-bee limah'ab-batik wash-ghal-hoo bid'ik-rik
segs.en: 49.empty my heart for Your love, occupy it with remembering You,
50.animate it with fear of You and quaking before You,

segs.ar: وَقَوِّهِ بِالرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَأَمِلْهُ إلَى طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa qaw-wihee bir-ragh-bati ilay-k wa amil-hooo ilaa t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 51.strengthen it with beseeching You, incline it to Your obedience,

segs.ar: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إلَيْكَ،
segs.en: 52.set it running in the path most beloved to You,

segs.ar: وَذَلِّلْهُ بِالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ أَيَّامَ حَيَاتِي كُلِّهَا،
segs.tr: wa d'al-lil-hoo bir-ragh-bati feemaa i'ndaka ay-yaama h'ayaatee kul-lihaa
segs.en: 53.and subdue it through desire for what is with You all the days of my life!
54.Let my provision in this world be reverential fear of You (ref. 2:197),

segs.ar: وَإلَى رَحْمَتِكَ رِحْلَتِي، وَفِي مَرْضَاتِكَ مَدْخَلِي.
segs.tr: wa ilaa rah'-matika rih'-latee wa fee mar-z''aatika mad-khalee
segs.en: 55.my journey be toward Your mercy, and my entrance be into Your good pleasure!
56.Appoint for me a lodging in Your Garden,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي قُوَّةً أَحْتَمِلُ بِهَا جَمِيعَ مَرْضَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa hab lee qoo-watan ah'-tamilu bihaa jameea' mar-z''aatik
segs.en: 57.give me strength to bear everything that pleases You,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ فِرَارِي إلَيْكَ، وَرَغْبَتِي فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l firaareee ilay-ka wa ragh-batee feemaa i'ndak
segs.en: 58.make me flee to You and desire what is with You,

segs.ar: وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرارِ خَلْقِكَ.
segs.tr: wa al-bis qal-beel-wah'-shata min shiraari khal-qik
segs.en: 59.clothe my heart in estrangement from the evil among Your creatures,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي الأُنْسَ بِكَ وَبِأَوْلِيَـآئِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa hab leeal-unsa bika wa biw-leeaaa-ika wa ah-li t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 60.and give me intimacy with You, Your friends, and those who obey You!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِـفَاجِـر وَلا كَافِر عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً،
segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l-lifaajiriw-wa laa kaafirin a'lay-ya min-nataw
segs.en: 61.Assign to no wicked person or unbeliever a kindness toward me

segs.ar: وَلاَ لَـهُ عِنْدِي يَداً، وَلا بِي إلَيْهِمْ حَاجَةً،
segs.tr: wa laa lahoo i'ndee yadaw-wa laa beee ilay-him h'aajah
segs.en: 62.or a hand that obliges me, nor to me a need for one of them!

segs.ar: بَل اجْعَـلْ سُكُـونَ قَلْبِي وَاُنْسَ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: bali aj-a'l sukoona qal-bee wa unsa naf-see
segs.en: 63.Rather make the stillness of my heart, the comfort of my soul,

segs.tr: was-tigh-naaa-ee wa kifaayatee bika wa bikheeaari khal-qik
segs.en: 64.my independence and my sufficiency lie in You and the best of Your creatures!
65.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ قَـرِيناً، وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ نَصِيْراً،
segs.tr: waj-a'l-nee lahum qareenaa waj-a'l-nee lahum nas'eeraa
segs.en: 66.make me their comrade, make me their helper,

segs.ar: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِشَوْق إلَيْكَ، وَبِالْعَمَلِ لَكَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى
segs.tr: wam-nun a'lay-ya bishaw-qin ilay-ka wa bil-a'mali laka bimaa tuh'ib-bu watar-z''aa
segs.en: 67.and oblige me with yearning for You and doing for You what You lovest and approvest!
68."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26)
69.and that is easy for You.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ كَلَّفْتَنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا أَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهِ مِنِّي
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka kallafnī min nafsī mā anta amlaku bihi minnī
segs.en: O Allah, You have tasked me with what You control over me

segs.ar: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيَّ أَغْلَبُ مِنْ قُدْرَتِي
segs.tr: Wa qudratuka ‘alayhi wa ‘alayya aghlabu min qudratī
segs.en: Your power over it and me surpasses my own power

segs.ar: فَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي
segs.tr: Fa a‘ṭinī min nafsī mā yurḍīka ‘annī
segs.en: So grant me from myself what pleases You about me

segs.ar: وَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ رِضَاهَا مِنْ نَفْسِي فِي عَافِيَةٍ
segs.tr: Wa khudh linafsika riḍāhā min nafsī fī ‘āfiyatin
segs.en: And take for Yourself its pleasure from me in well-being
O Allah, I have no strength for striving
Nor patience for affliction
Nor strength against poverty
So do not withhold my provision from me
Nor entrust me to Your creation

segs.tr: Bal tafarrad biḥājatī wa tawallā kifāyatī
segs.en: Rather, take sole charge of my needs and undertake my sufficiency

segs.ar: وَانْظُرْ إِلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِي
segs.tr: Wa anẓur ilayya wa anẓur lī fī jamī‘i umūrī
segs.en: Look upon me and care for me in all my affairs

segs.ar: فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا
segs.tr: Fa innaka in wakaltanī ilā nafsī ‘ajaztu ‘anhā
segs.en: For if You entrust me to myself, I will fail it

segs.tr: Wa lam uqim mā fīhi maṣlaḥatuhā
segs.en: And not fulfill what is in its best interest

segs.tr: Wa in wakaltanī ilā khalqika tajahhamūnī
segs.en: And if You entrust me to Your creation, they will frown upon me

segs.tr: Wa in alja’tanī ilā qarābatī ḥaramūnī
segs.en: And if You force me to my kin, they will deprive me

segs.tr: Wa in a‘ṭaw a‘ṭaw qalīlan nakidan
segs.en: And if they give, they give little, grudgingly

segs.tr: Wa mannū ‘alayya ṭawīlan wa dhammū kathīran
segs.en: And they will remind me of it endlessly and blame me much
So by Your grace, O Allah, make me self-sufficient
And by Your greatness, revive me
And by Your vastness, open my hand
And with what is with You, suffice me
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And deliver me from envy
And restrain me from sins
And make me pious against the forbidden
And do not embolden me toward disobedience
And make my desire be with You
And my contentment in what comes to me from You
And bless me in what You have provided me

segs.ar: وَفِيمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي وَفِيمَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ
segs.tr: Wa fīmā khawwaltanī wa fīmā an‘amta bihi ‘alayya
segs.en: And in what You entrusted to me and favored me with

segs.tr: Wa aj‘alnī fī kulli ḥālātī maḥfūẓan
segs.en: And make me in all my states protected
Guarded, covered, defended, sheltered, and granted refuge
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And fulfill for me all that You obligated upon me

segs.ar: وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِي وَجْهٍ مِنْ وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa faraḍtahu ‘alayya laka fī wajhin min wujūhi tā‘atika
segs.en: And prescribed for me in any form of Your obedience
Or for one of Your creation
Even if my body is too weak for it
And my strength fails in it
And my ability cannot reach it

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالِي وَلَا ذَاتُ يَدِي
segs.tr: Wa lam yasa‘hu māli wa lā dhātu yadī
segs.en: And my wealth or means cannot encompass it
Whether I remembered or forgot it

segs.ar: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ
segs.tr: Huwa yā rabbi mimmā qad aḥṣaytahu ‘alayya
segs.en: It is, O Lord, among what You have recorded against me
And I neglected it from myself
So discharge it for me from Your abundant gifts
And the plentiful that is with You
For You are vast and generous

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْءٌ مِنْهُ
segs.en: So that nothing of it remains upon me

segs.ar: تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِي بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي
segs.tr: Turīdu an tuqāṣṣanī bihi min ḥasanātī
segs.en: By which You would deduct from my good deeds
Or multiply my evil deeds
On the day I meet You, O Lord
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِي الرَّغْبَةَ فِي الْعَمَلِ لَكَ لِآخِرَتِي
segs.tr: Wa arzuqnī ar-raghbata fī al-‘amali laka li-ākhiratī
segs.en: And grant me the desire to work for You for my hereafter

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي
segs.tr: Ḥattā a‘rifa ṣidqa dhālika min qalbī
segs.en: Until I know the sincerity of that in my heart

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِي دُنْيَايَ
segs.tr: Wa ḥattā yakūna al-ghālibu ‘alayya az-zuhdu fī dunyāya
segs.en: And until detachment from my world prevails over me
And until I perform good deeds with longing

segs.tr: Wa āmana mina as-sayyi’āti faraqa wa khawfan
segs.en: And am safe from evil deeds out of fear and dread

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي نُورًا أَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ
segs.tr: Wa hab lī nūran amshī bihi fī an-nāsi
segs.en: And grant me a light by which I walk among people
And am guided by it in the darkness

segs.tr: Wa astaḍī’u bihi mina ash-shakki wa ash-shubuhāti
segs.en: And find illumination through it from doubt and confusion
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me fear of the distress of Your warning
And longing for the reward of Your promise

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ
segs.tr: Ḥattā ajida ladhdhata mā ad‘ūka lahu
segs.en: Until I find the sweetness of what I supplicate to You for

segs.tr: Wa ka’ābata mā astajīru bika minhu
segs.en: And the sorrow of what I seek refuge in You from
O Allah, You know what reforms me
In the matters of my world and my hereafter
So be attentive to my needs

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa āli Muḥammadin
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِي الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِي فِي الشُّكْرِ لَكَ
segs.tr: Wa arzuqnī al-ḥaqqa ‘inda taqṣīrī fī ash-shukri laka
segs.en: And grant me truthfulness despite my shortcomings in thanking You

segs.ar: بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِي الْيُسْرِ وَالْعُسْرِ
segs.tr: Bimā an‘amta ‘alayya fī al-yusri wa al-‘usri
segs.en: For what You have favored me with in ease and hardship
And health and illness

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِي رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
segs.tr: Ḥattā ata‘arrafa min nafsī rawḥa ar-riḍā
segs.en: Until I recognize within myself the spirit of contentment
And the tranquility of my soul from me
For what is due to You in what occurs
In states of fear and security
And contentment and displeasure
And harm and benefit
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.tr: Wa arzuqnī salāmata aṣ-ṣadri mina al-ḥasadi
segs.en: And grant me purity of heart from envy

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا أَحْسُدَ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā aḥsuda aḥadan min khalqika
segs.en: So that I do not envy anyone of Your creation
For anything of Your favor

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لَا أَرَى نِعْمَةً مِنْ نِعَمِكَ
segs.tr: Wa ḥattā lā arā ni‘matan min ni‘amika
segs.en: And so that I do not see a blessing of Your blessings

segs.ar: عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فِي دِينٍ
segs.en: Upon anyone of Your creation in religion

segs.ar: أَوْ دُنْيَا أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ تَقْوَى
segs.en: Or worldly life, or well-being, or piety
Or abundance, or ease
Except that I hope for myself something better than that

segs.ar: بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segs.tr: Bika wa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka
segs.en: Through You and from You alone, with no partner
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me caution against sins

segs.tr: Wa al-iḥtirāsa mina az-zalali fī ad-dunyā
segs.en: And vigilance against missteps in this world

segs.tr: Wa al-ākhirati fī ḥāli ar-riḍā wa al-ghaḍabi
segs.en: And the hereafter, in states of contentment and anger

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَكُونَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا
segs.en: So that I may be, with what comes to me from them
In an equal state, acting in Your obedience
Preferring Your pleasure over anything else
With friends and foes

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّي مِنْ ظُلْمِي وَجَوْرِي
segs.tr: Ḥattā ya’mana ‘aduwwī min ẓulmī wa jawrī
segs.en: So that my enemy is safe from my injustice and oppression
And my friend despairs of my inclination
And the degradation of my desires

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصًا فِي الرَّخَاءِ
segs.tr: Wa aj‘alnī mimman yad‘ūka mukhliṣan fī ar-rakhā’i
segs.en: And make me among those who call upon You sincerely in ease
With the supplication of the sincere, compelled to You
In supplication, for You are praiseworthy and glorious

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ كَلَّفْتَنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا أَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهِ مِنِّي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nak kal-laf-tanee min-naf-see maaa anta am-laku bihee min-nee
segs.en: 1.O God, You hast charged me concerning myself with that which belongs more to You than to me.

segs.ar: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيَّ أَغْلَبُ مِنْ قُدْرَتِي،
segs.tr: wa qud-ratuka a'lay-hee waa'lay-ya agh-labu min qud-ratee
segs.en: 2.Your power over it and over me is greater than my power,

segs.ar: فَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي،
segs.en: 3.so give me in myself what will make You pleased with me

segs.ar: وَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ رِضَاهَا مِنْ نَفْسِي فِي عَافِيَة.
segs.tr: wa khud' linaf-sika riz''aahaa min-naf-see fee a'afeeah
segs.en: 4.and take for Yourself Your good pleasure in my self's well-being!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِالجَهْدِ ، وَلاَ صَبْرَ لِي عَلَى البَلاَءِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa t'aaqata lee bil-jah-d wa laa s'ab-ra lee a'laal-balaaa
segs.en: 5.O God, I have no endurance for effort, no patience in affliction,

segs.ar: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْفَقْرِ، فَلاَ تَحْظُرْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي،
segs.tr: wa laa qoo-wata lee a'laal-faq-r falaa tah'-z'ur a'lay-ya riz-qee
segs.en: 6.no strength to bear poverty. So forbid me not my provision

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِيْ إلَى خَلْقِكَ بَلْ تَفَرَّدْ بِحَاجَتِي، وَتَولَّ كِفَايَتِي،
segs.tr: wa laa takil-neee ilaa khal-qik bal tafar-rad bih'aajatee wa tawal-la kifaayatee
segs.en: 7.and entrust me not to Your creatures, but take care of my need alone and Yourself attend to sufficing me!

segs.ar: وَانْظُرْ إلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِي فِي جَمِيْعِ اُمُورِي،
segs.tr: wanz'ur ilay-ya wanz'ur lee fee jameei' umooree
segs.en: 8.Look upon me and look after me in all my affairs,

segs.ar: فَإنَّكَ إنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى نَفْسِي عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا،
segs.tr: fa in-naka iw-wakal-taneee ilaa naf-see a'jaz-tu a'n-haa
segs.en: 9.for if You entrust me to myself, I will be incapable before myself

segs.tr: wa lam uqim maa feehee mas'-lah'atuhaa
segs.en: 10.and fail to undertake that in which my best interest lies.
11.If You entrust me to Your creatures, they will frown upon me,

segs.tr: wa in al-jaa-taneee ilaa qaraabatee h'aramoonee
segs.en: 12.and if You makest me resort to my kinsfolk, they will refuse to give to me;
13.if they give, they will give little and in bad temper,
14.making me feel long obliged and blaming me much.
15.So through Your bounty, O God, free me from need, through Your mightiness, lift me up,

segs.ar: وَبِسَعَتِكَ فَابْسُطْ يَدِي، وَبِمَا عِنْدَكَ فَاكْفِنِي.
segs.tr: wa bisaa'tika fab-sut' yadee wa bimaa i'ndaka fak-finee
segs.en: 16.through Your boundless plenty, open my hand, and with that which is with You, suffice me!
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنَ الْحَسَدِ، وَاحْصُرْنِي عَن الذُّنُوبِ،
segs.en: 18.rid me of envy, encircle me against sins,

segs.ar: وَوَرِّعْنِي عَنِ الْمَحَارِمِ، وَلا تُجَرِّئْنِي عَلَى الْمَعَاصِي،
segs.tr: wa war-ria'-nee a'nil-mah'aarim wa laa tujar-ri-nee a'laal-maa'as'ee
segs.en: 19.make me abstain from things unlawful, give me not the boldness of disobedient acts,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ هَوايَ عِنْدَكَ، وَرِضَايَ فِيمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l hawaaya i'ndaka wa riz''aaya feemaa yaridu a'lay-ya mink
segs.en: 20.assign me love for that which is with You and satisfaction with that which comes to me from You,

segs.ar: وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَفِيمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي،
segs.tr: wa baarik lee feemaa razaq-tanee wafeemaa khaw-wal-tanee
segs.en: 21.bless me in that which You providest me, that which You conferrest upon me,

segs.ar: وَفِيمَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي
segs.tr: wa feemaaa an-a'm-ta bihee a'lay waj-a'l-nee fee kul-li h'aalaatee
segs.en: 22.and that through which You favourest me, and make me in all my states

segs.ar: مَحْفُوظَاً مَكْلُوءاً مَسْتُوراً مَمْنُوعاً مُعَاذاً مُجَاراً.
segs.en: 23.safeguarded, watched, covered, defended, given refuge, and granted sanctuary!
24.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَاقْضِ عَنِّي كُلّ مَا أَلْزَمْتَنِيهِ وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِي وَجْه مِنْ وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.tr: waq-z''i a'n-nee kul-la maaa al-zam-taneehee wa faraz''-tahoo a'lay-ya laka fee waj-him-miw-wujoohee t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 25.and let me accomplish everything which You hast enjoined upon me or made obligatory for me toward You, in one of the ways of Your obedience,

segs.ar: أَوْ لِخَلْق مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَإنْ ضَعُفَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ بَدَنِي، وَوَهَنَتْ عَنْهُ قُـوَّتِي،
segs.tr: aw likhal-qim-min khal-qik wa in z''au'fa a'n d'alika badanee wa wahanat a'n-hoo qoo-watee
segs.en: 26.or toward one of Your creatures, though my body be too frail for that, my strength too feeble,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تَنَلْهُ مَقْدِرَتِي، وَلَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالِي وَلاَ ذَاتُ يَدِي، ذَكَرْتُهُ أَوْ نَسِيتُهُ
segs.tr: wa lam tanal-hoo maq-duratee wa lam yasaa'-hoo maalee wa laa d'aatu yadee d'akar-tuhooo aw naseetuh
segs.en: 27.my power not able to reach it, and my possessions and what my hand owns not encompass it, and whether I have remembered it or forgotten it.

segs.ar: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَأَغْفَلْتُهُ أَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِي،
segs.tr: huwa yaa rab-bi mim-maa qad ah'-s'ay-tahoo a'lay wa agh-fal-tuhooo ana min-naf-see
segs.en: 28.It, my Lord, is among that which You hast counted against me while I have been heedless of it in myself.

segs.ar: فَأَدِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيْلِ عَطِيَّتِكَ وَكَثِيرِ مَا عِنْدَكَ،
segs.tr: faad-dihee a'n-nee min jazeeli a't'ee-yatika wa kabeeri maa i'ndaka
segs.en: 29.Let me perform it through Your plentiful giving and the abundance which is with You

segs.ar: فَإنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: fa in-naka waasiu'n kareemun h'at-taa laa yab-qaa a'lay-ya shay-um min-hoo
segs.en: 30.- for You art Boundless, Generous - so that nothing of it may remain against me,

segs.ar: تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِي بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي،
segs.tr: tureedu an tuqaaas'-s'anee bihee min h'asanaatee
segs.en: 31.lest You wouldst wish to settle accounts for it from my good deeds

segs.ar: أَوْ تُضَاعِفَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ يَا رَبِّ.
segs.tr: aw tuz''aai'fa bihee min say-yi-aatee yaw-ma al-qaaka yaa rab
segs.en: 32.or to compound my evil deeds on the day I meet You, my Lord!
33.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِي الرَّغْبَةَ فِي الْعَمَـلِ لَكَ لآخِـرَتِي،
segs.en: 34.and provide me with desire to serve You for the sake of my state in the hereafter,

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي،
segs.en: 35.such that I know the truthfulness of that [desire] in my heart,

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِي دُنْيَايَ،
segs.tr: wa h'at-taa yakoonal-ghaalibu a'lay-yaz-zuh-da fee dunyaay
segs.en: 36.be dominated by renunciation while in this world,
37.do good deeds with yearning,
38.and remain secure from evil deeds in fright and fear!

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً أَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَأَهْتَدِي بِهِ فِي الظُّلُماتِ،
segs.tr: wa hab lee noorana am-shee bihee fin-naas wa ah-tadee bihee feez'-z'ulumaat
segs.en: 39.And give me 'a light whereby I may walk among the people' (ref.6:122), be guided in the shadows,
40.and seek illumination in doubt and uncertainty!
41.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
42.and provide me with fear of the threatened gloom

segs.ar: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ،
segs.tr: wa shaw-qa thawaabil-maw-u'wdi h'at-taa ajida lad'-d'ata maaa ad-u'wka lah
segs.en: 43.and yearning for the promised reward, such that I may find the pleasure of that for which I supplicate You

segs.tr: wa kaa-bata maaa as-tajeeru bika min-h
segs.en: 44.and the sorrow of that from which I seek sanctuary in You!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ قَـدْ تَعْلَمُ مَا يُصْلِحُنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِـرَتِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma qad t-taa'-lamu maa yus'-lih'unee min am-ri dunyaaya wa aaakhiratee
segs.en: 45.O God, You knowest what will set my affairs right in this world and the next,
46.so be ever gracious toward my needs!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segs.en: 47.O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِي الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِي فِي الشُّكْرِ لَكَ
segs.en: 48.and provide me with what is Your right when I fall short in thanking You

segs.ar: بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِي اليُسـرِ وَالْعُسْرِ وَالصِّحَّـةِ وَالسَّقَمِ
segs.tr: bimaaa an-a'm-ta a'lay-ya feel-yus-ri wal-u's-r was'-s'ih'-h'ati was-saqam
segs.en: 49.for that through which You hast favoured me in ease and difficulty, health and sickness,

segs.ar: حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِي رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
segs.en: 50.such that I may come to know in myself repose in satisfaction

segs.ar: وَطُمَأنِينَةَ النَّفْسِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَجِبُ لَكَ فِيمَا يَحْدُثُ
segs.tr: wa t'umaa-neenatan-naf-si min-nee bimaa yajibu lak feemaa yah'-duthu
segs.en: 51.and serenity of soul in that which You hast made incumbent upon me
52.in whatever states may occur: fear and security,
53.satisfaction and displeasure, loss and gain!
54.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
55.and provide me with a breast safe from envy,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ أَحْسُدَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى شَيْء مِنْ فَضْلِكَ،
segs.tr: h'at-taa laaa ah'-suda ah'adam-min khal-qika a'laa shay-im-min faz''-lik
segs.en: 56.such that I envy none of Your creatures and in anything of Your bounty

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لاَ أَرى نِعْمَـةً مِنْ نِعَمِـكَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: wa h'at-taa laaa araa nia'-matam-min-nia'mika a'laaa ah'adim-min khal-qika
segs.en: 57.and such that I see none of Your favours toward any of Your creatures

segs.ar: فِي دِيْن أَوْ دُنْيا، أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ تَقْوَى،
segs.tr: fee deenin aw dunyaa aw a'afeeatin aw taq-waa
segs.en: 58.in religion or this world, well-being or reverential fear,

segs.ar: أَوْ سَعَة أَوْ رَخاء، إلاّ رَجَوْتُ لِنَفْسِي أَفْضَلَ ذلِكَ،
segs.tr: aw saa'tin aw rakhaaa- il-laa rajaw-tu linaf-seee af-z''ala d'alika
segs.en: 59.plenty or ease, without hoping for myself better than it

segs.ar: بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
segs.tr: bika wa minka wah'-daka laa shareeka lak
segs.en: 60.through and from You alone, who hast no associate!
61.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
62.and provide me with caution against offenses

segs.ar: وَالاحْتِرَاسَ مِنَ الزَّلَلِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ،
segs.en: 63.and wariness against slips in this world and the next
64.in the state of satisfaction and wrath,

segs.ar: حَتَّى أكُونَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَنْزِلَة سَوَاء،
segs.tr: h'at-taaa akoona bimaa yaridu a'lay-ya min-humaa bimanzilatin sawaaa
segs.en: 65.such that I may remain indifferent toward that which enters upon me from the two states,

segs.ar: عَامِلاً بِطَاعَتِكَ مُؤْثِراً لِرِضَاكَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُمَا فِي الأَوْلِياءِ وَالأعْدَاءِ
segs.tr: a'amilam-bit'aaa'tika moo-thiral-liriz''aaka a'laa maa siwaahumaa fil-aw-leeaaa-i wal-aa'-daaa-i
segs.en: 66.work toward Your obedience, and prefer it and Your good pleasure over all else in both friends and enemies.

segs.ar: حَتّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّي مِنْ ظُلْمِي وَجَوْرِي،
segs.tr: h'at-taa yaa-mana a'doo-wee min z'ul-mee wa jaw-ree
segs.en: 67.Then my enemy may stay secure from my wrongdoing and injustice

segs.ar: وَيَيْأَسَ وَلِيِّي مِنْ مَيْلِي وَانْحِطَاطِ هَوَايَ،
segs.tr: wa yay-ssa wa lee-yee mim-may-lee wa an-h'it'aat'i hawaay
segs.en: 68.and my friend may despair of my inclination and the bent of my affection.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلنِي مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصاً في الرَّخَاءِ
segs.en: 69.Make me one of those who supplicate You with sincerity in ease

segs.ar: دُعَـاءَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ لَـكَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
segs.en: 70.with the supplication of those who supplicate You with sincerity in distress!
71.Verily You art Praiseworthy, Glorious.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And clothe me with Your well-being and envelop me in it

segs.tr: Wa ḥaṣṣinnī bi‘āfiyatika wa akrimnī bi‘āfiyatika
segs.en: Fortify me with Your well-being and honor me with it

segs.tr: Wa aghninī bi‘āfiyatika wa taṣaddaqa ‘alayya bi‘āfiyatika
segs.en: Enrich me with Your well-being and grant it to me as charity
Bestow upon me Your well-being and spread it beneath me

segs.ar: وَأَصْلِحْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ وَلَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa aṣliḥ lī ‘āfiyataka wa lā tufarriq baynī wa bayna ‘āfiyatika
segs.en: And make Your well-being perfect for me, and do not separate me from it
In this world and the hereafter
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me a sufficient and healing well-being

segs.ar: عَالِيَةً نَامِيَةً عَافِيَةً تُوَلِّدُ فِي بَدَنِي الْعَافِيَةَ
segs.en: Lofty and growing, a well-being that generates well-being in my body
Well-being of this world and the hereafter
And favor me with health and security

segs.tr: Wa as-salāmati fī dīnī wa badanī
segs.en: And safety in my religion and body

segs.ar: وَالْبَصِيرَةِ فِي قَلْبِي وَالنَّفَاذِ فِي أُمُورِي
segs.tr: Wa al-baṣīrati fī qalbī wa an-nafādhi fī umūrī
segs.en: And insight in my heart and success in my affairs

segs.tr: Wa al-khashyati laka wa al-khawfi minka
segs.en: And fear of You and dread of You

segs.ar: وَالْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa al-quwwati ‘alā mā amartanī bihi min tā‘atika
segs.en: And strength to fulfill Your commands of obedience

segs.ar: وَالِاجْتِنَابِ لِمَا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa al-ijtinābi limā nahaytanī ‘anhu min ma‘ṣiyatika
segs.en: And avoidance of what You forbade me from of Your disobedience

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa amnun ‘alayya bil-ḥajji wa al-‘umrati
segs.en: O Allah, favor me with Hajj and Umrah
And visiting the grave of Your Messenger, Your blessings upon him

segs.tr: Wa raḥmatuka wa barakātuka ‘alayhi wa ‘alā ālihi
segs.en: And Your mercy and blessings upon him and his family
And the family of Your Messenger, peace be upon them

segs.ar: أَبَدًا مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي فِي عَامِي هَذَا
segs.en: Forever as long as You keep me, in this year

segs.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ عَامٍ وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولًا
segs.tr: Wa fī kulli ‘āmin wa aj‘al dhālika maqbūlan
segs.en: And every year, and make it accepted
Appreciated, remembered with You, and stored by You

segs.tr: Wa anṭiq biḥamdika wa shukrika wa dhikrika
segs.en: And make my tongue speak Your praise, gratitude, and remembrance
And beautiful praise of You
And open my heart to the guidance of Your religion

segs.tr: Wa a‘idhnī wa dhurriyyatī mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi
segs.en: And protect me and my progeny from the accursed Satan

segs.tr: Wa min sharri as-sāmmati wa al-hāmmati
segs.en: And from the evil of the venomous and creeping creatures
And the roaming and lurking ones

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli shayṭānin marīdin
segs.en: And from the evil of every rebellious devil
And from the evil of every stubborn tyrant

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli mutrafin ḥafīdin
segs.en: And from the evil of every indulged heir

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli ḍa‘īfin wa shadīdin
segs.en: And from the evil of every weak and strong

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli sharīfin wa waḍī‘in
segs.en: And from the evil of every noble and lowly

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli ṣaghīrin wa kabīrin
segs.en: And from the evil of every small and great

segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli qarībin wa ba‘īdin
segs.en: And from the evil of every near and far

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ
segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli man naṣaba lirasūlika
segs.en: And from the evil of everyone who opposes Your Messenger

segs.ar: وَلِأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ
segs.tr: Wa li-ahli baytihi ḥarban mina al-jinni wa al-insi
segs.en: And his household with enmity from jinn and mankind

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segs.tr: Wa min sharri kulli dābbatin anta ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā
segs.en: And from the evil of every creature You hold by its forelock
Indeed, You are on a straight path
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And whoever intends harm against me, turn it away from me

segs.ar: وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ وَادْرَأْ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ
segs.tr: Wa adḥar ‘annī makrahu wa adra’ ‘annī sharrahu
segs.en: Repel his deceit from me and ward off his evil
And return his plot to his own throat
And place a barrier before him
So that You blind his sight from me
And deafen his hearing from my mention
And lock his heart from thinking of me
And silence his tongue regarding me
And crush his head and humble his pride

segs.tr: Wa taksira jabarūtahu wa tudhilla raqabatahu
segs.en: Break his might and lower his neck

segs.ar: وَتَفْسَخَ كِبْرَهُ وَتُؤْمِنَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ ضَرِّهِ
segs.tr: Wa tafsakha kibrahu wa tu’minanī min jamī‘i ḍarrihi
segs.en: And shatter his arrogance and protect me from all his harm

segs.tr: Wa sharrihi wa ghamzihi wa hamzihi wa lamzihi
segs.en: And his evil, insinuations, incitements, and slanders
And his envy, enmity, and traps

segs.tr: Wa maṣā’idihi wa rajlihi wa khaylihi
segs.en: And his snares, foot soldiers, and cavalry
Indeed, You are Mighty and Powerful
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa al-bis-nee a'afeeatak wa jal-lil-nee a'afeeatak
segs.en: 2.clothe me in Your well-being, wrap me in Your well-being,

segs.tr: wa h'as'-s'in-nee bia'afeeatik wa ak-rim-nee bia'afeeatik
segs.en: 3.fortify me through Your well-being, honour me with Your well-being,

segs.tr: wa agh-ninee bia'afeeatik wa tas'ad-daq a'lay-ya bia'afeeatik
segs.en: 4.free me from need through Your well-being, donate to me Your well-being,

segs.tr: wa hab lee a'afeeatak wa af-rish-nee a'afeeatak
segs.en: 5.bestow upon me Your well-being, spread out for me Your well-being,

segs.ar: وَأَصْلِحْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَلا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa as'-lih' lee a'afeeatak wa laa tufar-riq bay-nee wa bay-na a'afeeatika
segs.en: 6.set Your well-being right for me, and separate me not from Your well-being
7.in this world and the next!
8.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَعَافِنِي عَافِيَةً كَافِيَةً شَافِيَةً عَالِيَةً نَامِيةً،
segs.tr: wa a'afinee a'afeeatan kaafeeatan shaafeeatan a'aleeatan-naameeah
segs.en: 9.and make me well with a well-being sufficient, healing, sublime, growing,
10.a well-being that will give birth to well-being in my body,
11.a well-being in this world and the next!

segs.ar: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالأمْنِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِي دِيْنِي وَبَـدَنِي،
segs.tr: wa am-nun a'lay-ya bis'-s'ih'-h'ati wal-am-n was-salaamati fee deenee wa badanee
segs.en: 12.Oblige me through health, security, and safety in my religion and body,

segs.ar: وَالْبَصِيرَةِ فِي قَلْبِي وَالنَّفَاذِ فِي أمُورِيْ وَالْخَشْيَةِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: wal-bas'eerati fee qal-bee wan-nafaad'i feee umooree wal-khash-yati lak
segs.en: 13.insight in my heart, penetration in my affairs, dread of You,

segs.ar: وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ وَالْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: wal-khaw-fi mink wa alqoo-wati a'laa maaa amar-tanee bihee min t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 14.fear of You, strength for the obedience which You hast commanded for me,

segs.ar: وَالاجْتِنَابِ لِمَـا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِـكَ.
segs.en: 15.and avoidance of the disobedience which You hast prohibited for me!

segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa am-nun a'lay bil-h'aj-ji wal-u'm-rah
segs.en: 16.O God, oblige me through the hajj, the umra,

segs.tr: wa zeeaarati qab-ri rasoolika s'alawaatuka a'lay-hee
segs.en: 17.and visiting the graves of Your Messenger (Your blessings,
18.mercy, and benedictions upon him and upon his Household)

segs.ar: وَآلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
segs.tr: wa a'laaa aaali rasoolika a'lay-himus-salaamu abadam-maaa ab-qay-tanee
segs.en: 19.and the Household of Your Messenger (upon them be peace) for as long as You causest me to live,

segs.ar: فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَفِي كُلِّ عَام،
segs.tr: fee a'amee had'aa wa fee kul-li a'am
segs.en: 20.in this year of mine and in every year,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولاً مَشْكُوراً مَذْكُوراً لَدَيْكَ،
segs.en: 21.and make that accepted, thanked, and mentioned before You
22.and stored away with You!

segs.ar: وَأَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ الثَّناءِ عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي،
segs.tr: wa ant'iq bih'am-dika washuk-rika wad'ik-rika wah'us-nith-thanaaa-i a'lay-ka lisaanee
segs.en: 23.Make my tongue utter Your praise, Your thanksgiving, Your remembrance, and Your excellent laudation,
24.and expand my heart toward the right goals of Your religion!
25.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَالْعَامَّةِ وَاللاَّمَّةِ
segs.tr: wa min shar-ris-saaam-mati wal-haaam-mati wal-a'aam-mati wal-l-laaam-mah
segs.en: 26.the evil of venomous vermin, threatening pests, swarming crowds, and evil eyes,
27.the evil of "every rebel satan" (22:3),

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li sul-t'aanin a'need
segs.en: 28.the evil of every refractory sovereign,

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li mut-rafin h'afeed
segs.en: 29.the evil of everyone living in ease and served,

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li z''ae'efiw-wa shadeed
segs.en: 30.the evil of everyone weak or strong,

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li shareefiw-wa waz''eea'
segs.en: 31.the evil of everyone born high or low,

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li s'agheeriw-wa kabeer
segs.en: 32.the evil of everyone small or great,

segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li qareebiw-wa bae'ed
segs.en: 33.the evil of everyone near or far,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَلأهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبَـاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ،
segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li man-nas'aba lirasoolika waliah-li bay-tihee h'ar-bam-minal-jin-ni wal-ins
segs.en: 34.the evil of every one, jinn or man, who declares war on Your Messenger and his Household,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرّ كُلِّ دَابَّة أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segs.tr: wa min shar-ri kul-li daaab-batin anta aaakhid'um-binaas'eeatihaa
segs.en: 35.and the evil of "every crawling creature that You hast taken by the forelock!
36.Surely You art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).
37.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ،
segs.tr: wa man araadanee bisooo-in faas'-rif-hoo a'n-nee wa ad-h'ar a'n-nee mak-rah
segs.en: 38.and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception,

segs.ar: وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ،
segs.tr: wa ad-raa a'n-nee shar-rah wa rud-da kay-dahoo fee nah'-rih
segs.en: 39.avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l bay-na yaday-hee sad-dana h'at-taa tua'-meea a'n-nee bas'arah
segs.en: 40.and place before him a barricade, so that You mayest blind his eyes toward me,

segs.ar: وَتُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْري سَمْعَهُ، وَتُقْفِلَ دُونَ إخْطَارِي قَلْبَهُ،
segs.tr: wa tus'im-ma a'n d'ik-ree sam-a'h wa tuq-fila doona ikh-t'aaree qal-bah
segs.en: 41.deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me,

segs.tr: wa tukh-risa a'n-nee lisaanah wa taq-maa' raa-sah
segs.en: 42.silence his tongue against me, restrain his head,

segs.tr: wa tud'il-la i'z-zah wa tak-sira jabarootah
segs.en: 43.abase his exaltation, break his arrogance,

segs.tr: wa tud'il-la raqabatah wa taf-sakha kib-rah
segs.en: 44.abase his neck, disjoint his pride,
45.and make me secure from all his injury,

segs.tr: washar-rih wa gham-zihee wa ham-zihee wa lam-zih wa h'asadihee
segs.en: 46.his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy,

segs.tr: wa a'daawatih wa h'abaaa-ilihee wa mas'aaa-idih wa raj-lihee wakhay-lih
segs.en: 47.his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!
48.Surely You art Mighty, Powerful!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْـدِكَ وَرَسُولِـكَ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger,
and his pure family,

segs.tr: wa ikhṣuṣhum bi-afḍali ṣalawātika wa raḥmatik
segs.en: and single them out with the best of Your blessings, and Your mercy,
and Your favors, and Your peace.

segs.tr: wa ikhṣuṣi Allāhumma wālidayya bi-al-karāmati ladayk,
segs.en: And single out, O Allah, my parents with honor in Your presence,

segs.tr: wa aṣ-ṣalāti minka yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn.
segs.en: and blessings from You, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنِي عِلْمَ مَا يَجبُ لَهُمَا عَلَىَّ إلْهَاماً،
segs.tr: wa alhimnī ‘ilma mā yajibu lahumā ‘alayya ilhāmā,
segs.en: and inspire me with the knowledge of what is due to them from me, an inspiration,

segs.ar: وَاجْمَعْ لِي عِلْمَ ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامـاً،
segs.tr: wa ijma‘ lī ‘ilma dhālika kullihī tamāmā,
segs.en: and gather for me the complete knowledge of all of that,
then make me act according to what You inspire me with from it,

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلنُّفُوذِ فِيمَا تُبَصِّـرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ،
segs.tr: wa waffiqnī li-an-nufūdhi fīmā tubaṣṣirunī min ‘ilmih,
segs.en: and grant me success to penetrate what You give me insight into of its knowledge,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ يَفُوتَنِي اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْء عَلَّمْتَنِيْهِ،
segs.en: so that the practice of anything You have taught me does not escape me,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِي عَنِ الْحُفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ.
segs.tr: wa lā tathqula arkānī ‘ani al-ḥufūfi fīmā alhamtanīh.
segs.en: and my limbs do not become heavy in carrying out what You have inspired me with.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālih kamā sharraftanā bih
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, just as You honored us through him,
and send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ.
segs.tr: kamā awjabta lanā al-ḥaqqa ‘alā al-khalqi bi-sababih.
segs.en: just as You made incumbent upon the creation the right due to us because of him.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ij‘alnī ahābuhumā haybata as-sulṭāni al-‘asūf,
segs.en: O Allah, make me regard them with the awe of the fierce ruler,
and be more dutiful to them than the merciful mother,

segs.tr: wa ij‘al ṭā‘atī li-wālidayya wa birrī bihimā
segs.en: and make my obedience to my parents and my dutifulness to them
more delightful to my eyes than the sleep of the weary,

segs.tr: wa athlaja li-ṣadrī min sharbati aẓ-ẓam’ān
segs.en: and cooler to my chest than the drink of the thirsty,
so that I prefer their desire over my own desire,
and place their pleasure before my own pleasure,

segs.tr: wa astakthira birrahumā bī wa in qall
segs.en: and consider my parents’ kindness to me to be great, even if it is little,

segs.tr: wa astaqilla birrī bihimā wa in kathur.
segs.en: and consider my dutifulness to them to be little, even if it is much.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ خَفِّضْ لَهُمَا صَوْتِي، وَأَطِبْ لَهُمَا كَلاَمِي،
segs.tr: Allāhumma khaffiḍ lahumā ṣawtī, wa aṭib lahumā kalāmī,
segs.en: O Allah, lower my voice before them, and sweeten my speech for them,

segs.ar: وَأَلِنْ لَهُمَا عَرِيْكَتِي، وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيْهِمَا قَلْبِي،
segs.tr: wa alin lahumā ‘arīkatī, wa a‘ṭif ‘alayhimā qalbī,
segs.en: and soften my nature for them, and incline my heart toward them,

segs.tr: wa ṣayyirnī bihimā rafīqan, wa ‘alayhimā shafīqan.
segs.en: and make me a gentle companion to them, and a compassionate person toward them.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِي وَأَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ushkur lahumā tarbiyatī wa athibhuma ‘alā takrimatī,
segs.en: O Allah, thank them for raising me, and reward them for honoring me,

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْ لَهُمَا مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّي فِي صِغَرِي.
segs.tr: wa iḥfaẓ lahumā mā ḥafiẓāhu minnī fī ṣigharī.
segs.en: and preserve for them what they preserved of me in my childhood.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّي مِنْ أَذَىً
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa mā massahumā minnī min adhā
segs.en: O Allah, and whatever harm touched them from me,

segs.ar: أَوْ خَلَصَ إلَيْهِمَا عَنِّي مِنْ مَكْرُوه
segs.en: or whatever unpleasant thing reached them from me,

segs.ar: أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِي لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ
segs.tr: aw ḍā‘a qibalī lahumā min ḥaqqin
segs.en: or whatever right of theirs was lost by me,
then make it a means of relief for their sins,
and a raise in their ranks,
and an increase in their good deeds,

segs.ar: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ.
segs.tr: yā mubaddila as-sayyi’āti bi-aḍ‘āfihā mina al-ḥasanāt.
segs.en: O You who exchange bad deeds for many times their like in good deeds.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْل،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa mā ta‘addayā ‘alayya fīhi min qawl,
segs.en: O Allah, and whatever word they spoke that went beyond bounds against me,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَىَّ فِيْهِ مِنْ فِعْل،
segs.en: or whatever action they were excessive in against me,
or whatever right of mine they neglected,

segs.ar: أَوْ قَصَّرا بِي عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِب
segs.en: or whatever duty they fell short in towards me,
I have forgiven it and granted it to them generously,

segs.ar: وَرَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ فِي وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا
segs.tr: wa raghibtu ilayka fī waḍ‘i tabi‘atihi ‘anhumā
segs.en: and I appeal to You to remove its accountability from them,
for I do not accuse them regarding myself,
nor do I consider them slow in their kindness to me,

segs.ar: وَلا أكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّياهُ مِنْ أَمْرِي يَا رَبِّ
segs.tr: wa lā akrahu mā tawallayāhu min amrī yā Rabb
segs.en: nor do I dislike what they undertook concerning my affairs, O Lord.
For they have the most incumbent right over me,
and the oldest kindness towards me,
and the greatest favor with me—
than for me to take retribution from them with justice,
or reward them in kind.

segs.ar: أَيْنَ إذاً يَا إلهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي ؟
segs.tr: ayna idhan yā Ilāhī ṭūlu shughlihimā bi-tarbiyatī?
segs.en: Where then, O my God, is the long effort of their raising me?

segs.tr: wa ayna shiddatu ta‘abihimā fī ḥirāsatī?
segs.en: And where is the intensity of their toil in guarding me?

segs.ar: وَأَيْنَ إقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ؟
segs.en: And where is their scarcity for themselves in order to provide abundantly for me?
Far be it! They cannot exhaust their right from me,

segs.ar: وَلاَ اُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا
segs.tr: wa lā udriku mā yajibu ‘alayya lahumā
segs.en: nor can I reach what is incumbent upon me for them,

segs.tr: wa lā anā bi-qāḍin waẓīfata khidmatihimā.
segs.en: and I am not one who can fulfill the duty of serving them.
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَأَعِنِّي يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ.
segs.tr: wa a‘innī yā khayra mani istu‘īna bih.
segs.en: and help me, O Best of those whose help is sought.

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa waffiqnī yā ahdā man rughiba ilayh,
segs.en: And grant me success, O Most Guiding of those desired,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي فِي أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلآباءِوَالأُمَّهاتِ
segs.tr: wa lā taj‘alnī fī ahli al-‘uqūqi li-al-ābā’i wa al-ummahāt
segs.en: and do not place me among the people of disobedience to fathers and mothers

segs.ar: يَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لاَيُظْلَمُونَ.
segs.tr: yawma tujzā kullu nafsin bi-mā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn.
segs.en: on the Day every soul is recompensed for what it earned, and they will not be wronged.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālihī wa dhurrīyatih,
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and his descendants,

segs.ar: وَاخْصُصْ أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ
segs.tr: wa ikhṣuṣ abawayya bi-afḍali mā khaṣaṣta bih
segs.en: and single out my parents with the best of what You singled out

segs.ar: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.tr: ābā’a ‘ibādika al-mu’minīna wa ummahātihim yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn.
segs.en: the fathers of Your believing servants and their mothers, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
segs.tr: Allāhumma lā tunsīnī dhikrahumā fī adbāri ṣalawātī
segs.en: O Allah, do not make me forget their remembrance at the conclusions of my prayers,

segs.tr: wa fī anan min ānā’i laylī,
segs.en: and in any part of the moments of my night,

segs.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
segs.tr: wa fī kulli sā‘atin min sā‘āti nahārī.
segs.en: and in every hour of the hours of my day.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,
and forgive me through my prayer for them,
and forgive them through their dutifulness to me,
a definite forgiveness,

segs.ar: وَارْضَ عَنْهُمَا بِشَفَاعَتِي لَهُمَا رِضَىً عَزْماً،
segs.en: and be pleased with them through my intercession for them, a resolute pleasure,
and convey them with honor to the abodes of peace.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lahumā fa-shaffi‘humā fiyy,
segs.en: O Allah, if Your forgiveness preceded them, then make them intercede for me,

segs.ar: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segs.tr: wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lī fa-shaffi‘nī fīhimā,
segs.en: and if Your forgiveness preceded me, then make me intercede for them,

segs.ar: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.tr: ḥattā najtami‘a bi-ra’fatika fī dāri karāmatik
segs.en: so that we may gather by Your compassion in the abode of Your honor,
and the place of Your forgiveness and Your mercy.

segs.ar: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ
segs.tr: innaka dhū al-faḍli al-‘aẓīmi wa al-manni al-qadīm
segs.en: Truly, You are the Possessor of immense favor and ancient bounty,
and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave
2.and Your messenger, and his Household, the pure,

segs.ar: وَاخْصُصْهُمْ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَسَلاَمِكَ،
segs.tr: wa akh-s'us'-hum bif-z''ali s'alawaatika wa rah'-matika wa barakaatika wa salaamik
segs.en: 3.and single them out for the best of Your blessings, Your mercy, Your benedictions, and Your peace!
4.And single out my parents, O God, for honour with You
5.and blessings from You, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنِي عِلْمَ مَا يَجبُ لَهُمَا عَلَىَّ إلْهَاماً،
segs.tr: wa al-him-nee i'l-ma maa yajibu lahumaa a'l-lay il-haamaa
segs.en: 7.teach me through inspiration knowledge of everything incumbent upon me toward them,

segs.ar: وَاجْمَعْ لِي عِلْمَ ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامـاً،
segs.tr: wa aj-maa' lee i'l-ma d'alika kul-lihee tamaamaa
segs.en: 8.and gather within me knowledge of all that completely!
9.Then make me act in accordance with what You hast inspired me

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلنُّفُوذِ فِيمَا تُبَصِّـرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ،
segs.tr: wa waf-fiq-nee liln-nufood'i feemaa tubas'-s'irunee min i'l-mih
segs.en: 10.and give me the success to put into practice the knowledge You hast shown to me,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ يَفُوتَنِي اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْء عَلَّمْتَنِيْهِ،
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa yafootanee as-tia'-maalu shay-in a'l-lam-taneeh
segs.en: 11.lest I fail to act according to something You hast taught me

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِي عَنِ الْحُفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ.
segs.tr: wa laa tath-qula ar-kaanee a'nil-h'ufoofi feemaaa al-ham-taneeh
segs.en: 12.or my limbs feel too heavy to perform that with which You hast inspired me!
13.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
14.as You hast ennobled us through him,
15.and bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ.
segs.en: 16.as You hast made incumbent upon us rights toward the creatures because of him!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ،
segs.en: 17.O God, fill me with awe of my parents, the awe one has toward a tyrannical sovereign,
18.and let me be devoted to them, with the devotion of a compassionate mother!

segs.tr: waj-a'l t'aaa'tee liwaaliday-ya wa bir-ree bihimaa
segs.en: 19.Make my obedience and devotion to them
20.more gladdening to my eyes than sleep to the drowsy
21.and more refreshing to my breast than drink to the thirsty,
22.so that I may prefer their inclination to my inclination,

segs.ar: وَأُقَدِّمَ عَلَى رِضَاىَ رِضَاهُمَا وَأَسْتَكْثِرَ بِرَّهُمَا
segs.tr: wa uqad-dima a'laa riz''aaya riz''aahumaa wa as-tak-thira bir-rahumaa
segs.en: 23.set their satisfaction before my satisfaction, make much of their devotion to me

segs.ar: بِي وَإنْ قَلَّ وَأَسْتَقِلَّ بِرِّي بِهِمَا وَإنْ كَثُرَ.
segs.tr: bee wa in qal wa as-taqil-la bir-ree bihimaa wa in kathur
segs.en: 24.though it be little, and make little of my devotion to them though it be great.
25.O God, lower before them my voice,
26.make agreeable to them my words,
27.make mild before them my temper,
28.make tender toward them my heart,

segs.tr: wa s'ay-yir-nee bihimaa rafeeqaw-wa a'lay-himaa shafeeqaa
segs.en: 29.and turn me into their kind companion, their loving friend!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِي وَأَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma ush-kur lahumaa tar-beeatee wa athib-humaa a'laa tak-rimatee
segs.en: 30.O God, thank them for my upbringing, reward them for honouring me,

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْ لَهُمَا مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّي فِي صِغَرِي.
segs.tr: wa ah'-faz' lahumaa maa h'afiz'aahoo min-nee fee s'igharee
segs.en: 31.and guard them as they guarded me in my infancy!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّي مِنْ أَذَىً أَوْ خَلَصَ إلَيْهِمَا عَنِّي مِنْ مَكْرُوه
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa maa mas-sahumaa min-nee min ad'ana aw khalas'a ilay-himaa a'n-nee mim-mak-rooh
segs.en: 32.O God, and whatever harm has touched them from me, detested thing has reached them from me,

segs.ar: أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِي لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ
segs.tr: aw z''aaa' qibalee lahumaa min h'aq
segs.en: 33.or right of theirs which has been neglected by me,
34.allow it to alleviate their sins,
35.raise them in their degrees,
36.and add to their good deeds!

segs.ar: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ.
segs.en: 37.O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْل،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa maa taa'd-dayaa a'lay-ya feehee min qaw-l
segs.en: 38.O God, whatever word through which they have transgressed against me,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَىَّ فِيْهِ مِنْ فِعْل،
segs.tr: aw as-rafaa a'lay-ya feehee min fia'-l
segs.en: 39.act through which they have been immoderate with me,

segs.ar: أَوْ ضَيَّعَاهُ لِي مِنْ حَقٍّ أَوْ قَصَّرا بِي عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِب
segs.tr: aw z''ay-yaa'ahoo lee min h'aq aw qas'-s'araa bee a'n-hoo miw-waajib
segs.en: 40.right of mine which they have left neglected, or obligation toward me in which they have fallen short,

segs.tr: faqad wahab-tuhoo lahumaa wa jut-tu bihee a'lay-himaa
segs.en: 41.I grant it to them and bestow it upon them,

segs.ar: وَرَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ فِي وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا
segs.tr: wa raghib-tu ilay-ka fee waz''-i' tabia'tihee a'n-humaa
segs.en: 42.and I beseech You to remove from them its ill consequence,

segs.tr: fa in-nee laaa at-tahimuhumaa a'laa naf-see
segs.en: 43.for I do not accuse them concerning myself,
44.find them slow in their devotion toward me,

segs.ar: وَلا أكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّياهُ مِنْ أَمْرِي يَا رَبِّ
segs.tr: wa laaa ak-rahoo maa tawal-layaahoo min am-ree yaa rab
segs.en: 45.or dislike the way they have attended to my affairs, my Lord!
46.They have rights against me which are more incumbent,
47.precedence in beneficence toward me that is greater

segs.ar: وَأَعْظَمُ مِنَّةً لَـدَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أقَاصَّهُمَا بِعَدْل،
segs.tr: wa aa'-z'amu min-natal-laday min an uqaaas'-s'ahumaa bia'd-l
segs.en: 48.and kindness toward me that is mightier than that I should settle accounts with justice
49.or repay them with equivalents.

segs.ar: أَيْنَ إذاً يَا إلهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي ؟
segs.tr: sy-na id'ay-yaaa ilaahee t'oolu shugh-lihimaa bitarbeeatee?
segs.en: 50.Where then, my God, would be their long occupation with bringing me up?

segs.tr: wa ay-na shid-datu taa'bihimaa fee h'iraasatee?
segs.en: 51.Where the hardship of their toil in taking care of me?

segs.ar: وَأَيْنَ إقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ؟
segs.tr: wa ay-na iq-taaruhumaa a'laaa anfusihimaa lilt-taw-sia'ti a'lay-ya?
segs.en: 52.Where the stinting of themselves to provide me with plenty?
53.What an idea! I can never discharge their right against me,

segs.ar: وَلاَ اُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا
segs.tr: wa laaa ud-riku maa yajibu a'lay-ya lahumaa
segs.en: 54.fulfil my obligations toward them,
55.or accomplish the duty of serving them.
56.So bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَأَعِنِّي يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ.
segs.tr: wa ai'n-nee yaa khay-ra mani as-tue'ena bih
segs.en: 57.and help me, O Best of those whose help we seek!

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa waf-fiq-nee yaaa ah-daa mar-rughiba ilay-h
segs.en: 58.Give me success, O Most Guiding of those whom we beseech!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي فِي أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلآباءِوَالأُمَّهاتِ
segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l-nee feee ah-lil-u'qooqi lil-abaaa-i wal-um-mahaati
segs.en: 59.Place me not among the people of disrespect to fathers and mothers

segs.ar: يَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لاَيُظْلَمُونَ.
segs.tr: (yaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim-bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuz'-lamoon)
segs.en: 60.on the day when "every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, they shall not be wronged" (45:22).

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wad'ur-ree-yatih
segs.en: 61.O God, bless Muhammad, his Household, and his progeny

segs.ar: وَاخْصُصْ أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ
segs.tr: wa akh-s'us' abaway-ya bif-z''ali maa khas'as'-ta biheee
segs.en: 62.and single out my parents for the best which You hast singled out for

segs.ar: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.en: 63.the fathers and mothers of Your faithful servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa tunsinee d'ik-rahumaa feee ad-baari s'alawaatee
segs.en: 64.O God, let me not forget to remember them after my ritual prayers,

segs.tr: wa feee inana min aaanaaa-i lay-lee
segs.en: 65.at every time throughout my night,

segs.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
segs.tr: wa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'ati nahaaree
segs.en: 66.and in each of the hours of my day!
67.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
68.forgive me through my supplication for my parents,
69.and forgive them through their devotion toward me
70.with unfailing forgiveness, be well pleased with them
71.through my intercession for them with resolute good pleasure,
72.and make them reach through Your generosity the abodes of safety!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lahumaa fashaf-fia'-humaa fee
segs.en: 73.O God, if Your forgiveness reaches them first, make them my intercessors,

segs.ar: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segs.tr: wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lee fashaf-fia'-nee feehimaa
segs.en: 74.and if Your forgiveness reaches me first, make me their intercessors,

segs.ar: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.tr: h'at-taa naj-tamia' biraa-fatika fee daari karaamatika
segs.en: 75.so that we may gather together through Your gentleness in the house of Your generosity
76.and the place of Your forgiveness and mercy!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ .
segs.tr: in-naka d'ool-faz''-lil-a'z'eemi wal-man-nil-qadeem wa anta ar-h'amur-raah'imeen
segs.en: 77.Verily You art Possessor of abounding bounty and ancient kindness, and "Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful" (7:151)!
O Allah, and bestow upon me the favor of the survival of my children,

segs.tr: wa bi-iṣlāḥihim lī, wa bi-imtā‘ī bihim.
segs.en: and their righteousness towards me, and my enjoyment of them.
My God, prolong their lifespans for me,
and increase their appointed times for me,
and raise their young ones for me,
and strengthen their weak ones for me,

segs.tr: wa aṣiḥḥa lī abdānahum wa adyānahum wa akhlāqahum,
segs.en: and make their bodies, their religions, and their characters sound for me,

segs.tr: wa ‘āfihim fī anfusihim wa fī jawāriḥihim
segs.en: and grant them well-being in their souls and in their limbs,

segs.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa fī kulli mā ‘unītu bihi min amrihim,
segs.en: and in everything concerning their affairs that I care about.

segs.tr: wa adrir lī wa ‘alā yadī arzāqahum,
segs.en: And abundantly provide their sustenance for me, and by my hand,

segs.tr: wa ij‘alhum abrāran atqiyā’a buṣarā’a sāmi‘īn
segs.en: and make them righteous, pious, insightful, listening,
