segs.en: 37.and asking the fulfilment of Your promise, (for You hast promised to respond):
38.You hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you" (40:60).
39.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa al-qanee bimagh-firatika kamaa laqeetuka biiq-raaree
segs.en: 40.meet me with Your forgiveness just as I have met You with my confession,

segs.ar: وَارْفَعْنِي عَنْ مَصَارعِ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: war-faa'-nee a'm-mas'aarii'd'-d'unoobi kamaa waz''aa'-tu laka naf-see
segs.en: 41.lift me up from the fatal infirmities of sins just as I have let myself down before You,

segs.ar: وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِي عَنِ الانْتِقَامِ مِنِّي.
segs.tr: was-tur-nee bisit-rika kamaa taan-nay-tanee a'n?lintiqaami min-nee
segs.en: 42.and cover me with Your covering just as You hast shown no haste to take vengeance on me!

segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa thab-bit fee t'aaa'tika nee-yatee
segs.en: 43.O God, make firm my intention to obey You,
44.strengthen my insight in worshipping You,
45.give me the success of works

segs.ar: لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي،
segs.en: 46.which will wash away the defilement of offenses,

segs.tr: wa tawaf-fanee a'laa mil-latika wamil-lati nabee-yika
segs.en: 47.and take me when You takest me in the creed of Your prophet
48.Muhammad (upon him be peace).

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee atoobu ilay-ka fee maqaamee had'aa
segs.en: 49.O God, I repent to You in this my station from
50.my sins, great and small,
51.my evil deeds, inward and outward,
52.my lapses, past and recent,

segs.ar: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
segs.en: 53.with the repentance of one who does not tell himself that he might disobey

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي خَطِيئَةٍ،
segs.tr: wa laa yuz''-miru ay-yau'wda fee khat'ee-ah
segs.en: 54.or secretly think that he might return to an offense.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إلهِي فِي مُحْكَمِ كِتابِكَ
segs.tr: wa qad qul-ta yaaa ilaahee fee muh'-kami kitaabika
segs.en: 55.You hast said, my God, in the firm text of Your Book,
56.that You 'acceptest repentance from Your servants,
57.pardonest evil deeds' (ref.42:25), and lovest the repenters (ref.2:222),

segs.ar: فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَأعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِي كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ،
segs.tr: faq-bal taw-batee kamaa waa't-t waa'-fu a'n say-yi-aatee kamaa z''amint
segs.en: 58.so accept my repentance as You hast promised, pardon my evil deeds as You hast guaranteed,

segs.tr: wa aw-jib lee mah'ab-bataka kamaa sharat'-t
segs.en: 59.and make obligatory toward me Your love as You hast stipulated!

segs.ar: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِي أَلاّ أَعُودَ فِي مَكْرُوهِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laka yaa rab shar-t'eee al-laaa au'wda fee mak-roohik
segs.en: 60.To You, my Lord, belongs my stipulation that I will not return to what is disliked by You,

segs.tr: wa z''amaaneee al-laaa ar-jia' fee mad'-moomik
segs.en: 61.my guarantee that I will not go back to what You blamest,

segs.tr: wa a'h-deee an ah-jura jameea' maa'as'eek
segs.en: 62.and my covenant that I will stay away from acts of disobedience to You.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-naka aa'-lamu bimaa a'mil-t fagh-fir lee maa a'lim-t
segs.en: 63.O God, You knowest better what I have done, so forgive me what You knowest
64.and turn me through Your power to what You lovest!
65.O God, counted against me are claims that stay in my memory
66.and claims that I have forgotten,
67.while all of them remain in Your eye that does not sleep
68.and Your knowledge that does not forget!

segs.ar: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا،
segs.tr: faa'w-wiz'' min-haaa ah-lahaa wah'-t'ut' a'n-nee wiz-rahaa
segs.en: 69.So compensate their owners, lighten their load upon me,

segs.ar: وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّي ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا.
segs.tr: wa khaf-fif a'n-nee thiq-lahaa waa'-s'im-nee min an uqaarifa mith-lahaa
segs.en: 70.lift up their weight from me, and preserve me from approaching their like!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنَّهُ لاَ وَفَاءَ لِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ إلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa in-nahoo laa wafaaa-a lee bit-taw-bati il-laa bii's'-matik
segs.en: 71.O God, but I can not be faithful to my repentance without Your preservation,

segs.ar: وَلا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِي عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إلاَّ عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa as-tim-saaka bee a'nil-khat'aayaaa il-laa a'n qoo-watik
segs.en: 72.nor can I refrain from offenses without Your strength.

segs.ar: فَقَوِّنِي بِقُوَّة كَافِيَة، وَتَوَلَّنِي بِعِصْمَة مَانِعَة.
segs.tr: faqaw-winee biqoo-watin kaafeeah wa tawal-lanee bii's'-matim-maania'h
segs.en: 73.So strengthen me with a sufficient strength and attend to me with a defending preservation!
74.O God, if any servant repents to You,

segs.ar: وَهُوَ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ
segs.tr: wa huwa fee i'l-mil-ghay-bi i'ndaka faasikhul-litaw-batih
segs.en: 75.while in Your knowledge of the Unseen he will break his repentance
76.and return to his sin and offense,

segs.ar: فَإنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذلِكَ،
segs.tr: fa in-nee e au'wd'u bika an akoona kad'alik
segs.en: 77.I seek refuge in You lest I be like that!

segs.ar: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ تَوْبَةً لا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إلَى تَوْبَة،
segs.tr: faj-a'l taw-batee hd'ih taw-batal-laaa ah'-taaju baa'-dahaaa ilaa taw-bah
segs.en: 78.So make this my repentance a repentance after which I will need no repentance

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً مُوجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيمَـا بَقِيَ.
segs.tr: taw-batam-moojibatal-limah'-wi maa salafa was-salaamati feemaa baqee
segs.en: 79.and a repentance which will obligate the erasing of what has gone by and safety in what remains!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee aa'-tad'iru ilay-ka min jah-lee
segs.en: 80.O God, I ask pardon from You for my ignorance,
81.and I ask You to disregard my evil acts!
82.So join me to the shelter of Your mercy through graciousness
83.and cover me with the covering of Your well-being through bounteousness!
84.O God, I repent to You
85.from everything opposed to Your will
86.or far from Your love -
87.the thoughts of my heart,
88.the glances of my eye,
89.the tales of my tongue -

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَة عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: taw-batan tas-lamu bihaa kul-lu jaarih'atin a'laa h'eeaalihaa min tabia'atika
segs.en: 90.with a repentance through which each bodily part will by itself stay safe from ill consequences with You

segs.ar: وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa taa-manu mim-maa yakhaaful-mua'-tadoona min sleemi sat'awaatik
segs.en: 91.and remain secure from Your painful penalties feared by transgressors!
92.O God, so have mercy on my being alone before You,
93.the pounding of my heart in dread of You,
94.the trembling of my limbs in awe of You!

segs.ar: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِي يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوبِي مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ،
segs.tr: faqad aqaamat-nee yaa rab-bi d'unoobee maqaamal-khiz-yi bifinaaa-ik
segs.en: 95.My sins, my God, have stood me in the station of degradation in Your courtyard.

segs.ar: فَإنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ عَنِّي أَحَدٌ،
segs.tr: faan sakat-tu lam yant'iq a'n-neee ah'ad
segs.en: 96.If I remain silent, none will speak for me;
97.if I seek an intercessor, I am not worthy for intercession.
98.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
99.make Your generosity intercede for my offenses,
100.follow up my evil deeds with Your pardon,

segs.tr: wa laa taj-zinee jazaaa-ee min u'qoobatik
segs.en: 101.repay me not with the punishment that is my proper repayment,

segs.tr: wab-sut' a'lay-ya t'aw-lak wa jal-lil-nee bisit-rik
segs.en: 102.spread over me Your graciousness, wrap me in Your covering,

segs.ar: وَافْعَلْ بِي فِعْلَ عَزِيز تَضَرَّع إلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ،
segs.tr: waf-a'l bee fia'-l a'zeezin taz''ar-raa' ilay-hee a'b-dun d'aleelun farah'imah
segs.en: 103.and do with me what is done by a mighty man, when a lowly slave pleads to him and he shows him mercy,

segs.ar: أَوْ غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ.
segs.tr: aw ghanee-yin taa'r-raz''a lahoo a'b-dun faqeerun fanaa'shah
segs.en: 104.or a rich man, when a poor slave submits himself and he raises him to wealth!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَفِيرَ لِي مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma laa khafeera lee mink fal-yakh-fur-nee i'z-zuk
segs.en: 105.O God, I have no protector against You, so let Your might be my protector!

segs.ar: وَلا شَفِيعَ لِيْ إلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِي فَضْلُكَ،
segs.tr: walaa shafeea' leee ilay-ka fal-yash-faa' lee faz''-luk
segs.en: 106.I have no intercessor with You, so let Your bounty be my intercessor!

segs.tr: wa qad aw-jalat-nee khat'aayaaya fal-yoo-min-nee a'f-wuk
segs.en: 107.My offenses have set me quaking, so let Your pardon give me security!

segs.ar: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْل مِنِّي بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي،
segs.tr: famaa kul-lu maa nat'aq-tu bihee a'n- jah-lim-min-nee bisooo-i atharee
segs.en: 108.Not all that I have said rises up from my ignorance of my evil footsteps

segs.ar: وَلاَ نِسيَان لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيمِ فِعْلِي،
segs.tr: wa laa nis-yaanil-limaa sabaqa min d'ameemi fia'-lee
segs.en: 109.or forgetfulness of my blameworthy acts in the past,
110.but in order that Your heaven and those within it

segs.ar: وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ،
segs.tr: wa ar-z''uka waman a'lay-haa maa az'-har-tu laka minan-nadam
segs.en: 111.and Your earth and those upon it may hear the remorse which I have professed to You
112.and the repentance through which I have sought asylum with You.

segs.ar: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِي لِسُوءِ مَوْقِفِي،
segs.tr: falaa'l-la baa'-z''ahum birah'-matik yar-h'amunee lisooo-i maw-qifee
segs.en: 113.Then perhaps one of them, through Your mercy, may show mercy upon my evil situation

segs.ar: أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَىَّ لِسُوءِ حَالِي
segs.en: 114.or be seized by tenderness for my evil state.

segs.ar: فَيَنَالَنِي مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي،
segs.tr: fayanaalanee min-h bidaa'-watin heea as-mau' laday-ka min dua'aa-ee
segs.en: 115.There may come from him for my sake a supplication to which You givest ear more than to my supplication

segs.ar: أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي
segs.tr: aw shafaaa'tin aw-kadu i'ndaka min shafaaa'tee
segs.en: 116.or an intercession surer with You than my intercession

segs.ar: تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِي مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِي بِرضَاكَ.
segs.tr: takoonu bihaa najaatee min ghaz''abik wa faw-zee biriz''aak
segs.en: 117.through which I may be delivered from Your wrath and attain to Your good pleasure!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ اْلنَّادِمِينَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma ee-yakunin-nadamu taw-batan ilay-ka faanaa andamun-naadimeen
segs.en: 118.O God, if remorse is a repentance toward You, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful!

segs.ar: وَإنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيبينَ،
segs.tr: wa ee-yakunit-tar-ku limaa'-s'eeatika inaabatan faanaa aw-walul-muneebeen
segs.en: 119.If refraining from disobedience is a turning back to You, then I am the first of those who turn back!

segs.ar: وَإنْ يَكُنِ الاسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلذُّنُوبِ فَإنَي لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ.
segs.tr: wa ee-yak-nilis-tigh-faaru h'it'-t'atal-lild'-d'unoobi fa in-nee ? laka minal-mus-tagh-fireen
segs.en: 120.If praying for forgiveness alleviates sins, surely I am one of those who pray for Your forgiveness!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ
segs.en: 121.O God, as You hast commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance,
122.as You hast urged supplication, and promised to respond,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَآلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waq-bal taw-batee
segs.en: 123.so also bless Muhammad and his Household, accept my repentance,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَرْجِعْني مَرجَعَ الخَيبَةِ منْ رَحْمَتِك
segs.en: 124.and return me not to the returning place of disappointment in Your mercy!
125.Surely You art "Ever-turning" (2:128) toward the sinners,
126."All-compassionate" (2:128) toward the offenders who turn back!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee kamaa haday-tanaa bih
segs.en: 127.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast guided us by him!

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee kamas-tanqad'-tanaa bih
segs.en: 128.Bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast rescued us through him!
129.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: s'alaatan tash-fau' lanaa yaw-mal-qeeaamati wayaw-mal-faaqati ilay-k
segs.en: 130.with a blessing that will intercede for us on the Day of Resurrection, the day of neediness toward You!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
segs.tr: in-naka a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer wa huwa a'lay-ka yaseer
segs.en: 131."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26), and that is easy for You!

S_32.name: 32. After the Night Prayer
S_32.nameUr: نمازِ شب کے بعد کی دعا

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma yā dhā al-mulki al-muta’abbidi bi-al-khulūd wa aṣ-ṣulṭān,
segs.en: O God, O Possessor of the everlasting kingdom through eternity and dominion,

segs.tr: al-mumtani‘i bi-ghayri junūd wa lā a‘wān,
segs.en: the Unassailable without armies or helpers,
and the Enduring Might throughout the passing of ages,

segs.tr: wa khawālī al-a‘wām, wa mawāḍī al-azmān wa al-ayyām,
segs.en: the long-passed years, and the elapsed times and days!

segs.ar: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
segs.tr: ‘azza sulṭānuka ‘izzan lā ḥadda lahū bi-awwaliyyah wa lā muntahā lahū bi-ākhiriyyah,
segs.en: Your dominion is Mighty with a Might that has no limit in beginning and no end in finality,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
segs.tr: wa ista‘lā mulkuka ‘uluwwan saqaṭati al-ashyā’u dūna bulūghi amadih,
segs.en: and Your kingdom is exalted with an Exaltation below the attainment of whose term all things fall short,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
segs.tr: wa lā yablughu adnā mā ista’tharta bihī min dhālika aqṣā na‘ti an-nā‘itīn.
segs.en: and the utmost description of the describers does not reach the least of what You have singled out for Yourself of that.

segs.ar: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
segs.tr: Ḍallat fīka aṣ-ṣifātu wa tafassakhat dūnakā an-nu‘ūt,
segs.en: The attributes have been lost concerning You, and the descriptions have been dissolved below You,

segs.tr: wa ḥārat fī kibriyā’ika laṭā’ifu al-awhām,
segs.en: and the subtleties of imaginings are bewildered in Your Grandeur.

segs.ar: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: Kadhālika anta Allāhu al-Awwalu fī awwaliyyatik,
segs.en: Thus are You, God, the First in Your primordiality,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
segs.tr: wa ‘alā dhālika anta dā’imun lā tazūl,
segs.en: and upon that You are Everlasting, You do not pass away.

segs.ar: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
segs.tr: Wa anā al-‘abdu aḍ-ḍa‘īfu ‘amalan al-jasīmu amalan,
segs.en: And I am the servant, weak in deed, tremendous in hope,

segs.ar: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
segs.tr: kharajat min yadī asbābu al-wuṣulāt illā mā waṣalahū raḥmatuk,
segs.en: the means of connections have passed from my hand, save what Your Mercy connects,
and the ties of hopes have been cut off from me,

segs.ar: إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
segs.tr: illā mā anā mu‘taṣimun bihī min ‘afwik,
segs.en: save what I cling to of Your Pardon.

segs.ar: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Qalla ‘indī mā a‘taddu bihī min ṭā‘atik
segs.en: Little is what I hold in esteem of my obedience to You,

segs.ar: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa kathura ‘alayya mā abū’u bihī min ma‘ṣiyatik,
segs.en: and much is what I acknowledge of my disobedience to You.

segs.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segs.tr: Wa lan yaḍīqa ‘alayka ‘afwun ‘an ‘abdika wa in asā’a fa-‘fu ‘annī.
segs.en: And Your pardon will not be too difficult for You regarding Your servant, even if he did wrong, so pardon me.

segs.ar: أَللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa qad ashrafa ‘alā khafāyā al-a‘māl ‘ilmuk
segs.en: O God, Your knowledge has looked over the hidden parts of deeds,

segs.tr: wa inkashafa kullu mastūrin dūna khubrik
segs.en: and every concealed thing has been unveiled before Your awareness,
and the subtleties of affairs are not folded up from You,
nor are the hidden things of secrets absent from You.

segs.ar: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
segs.tr: Wa qad istaḥwadha ‘alayya ‘aduwwuka alladhī istanẓaraka li-ghiwāyatī fa-anẓartah,
segs.en: And Your enemy has overcome me—the one who asked You for a respite to lead me astray, and You granted him respite,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
segs.tr: wa istamhalaka ilā yawmi ad-dīn li-iḍlālī fa-amhaltah,
segs.en: and who asked You for a delay until the Day of Judgment to mislead me, and You gave him a delay.
So he made me fall, while I was fleeing to You,
from minor sins that destroy,
and major deeds that ruin,
until when I committed an act of disobedience to You,
and incurred Your wrath through my evil striving,
he twisted the rope of his treachery away from me,
and met me with his word of ingratitude,

segs.ar: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa tawallā al-barā’ata minnī wa adbara muwalliyan ‘annī,
segs.en: and he assumed innocence of me and turned away, retreating from me.
So he left me exposed to Your wrath, alone,

segs.tr: wa akhrajanī ilā finā’i naqimatika ṭarīdā
segs.en: and expelled me to the courtyard of Your vengeance, driven out.
There is no intercessor to intercede for me with You,
and no protector to grant me security from You,
and no fortress to veil me from You,

segs.tr: wa lā malādhun alja’u ilayhī mink.
segs.en: and no refuge to shelter in from You.

segs.ar: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: Fa-hādhā maqāmu al-‘ā’idhi bik, wa maḥallu al-mu‘tarif lak,
segs.en: So this is the station of the one seeking refuge in You, and the place of the one confessing to You,

segs.ar: فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
segs.tr: fa-lā yaḍīqanna ‘annī faḍluk, wa lā yaqṣuranna dūnī ‘afwuk,
segs.en: so let Your Favor not become narrow for me, and let Your Pardon not fall short of me,
and let me not be the most disappointed of Your repenting servants,
and not the most despairing of Your hopeful delegations.

segs.tr: Wa ighfir lī innaka khayru al-ghāfirīn.
segs.en: And forgive me, surely You are the best of those who forgive.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka amartanī fa-taraktu, wa nahaytanī fa-rakibt,
segs.en: O God, surely You commanded me, and I abandoned, and You forbade me, and I committed,

segs.ar: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
segs.tr: wa sawwala liya al-khaṭa’ khuṭūru as-sū’ fa-farraṭt,
segs.en: and the thought of evil tempted me to error, and I neglected,
and I do not call to witness my fasting by day,
nor do I seek refuge in my night vigil,
and no supererogatory act praises me for reviving it,

segs.ar: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
segs.tr: ḥāshā furūḍika allatī man ḍayya‘ahā halak,
segs.en: except for Your obligatory duties, which he who neglects them perishes.

segs.tr: wa lastu atawassalu ilayka bi-faḍli nāfilah
segs.en: And I do not draw close to You by the merit of a supererogatory prayer,

segs.ar: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ،
segs.tr: ma‘a kathīri mā aghfaltu min waẓā’ifi furūḍik,
segs.en: along with the great deal I have neglected of the functions of Your obligatory duties,
and transgressed beyond the bounds of Your limits,

segs.ar: إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
segs.tr: ilā ḥurumātin intahaktuhā, wa kabā’iri dhunūbin ijtaraḥtuhā
segs.en: to sacred things that I violated, and major sins that I committed,

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
segs.en: while Your well-being was a covering for me from their disgraces.

segs.ar: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: Wa hādhā maqāmu mani istaḥyā li-nafsihī mink,
segs.en: And this is the station of him who was ashamed of himself before You,
and became angry with it, and was pleased with You.

segs.ar: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
segs.tr: Fa-talaqqāka bi-nafsin khāshi‘ah, wa raqabatin khāḍi‘ah, wa ẓahrin muthqalin mina al-khaṭāyā
segs.en: So he met You with a humble soul, a submissive neck, and a back heavily laden with errors,

segs.ar: وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wāqifan bayna ar-raghbati ilayka wa ar-rahbati mink,
segs.en: standing between desire for You and dread of You.
And You are the worthiest of those he has hoped for,

segs.tr: wa aḥaqqu man khashiyahū wa ittqāh,
segs.en: and the most entitled of those he has feared and guarded against.

segs.ar: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ،
segs.tr: Fa-‘aṭinī yā Rabbi mā rajawtu, wa āminnī mā ḥadhirt,
segs.en: So give me, O Lord, what I have hoped for, and grant me security from what I have warned against,

segs.ar: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
segs.tr: wa ‘ud ‘alayya bi-‘ā’idati raḥmatik innaka akramu al-mas’ūlīn.
segs.en: and revert to me with the benefit of Your mercy, surely You are the Most Generous of those asked.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa idh satartanī bi-‘afwika wa taghammadtanī bi-faḍlik
segs.en: O God, since You covered me with Your pardon and submerged me in Your favor,
in the abode of passing away, in the presence of equals,
then shelter me from the disgraces of the abode of permanence,

segs.ar: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segs.en: at the standing-places of the witnesses: the nearest angels,

segs.tr: wa ar-rusuli al-mukarramīn wa ash-shuhadā’ wa aṣ-ṣāliḥīn,
segs.en: the honored Messengers, the martyrs, and the righteous,
from a neighbor whom I used to conceal my evil deeds from,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
segs.tr: wa min dhī raḥimin kuntu aḥtashimu minhu fī sarīrātī,
segs.en: and from a relative whom I used to feel ashamed before concerning my secrets.

segs.ar: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: Lam athiq bihim Rabbi fī as-sitr ‘alayya,
segs.en: I did not trust them, my Lord, in covering me,

segs.ar: وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa wathiqtu bika Rabbi fī al-maghfirah lī,
segs.en: but I trusted in You, my Lord, in forgiving me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wa anta awlā man wuthiqa bihī wa a‘ṭā man rughiba ilayh
segs.en: and You are the worthiest of those trusted, and the most giving of those desired,
and the most compassionate of those whose mercy is sought, so have mercy on me.

segs.ar: أَللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa anta ḥadartanī mā’an mahīnan min ṣulb,
segs.en: O God, You caused me to descend as a despised water from a loins,
narrow in bones, difficult in passages,
to a narrow womb that You covered with veils.

segs.ar: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاً عَنْ حَالٍ حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
segs.tr: tuṣarrifunī ḥālan ‘an ḥālin ḥattā intahayta bī ilā tamāmi aṣ-ṣūrah
segs.en: You varied me from one state to another until You brought me to the completion of the form,
and established the limbs in me,
as You described in Your Book:

segs.ar: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
segs.en: a drop, then a clot, then a lump of flesh, then bones,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
segs.tr: thumma kasawta al-‘iẓāma laḥmā thumma ansha’tanī khalqan ākharā kamā shi’t,
segs.en: then You clothed the bones with flesh, then You brought me forth as another creation, as You willed,
until when I needed Your provision,
and could not dispense with the help of Your favor,

segs.ar: جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
segs.tr: ja‘alta lī qūtan min faḍli ṭa‘āmin wa sharāb
segs.en: You made for me sustenance from the excess of food and drink

segs.ar: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لِامَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
segs.tr: ajraytahū li-amatika allatī askantanī jawfahā wa awda‘tanī qarāra raḥimihā,
segs.en: that You caused to flow for Your female servant in whose belly You lodged me and in the settled place of whose womb You deposited me.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي،
segs.tr: Wa law takilunī yā Rabbi fī tilka al-ḥālāt ilā ḥawlī,
segs.en: And if You had abandoned me, O Lord, in those states to my own ability,
or compelled me to my own strength,

segs.ar: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
segs.tr: la-kāna al-ḥawlu ‘annī mu‘tazilā, wa la-kānat al-quwwatu minnī ba‘īdah,
segs.en: the ability would have been withdrawn from me, and the strength would have been far from me.
So You nourished me with Your favor, the nourishment of the Kind, Gentle One,

segs.ar: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
segs.tr: taf‘alu dhālika bī taṭawwulan ‘alayya ilā ghāyatī hādhih,
segs.en: doing that to me as a bounty upon me, until this present time of mine.

segs.ar: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
segs.tr: Lā a‘damu birraka wa lā yubṭi’u bī ḥusnu ṣanī‘ik,
segs.en: I am not deprived of Your goodness, nor is the excellence of Your making slow for me.

segs.tr: wa lā tata’akkadu ma‘a dhālika thiqatī,
segs.en: Yet, with all that, my trust is not confirmed,

segs.ar: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
segs.en: so that I might devote myself to what is more felicitous for me with You.

segs.ar: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
segs.tr: Qad malaka ash-shayṭānu ‘inānī fī sū’i aẓ-ẓann wa ḍa‘fi al-yaqīn,
segs.en: Satan has taken hold of my rein through ill opinion and weakness of certainty,

segs.ar: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
segs.tr: fa-anā ashkū sū’a mujāwaratihī lī wa ṭā‘ata nafsī lah,
segs.en: so I complain of the evil of his neighboring me and the obedience of my soul to him.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ فِي صَرفِ كَيْدِهِ عَنّي
segs.tr: wa asta‘ṣimuka min malakatih, wa ataḍarra‘u ilayka fī ṣarf kaydihī ‘annī
segs.en: And I ask You for protection from his dominion, and I implore You to turn his trickery away from me,

segs.ar: وَ أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً،
segs.tr: wa as’aluka fī an tusahhila ilā rizqī sabīlā,
segs.en: and I ask You to make easy a path to my provision.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ،
segs.en: So praise belongs to You for Your initiation of immense blessings,

segs.tr: wa ilhāmika ash-shukra ‘alā al-iḥsān wa al-in‘ām,
segs.en: and Your inspiration of thanks for kindness and favor.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ،
segs.tr: wa sahhil ‘alayya rizqī wa an tuqanni‘anī bi-taqdīrika lī,
segs.en: and make my provision easy for me, and make me content with Your destiny for me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa an turḍiyanī bi-ḥiṣṣatī fīmā qasamt lī,
segs.en: and satisfy me with my portion in what You have allocated for me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
segs.tr: wa an taj‘ala mā dhahaba min jismī wa ‘umurī
segs.en: and make what has passed of my body and my life

segs.ar: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
segs.tr: fī sabīli ṭā‘atik innaka khayru ar-rāziqīn.
segs.en: in the way of Your obedience, surely You are the best of providers.

segs.ar: أَللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika min nārin taghallaẓta bihā ‘alā man ‘aṣāk,
segs.en: O God, I seek refuge in You from a Fire by which You showed severity toward whoever disobeyed You,

segs.ar: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
segs.tr: wa tawa‘‘adta bihā man ṣadafa ‘an riḍāk,
segs.en: and with which You threatened whoever turned away from Your pleasure,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نُورُهَا ظُلْمَةٌ وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
segs.tr: wa min nārin nūruhā ẓulmah wa hayyinuhā alīm, wa ba‘īduhā qarīb,
segs.en: and from a Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is painful, and whose far is near,

segs.tr: wa min nārin ya’kulu ba‘ḍahā ba‘ḍ,
segs.en: and from a Fire some of which devours some,
and some of which assaults some,

segs.tr: wa min nārin tadharu al-‘iẓāmā ramīmā,
segs.en: and from a Fire that leaves the bones as decayed dust,
and gives its inhabitants scalding water to drink,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa min nārin lā tubqī ‘alā man taḍarra‘a ilayhā,
segs.en: and from a Fire that does not spare whoever implores it,
and does not pity whoever asks for its compassion,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa lā taqdiru ‘alā at-takhfīf ‘amman khasha‘a lahā wa istaslama ilayhā,
segs.en: and cannot alleviate from whoever is humbled before it and surrenders to it.

segs.ar: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
segs.tr: Talqā sukkānahā bi-aḥarri mā ladayhā min alīmi an-nakāl wa shadīd al-wabāl,
segs.en: It meets its inhabitants with the hottest of what it possesses of painful retribution and severe wretchedness.

segs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا،
segs.tr: Wa a‘ūdhu bikā min ‘aqāribihā al-fāghirah afwāhuhā,
segs.en: And I seek refuge in You from its scorpions whose mouths are wide open,
and its serpents that strike with their fangs,

segs.ar: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa sharābihā alladhī yuqaṭṭi‘u am‘ā’ wa af’idata sukkānihā, wa yanzi‘u qulūbahum,
segs.en: and its drink which cuts up the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and tears out their hearts.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا بَاعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
segs.tr: Wa astahdīka li-mā bā‘ada minhā wa akhkhara ‘anhā.
segs.en: And I ask You for guidance to what keeps far from it and delays from it.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and shelter me from it through the favor of Your mercy,
and pardon my slips through the excellence of Your pardon,

segs.tr: wa lā takhdhulnī yā khayra al-mujīrīn
segs.en: and do not forsake me, O best of those who grant shelter.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka taqī al-karīhah, wa tu‘ṭī al-ḥasanah,
segs.en: O God, surely You ward off the detested, and You give the good,

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
segs.tr: wa taf‘alu mā turīd wa anta ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr.
segs.en: and You do what You will, and You are powerful over everything.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālih, idhā dhukira al-abrār,
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the righteous are mentioned,

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
segs.tr: wa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālihī mā ikhtalafa al-laylu wa an-nahār
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as the night and the day follow each other,
a blessing whose supply is not cut off,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
segs.tr: wa lā yuḥṣā ‘adaduhā ṣalātan tashḥanu al-hawā’,
segs.en: and whose number is not counted, a blessing that loads the atmosphere,
and fills the earth and the sky.
May God bless him until He is pleased,
and may God bless him and his Household

segs.ar: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
segs.tr: ba‘da ar-riḍā ṣalātan lā ḥadda lahā
segs.en: after His pleasure, with a blessing that has no limit

segs.tr: wa lā muntahā yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn.
segs.en: and no end, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma yaa d'aal- mul-kil-mutaab-bidi bil-khulood was-sul-t'aan
segs.en: 1.O God, O Possessor of kingdom perpetual in everlastingness,
2.authority invincible without armies or helpers,
3.might abiding through aeons past,
4.years gone by, times and days elapsed!

segs.ar: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
segs.tr: a'z-za sul-t'aanuka i'z-zal-laa h'ad-da lahoo biw-walee-yatiw-wa laa muntahaa lahoo biaakharee-yah
segs.en: 5.Your authority is mighty with a might that knows no bound by being first nor utmost end by being last!

segs.ar: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
segs.tr: was-taa'-laa mul-kuka u'loo-wana saqat'atil-ash-yaaa-u doona bulooghi amadih
segs.en: 6.Your kingdom towers high with a towering before which all things fall down without reaching its term;

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
segs.tr: wa laa yab-lughu ad-naa mas-taa-thar-ta bihee min d'alika aq-s'aa naa'-tin-naai'teen
segs.en: 7.the least of it which You hast kept to Yourself is not reached by the furthest description of the describers!

segs.ar: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
segs.en: 8.Attributes go astray in You, descriptions fall apart below You,
9.the subtlest of imaginations are bewildered by Your magnificence!

segs.ar: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ،
segs.en: 10.So art Thou: God, the First in Your firstness,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
segs.tr: wa a'laa d'alika anta daaa-imul-laa tazool
segs.en: 11.and so art You everlastingly. You dost not pass away.

segs.ar: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
segs.tr: wa anaal-a'b-d az''-z''ae'efu a'malaan al-jaseemu amalaa
segs.en: 12.But I am the slave, feeble in works, immense in hopes.

segs.ar: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
segs.tr: kharajat mee-yadeee as-baabul-wus'ulaati il-laa maa was'alahoo rah'-matuk
segs.en: 13.The tying links are outside my hand, except what is tied by Your mercy;
14.the bonds of hopes have been cut away from me,

segs.ar: إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
segs.tr: il-laa maaa ana mua'-tas'imum-bihee min a'f-wik
segs.en: 15.except the pardon to which I hold fast.

segs.ar: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: qal-la i'ndee maaa aa'-tad-du bihee min t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 16.Little on my part is the obedience toward You upon which I count,

segs.ar: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa kathura a'lay-ya maaa abooo-u bihee mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segs.en: 17.and great against me the disobedience toward You to which I have reverted.

segs.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segs.tr: wa lay-yaz''eeqa a'lay-ka a'f-wun a'n a'b-dika wa in asaaa-a faa'-fu a'n-nee
segs.en: 18.But pardoning Your slave will not constrain You, even if he be bad, so pardon me!

segs.ar: أللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma waqad ash-rafa a'laa khafaayaal-aa'-maali i'l-muk
segs.en: 19.O God, Your knowledge watches over hidden works
20.every covered thing is exposed before Your awareness,
21.the intricacies of things are not concealed from You,
22.and unseen mysteries slip not away from You.

segs.ar: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
segs.tr: wa qadi as-tah'-wad'a a'lay-ya a'doo-wukal-lad'ee s-tanz'araka lighawaayatee faanz'ar-tah
segs.en: 23.But over me Your enemy has gained mastery: He asked a delay from You to lead me astray, and You gavest him the delay!

segs.ar: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
segs.en: 24.He asked a respite from You until the Day of Doom to misguide me, and You gavest him the respite!
25.So he threw me down, though I had fled to You
26.from small, ruinous sins
27.and great, deadly works,
28.until, when I had yielded to disobeying You
29.and merited Your anger through my bad efforts,
30.he turned the bridle of his treachery away from me,
31.met me with the word of his ingratitude,

segs.ar: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa tawal-laal-baraaa-ata min-nee wa ad-bara muwal-leeana a'n-nee
segs.en: 32.undertook to be quit of me, turned his back to flee from me,
33.threw me to the desert of Your wrath alone,

segs.tr: wa akh-rajaneee ilaa finaaa-i naqimatika t'areedaa
segs.en: 34.and sent me as an outcast into the courtyard of Your vengeance.
35.There is no intercessor to intercede for me with You,
36.no protector to make me feel secure against You,
37.no fortress to veil me from You,

segs.tr: wa laa malaad'un al-jaa ilay-hee mink
segs.en: 38.no shelter in which to seek asylum apart from You!

segs.ar: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: fahd'aa maqaamul-a'aa-id'i bika wa mah'al-lul-mua'-tarifi lak
segs.en: 39.This is the station of him who takes refuge with You, the place of the confessor to You:

segs.ar: فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
segs.tr: falaa yaz''eeqan-na a'n-nee faz''-luk wa laa yaq-s'uran-na doonee a'f-wuk
segs.en: 40.Let not Your bounty be too narrow for me, let not Your pardon fall short of me!
41.Let me not be the most disappointed of Your repentant servants,
42.nor the most despairing of those who come to You with expectations!
43.Forgive me, surely You art the best of the forgivers!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nak amar-tanee fatarak-t wa nahay-tanee farakib-t
segs.en: 44.O God, You commanded me, and I refrained, You prohibited me, and I committed.

segs.ar: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
segs.en: 45.evil thoughts tempted me to offend, and I was negligent.

segs.tr: wa laaa as-tash-hidu a'laa s'eeaamee nahaaraa
segs.en: 46.I cannot call upon daytime to witness my fasting,
47.nor can I seek sanctuary in night because of my vigil;

segs.tr: wa laa tuth-nee a'lay-ya biih'-yaaa-ihaa sun-natun
segs.en: 48.no Sunna praises me for keeping it alive,

segs.ar: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
segs.en: 49.only Your obligations, he who neglects which has perished.

segs.tr: wa las-tu atawas-salu ilay-ka bifaz''-li naafilatin
segs.en: 50.I cannot seek access to You through the excellence of a supererogatory work,

segs.ar: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ،
segs.tr: maa' katheeri maaa agh-fal-tu miw-waz'aaa-ifi furooz''ik
segs.en: 51.given the many duties of Your obligations of which I have been heedless
52.and the stations of Your bounds which I have transgressed,

segs.ar: إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
segs.tr: ilaa h'urumaatin antahak-tuhaa wa kabaaa-iri d'unoobin aj-tarah'-tuhaa
segs.en: 53.thereby violating sacred things and committing great sins,

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
segs.tr: kaanat a'afeeatuka lee min faz''aaa-ih'ihaa sit-raa
segs.en: 54.though You hast given me safety from their disgraces as a covering.

segs.ar: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wa had'aa maqaamu man as-tah'-yaa linaf-sihee mink
segs.en: 55.This is the station of him who is ashamed of himself before You,

segs.tr: wa sakhit'a a'lay-haa wa raz''eea a'nka
segs.en: 56.angry with himself, and satisfied with You.

segs.ar: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
segs.tr: fatalaq-qaaka binaf-sin khaashia'h wa raqabatin khaaz''ia'h wa z'ah-rim-muth-qalim-mina alkhat'aayaa
segs.en: 57.He meets You with a humble soul, a neck bent down, a back heavy with offenses,

segs.ar: وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segs.en: 58.hesitating between longing for You and fear of You.
59.You art the most worthy of those in whom he might hope,

segs.tr: wa ah'aq-qu man khasheeahoo wa at-taqaah
segs.en: 60.the most deserving for him to dread and fear.

segs.ar: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ،
segs.tr: faaa'-t'inee yaa rab-bi maa rajaw-t wa aaamin-nee maa h'ad'ir-t
segs.en: 61.So give me, my Lord, what I hope for, make me secure against what frightens me,

segs.ar: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
segs.tr: wa u'd a'lay-ya bia'aa-idati rah'-matik in-naka ak-ramul-mas-ooleen
segs.en: 62.and act kindly toward me with the kindly act of mercy! Surely You art the most generous of those from whom are asked!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa id' satar-tanee bia'f-wik wa tagham-mat-tanee bifaz''-lika
segs.en: 63.O God, since You hast covered me with Your pardon and shielded me with Your bounty
64.in the abode of annihilation and the presence of equals
65.grant me sanctuary from the disgraces of the Abode of Subsistence

segs.ar: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ المَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segs.en: 66.at the standing places of the Witnesses (the angels brought nigh,
67.the messengers honoured, the martyrs, the righteous)
68.before the neighbour from whom I have hidden my evil deeds

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
segs.tr: wa min d'ee rah'imin kuntu ah'-tashimu min-hoo fee sareeraatee
segs.en: 69.and the womb relative before whom I feel ashamed in my secret thoughts!

segs.ar: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: lam athiq bihim rab-bi fis-sit-ri a'lay
segs.en: 70.I trust them not, my Lord, to cover me over,

segs.ar: وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa wathiq-t bika rab-bi fil-magh-firati lee
segs.en: 71.but I trust You, my Lord, to forgive me!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wa anta aw-laa maw-wuthiqa bih wa aa'-t'aa mar-rughiba ilay-h
segs.en: 72.You art the most worthy of those in whom confidence is had, the most giving of those who are besought,
73.and the most clement of those from whom mercy is asked. So have mercy upon me!

segs.ar: أللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa anta h'adar-tanee maaa-am-maheenaa min s'ul-bim
segs.en: 74.O God, You caused me to descend as mean water from loins
75.of narrow bones and tight passages
76.into a constricted womb which You hadst covered with veils;

segs.ar: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاًَ عَنْ حَال حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
segs.tr: tus'ar-rifunee h'aalana a'n h'aalin h'at-taa antahay-ta beee ilaa tamaamis'-s'oorah
segs.en: 77.You turned me about from state to state until You tookest me to the completion of the form
78.and fixed within me the bodily parts,
79.as You hast described in Your Book:

segs.ar: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
segs.tr: (nut'-fatan thum-ma a'laqatan thum-ma muz''-ghatan thum-ma i'z'aamana
segs.en: 80.a drop, then a clot, then a tissue, then bones,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
segs.tr: thum-ma kasaw-tal-i'z'aama lah'-mana thum-ma anshaa-tanee khal-qan aaakhar) kamaa shi-t
segs.en: 81.then You garmented the bones with flesh, then You produced me as another creature as You willed (ref.23:12-14).
82.Then, when I needed Your provision,

segs.tr: wa lam as-tagh-ni a'n gheeaathi faz''-lik
segs.en: 83.and could not do without the aid of Your bounty,

segs.ar: جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
segs.tr: jaa'l-ta lee qootam-min faz''-li t'aa'amiw-wa sharaabin
segs.en: 84.You appointed for me a nourishment from the bounty of the food and drink

segs.ar: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لاِمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
segs.tr: aj-ray-tahoo liamatikal-latee as-kantanee jaw-fahaa wa aw-daa'-tanee qaraara rah'imihaa
segs.en: 85.which You bestowed upon Your handmaid in whose belly You gavest me to rest and in the lodging of whose womb You deposited me.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي،
segs.tr: wa law takil-nee yaa rab-bi fee til-kal-h'aalaati ilaa h'aw-leee
segs.en: 86.Hadst You entrusted me in those states, my Lord, to my own force
87.or driven me to have recourse to my own strength,

segs.ar: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
segs.tr: lakaanal-h'aw-lu a'n-nee mua'-tazilaa wa lakaanati alqoo-watu min-nee bae'edah
segs.en: 88.force would have been removed from me and strength taken far away.
89.So You hast fed me through Your bounty with the food of the Good, the Gentle;

segs.ar: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
segs.tr: taf-a'lu d'alika bee tat'aw-wulana a'lay-ya ilaa ghaayatee had'ih
segs.en: 90.You hast done that for me in graciousness toward me up to this my present point.

segs.ar: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
segs.tr: laaa aa'-damu bir-rak wa laa yub-t'i-u bee h'us-nu s'aneei'k
segs.en: 91.I do not lack Your goodness nor does Your benefaction keep me waiting.

segs.tr: wa laa tataak-kadu maa' d'alika thiqatee
segs.en: 92.Yet with all that, my trust has not become firm enough

segs.ar: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
segs.tr: faatafar-ragha limaa huwa ah'-z'a lee i'ndak
segs.en: 93.that I might free myself for that which is more favoured by You.

segs.ar: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
segs.tr: qad malakash-shay-t'aanu i'naanee fee sooo-iz'-z'an-ni waz''aa'-fil-yaqeen
segs.en: 94.Satan has taken possession of my reins through my distrust and frail certainty.

segs.ar: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
segs.tr: faanaa ash-koo sooo-a mujaawaratihee lee wa t'aaa'ta naf-see lah
segs.en: 95.I complain of his evil neighbourhood with me and my soul's obedience toward him!

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ في صَرفِ كَيدِهِ عَنّي
segs.tr: wa as-taa'-s'imuka mim-malakatih wa ataz''ar-rau' ilay-ka fee s'arf-i kaydihee 'annee
segs.en: 96.I ask You to preserve me against his domination, and I plead with You to turn his trickery away from me!

segs.ar: و أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً،
segs.tr: wa as-aluka feee an tusah-hila ilaa riz-qee sabeela
segs.en: 97.I ask You to make the path to my provision easy,

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ،
segs.en: 98.since to You belongs praise for Your beginning with immense favours
99.and Your inspiring gratitude for beneficence and bestowing favour!
100.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ،
segs.tr: wasah-hil a'lay-ya riz-qee wa an tuq-nia'nee bitaq-deerika lee
segs.en: 101.and make the way to my provision easy for me! [I ask You] to make me content with Your ordainment for me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa an tur-z''eeanee bih'is'-s'atee feemaa qasam-ta lee
segs.en: 102.to make me satisfied with my lot in that which You hast apportioned for me

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
segs.tr: wa an taj-a'la maa d'ahaba min jis-mee wau'm-ree
segs.en: 103.and to place what has gone of my body and my life-span

segs.ar: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
segs.en: 104.into the path of Your obedience! Surely You art the Best of providers!

segs.ar: أللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee su'wd'u bika min-naar taghal-laz'-ta bihaa a'laa man a's'aak
segs.en: 105.O God, I seek refuge in You from the Fire through which You art harsh toward him who disobeys You

segs.ar: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
segs.tr: wa tawaa'-a't-ta bihaa man s'adafa a'r-riz''aak
segs.en: 106.and by which You hast threatened him who turns away from Your good pleasure;

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نورُهَا ظُلْمَة وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
segs.tr: wa min-naarin-nooruhaa z'ul-mah wa hay-yinuhaaa aleem wa bae'eduhaa qareeb
segs.en: 107.from the Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is pain, and whose far is near;
108.from the Fire parts of which devour parts
109.and parts of which leap upon parts;
110.from the Fire which leaves bones decayed
111.and lets its people drink boiling water;

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa min-naaril-laa tub-qee a'laa man taz''ar-raa' ilay-haa
segs.en: 112.from the Fire which 'does not spare him who pleads to it,'
113.has no mercy on him who seeks sympathy from it,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa laa taq-diru a'laat-takh-feefi a'm-man khashaa' lahaa was-tas-lama ilay-haa
segs.en: 114.and has no power to relieve him who humbles himself before it and yields himself to it;

segs.ar: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
segs.tr: tal-qaa suk-kaanahaa bih'ar-ri maa laday-haa min aleemin-nakaali washadeedil-wabaal
segs.en: 115.it meets its inhabitants with the hottest that it possesses: painful punishment and intense noxiousness.

segs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا،
segs.tr: wa au'wd'u bika min- a'qaaribihaal-faaghirati af-waahuhaa
segs.en: 116.seek refuge in You from its gaping-jawed scorpions,
117.its scraping-toothed serpents,

segs.ar: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa sharaabihaal-lad'ee yuqat'-t'iu' am-a'aa-a wa af-idata suk-kaanihaa wa yanziu' quloobahum
segs.en: 118.and its drinks, which tear apart the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and root out their marrows.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا باعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
segs.tr: wa as-tah-deeka limaa baaa'da min-haa wa akh-khara a'n-haa
segs.en: 119.I ask guidance from You to that which will keep far from it and make it retreat!
120.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
121.grant me sanctuary from it through the bounty of Your mercy,
122.release me from my stumbles through Your good releasing,
123.and abandon me not, O Best of the sanctuary-granters!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ،
segs.en: 124.O God, You protectest from the disliked, givest the good,

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
segs.tr: wa taf-a'lu maa tureed wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segs.en: 125.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaaliheee id'aa d'ukiral-ab-raar
segs.en: 126.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the pious are mentioned

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
segs.tr: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee makh-talafal-lay-lu wan-nahaar
segs.en: 127.and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as night and day come
128.and go with a blessing whose replenishment is never cut off

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
segs.tr: wa laa yuh'-s'aa a'daduhaa s'alaatan tash-h'anul-hawaaa-a
segs.en: 129.and whose number cannot be counted, a blessing that will fill up the air
130.and crowd the earth and the heaven!
131.God bless him until he is well pleased
132.and God bless him and his Household

segs.ar: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
segs.en: 133.after good pleasure with a blessing that has neither bound
134.nor utmost limit! O Most Merciful of the merciful!
O Allah! I seek the best from You through Your knowledge.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ لِي بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segs.tr: Fa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-Ālihī, wa-qḍi lī bil-khīrah
segs.en: So bless Muḥammad and his family, and decree for me the best choice.
And inspire us with knowledge of choosing rightly.
And make that a means to contentment.

segs.ar: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ
segs.tr: Bimā qaḍayta lanā, wa-al-taslīmi limā ḥakamta
segs.en: With what You have decreed for us, and submitting to what You decide.
So remove from us the doubts of uncertainty.
And strengthen us with the certainty of the sincere.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā tasumnā ʿajza al-maʿrifati ʿammā takhayyarta
segs.en: And do not make us suffer the ignorance of what You have chosen.
So that we belittle Your decree or dislike the place of Your pleasure.

segs.ar: وَنَجْنَحَ إِلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
segs.tr: Wa-najnaḥa ilā allatī hiya abʿadu min ḥusni al-ʿāqibah
segs.en: And incline towards that which is far from a good outcome.
And nearer to the opposite of well-being.

segs.ar: حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segs.tr: Ḥabbib ʾilaynā mā nakrahu min qaḍāʾika
segs.en: Make beloved to us what we dislike from Your decree.

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-sahhil ʿalaynā mā nastasʿibu min ḥukmika
segs.en: And make easy for us what we find difficult from Your judgment.

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا الِانْقِيَادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-alhimnā al-inqiyāda limā awradta ʿalaynā min mashīʾatika
segs.en: And inspire us to submit to whatever You bring upon us from Your will.

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نُحِبَّ تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā nuḥibba taʾkhīra mā ʿajjalta
segs.en: So that we do not wish to delay what You hasten.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلَا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā taʿjīla mā akhkharta, wa-lā nakraha mā aḥbabta
segs.en: Nor hasten what You delay, nor dislike what You love.
Nor choose what You dislike.

segs.ar: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبَةً وَأَكْرَمُ مَصِيرًا
segs.tr: Wa-akhtim lanā billatī hiya aḥmadu ʿāqibatan wa-akramu maṣīrā
segs.en: And seal for us with that which is the best outcome and most honorable end.
Surely You bestow generosity and grant great gifts.

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segs.tr: Wa-tafʿalu mā turīdu, wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
segs.en: And You do what You will, and You are powerful over all things.
1.O God, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاقْضِ لِيْ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waq-z''i lee bil-kheearah
segs.en: 2.so bless Muhammad and his Household and decree for me the best!
3.Inspire us with knowledge to chose the best
4.and make that a means to being pleased

segs.ar: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ.
segs.tr: bimaa qaz''ay-ta lanaa wat-tas-leemi limaa h'akam-t
segs.en: 5.with what You hast decreed for us and submitting to what You hast decided!
6.Banish from us the doubt of misgiving
7.and confirm us with the certainty of the sincere!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ،
segs.tr: wa laa tasum-naa a'j-zal-maa'-rifati a'm-maa takhay-yar-t
segs.en: 8.Visit us not with incapacity to know what You hast chosen,

segs.tr: fanagh-mit'a qad-rak wa nak-raha maw-z''ia' riz''aak
segs.en: 9.lest we despise Your measuring out, dislike the place of Your good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَنَجْنَحَ إلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
segs.tr: wa naj-nah'a ilaal-latee hee ab-a'du min h'us-nil-a'aqibah
segs.en: 10.and incline toward that which is further from good outcome
11.and nearer to the opposite of well-being!

segs.ar: حَبِّبْ إلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segs.tr: h'ab-bib ilay-naa maa nak-rahoo min qaz''aaa-ik
segs.en: 12.Make us love what we dislike in Your decree

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ،
segs.tr: wa sah-hil a'lay-naa maa nas-tas'-i'bu min h'uk-mik
segs.en: 13.and make easy for us what we find difficult in Your decision!

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَـا الانْقِيَـادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَـا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segs.tr: wa al-him-naalinqeeaada limaaa aw-rat-ta a'lay-naa mim-mashee-yatik
segs.en: 14.Inspire us to yield to that which You bringest upon us by Your will,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لاَ نُحِبَّ تَأخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ،
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa nuh'ib taa-kheera maa a'j-jal-t
segs.en: 15.lest we love the delay of what You hast hastened

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَعْجيْلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ،
segs.tr: wa laa taa'-jeela maaa skh-khar-t wa laa nak-raha maaa ah'-bab-t
segs.en: 16.and the hastening of what You hast delayed, dislike what You lovest,
17.and choose what You dislikest!

segs.ar: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبةً وَأكْرَمُ مَصِيراً
segs.tr: wakh-tim lanaa bil-latee hee ah'-madu a'aqibah wa ak-ramu mas'eeraa
segs.en: 18.Seal us with that which is most praised in outcome and most generous in issue!
19.Surely You givest generous gain, bestowest the immense,

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
segs.tr: wa taf-a'lu maa tureed wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segs.en: 20.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).

S_34.name: 34. When Afflicted or Seeing Sinners Disgraced

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،
segs.en: O God, praise be to You for Your covering after Your knowledge,
and Your granting of well-being after Your awareness.

segs.ar: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ،
segs.tr: Fa-kullunā qadi iqtarafa al-‘ā’ibah fa-lam tashharh,
segs.en: For all of us have committed a shameful act, yet You did not make it public,
and perpetrated an indecency, yet You did not disgrace him,
and concealed himself with evil deeds, yet You did not point them out.
How many prohibitions of Yours have we transgressed,
and a command upon which You made us stand, yet we exceeded it,

segs.tr: wa sayyi’atan iktasabnāhā, wa khaṭī’atan irtakabnāhā,
segs.en: and an evil deed we acquired, and an error we committed.
You were the Observer of it without the sight of others,
and the One powerful to announce it beyond all who are powerful.

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ،
segs.en: Your well-being was a veil for us, excluding their eyes,
and a barrier excluding their ears.
So make what You covered of the faults,

segs.tr: wa akhfayta mina ad-dakhīlah wā‘iẓan lanā,
segs.en: and what You hid of the secret sin, an admonition for us,

segs.ar: وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ،
segs.tr: wa zājiran ‘an sū’i al-khulq wa iqtirāf al-khaṭī’ah,
segs.en: and a deterrent from evil character and the commission of error,

segs.ar: وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
segs.tr: wa sa‘yan ilā at-tawbati al-māḥiyah wa aṭ-ṭarīqi al-maḥmūdah,
segs.en: and a striving toward the effacing repentance and the praiseworthy path.
And bring near the time for it,
and do not burden us with heedlessness toward You.

segs.ar: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
segs.tr: Innā ilayka rāghibūn, wa mina adh-dhunūbi tā’ibūn.
segs.en: Surely we are desirous of You, and repentant from sins.

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: Wa ṣalli ‘alā khiyaratika Allāhumma min khalqik
segs.en: And bless, O God, Your chosen one from Your creation,

segs.ar: مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ،
segs.tr: Muḥammad wa ‘itratyhī aṣ-ṣifwah min barriyyatika aṭ-ṭāhirīn,
segs.en: Muḥammad, and his progeny, the elite of Your pure creation,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
segs.tr: wa ij‘alnā lahum sāmi‘īn wa muṭī‘īn kamā amart.
segs.en: and make us attentive and obedient to them, as You commanded.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma lakal-h'am-du a'laa sit-rika baa'-da i'l-mik
segs.en: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your covering over after Your knowledge
2.and Your pardon after Your awareness!

segs.ar: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ،
segs.en: 3.Each of us has committed faults, but You hast not made him notorious,
4.done indecencies, but You hast not disgraced him,

segs.tr: wa tasat-tara bil-masaawi-i falam tad-lul a'lay-h
segs.en: 5.and covered over evil deeds, but You hast not pointed to him.
6.How many are Your prohibited acts which we have performed,

segs.tr: wa am-rin qad waqaf-tanaa a'lay-hee fataa'd-day-naah
segs.en: 7.Your commandments of which You hast told us which we have transgressed,

segs.tr: wa say-yi-atin ak-tasab-naahaa wa khat'ee-atin ar-takab-naahaa
segs.en: 8.the evil deeds which we have earned, the offenses which we have committed!
9.You seest them to the exclusion of all observers;
10.You hast the power to make them public above all the powerful!

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ،
segs.tr: kaanat a'afeeatuka lanaa h'ijaabana doona ab-s'aarhim
segs.en: 11.By giving us safety You hast veiled their eyes
12.and stopped their ears.
13.So make the shameful things You hast covered over
14.and the inward reality You hast concealed our admonisher,

segs.ar: وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ،
segs.en: 15.a restrainer upon bad character traits and committing offenses,

segs.ar: وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
segs.en: 16.and a striving toward the repentance that erases [sins] and the praiseworthy path!
17.Bring the time of striving near
18.and visit us not with heedlessness of You!

segs.ar: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
segs.tr: in-naaa ilay-ka raaghiboon wa minad'-d'unoobi taaa-iboon
segs.en: 19.Surely we are Your beseechers, the repenters of sins.

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: wa s'al-li a'laa kheearatikal-laahum-ma min khal-qika
segs.en: 20.And bless Your chosen, O God, from Your creation,

segs.ar: مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ،
segs.en: 21.Muhammad and his descendants, the friends selected from among Your creatures, the pure,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
segs.tr: waj-a'l-naa lahum saamie'ena wamut'eee'ena kamaaa amar-t
segs.en: 22.and make us listeners to them and obeyers, as You hast commanded!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
All praise is for Allah, in satisfaction with His decree.

segs.ar: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ،
segs.tr: shahidtu anna llāha qasama ma‘āyisha ‘ibādihi bil-‘adli
segs.en: I bear witness that Allah divided the livelihoods of His servants with justice.
And He deals with all His creation with grace.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And do not test me with what You have given them.
And do not test them with what You withheld from me.
So that I do not envy Your creation, nor reject Your judgment.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And make my soul content with Your decree.
And expand my chest through the places of Your judgment.
And grant me trust so that I acknowledge with it—

segs.ar: بِأَنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ.
segs.tr: bi-anna qaḍā’aka lam yajri illā bil-khīrati
segs.en: That Your decree runs only with wisdom and goodness.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي،
segs.en: And make my gratitude to You for what You withheld from me—

segs.ar: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إِيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي.
segs.tr: awfara min shukrī iyyāka ‘alā mā khawwaltanī
segs.en: Greater than my gratitude for what You granted me.

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَظُنَّ بِذِي عَدَمٍ خَسَاسَةً،
segs.tr: wa-‘ṣimnī min an aẓunna bidhī ‘adamin khasāsatan
segs.en: And protect me from thinking the poor are lowly.
Or from thinking that the wealthy have virtue.
For the noble one is he whom Your obedience ennobles.
And the mighty is he whom Your worship strengthens.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And grant us an endless wealth.
And support us with a strength that never vanishes.
And let us roam freely in the kingdom of eternity.
Indeed, You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge.
The One who neither begets nor is begotten.
And none is comparable to You.

segs.tr: aal-h'am-du ll-lahee riz''an bih'uk-mil-laah shahit-tu an-nal-laah
segs.en: 1.Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

segs.ar: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ،
segs.en: 2.I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice

segs.tr: wa akhad'a a'laa jameei' khal-qihee bil-faz''-l
segs.en: 3.and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.
4.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
5.tempt me not with what You hast given to Your creatures

segs.ar: وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa taf-tin-hum bimaa manaa'-tanee faah'-suda khal-qak wa agh-mit'a h'uk-mak
segs.en: 6.and tempt them not with what You hast withheld from me, lest I envy Your creatures and despise Your decision!
7.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
8.delight my soul through Your decree,
9.expand my breast through the instances of Your decision,
10.give to me a trust through which I may admit

segs.ar: بِأََنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segs.tr: bi an-na qaz''aaa-aka lam yaj-ri il-laa bil-kheearah
segs.en: 11.that Your decree runs only to the best,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنّي
segs.tr: waj-a'l shuk-ree laka a'laa maa zaway-ta a'n-neee
segs.en: 12.and let my gratitude to You for what You hast taken away from me

segs.ar: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
segs.tr: aw-fara min shuk-reee ee-yaaka a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanee
segs.en: 13.be more abundant than my gratitude to You for what You hast conferred upon me!

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً،
segs.tr: waa'-s'im-nee min an az'un-na bid'ee a'damin khasaasah
segs.en: 14.Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute
15.or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth,
16.for the noble is he whom obedience to You has ennobled
17.and the exalted is he whom worship of You has exalted!
18.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ
segs.tr: wa mat-tia'-naa bithar-watil-laa tanfad wa ay-yid-naa bii'z-zil-laa yuf-qad
segs.en: 19.give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost,
20.and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!
21.Surely You art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;
22.You hast not begotten, nor hast You been begotten,
23.and equal to You is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!

S_36.name: 36. On Hearing Thunder
S_36.nameUr: بجلی اور گرج کے وقت کی دعا

segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma inna hadhayni āyatāni min āyātika,
segs.en: O Allah! Indeed these two are among Your signs,
And these two are among Your helpers,

segs.ar: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَةٍ نَافِعَةٍ أَوْ نِقْمَةٍ ضَارَّةٍ،
segs.tr: Yabtadirāni ṭā‘ataka biraḥmatin nāfi‘atin aw niqmatin ḍārratin,
segs.en: They hasten to obey You, bringing either helpful mercy or harmful punishment,
So do not pour upon us their evil rain,
And do not clothe us with affliction through them.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segs.tr: Wa anzil ‘alaynā naf‘a hādhihi as-saḥā’ibi wa barakatahā,
segs.en: And send down upon us the benefit and blessing of these clouds,
And turn away from us their harm and damage,
And do not strike us with calamity through them,
And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa in kunta ba‘athtahā niqmah wa arsaltahā sakhta,
segs.en: O Allah, if You have sent them as a punishment and anger,
Then we seek refuge in You from Your anger,
And we implore You in asking for Your pardon,
So direct Your anger towards the polytheists,
And turn the mill of Your punishment upon the disbelievers.
O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,
And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,
And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segs.en: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,
For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,
And the safe one is the one You protect,
No one besides You has defense,
And no one can resist Your might,

segs.ar: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segs.en: You judge as You will over whom You will,

segs.tr: Wataqḍī bimā aradta fī man aradta,
segs.en: And You decree as You wish upon whom You wish.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segs.en: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النِّعْمَاءِ
segs.en: And thanks are Yours for what You granted us of blessings,
A praise that surpasses the praise of those who praise,
A praise that fills His earth and His heaven,
Surely, You are the Bestower of immense favors,
The Giver of great blessings,
The Accepter of even little praise,
The Thankful for even little gratitude,
The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segs.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segs.tr: Lā ilāha illā anta ilayka al-maṣīr,
segs.en: There is no god but You; to You is the return.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-na hd'ay-ni aaayataani min aaayaatik
segs.en: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs
2.and these are two of Your helpers.

segs.ar: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
segs.tr: yab-tadiraani t'aaa'taka birah'-matin-naafia'tin aw naqimatin z''aaar-rah
segs.en: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,
4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain
5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segs.tr: wa anzil a'lay-naa naf-a' had'ihs-sah'aaa-ibi wa barakatahaa
segs.en: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,
8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,
9.strike us not through them with blight,

segs.tr: wa laa tur-sil a'laa maa'ayishinaa a'ahah
segs.en: 10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa in kunta baa'th-tahaa naqimah wa ar-sal-tahaa sakh-t'ah
segs.en: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,
12.we seek sanctuary with You from Your wrath

segs.tr: wa nab-tahilu ilay-ka fee soo-aali a'f-wik
segs.en: 13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!
14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters
15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics
16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,
17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,
18.distract us not from You through other than You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa taq-t'aa' a'n kaaaf-fatinaa maaad-data bir-rik
segs.en: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,
20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,
21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!
22.No one has any defense against You,

segs.tr: wa laa bih'adin a'n sat'-watika am-tinaaa'
segs.en: 23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

segs.ar: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segs.tr: tah'-kumu bimaa shi-ta a'laa man shi-t
segs.en: 24.You decidest what You wilt for whom You wilt

segs.tr: wa taq-z''ee bimaaa arat-ta fee man arat-t
segs.en: 25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segs.en: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
segs.tr: wa lakash-shuk-ru a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanaa minan-naa'-maaa-i
segs.en: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,
28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,
29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!
30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,
31.the Giver of abounding favours,
32.the Accepter of small praise,
33.the Grateful for little gratitude,
34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

segs.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segs.en: 35.There is no god but Thou; unto You is the homecoming
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ أَحَدًا لَا يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً
segs.tr: Allāhumma inna aḥadan lā yablughu min shukrika ghāyah
segs.en: O Allah, nobody can ever reach the limit of thanking You

segs.ar: إِلَّا حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إِحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرًا
segs.tr: Illā ḥaṣala ʿalayhi min iḥsānika mā yulzimuhu shukran
segs.en: Except that Your kindness to him requires him to thank You further

segs.ar: وَلَا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغًا مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإِنِ اجْتَهَدَ
segs.tr: Wa lā yablughu mablaghan min ṭāʿatika wa in ijtahada
segs.en: And no one attains the rank of truly obeying You, even by striving

segs.ar: إِلَّا كَانَ مُقَصِّرًا دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: Illā kāna muqaṣṣiran dūna istiḥqāqika bifaḍlika
segs.en: Except that he always falls short of deserving Your grace
Thus, the most grateful of Your servants is weak in thanking You
And the best worshipper among them falls short in serving You

segs.ar: لَا يَجِبُ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ
segs.tr: Lā yajibu li-aḥadin an taghfira lahu bi-istiḥqāqihi
segs.en: No one deserves forgiveness on account of their own merit

segs.tr: Wa lā an tarḍā ʿanhu bi-istijābihi
segs.en: Nor does anyone earn Your pleasure by their own acts
Whomever You forgive, it is through Your benevolence
And whomever You are pleased with, it is by Your favor

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ
segs.tr: Tashkuru yasīra mā shukirta wa tuthību ʿalā qalīli mā tuṭāʿu fīh
segs.en: You reward even a little thankfulness, and grant much for few acts of obedience

segs.ar: حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ
segs.tr: Ḥattā ka-anna shukra ʿibādika alladhī awjabta ʿalayhi thawābahum
segs.en: Until it seems that the thankfulness of Your servants has necessitated their reward
And You have magnified their recompense

segs.ar: أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الاِمْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
segs.tr: Amrun malakū istiṭāʿata al-imtināʿ minhu dūnaka
segs.en: As if they possessed the strength to abstain from it without You

segs.ar: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ
segs.tr: Fa-kāfaytahum aw lam yakun sababuhu biyadika fa-jāzaytahum
segs.en: You rewarded them—or if its reason were not in Your hand, You would still reward them

segs.ar: بَلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إِلَهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ
segs.tr: Bal malakta yā Ilāhī amrahum qabla an yamlikū ʿibādataka
segs.en: Rather, O my God, You owned their affair before they owned Your worship

segs.ar: وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa aʿdadda thawābahum qabla an yufīḍū fī ṭāʿatika
segs.en: And prepared their reward before they could even perform Your obedience
And that is because Your tradition is to show grace
Your custom is generosity, and Your way is forgiveness

segs.ar: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ مُعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ
segs.tr: Fa-kullu al-barīyah muʿtarifatun bi-anna-ka ghayru ẓālimin liman ʿāqabta
segs.en: All creation acknowledges that You do not wrong those whom You punish

segs.ar: وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ
segs.tr: Wa shāhidatun bi-anna-ka mutafaḍḍilun ʿalā man ʿāfayta
segs.en: And witnesses that You bestow grace upon those You pardon

segs.ar: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ
segs.tr: Wa kullun muqirrun ʿalā nafsihi bi-t-taqṣīr ʿammā istawjabta
segs.en: And everyone admits his own shortcomings before what You rightfully deserve
Glory be to You, how clear Your generosity is

segs.ar: فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ
segs.tr: Fī muʿāmalati man aṭāʿaka aw ʿaṣāk
segs.en: In Your dealing with those who obey or disobey You

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ لِلْمُطِيعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ
segs.tr: Tashkuru lil-muṭīʿi mā anta tawallaytahu lahu
segs.en: You thank the obedient for what You undertook for him

segs.ar: وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيهِ
segs.tr: Wa tumlī lil-ʿāṣī fīmā tamluku muʿājilatahu fīh
segs.en: And You give respite to the sinner in matters You could punish him for

segs.ar: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلًّا مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ
segs.tr: Aʿṭayta kulla minhumā mā lam yajib lahu
segs.en: You have given both what they did not earn

segs.ar: وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
segs.tr: Wa tafadalt ʿalā kullin minhumā bimā yaqṣuru ʿamaluhu ʿanhu
segs.en: And You granted each of them what his deeds could not attain

segs.ar: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ
segs.tr: Wa law kāfa'ta al-muṭīʿa ʿalā mā anta tawallaytahu
segs.en: And if You rewarded the obedient only for what You undertook
He would soon lose Your reward
And Your blessing would depart from him
But by Your generosity, You rewarded him

segs.ar: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الْفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ
segs.tr: ʿalā al-muddati al-qaṣīrati al-fāniyati bil-muddati al-ṭawīlati al-khālidah
segs.en: With the passing, brief time by the everlasting time

segs.ar: وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغَايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ
segs.tr: Wa ʿalā al-ghāyati al-qarībati az-zā'ilati bil-ghāyati al-madīdati al-bāqiyah
segs.en: And for the short-lived outcome by the never-ending final reward

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segs.tr: Thumma lam tasumhu al-qiṣāṣa fīmā akala min rizqika
segs.en: Then, You did not demand compensation for what he ate from Your provision
By which he was able to obey You
