segs.ar: وَلَمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَةِ فِي الْآلاتِ
segs.tr: Wa lam taḥmilhu ʿalā al-munāqasha fī al-ālāt
segs.en: Nor did You call him to account for all the means
Which he used to obtain Your forgiveness
And had You done so to him
It would have taken away all his efforts
And all that he tried to achieve

segs.tr: Jazā'an lil-ṣughra min ayādīka wa minanik
segs.en: As a price for the smallest of Your gifts and blessings

segs.ar: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهِينًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
segs.tr: Wa labaqiya rahīnan bayna yadayka bisā'iri niʿamik
segs.en: And he would remain hostage to You for all Your blessings

segs.ar: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئًا مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ، لَا، مَتَى؟
segs.tr: Fa-matā kāna yastaḥiqu shay'an min thawābaka, lā, matā?
segs.en: So when would he ever deserve any of Your reward? Never. When?

segs.ar: هَذَا يَا إِلَهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ
segs.tr: Hādhā yā Ilāhī ḥālu man aṭāʿaka wa-sabīlu man taʿabbada laka
segs.en: This, O my God, is the state of those who obey You and the path of those devoted in worship to You
But as for the one who defies Your commands and carries out Your prohibitions

segs.ar: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: Fa-lam tuʿājilhu bi-niqmatik li-kay yastabdil bi-ḥālihi fī maʿṣiyatik
segs.en: You did not hasten punishment, that he might change his condition in Your disobedience
To a state of returning to Your obedience

segs.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
segs.tr: Wa la-qad kāna yastaḥiqu fī awwali mā hamma bi-ʿiṣyānika
segs.en: Indeed, he deserved, the moment he intended to defy You

segs.ar: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
segs.tr: Kulla mā aʿdadda li-jamīʿ khalqika min ʿuqūbatik
segs.en: All that You have prepared for all Your creation of retribution

segs.ar: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنِ الْعَذَابِ
segs.tr: Fa-jamīʿu mā akhkharta ʿanhu min al-ʿadhāb
segs.en: So all that You have delayed from him of punishment

segs.ar: وَأَبْطَأْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ
segs.tr: Wa abṭa'ta bihi ʿalayhi min saṭawāti an-niqmah wa-l-ʿiqābi tarkun min ḥaqqika
segs.en: And withheld from him of Your wrath and retribution is a reduction in what he truly deserves from You
And contentment with less than what was obligatory (upon him)
So who is more generous than You, my God?

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْكَ ، لَا ، مَنْ؟
segs.tr: Wa-man ashqā mimman halak ʿalayk, lā, man?
segs.en: And who is more wretched than one destroyed before You? No one—who?
You are Blessed, none may describe You except with excellence

segs.ar: وَكَرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إِلَّا الْعَدْلُ
segs.tr: Wa karumta an yukhāfa minka illā al-ʿadl
segs.en: You are Noble, none should fear You except in justice

segs.ar: لَا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ
segs.tr: Lā yukhshā jawruka ʿalā man ʿāṣāk
segs.en: No one fears injustice from You, even those who disobey

segs.ar: وَلَا يُخَافُ إِغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ
segs.tr: Wa lā yukhāfu ighfāluka thawāba man arḍāk
segs.en: Nor should anyone fear being deprived of reward who has pleased You

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِي أَمَلِي
segs.tr: Fa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad wa ālih wa hab lī amalī
segs.en: So bless Muḥammad and his family, and grant me my hopes
And increase me in Your guidance

segs.ar: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إِلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي
segs.tr: Mā aṣilu bihi ilā at-tawfīqi fī ʿamalī
segs.en: So I may attain success in my actions through it
Truly, You are Most Generous and Noble

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ أَحَداً لاَ يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-na ah'adal- laa yab-lughu min shuk-rika ghaayatan
segs.en: 1.O God, no one reaches a limit in thanking You

segs.ar: إلاّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرَاً،
segs.tr: il-laa h'as'ala a'lay-hee min ih'-saanika maa yul-zimuhoo shuk-ran
segs.en: 2.without acquiring that of Your beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving,

segs.ar: وَلا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإن اجْتَهَدَ
segs.tr: wa laa yab-lughu mab-lagham-min t'aaa'tika waani aj-tahada
segs.en: 3.nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying You, even if he strives,

segs.ar: إلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّراً دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ،
segs.tr: laa kaana muqas'-s'irana doona as-tih'-qaaqika bifaz''-lik
segs.en: 4.without falling short of what You deservest because of Your bounty.
5.The most thankful of Your servants has not the capacity to thank You,

segs.tr: wa aa'-baduhum lak mqas'-s'irun a'n t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 6.and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying You.

segs.ar: لا يَجبُ لأِحَد أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ،
segs.tr: laa yajibu liah'adim-min-hum an tagh-fira lahoo bis-tih'-qaaqih
segs.en: 7.To none of them is due Your forgiveness through what he himself deserves

segs.tr: wa laa yah'iq-qu lahooo an tar-z''aa a'n-hoo bis-teejaabih
segs.en: 8.or Your good pleasure for his own merit.
9.When You forgivest someone, it is through Your graciousness,
10.and when You art pleased with someone, it is through Your bounty.

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ
segs.tr: tash-kuru yaseera maa shukir-tah wa tutheebu a'laa qaleeli maa tut'aau' feeh
segs.en: 11.You showest gratitude for the paltry for which gratitude is shown to You and You rewardest the small act in which You art obeyed,

segs.ar: حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْـرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ
segs.tr: h'at-taa kaan-na shuk-ra i'baadikal-lad'ee aw-jab-ta a'lay-hee thawaabahum
segs.en: 12.so that it seems as if Your servants' thanksgiving for which You hast made incumbent their reward
13.and made great their repayment

segs.ar: أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
segs.en: 14.is an affair from which they could have held back without You,

segs.ar: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ،
segs.tr: fakaafaa-tahum- wa lam yakun sababuhoo beeadika fajaazay-tahum
segs.en: 15.and hence You wilt recompense them, and whose cause is not in Your hand, and hence You wilt repay them.

segs.ar: بَـلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إلهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ،
segs.tr: bal malak-ta yaaa ilaaheee am-rahum qab-la ay-yam-likoo i'baadatak
segs.en: 16.Nay, my God, You hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship You,

segs.ar: وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa aa'-dat-ta thawaabahum qab-la ay-yufeez''oo fee t'aaa'tik
segs.en: 17.and You hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey You;
18.and that because Your wont is bestowal of bounty,
19.Your custom beneficence, Your way pardon.

segs.ar: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيِّةِ مًعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ،
segs.tr: fakul-lul-baree-yah mua'-tarifatum-bi n-naka ghay-ru z'aalimil-liman a'aqab-t
segs.en: 20.So all creatures confess that You wrongest not him whom You punishest

segs.ar: وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ،
segs.tr: wa shaahidatum-bi n-naka mutafaz''-z''ilun a'laa man a'afay-t
segs.en: 21.and bear witness that You bestowest bounty upon him whom You pardonest.

segs.ar: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ،
segs.tr: wa kul-lu muqir-ru a'laa naf-sihee bit-taq-s'eeri a'm-mas-taw-jab-t
segs.en: 22.Each admits that he has fallen short of what You meritest.

segs.ar: فَلَوْلا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ ما عَصاكَ عاصٍ
segs.tr: falaw-laaa an-nash-shay-t'aana yakh-tadiu'hum a'n t'aaa'tika maa a's'aaka a'as'
segs.en: 23.Had Satan not misled them from Your obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed You,

segs.ar: وَلَوْلا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ البَاطِلَ فِي مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ
segs.en: 24.and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth

segs.tr: fee mithaalil-h'aq-qi maa z''al-la a'n t'areeqika z''aaal
segs.en: 25.no strayer would have gone astray from Your path.
26.So glory be to You! How manifest is Your generosity

segs.ar: فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ،
segs.tr: fee mua'amalati man at'aaa'ka aw a's'aak
segs.en: 27.in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys You!

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ للْمُطِيْعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ،
segs.tr: tash-kurul-mut'eea' a'laa maaa anta tawal-lay-tahoo lah
segs.en: 28.You showest gratitude to the obedient for that which You undertakest for him,

segs.ar: وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa tum-lee lil-a'as'ee feemaa tam-liku mua'ajalatahoo feeh
segs.en: 29.and You grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which You art able to hurry him.

segs.ar: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلاًّ مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ،
segs.tr: aa'-t'ay-ta kul-lam-min-humaa maa laa yajibu lah
segs.en: 30.You givest to each of them that which is not his due,

segs.ar: وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
segs.tr: wa tafaz''-z''al-ta a'laa kul-lim-min-humaa bimaa yaq-s'uru a'maluhoo a'n-h
segs.en: 31.and You bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ
segs.tr: wa law kaafay-tal-mut'eea' a'laa maaa anta tawal-lay-tahoo
segs.en: 32.Wert You to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which You Yourself hadst undertaken,
33.he would be on the point of losing Your reward
34.and seeing the end of Your favour,
35.but through Your generosity You hast repaid him

segs.ar: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ،
segs.en: 36.for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ،
segs.en: 37.and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segs.tr: thum-ma lam tasum-hul-qis'aas'a feemaaa akala mir-riz-qika
segs.en: 38.Then You dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Your provision
39.through which he gained strength to obey You,

segs.ar: وَلَـمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِي الآلاتِ
segs.en: 40.nor dost You force him to make reckonings for the organs
41.he employed to find the means to Your forgiveness.
42.Wert You to do that to him,
43.it would take away everything for which he had laboured
44.and all wherein he had exerted himself
45.as repayment for the smallest of Your benefits and kindnesses,

segs.ar: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهيناً بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
segs.tr: wa labaqeea raheenam-bay-na yaday-ka bisaaa-iri nia'mik
segs.en: 46.and he would remain hostage before You for Your other favours.

segs.ar: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئاً مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ ، لا ، مَتَى؟.
segs.tr: famataa kaana yastah'iq-qu shay-am-min thawaabika? laa mataa?
segs.en: 47.So how can he deserve something of Your reward? Indeed, how?

segs.ar: هَذَا يا إلهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ،
segs.tr: had'aa yaaa ilaahee h'aalu man at'aaa'ka wa sabeelu man taa'b-bada lak
segs.en: 48.This, my God, is the state of him who obeys You and the path of him who worships You.
49.But as for him who disobeys Your command and goes against Your prohibition,

segs.ar: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.tr: falam tua'ajil-hoo binaqimatika likay yas-tab-dila bih'aalihee fee maa'-s'eeatika
segs.en: 50.You dost not hurry him to Your vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying You
51.with the state of turning back to obey You,

segs.ar: وَلَقَـدْ كَـانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَـا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
segs.tr: wa laqad kaana yas-tah'iq-qu yaaa ilaahee feee aw-wali maa ham-ma bii's'-yaanika
segs.en: 52.though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey You

segs.ar: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
segs.tr: kul-la maaa aa'-dat-ta lijameei' khal-qika min u'qoobatik
segs.en: 53.every punishment which You hast prepared for all Your creatures.

segs.ar: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنْ الْعَذَابِ،
segs.en: 54.Through each chastisement which You hast kept back from him

segs.ar: وَأَبْطَأتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
segs.tr: wa ab-t'aa-ta a'lay-hee min sat'awaatin-niq-mati wal-i'qaab tar-kum-min h'aq-qika
segs.en: 55.and each penalty of Your vengeance and Your punishment which You hast delayed from him, You hast refrained from Your right
56.and shown good pleasure in place of what You hast made obligatory.
57.So who is more generous, my God, than Thou?

segs.ar: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْـكَ، لا ، مَنْ؟
segs.tr: waman ash-qaa mim-man halaka a'lay-ka? laa man-?!
segs.en: 58.And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of You? Indeed, who?
59.You art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence

segs.ar: وَكَـرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إلاّ الْعَدْلُ،
segs.en: 60.and too generous for any but justice to be feared from You!

segs.ar: لا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segs.tr: laa yukh-shaa jaw-ruka a'laa man a's'aak
segs.en: 61.There is no dread that You wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُخَافُ إغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa yukhaafu igh-faaluka thawaaba man ar-z''aaka
segs.en: 62.nor any fear of Your neglecting to reward him who satisfies You.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي،
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa hab lee minka amalee
segs.en: 63.So bless Muhammad and his Household, give me my hope,
64.and increase me in that of Your guidance

segs.ar: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي،
segs.tr: maaa as'ilu biheee ilaat-taw-feeqi fee a'malee
segs.en: 65.through which I may be successful in my works!
66.Surely You art All-kind, Generous.
O Allah, I apologize to You

segs.ar: مِنْ مَظْلُومٍ ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ
segs.tr: Min maẓlūmin ẓulima bi-ḥaḍratī fa-lam anṣuruh
segs.en: From an oppressed person who was wronged in my presence, yet I did not aid him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ أُسْدِيَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min maʿrūfin usdīya ilayya fa-lam ashkurhu
segs.en: And from a favor that was given to me, but I did not thank for it

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مُسِيءٍ اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min musī'in iʿtadhara ilayya fa-lam aʿdhirhu
segs.en: And from a wrongdoer who apologized to me, yet I did not forgive him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَةٍ سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ أُوثِرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min dhī fāqatin saʾalanī fa-lam ūthirhu
segs.en: And from one in need who asked me, but I did not prefer him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذِيْ حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِنٍ فَلَمْ أُوَفِّرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min haqqi dhī ḥaqqin lazimani limuʾminin fa-lam uwaffirhu
segs.en: And from the right due to a believer that was my duty, but I did not fulfill it

segs.ar: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِنٍ ظَهَرَ لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min ʿaybi muʾminin ẓahara lī fa-lam asturuh
segs.en: And from a fault of a believer that appeared to me, yet I did not conceal it

segs.ar: وَمِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ عَرَضَ لِي فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min kulli ithmin ʿaraḍa lī fa-lam ahjurhu
segs.en: And from every sin that came my way, but I did not abandon it
I apologize to You, my God, for these
And from their similar actions, a regretful apology

segs.ar: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ
segs.tr: Yakūnu wāʿiẓan limā bayna yadayya min ashbāhihinna
segs.en: So that it may be a lesson for what lies ahead among their likes
So send blessings on Muḥammad and his family

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّلَّاتِ
segs.tr: Wa-jʿal nadāmatī ʿalā mā waqaʿtu fīhi mina az-zallāt
segs.en: And make my regret for the slips I fell into

segs.ar: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَرْكِ مَا يَعْرِضُ لِي مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
segs.tr: Wa-ʿazmī ʿalā tarki mā yaʿriḍu lī min as-sayyiʾāt
segs.en: And my resolution to avoid the misdeeds that may come before me
A repentance that makes me deserving of Your love
O Lover of those who repent
1.O God, I ask pardon from You for

segs.ar: مِنْ مَـظْلُوم ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ،
segs.en: 2.the person wronged in my presence whom I did not help,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوف أُسْدِيَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ،
segs.tr: wa mim-maa'-roofin us-deea ilay-ya falam ash-kur-h
segs.en: 3.the favour conferred upon me for which I returned no thanks,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مُسِيء أعْتَذَرَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ،
segs.tr: wa mim-musee-in aa'-tad'ara ilay-ya falam aa'-d'ir-h
segs.en: 4.the evildoer who asked pardon from me and whom I did not pardon,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَة سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ اُوثِرْهُ،
segs.tr: wa min d'ee faaqatin saalanee falam oo-thir-h
segs.en: 5.the needy person who asked from me and whom I preferred not over myself,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذي حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِن فَلَمْ أوَفِّـرْهُ،
segs.tr: wa min h'aq-qi d'ee h'aq-qil-lazimanee limoo-minin falam uwaf-fir-h
segs.en: 6.the right of a believer who possesses a right incumbent upon me which I did not fulfil,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِن ظَهَر لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ،
segs.tr: wa min a'y-bi moo-minin z'ahara lee falam as-tur-h
segs.en: 7.the fault of a believer which became evident to me and which I did not conceal,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ كُلِّ إثْم عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ.
segs.tr: wa min kul-li ith-min a'raz''a lee falam ah-jur-h
segs.en: 8.and every sin which presented itself to me and which I failed to avoid.
9.I ask pardon, my God, for all of these
10.and their likes, with an asking of pardon in remorse

segs.ar: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ.
segs.tr: yakoonu waai'z'al-limaa bay-na yaday-ya min ash-baahihin
segs.en: 11.which may act as an admonisher against similar things ahead of me.
12.So bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الـزَّلاّتِ
segs.tr: waj-a'l nadaamatee a'laa maa waqaa'-tu feehee minaz-zal-laat
segs.en: 13.and make my remorse for the slips into which I have fallen

segs.ar: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَـرْكِ مَا يَعْـرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئـاتِ
segs.tr: wa a'z-mee a'laa tar-ki maa yaa'-riz''u lee mina-s say-yi-aat
segs.en: 14.and my determination to refrain from the evil deeds which present themselves to me
15.a repentance which will make Your love for me obligatory,
16.O lover of those who repent!

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And break my desire from every forbidden thing
And turn away my greed from every sin

segs.ar: وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ وَمُسْلِمٍ وَمُسْلِمَةٍ
segs.tr: Wa-mnaʿnī ʿan adhā kulli muʾminin wa muʾminatin wa muslimin wa muslimatin
segs.en: And prevent me from harming any believing man, believing woman, Muslim man, or Muslim woman

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ نَالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa ayyuma ʿabdin nāla minnī mā ḥazarta ʿalayh
segs.en: O Allah, whomever among Your servants gained from me what You have prohibited
And violated from me what You have forbidden
And so he went with my wrongdoing against him as a deceased
Or it remains for me against him while he is alive

segs.ar: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي
segs.tr: Faghfir lahu mā alamma bihi minnī
segs.en: Then forgive him for what befell him from me

segs.ar: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي
segs.tr: Wa-ʿfu lahu ʿammā adbara bihi ʿannī
segs.en: And pardon him for what he kept away from me

segs.ar: وَلَا تَقِفْهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ
segs.tr: Wa lā taqifhu ʿalā mā irtakaba fīya
segs.en: And do not hold him accountable for what he committed against me

segs.tr: Wa lā takshifhu ʿammā iktasaba bī
segs.en: And do not expose him for what he gained through me

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْوِ عَنْهُمْ
segs.tr: Wa-jʿal mā samaḥtu bihi mina al-ʿafwi ʿanhum
segs.en: And make my forgiveness of them
And my charity towards them
Most pure of the charities of the charitable
And highest of the acts of approach by those close to You
And exchange my forgiveness of them with Your forgiveness for me
And my prayers for them for Your mercy

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā yasʿada kullu wāḥidin minnā bi-faḍlika
segs.en: So that each one of us is made happy by Your grace
And each one of us is saved by Your bounty

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa ayyuma ʿabdin min ʿabīdika
segs.en: O Allah, whichever servant of Yours

segs.ar: أَدْرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذًى
segs.tr: Adrakahu minnī darakun aw massahu min nāḥiyatī adhā
segs.en: Who was touched by me or harmed by my actions

segs.ar: أَوْ لَحِقَهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبِي ظُلْمٌ
segs.tr: Aw laḥiqahu bī aw bi-sababī ẓulmun
segs.en: Or was wronged by me or through my actions
Or I neglected his right
Or I was quicker to wrong him
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And please him from Your bounty
And grant him his right from Yourself

segs.ar: ثُمَّ قِنِي مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ
segs.tr: Thumma qinī mā yūjibu lahu ḥukmuk
segs.en: Then protect me from what Your judgment imposes on him
And save me from what Your justice decrees
For my strength cannot withstand Your punishment
And my capacity cannot bear Your anger
If You judge me by truth, You will destroy me
And unless You envelop me in Your mercy, I will perish

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلَهِي مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī astawhibuka yā Ilāhī mā lā yanquṣuka badhluhu
segs.en: O Allah, I seek as a gift what You never lose by giving
And I ask You to carry what is not heavy for You

segs.ar: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلَهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِي لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوءٍ
segs.tr: Astawhibuka yā Ilāhī nafsī allātī lam takhluqha li-tamteniʿ bihā min sūʾin
segs.en: I request from You, O my God, my soul which You didn't create to withhold from evil
Or to use it for benefit

segs.ar: وَلَكِنْ أَنْشَأْتَهَا إِثْبَاتًا لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا
segs.tr: Walākin anshaʾtaha ithbātan li-qudratika ʿalā mithlihā
segs.en: But You originated it to affirm Your power over its like
And as an argument over whatever resembles it

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ
segs.tr: Wa-astaḥmiluka min dhunūbī mā qad bahaẓanī ḥamluhu
segs.en: And I ask You to carry for me from my sins that which burdens me

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ
segs.tr: Wa-astaʿīnu bika ʿalā mā qad fadaḥanī thiquluhu
segs.en: And I seek Your help for what I struggle with its weight
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant my soul to myself, despite its wrongdoing
And assign Your mercy to bear my burden
How often Your mercy has reached the wrongdoers
How often Your forgiveness has encompassed the transgressors

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
segs.tr: Faṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad wa ālihi wa-jʿalnī uswat man qad anhaḍtahu
segs.en: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and make me an example of those whom You have raised
By Your pardon from the downfall of the erring
And You saved him, through Your guidance, from the traps of the criminals

segs.ar: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ
segs.tr: Fa-aṣbaḥa ṭalīqa ʿafwika min isāri sukhṭika
segs.en: And so he became freed by Your pardon from the bonds of Your anger
And emancipated by Your favor from the chains of Your justice

segs.ar: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إِلَهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
segs.tr: Innaka in tafʿal dhalika yā Ilāhī tafʿalhu biman
segs.en: If You do that, O my God, You do it for one
Who does not ever deny deserving Your punishment

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā yubarriʾu nafsahu min istījābi naqimatika
segs.en: And does not absolve himself of deserving Your wrath

segs.ar: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ يَا إِلَهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ
segs.tr: Tafʿalu dhalika yā Ilāhī bi-man khawfuhu minka aktharu min ṭamaʿihi fīk
segs.en: You treat in this way, my God, those whose fear of You is greater than their hope in You

segs.ar: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ
segs.tr: Wa-biman ya'suhu mina an-najāti awkadu min rajā'ihi lil-khalāṣ
segs.en: And those whose despair of deliverance is stronger than their hope for salvation
Not because his despair is disbelief
Nor his hope is recklessness
But due to the scarcity of his good deeds among his sins
And his weak excuses for all of his consequences

segs.ar: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إِلَهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ لاَ يَغْتَرَّ بِكَ الصِّدِّيقُونَ
segs.tr: Fa-ammā anta yā Ilāhī fa-ahlu an lā yagh-tarra bika as-ṣiddīqūn
segs.en: As for You, my God, it is fitting that the sincere do not become deluded by You
And that the guilty do not despair of You

segs.ar: لاِنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا فَضْلَهُ
segs.tr: Li-annaka ar-rabbu al-ʿaẓīm alladhī lā yamnaʿu aḥadan faḍlahu
segs.en: For You are the Supreme Lord who never withholds His bounty from anyone
Nor exacts from anyone all of his due
Exalted is Your remembrance above those who are mentioned
And hallowed are Your names above those who are attributed
And Your blessings have spread in all creation

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segs.tr: Fa-laka al-ḥamdu ʿalā dhālika yā Rabba al-ʿālamīn
segs.en: So to You is all praise for that, O Lord of the worlds
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.break my passion for every unlawful thing,
3.take away my craving for any sin,

segs.ar: وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُـلِّ مُؤْمِن وَمُؤْمِنَـة وَمُسْلِم وَمُسْلِمَة،
segs.tr: wam-naa'-nee a'n ad'a kul-li moo-miniw-wa moo-minatiw-wa mus-limiw-wa mus-limah
segs.en: 4.and bar me from harming any believer, male or female, and any Muslim, male or female!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْد نالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa a'b-d naala min-nee maa h'az'ar-ta a'lay-h
segs.en: 5.O God, if any of Your servants should harm me in what You hast forbidden
6.or violate me in what You hast interdicted,
7.and if he should pass into death with my complaint
8.or I come to have a complaint against him while he is alive,

segs.ar: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي،
segs.tr: fagh-fir lahoo maaa alam-ma bihee min-nee
segs.en: 9.forgive him what he did to me

segs.ar: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي،
segs.tr: waa'-fu lahoo a'm-maaa ad-bara bihee a'n-nee
segs.en: 10.and pardon him that through which he turned his back on me!

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقِفْـهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ،
segs.tr: wa laa taqif-hoo a'laa mar-tkaba fee
segs.en: 11.Inquire not from him about what he committed toward me
12.and expose him not through what he earned by me!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْـوِ عَنْهُمْ
segs.tr: waj-a'l maa samah'-tu bihee minal-a'f-wi a'n-hum
segs.en: 13.Make my open-handedness in pardoning such servants
14.and my contribution in charity toward them
15.the purest charity of the charitable
16.and the highest gift of those seeking nearness to You!

segs.tr: wa a'w-wiz''-nee min a'f-wee a'n-hum a'f-wak
segs.en: 17.Recompense me for my pardoning them with Your pardon
18.and for my supplicating for them with Your mercy

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِد مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.en: 19.so that each one of us may gain felicity through Your bounty
20.and each may attain deliverance through Your kindness!
21.O God, if there is a servant from among Your servants

segs.ar: أدرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذَىً،
segs.tr: ad-rakahoo min-nee darak aw mas-sahoo min-naah'eeateee ad'ana
segs.en: 22.whom an ill visits on my account, a harm touches from my direction,

segs.ar: أَوْ لَحِقَـهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبي ظُلْمٌ
segs.tr: aw lah'iqahoo beee aw bisababee z'ul-m
segs.en: 23.or a wrong overtakes through me or because of me,
24.and should I fail to take care of his right
25.or go before him [in death] with his complaint,
26.bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي مِنْ وُجْدِكَ، وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ar-z''ihee a'n-nee miw-wuj-dik wa aw-fihee h'aq-qahoo min i'ndik
segs.en: 27.satisfy him toward me through Your wealth, and give him his full right from Yourself!

segs.ar: ثُمَّ قِنيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ،
segs.tr: thum-ma qinee maa yoojibu lahoo h'uk-muk
segs.en: 28.Then protect me from what Your decision mandates

segs.tr: wa khal-lis'-nee mim-maa yah'-kumu bihee a'd-luk
segs.en: 29.and save me from what Your justice decides,

segs.tr: fa in-na qoo-watee laa tas-taqil-lu binaqimatik
segs.en: 30.for my strength cannot bear Your vengeance

segs.tr: wa in-na t'aaqatee laa tan-haz''u bisukh-t'ik
segs.en: 31.and my power cannot stand up to Your displeasure!

segs.tr: fa in-naka in tukaafinee bil-h'aq-qi tuh-lik-nee
segs.en: 32.If You recompensest me with the right, You wilt destroy me,
33.and if You dost not shield me in Your mercy, You wilt lay me waste.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي مَا لا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nee as-taw-hibuka yaaa ilaahee maa laa yanqus'uka bad'-luh
segs.en: 34.O God, I ask You to grant, my God, that whose giving will not decrease You,

segs.tr: wa as-tah'-miluka maa laa yab-haz'uka h'am-luh
segs.en: 35.and I ask You to carry that whose carrying will not weigh You down:

segs.ar: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوء،
segs.tr: as-taw-hibuka yaaa ilaahee naf-seeal-latee lam takh-luq-haa litam-tania' bihaa min sooo-in
segs.en: 36.My God, I ask You to give my soul, which You didst not create to keep Yourself from evil
37.nor to find the way to profit.

segs.ar: وَلكِنْ أَنْشَأتَهَا إثْبَاتاً لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا،
segs.tr: wa lkin anshaa-tahaa ith-baatal-liqud-ratika a'laa mith-lihaa
segs.en: 38.No, You brought it forth to demonstrate Your power over its like
39.and to provide an argument against its similar.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ،
segs.tr: wa as-tah'-miluka min d'unoobee maa qad bahaz'anee h'am-luh
segs.en: 40.I ask You to carry those of my sins whose carrying weighs me down

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ.
segs.tr: wa as-tae'enu bika a'laa maa qad fadah'anee thiq-luh
segs.en: 41.and I seek help from You in that whose heaviness oppresses me.
42.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.tr: wa hab linaf-see a'laa z'ul-mihaa naf-see
segs.en: 43.give to me my soul in spite of its wrongdoing,
44.and appoint Your mercy to carry my burden!
45.How many evildoers Your mercy has overtaken!
46.How many wrongdoers Your pardon has embraced!

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waj-a'l-neee us-wata man qad an-haz''-tahoo
segs.en: 47.So bless Muhammad and his Household and make me the model of him whom You hast aroused
48.through Your forbearance from the deadly infirmities of the offenders
49.and saved through Your giving success from the tangled plights of the sinners,

segs.ar: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ،
segs.tr: faas'-bah'a t'aleeqa a'f-wika mn isaari sukh-t'ik
segs.en: 50.so that I may rise up freed by Your pardon from the bonds of Your displeasure
51.and released by Your benefaction from the ties of Your justice!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إلهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
segs.tr: in-naka in taf-a'l d'alika yaaa ilaahee taf-a'l-hoo biman
segs.en: 52.Surely if You dost that, my God, You wilt do it to one
53.who does not deny deserving Your punishment

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa yubar-ri-u naf-sahoo min as-teejaabi naqimatik
segs.en: 54.or acquit himself from merit for Your vengeance.

segs.ar: تَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ يَا إلهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ،
segs.tr: taf-a'lu d'alika yaaa ilaahee biman khaw-fuhoo minka ak-tharu min t'amai'hee feek
segs.en: 55.Do that, my God, for one whose fear of You is greater than his craving from You,

segs.ar: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ،
segs.tr: wa bimay-yaa-suhoo minan-najaati aw-kadu mir-rajaaa-ihee lil-khalaas'
segs.en: 56.whose hopelessness of deliverance is firmer than his hope for salvation!
57.Not that his hopelessness is despair,
58.nor that his expectation is deluded.
59.No, rather his good deeds are few among his evil deeds

segs.tr: wa z''aa'-fi h'ujajihee fee jameei' tabia'atih
segs.en: 60.and his arguments are frail in face of everything due from his acts.

segs.ar: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ
segs.tr: faam-maaa anta yaaa ilaahee faah-lun an
segs.en: 61.But Thou, my God, art worthy that
62.the righteous not be deluded concerning You
63.and the sinners not lose hope in You,

segs.ar: لاَِنَّكَ ألرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَداً فَضْلَهُ
segs.en: 64.for You art the All-mighty Lord who holds back His bounty from none

segs.tr: wa laa yas-taq-s'ee min ah'adin h'aq-qah
segs.en: 65.and takes His full right from no one.
66.High exalted is Your mention above those mentioned!
67.Holy are Your names beyond those described!
68.Spread is Your favour among all creatures!

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
segs.en: 69.Thine is the praise for that, O Lord of the worlds!

S_40.name: 40. When Death was Mentioned
S_40.nameUr: یادِ موت کے وقت کی دعا

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ālihi
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنَا طُولَ الْأَمَلِ وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ
segs.tr: wakfinā ṭūla l-amali wa qaṣṣirhu ʿannā biṣidqi l-ʿamali
segs.en: protect us from long hopes and shorten them with sincere actions,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
segs.tr: ḥattā lā nuʾammila istitmāma sāʿatin baʿda sāʿatin
segs.en: so we do not hope to complete one hour after another,

segs.tr: wa lā istīfāʾa yawmin baʿda yawmin
segs.en: nor to fulfill one day after another,
nor the connection of one breath to another,
nor the joining of one step to another.

segs.ar: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ وَآمِنَّا مِنْ شُرُورِهِ
segs.tr: wa sallimnā min ghurūrihi wa āminnā min shurūrihi
segs.en: Deliver us from its delusion and protect us from its evils,

segs.tr: wa nṣibi l-mawta bayna aydīnā naṣban
segs.en: and set death before us clearly,

segs.tr: wa lā tajʿal dhikranā lahu ghibban
segs.en: and let not our remembrance of it be absent.

segs.tr: wa jʿal lanā min ṣāliḥi l-aʿmāli
segs.en: Grant us from righteous deeds
a deed that makes us slow to reach You,

segs.ar: وَنَحْرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
segs.tr: wa naḥriṣu lahu ʿalā washki l-liḥāqi bika
segs.en: and eager to hasten toward You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأْنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأْنَسُ بِهِ
segs.tr: ḥattā yakūna l-mawtu maʾnasanā lladhī naʾnasu bihi
segs.en: so that death becomes our intimate with which we are familiar,
our acquaintance we long for,

segs.tr: wa ḥāmmatana llatī nuḥibbu d-dunūwa minhā
segs.en: and our beloved we love to approach.

segs.tr: fa idhā awradtahu ʿalaynā wa anzaltahu binā
segs.en: When You bring it upon us and send it down to us,

segs.ar: فَأَسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِرًا وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِمًا
segs.tr: fa asʿidnā bihi zāʾiran wa ānisnā bihi qādiman
segs.en: make us happy with it as a visitor and comfort us with its arrival,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُشْقِنَا بِضِيَافَتِهِ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيَارَتِهِ
segs.tr: wa lā tushqinā biḍiyāfatihi wa lā tukhzīnā biziyāratihi
segs.en: do not make us wretched by hosting it or disgrace us by its visit.

segs.tr: wa jʿalhu bāban min abwābi maghfiratika
segs.en: Make it a gate from the gates of Your forgiveness,
and a key from the keys of Your mercy.
Cause us to die guided, not astray,
obedient, not reluctant,

segs.tr: tāʾibīna ghayra ʿāṣīna wa lā muṣirrīna
segs.en: repentant, not rebellious nor persisting in sin,
O Guarantor of the reward of the righteous,
and Reformer of the deeds of the corrupt!
1.O God, Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الأمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ
segs.tr: wak-finaa t'oolal-amal wa qas'-s'ir-hoo a'n-naa bis'id-qil-a'mal
segs.en: 2.spare us drawn out expectations and cut them short in us through sincerity of works,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa noo-am-mila is-tit-maama saaa'tim-baa'-da saaa'h
segs.en: 3.that we may not hope expectantly for completing an hour after an hour,
4.closing a day after a day,
5.joining a breath to a breath,
6.or overtaking a step with a step!

segs.ar: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَآمَنَّا مِنْ شُـرُوْرِهِ،
segs.tr: wa sal-lim-naa min ghuroorih wa aaamin-naa min shuroorih
segs.en: 7.Keep us safe from the delusions of expectations, make us secure from their evils,
8.set up death before us in display.

segs.tr: wa laa taj-a'l d'ik-ranaa lahoo ghib-baa
segs.en: 9.and let not our remembering of it come and go!
10.Appoint for us from among the righteous works
11.a work through which we will feel the homecoming to You as slow

segs.ar: وَنحْـرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
segs.tr: wa nah'-ris'u lahoo a'laa wash-kil-lah'aaqi bik
segs.en: 12.and crave a quick joining with You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأنَسُ بِهِ،
segs.en: 13.so that death may be our intimate abode with which we are intimate,

segs.ar: وَمَألَفَنَا الَّذِي نَشْتَاقُ إلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِي نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
segs.tr: wa maa-lafanaal-lad'ee nash-taaqu ilay-h wa h'aaam-matanaal-latee nuh'ib-bud-dunoo-wa min-haa
segs.en: 14.our familiar place toward which we yearn, and our next of kin whose coming we love!

segs.tr: fa id'aaa aw-rat-tahoo a'lay-naa wa anzal-tahoo binaa
segs.en: 15.When You bringest it to us and sendest it down upon us,

segs.ar: فَأسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِراً، وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِماً،
segs.tr: faas-i'd-naa bihee zaaa-iraa wa aaanis-naa bihee qaadimaa
segs.en: 16.make us happy with it as a visitor, comfort us with its arrival,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُشْقِنَا بِضِيافَتِهِ، وَلا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيارَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa laa tush-qinaa biz''eeaafatih wa laa tukh-zinaa bizeeaaratih
segs.en: 17.make us not wretched through entertaining it, degrade us not through its visit,
18.and appoint it one of the gates to Your forgiveness
19.and the keys to Your mercy!
20.Make us die guided, not astray,

segs.ar: طائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ تَائِبينَ غَيْرَ عاصِينَ وَلا مُصِرِّينَ
segs.tr: t'aaa-ie'ena ghay-ra mus-tak-riheen taaa-ibeena ghay-ra a'as'eena wa laa mus'ir-reen
segs.en: 21.obedient, not averse, repentant, not disobedient or persisting,
22.O He who guarantees the repayment of the good-doers
23.and seeks to set right the work of the corrupt!

S_41.name: 41. For Covering and Protection
S_41.nameUr: پردہ پوشی اور حفاظت کی دعا

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spread beneath me the bed of Your generosity
And bring me to the springs of Your mercy
And settle me in the spaciousness of Your Paradise
And do not label me as one turned away from You
And do not deprive me by Your rejection
And do not hold me accountable for what I have committed
Nor debate me about what I have acquired

segs.ar: وَلَا تُبْرِزْ مَكْتُومِي، وَلَا تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي
segs.tr: Wa-lā tubriz maktūmī, wa-lā takshif mastūrī
segs.en: Do not expose my hidden faults, nor unveil my private matters

segs.ar: وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزَانِ الْأَنْصَافِ عَمَلِي
segs.tr: Wa-lā taḥmil ʿalā mīzāni al-anṣāfi ʿamalī
segs.en: Do not weigh my deeds with the strict scale of justice

segs.ar: وَلَا تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلَاءِ خَبَرِي
segs.tr: Wa-lā tuʿlin ʿalā ʿuyūni al-malāʾi khabari
segs.en: Nor disclose my news before the eyes of the assembly

segs.ar: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَارًا
segs.tr: Akhfi ʿanhum mā yakūnu nashruhu ʿalayya ʿāran
segs.en: Hide from them what would bring me shame if made public

segs.ar: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِندَكَ شَنَارًا
segs.tr: Waṭwi ʿanhum mā yulḥiqunī ʿindak shanāran
segs.en: And conceal from them what would disgrace me before You
Honor my rank with Your satisfaction
And perfect my dignity through Your forgiveness
And enroll me among the companions of the right
Enable me to travel the paths of the secure
And make me among the group of the successful
Let me fill the gatherings of the righteous
Amen, Lord of the worlds
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.spread for me the bed of Your honour,
3.bring me to the wateringholes of Your mercy,
4.set me down in the midst of Your Garden,
5.stamp me not with rejection by You,
6.deprive me not through disappointment by You,
7.settle not accounts with me for what I have committed,
8.make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

segs.ar: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي،
segs.tr: wa laa tub-riz mak-toomee wa laa tak-shif mas-tooree
segs.en: 9.display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزانِ الأنْصَافِ عَمَلِي،
segs.tr: wa laa tah'-mil a'laa meezaanil-ins'aafi a'malee
segs.en: 10.weigh not my works on the scales of fairness,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلاَءِ خَبَـرِي.
segs.tr: wa laa tua'-lin a'laa u'yoonil-malaa khabaree
segs.en: 11.and make not my tidings known to the eyes of the crowd!

segs.ar: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَاراً،
segs.tr: akh-fi a'n-hum maa yakoonu nash-ruhoo a'lay-ya a'araa
segs.en: 12.Conceal from them everything whose unfolding would shame me

segs.ar: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِنْدَكَ شَنَاراً،
segs.tr: wat'-wi a'n-hum maa yul-h'iqunee i'ndaka shanaaraa
segs.en: 13.and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with You!
14.Ennoble my degree through Your good pleasure,
15.perfect my honour through Your forgiveness,
16.rank me among the companions of the right hand,
17.direct me to the roads of the secure,
18.place me in the throng of the triumphant,
19.and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
20.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ اَعَنْتَنِىْ عَلٰى خَتْمِ كِتَابِكَ الَّذِىْٓ
segs.en: O Allah, Thou hast helped me complete Thy Book, which Thou
sent down as a light and

segs.ar: وَ جَعَلْتَهٗ مُهَيْمِنًا عَلٰى كُلِّ كِتَابٍ اَنْزَلْتَهٗ
segs.en: appointed as a guardian over every book Thou hast sent down,

segs.ar: وَ فَضَّلْتَهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ حَدِيْثٍ قَصَصْتَهٗ
segs.en: preferring it over every narrative which Thou hast recounted,

segs.ar: وَ فُرْقَانًا فَرَقْتَ بِهٖ بَيْنَ حَلَالِكَ وَ حَرَامِكَ
segs.en: a separator, through which Thou hast separated Thy lawful from Thy unlawful,

segs.ar: وَ قُرْاٰنًا اَعْرَبْتَ بِهٖ عَنْ شَرَآئِعِ اَحْكَامِكَ
segs.en: a Qur'an, through which Thou hast made plain the approaches to Thy ordinances,
a book, which Thou hast distinguished very distinctly for Thy servants,

segs.ar: وَ وَحْيًا اَنْزَلْتَهٗ عَلٰى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوٰتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ تَنْزِيْلًا
segs.en: a revelation, which Thou hast sent down, a sending down, upon Thy prophet Muhammad (Thy blessings be upon him and his Household).
Thou appointed it

segs.ar: نُوْرًا نَهْتَدِىْ مِنْ ظُلَمِ الضَّلَالَةِ وَ الْجَهَالَةِ بِاتِّبَاعِهٖ
segs.en: a light through following which we may be guided from the shadows of error and ignorance,

segs.ar: وَ شِفَآءً لِمَنْ اَنْصَتَ بِفَهْمِ التَّصْدِيْقِ اِلَى اسْتِمَاعِهٖ
segs.en: a healing for him who turns ear toward hearing it with the understanding of attestation,

segs.ar: وَ مِيْزَانَ قِسْطٍ لَا يَحِيْفُ عَنِ الْحَقِّ لِسَانُهٗ
segs.en: a just balance whose tongue does not incline away from truth,

segs.ar: وَ نُوْرَ هُدًى لَا يُطْفَاُ عَنِ الشَّاهِدِيْنَ بُرْهَانُهٗ وَ عَلَمَ نَجَاةٍ
segs.en: a light of guidance whose proof is not extinguished before the witnesses, and a guidepost of deliverance, so that

segs.ar: لَا يَضِلُّ مَنْ اَمَّ قَصْدَ سُنَّتِهٖ
segs.en: he who repairs straightway to its prescription will not go astray

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَنَالُ اَيْدِىْ الْهَلَكَاتِ مَنْ تَعَلَّقَ بِعُرْوَةِ عِصْمَتِهٖ
segs.en: and he who clings to its preservation's handhold will not be touched by the hands of disasters.
O Allah, since Thou hast
given us help to recite it

segs.ar: وَ سَهَّلْتَ جَوَاسِىْ اَلْسِنَتِنَا بِحُسْنِ عِبَارَتِهٖ
segs.en: and made smooth the roughness of our tongues through the beauty of its expression,
place us among those who
observe it as it should be observed,

segs.ar: وَ يَدِيْنُ لَكَ بِاعْتِقَادِ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِمُحْكَمِ اٰيَاتِهٖ
segs.en: serve Thee by adhering in submission to the firm text of its verses,

segs.ar: وَ يَفْزَعُ اِلَى الْاِقْرَارِ بِمُتَشَابِهِهٖ وَ مُوْضِحَاتِ بَيِّنَاتِهٖ
segs.en: and seek refuge in admitting both its ambiguous parts and the elucidations of its clear signs!
O Allah, Thou

segs.ar: اَنْزَلْتَهٗ عَلٰى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلّٰى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ مُجْمَلًا
segs.en: sent it down upon Thy prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) in summary form,
inspired him with the science of its wonders to complement it,
made us the heirs of its knowledge as interpreters,

segs.ar: وَ فَضَّلْتَنَا عَلٰى مَنْ جَهِلَ عِلْمَهٗ
segs.en: made us to surpass him who is ignorant of its knowledge,

segs.ar: وَ قَوَّيْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ لِتَرْفَعَنَا فَوْقَ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِقْ حَمْلَهٗ
segs.en: and Thou gave us strength over it to raise us above those not able to carry it.
O Allah, just as Thou hast
appointed our hearts as its carriers

segs.ar: وَ عَرَّفْتَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ شَرَفَهٗ وَ فَضْلَهٗ
segs.en: and made known to us through Thy mercy its nobility and excellence,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ الْخَطِيْبِ بِهٖ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِهٖ الْخُزَّانِ لَهٗ
segs.en: so also bless Muhammad, its preacher, and his Household, its guardians,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَرِفُ بِاَنَّهٗ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ حَتّٰى
segs.en: and place us among those who confess that it has come from Thee,
lest doubt about attesting to it assail us,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَخْتَلِجَنَا الزَّيْغُ عَنْ قَصْدِ طَرِيْقِهٖ
segs.en: or deviation from its straightforward path shake us!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and make us one of those who
hold fast to its cord,

segs.ar: وَ يَاْوِىْ مِنَ الْمُتَشَابِهَاتِ اِلٰى حِرْزِ مَعْقِلِهٖ
segs.en: seek haven from its ambiguities in its fortified stronghold,
rest in the shadow of its wing,
find guidance in the brightness of its morning,
follow the shining of its disclosure,
acquire light from its lamp,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَلْتَمِسُ الْهُدٰى فِىْ غَيْرِهٖ
segs.en: and beg not guidance from any other!
O Allah, just as

segs.ar: نَصَبْتَ بِهٖ مُحَمَّدًا عَلَمًا لِلدَّلَالَةِ عَلَيْكَ
segs.en: through it Thou hast set up Muhammad as a guidepost to point to Thee

segs.ar: وَ اَنْهَجْتَ بِاٰلِهٖ سُبُلَ الرِّضَا اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and through his Household Thou hast made clear Thy good pleasure's roads to Thee,
so also bless Muhammad and his Household
and make the Qur'an

segs.ar: وَسِيْلَةً لَنَا اِلٰى اَشْرَفِ مَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
segs.en: our mediation to the noblest stations of Thy honour,

segs.ar: وَ سُلَّمًا نَعْرُجُ فِيْهِ اِلٰى مَحَلِّ السَّلَامَةِ
segs.en: a ladder by which we may climb to the place of safety,

segs.ar: وَ سَبَبًا نُجْزٰى بِهِ النَّجَاةَ فِىْ عَرْصَةٍ الْقِيٰمَةِ
segs.en: a cause for our being repaid with deliverance at the Plain of Resurrection,

segs.ar: وَ ذَرِيْعَةً نَقْدَمُ بِهَا عَلٰى تَعِيْمِ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
segs.en: and a means whereby we may reach the bliss of the House of Permanence!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
lessen for us through the Qur'an the weight of heavy sins,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لَنَا حُسْنَ شَمَآئِلِ الْاَبْرَارِ
segs.en: give to us the excellent qualities of the pious,

segs.ar: وَاقْفُ بِنَا اٰثَارَ الَّذِيْنَ قَامُوْا لَكَ بِهٖ اٰنَآءَ اللَّيْلِ وَ اَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ حَتّٰى
segs.en: and make us follow the tracks of those who stood before Thee in the watches of the night and the ends of the day, such that Thou
purifiest us from every defilement through its purification
and makest us to follow the tracks of those
who have taken illumination from its light

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يُلْهِهِمُ الْاَمَلُ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ فَيَقْطَعَهُمْ بِخُدَعِ غُرُوْرِهٖ
segs.en: and whom expectation has not distracted from works, cutting them off through its delusions' deceptions!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and appoint the Qur'an for us
an intimate in the shadows of nights

segs.ar: وَ مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ خَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ حَارِسًا
segs.en: and a guardian against the instigations of Satan and confusing thoughts,

segs.ar: وَ لِاَقْدَامِنَا عَنْ نَقْلِهَا اِلَى الْمَعَاصِىْ حَابِسًا
segs.en: for our feet an obstruction from passing to acts of disobedience,

segs.ar: وَ لِاَلْسِنَتِنَا عَنِ الْخَوْضِ فِىْ الْبَاطِلِ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَا اٰفَةٍ مُخْرِسًا
segs.en: for our tongues a silencer without blight preventing a plunge into falsehood,

segs.ar: وَ لِجَوَارِحِنَا عَنِ اقْتِرَافِ الْاٰثَامِ زَاجِرًا
segs.en: for our limbs a restrainer from committing sins,

segs.ar: وَ لِمَا طَوَتِ الْغَفْلَةُ عَنَّا مِنْ تَصَفُّحِ الْاِعْتِبَارِ نَاشِرًا
segs.en: and for the scrutiny of heedfulness rolled up in heedlessness an unroller,

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تُوْصِلَ اِلٰى قُلُوْبِنَا فَهْمَ عَجَآئِبِهٖ وَ زَوَاجِرَ اَمْثَالِهِ الَّتِىْ ضَعُفَتِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِىْ عَلٰى صَلَابَتِهَا عَنِ احْتِمَالِهٖ
segs.en: such that Thou attachest to our hearts the understanding of the Qur'an's wonders and its restraining similitudes which immovable mountains in all their solidity were too weak to carry!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and through the Qur'an make permanent the rightness of our outward selves,

segs.ar: وَ احْجُبْ بِهٖ خَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ عَنْ صِحَّةِ ضَمَآئِرِنَا
segs.en: veil the ideas of confusing thoughts from the soundness of our innermost minds,

segs.ar: وَ اغْسِلْ بِهٖ دَرَنَ قُلُوْبِنَا وَ عَلَآئِقَ اَوْزَارِنَا
segs.en: wash away the dirt of our hearts and the ties of our heavy sins,
gather our scattered affairs,

segs.ar: وَ اَرْوِ بِهٖ فِىْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ظَمَاءَ هَوَاجِرِنَا
segs.en: quench the thirst of our burning heat in the standing place of the presentation to Thee,

segs.ar: وَ اكْسُنَا بِهٖ حُلَلَ الْاَمَانِ يَوْمَ الْفَزَعِ الْاَكْبَرِ فِىْ نُشُوْرِنَا
segs.en: and clothe us in the robes of security on the Day of the Greatest Terror at our uprising!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَاجْبُرْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ خَلَّتَنَا مِنْ عَدَمِ الْاِمْلَاقِ
segs.en: and through the Qur'an redress our lack - our destitution in poverty -

segs.ar: وَ سُقْ اِلَيْنَا بِهٖ رَغَدَ الْعَيْشِ وَ خِصْبَ سَعَةِ الْاَرْزَاقِ
segs.en: drive toward us the comforts of life and an abundance of plentiful provisions,

segs.ar: وَ جَنِّبْنَا بِهٖ الضَّرَآئِبَ الْمَذْمُوْمَةَ وَ مَدَانِىَ الْاَخْلَاقِ
segs.en: turn aside blameworthy character traits and base moral qualities,

segs.ar: وَ اعْصِمْنَا بِهٖ مِنْ هُوَّةِ الْكُفْرِ وَ دَوَاعِى النِّفَاقِ
segs.en: and preserve us from the pit of unbelief and the motives for hypocrisy,
such that the Qur'an may be

segs.ar: لَنَا فِى الْقِيَامَةِ اِلٰى رِضْوَانِكَ وَ جِنَانِكَ قَائِدًا
segs.en: for us at the resurrection a leader to Thy good pleasure and Thy gardens,

segs.ar: وَ لَنَا فِى الدُّنْيَا عَنْ سُخْطِكَ وَ تَعَدِّىْ حُدُوْدِكَ ذَائِدًا
segs.en: for us in this world a protector against Thy displeasure and transgressing Thy bounds

segs.ar: وَ لِمَا عِنْدَكَ بِتَحْلِيْلِ حَلَالِهٖ وَ تَحْرِيْمِ حَرَامِهٖ شَاهِدًا
segs.en: and for what is with Thee a witness by its declaring lawful the lawful and its declaring unlawful the unlawful!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَ هَوِّنْۢ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ عَلٰى اَنْفُسِنَا
segs.en: and through the Qur'an make easy for our souls at death
the distress of the driving,
the effort of the moaning,
and the succession of the rattling,

segs.ar: اِذَا بَلَغَتِ النُّفُوْسُ التَّرَاقِىَ وَ قِيْلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
segs.en: when souls reach the throats and it is said, 'Where is the enchanter?';

segs.ar: وَ تَجَلّٰى مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِهَا مِنْ حُجُبِ الْغُيُوْبِ
segs.en: when the angel of death discloses himself to seize them from behind the veils of unseen things,

segs.ar: وَ رَمَاهَا عَنْ قَوْسِ الْمَنَايَا بِاَسْهُمِ وَحْشَةِ الْفِرَاقِ
segs.en: letting loose at them from the bow of destinies the arrows of the terror of lonesome separation,

segs.ar: وَ دَافَ لَهَا مِنْ ذُعَافِ الْمَوْتِ كَاسًا مَسْمُوْمَةً الْمَذَاقِ
segs.en: and mixing for them from sudden death a cup poisoned to the taste;

segs.ar: وَ دَنَا مِنَّا اِلَى الْاٰخِرَةِ رَحِيْلٌ وَ انْطِلَاقٌ
segs.en: and when departure and release for the hereafter come close to us,

segs.ar: وَ صَارَتِ الْاَعْمَالُ قَلَائِدَ فِى الْاَعْنَاقِ
segs.en: works become collars around the necks,

segs.ar: وَ كَانَتِ الْقُبُوْرُ هِىَ الْمَأوٰى اِلٰى مِيْقَاتِ يَوْمِ التَّلَاقِ
segs.en: and the graves become the haven until the appointed time of the Day of Encounter!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِىْ حُلُوْلِ دَارِ الْبِلٰى وَ طُوْلِ الْمُقَامَةِ بَيْنَ اَطْبَاقِ الثَّرٰى
segs.en: make blessed for us the arrival at the house of decay and the drawn out residence between the layers of the earth,

segs.ar: وَ اجْعَلِ الْقُبُوْرَ بَعْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا خَيْرَ مَنَازِلِنَا
segs.en: appoint the graves, after separation from this world, the best of our way stations,

segs.ar: وَ افْسَحْ لَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِىْ ضِيْقِ مَلَاحِدِنَا
segs.en: make roomy for us through Thy mercy the narrowness of our tombs,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنَا فِىْ حَاضِرِى الْقِيَامَةِ بِمُوْبِقَاتِ اٰثَامِنَا
segs.en: and disgrace us not among those present at the Resurrection through our ruinous sins!

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ فِىْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَقَامِنَا
segs.en: Through the Qur'an have mercy upon the lowliness of our station at the standing place of presentation to Thee,

segs.ar: وَ ثَبِّتْ بِهٖ عِنْدَ اضْطِرَابِ جِسْرِ جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَ الْمَجَازِ عَلَيْهَا زَلَلَ اَقْدَامِنَا
segs.en: make firm the slips of our feet during the shaking of the bridge across hell on the day of passage over it,

segs.ar: وَ نَوِّرْ بِهٖ قَبْلَ الْبَعْثِ سُدَفَ قُبُوْرَنَا
segs.en: illuminate the darkness of our graves before the Uprising,

segs.ar: وَ نَجِّنَا بِهٖ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ شَدَآئِدِ اَهْوَالِ يَوْمِ الطَّامَّةِ
segs.en: and deliver us from every distress on the Day of Resurrection and from the hardships of terrors on the Day of Disaster!

segs.ar: وَ بَيِّضْ وُجُوْهَنَا يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ وُجُوْهُ الظَّلَمَةِ فِىْ يَوْمِ الْحَسْرَةِ وَ النَّدَامَةِ
segs.en: Whiten our faces on the day when the faces of wrongdoers are blackened during the Day of Regret and Remorse,

segs.ar: وَ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِىْ صُدُوْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وُدًّا
segs.en: appoint love for us in the breasts of the faithful,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَجْعَلِ الْحَيٰوةَ عَلَيْنَا نَكَدًا
segs.en: and make not life for us troublesome!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُوْلِكَ كَمَا
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad, Thy servant and Thy messenger, just as He
delivered Thy message,
executed Thy command,
and counselled Thy servants!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ نَبِيِّنَا صَلٰوتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِهٖ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ
segs.en: O Allah, on the Day of Resurrection make our Prophet (Thy blessings be upon him and his Household)
the nearest of the prophets to Thee in seat,
the ablest of them before Thee with intercession,
the greatest of them with Thee in measure,
and the most eminent of them with Thee in rank!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
ennoble his edifice,
magnify his proof,
make weighty his balance,
accept his intercession,
bring near his mediation,
whiten his face,
complete his light,
and raise his degree!
Make us live according to his Sunna,
make us die in his creed,
take us on his road,
make us travel his path,
place us among the people who obey him,
muster us in his band,
lead us to up his pool,
and give us to drink of his cup!

segs.ar: وَ صَلِّ اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: And bless Muhammad and his Household, with a blessing through which

segs.ar: صَلٰوةً تُبَلِّغُهٗ بِهَا اَفْضَلَ مَا يَاْمُلُ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ وَ فَضْلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ
segs.en: Thou wilt take him to the most excellent of Thy good, Thy bounty, and Thy generosity for which he hopes!

segs.ar: اِنَّكَ ذُوْ رَحْمَةٍ وَّاسِعَةٍ وَ فَضْلٍ كَرِيْمٍ
segs.en: Thou art Possessor of boundless mercy and generous bounty.
O Allah, repay him for
Thy messages which he delivered,
Thy signs which he passed on,
the good counsel he gave to Thy servants,
and the struggle he undertook in Thy way,
with the best Thou hast repaid any of
Thy angels brought nigh
and Thy prophets sent out and chosen!

segs.ar: وَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ.
segs.en: And upon him and his Household, the good, the pure, be peace, Allah's mercy, and His blessings!

S_43.name: 43. On Seeing the New Moon
S_43.nameUr: نئے چاند کو دیکھنے کی دعا

segs.en: O obedient creature,
speedy and untiring,
frequenter of the mansions of determination,
moving about in the sphere of governance!
I have faith in Him Who lights up darkness through you,
illuminates jet-black shadows by you,

segs.tr: wa ja`alaka ayatan min ayati mulkihi
segs.en: appointed you one of the signs of His kingdom
and one of the marks of His authority,
so, He identified time through You,
and humbled you through increase and decrease,
and rising and setting,
and illumination and eclipse.

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ ذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَهُ مُطِيعٌ
segs.tr: fi kulli dhalika anta lahu muti`un
segs.en: In all of this you are obedient to Him,
and prompt toward His will.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَهُ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَمْرِكَ!
segs.tr: subhanahu ma a`jaba ma dabbara fi amrika
segs.en: Glory be to Him! How wonderful is what He has arranged in Your situation!

segs.tr: wa altafa ma sana`a fi sha'nika
segs.en: How subtle what He has made for Your task!

segs.ar: جَعَلَكَ مِفْتَاحَ شَهْرٍ حَادِثٍ لِأَمْرٍ حَادِثٍ
segs.tr: ja`alaka miftaha shahrin hadithin li'amrin hadithin
segs.en: He has made You the key to a new month for a new situation.
So I ask Allah, my Lord and Your Lord,
my Creator and Your Creator,
my Determiner and Your Determiner,
my Form-giver and Your Form-giver,
that He bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَكَ هِلاَلَ بَرَكَةٍ لاَ تَمْحَقُهَا ٱلأَيَّامُ
segs.tr: wa an yaj`alaka hilala barakatin la tamhaquha al-ayyamu
segs.en: and appoint You a crescent of blessings not effaced by days
and of purity not defiled by sins;
a crescent of security from blights
and of safety from evil deeds;
a crescent of auspiciousness containing no misfortune,
of prosperity accompanied by no adversity,
of ease not mixed with difficulty,
of good unstained by evil;
a crescent of security and faith,
favor and good-doing,
safety and submission!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَٱجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَىٰ مَنْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: place us among the most satisfied of those over whom the crescent has risen,
the purest of those who have looked upon it,

segs.tr: wa as`ada man ta`abbada laka fihi
segs.en: the most fortunate of those who have worshiped You under it;

segs.tr: wa waffiqna allahumma fihi liltta`ati walttawbati
segs.en: give us the success during [the new month] to repent,
preserve us within it from misdeeds,
guard us therein from pursuing disobedience to You,
allot to us within it thanksgiving for Your favor,
clothe us during it in the shields of well-being,

segs.ar: وَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِٱسْتِكْمَالِ طَاعَتِكَ فِيهِ ٱلْمِنَّةَ
segs.tr: wa atmim `alayna bistikmali ta`atika fihi alminnata
segs.en: and complete for us Your kindness by perfecting therein obedience to You!
Surely You are All-kind, Praiseworthy.

segs.ar: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاھِرِیْنَ۔
segs.tr: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttayyibina alttahirina.
segs.en: And bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure.

S_44.name: 44. At the Coming of Ramadan
S_44.nameUr: ماہِ رمضان کی آمد پر دعا

segs.en: Praise belongs to God who guided us to His praise

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ اَهْلِهٖ لِنَكُونَ لِاِحْسَانِهٖ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
segs.en: and placed us among the people of praise, that we might be among the thankful for His beneficence
segs.tr: WA JA'ALANAA MIN AHLIHEE LINAKOONA LI-IHSAANIHEE MINASH SHAAKIREEN

segs.en: and that He might recompense us for that with the recompense of the good-doers!
segs.tr: WA LIYAJZIYANAA A'LAA DHAALIKA JAZAA'AL MUHSINEEN

segs.en: And praise belongs to God who showed favour to us through His religion,
segs.tr: WAL HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE HABAANAA BIDEENIH

segs.ar: وَاخْتَصَّنَا بِمِلَّتِهٖ، وَسَبَّلَنَا فِي سُبُلِ اِحْسَانِهٖ
segs.en: singled us out for His creed, and directed us onto the roads of His beneficence,
segs.tr: WAKHTASSANAA BIMILLATIHEE WA SABBALANAA FEE SUBULI IHSAANIH

segs.en: in order that through His kindness we might travel upon them to His good pleasure,

segs.ar: حَمْداً يَتَقَبَّلُهٗ مِنَّا، وَيَرْضَى بِهٖ عَنَّا
segs.en: a praise which He will accept from us and through which He will be pleased with us!
segs.tr: HAMDAN YATAQABBALUHOO MINNAA WA YARDAA BIHEE A'NNAA

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ السُّبُلِ شَهْرَهٗ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: And praise belongs to God who appointed among those roads His month, the month of Ramadan,
segs.tr: WAL HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE JA'ALA MIN TILKAS SUBULI SHAHRAHOO SHAHRA RAMADAAN

segs.ar: شَهْرَ الصِّيَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الْاِسْلَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الطَّهُورِ
segs.en: the month of fasting, the month of submission, the month of purity,
segs.tr: SHAHRAS SIYAAMI WA SHAHRAL ISLAAMI WA SHAHRAT TAHOOR

segs.en: the month of putting to test, the month of standing in prayer,
segs.tr: WA SHAHRAT TAMHEESI WA SHAHRAL QIYAAM

segs.ar: الَّذِي اُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ، هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ
segs.en: "in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance to the people,
segs.tr: ALLADHEE UNZILA FEEHIL QUR'AANU HUDAN LIN NAAS

segs.en: and as clear signs of the Guidance and the Separator" (2:185)!
segs.tr: WA BAYYINAATIN MINAL HUDAA WAL FURQAAN

segs.en: He clarified its excellence over other months

segs.ar: بِمَا جَعَلَ لَهٗ مِنَ الْحُرُمَاتِ الْمَوْفُورَةِ، وَالْفَضَائِلِ الْمَشْهُورَةِ
segs.en: by the many sacred things and well-known excellencies which He placed therein,
segs.tr: BIMAA JA'ALA LAHOO MINAL HURUMAATIL MAWFOORATI WAL FADAA'ILIL MASH-HOORAH

segs.ar: فَحَرَّمَ فِيهِ مَا اَحَلَّ فِي غَيْرِهٖ اِعْظَاماً
segs.en: for He made unlawful in it what He declared lawful in others to magnify it,
segs.tr: FAHARRAMA FEEHI MAA AHALLA FEE GHAYRIHEE I'ZAAMAA

segs.en: He prohibited foods and drinks in it to honour it,
segs.tr: WA HAJARA FEEHIL MATAA'IMA WAL MASHAARIBA IKRAAMAA

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ لَهٗ وَقْتاً بَيِّناً لَا يُجِيزُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ اَنْ يُقَدَّمَ قَبْلَهٗ
segs.en: and He appointed for it a clear time which He (majestic and mighty is He) allows not to be set forward
segs.tr: WA JA'ALA LAHOO WAQTAN BAYYINAN LAA YUJEEZU JALLA WA A'ZZA AN YUQADDAMA QABLAH

segs.en: and accepts not to be placed behind.
segs.tr: WA LAA YAQBALU AN YU'AKHKHARA A'NH

segs.ar: ثُمَّ فَضَّلَ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ لَيَالِيهِ عَلَى لَيَالِي اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: Then He made one of its nights surpass the nights of a thousand months
segs.tr: THUMMA FADDALA LAYLATAN WAAHIDATAN MIN LAYAALEEHI A'LAA LAYAALEE ALFI SHAHR

segs.en: and named it the Night of Decree;

segs.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍ
segs.en: "in it the angels and the Spirit descend by the leave of their Lord upon every command,
segs.tr: TANAZZALUL MALAA'IKATU WAR ROOHU FEEHAA BI-IDHNI RABBIHIM MIN KULLI AMR

segs.ar: سَلَامٌ، دَائِمُ الْبَرَكَةِ اِلَى طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ
segs.en: a peace" (97:4-5) constant in blessings until the rising of the dawn
segs.tr: SALAAMUN DAA'IMUL BARAKATI ILAA TULOO'IL FAJR

segs.ar: عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ بِمَا اَحْكَمَ مِنْ قَضَائِهِ
segs.en: upon whomsoever He will of His servants according to the decision He has made firm.
segs.tr: A'LAA MAN YASHAA'U MIN I'BAADIHEE BIMAA AHKAMA MIN QADAA'IH

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: inspire us with knowledge of its excellence, veneration of its inviolability,
segs.tr: WA ALHIMNAA MA'RIFATA FADLIHEE WA IJLAALA HURMATIH

segs.en: and caution against what You have forbidden within it,

segs.ar: وَاَعِنَّا عَلَى صِيَامِهٖ بِكَفِّ الْجَوَارِحِ عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ
segs.en: and help us to fast in it by our restraining our limbs from acts of disobedience toward You
segs.tr: WA A'INNAA A'LAA SIYAAMIHEE BIKAFFIL JAWAARIHI A'N MA'AASEEK

segs.en: and our employing them in that which pleases You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نُصْغِيَ بِاَسْمَاعِنَا اِلَى لَغْوٍ
segs.en: so that we lend not our ears to idle talk
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA NUSGHIYA BI-ASMAA'INAA ILAA LAGHW

segs.en: and hurry not with our eyes to diversion,
segs.tr: WA LAA NUSRI'A BI-ABSAARINAA ILAA LAHW

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لَا نَبْسُطَ اَيْدِيَنَا اِلَى مَحْظُورٍ
segs.en: we stretch not our hands toward the forbidden
segs.tr: WA HATTAA LAA NABSUTA AYDIYANAA ILAA MAHZOOR

segs.en: and stride not with our feet toward the prohibited,
segs.tr: WA LAA NAKHTUWA BI-AQDAAMINAA ILAA MAHJOOR

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لَا تَعِيَ بُطُونُنَا اِلَّا مَا اَحْلَلْتَ
segs.en: our bellies hold only what You have made lawful
segs.tr: WA HATTAA LAA TA'IYA BUTOONUNAA ILLAA MAA AHLALT

segs.ar: وَلَا تَنْطِقَ اَلْسِنَتُنَا اِلَّا بِمَا مَثَّلْتَ
segs.en: and our tongues speak only what You have exemplified,
segs.tr: WA LAA TANTIQA ALSINATUNAA ILLAA BIMAA MATHTHALT

segs.ar: وَلَا نَتَكَلَّفَ اِلَّا مَا يُدْنِي مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ
segs.en: we undertake nothing but what brings close to Your reward
segs.tr: WA LAA NATAKALLAFA ILLAA MAA YUDNEE MIN THAWAABIK

segs.ar: وَلَا نَتَعَاطَى اِلَّا الَّذِي يَقِي مِنْ عِقَابِكَ
segs.en: and pursue nothing but what protects from Your punishment!
segs.tr: WA LAA NATA'AATAA ILLAL LADHEE YAQEE MIN I'QAABIK

segs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلِّصْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهٗ مِنْ رِئَاءِ الْمُرَاءِينَ، وَسُمْعَةِ الْمُسْمِعِينَ
segs.en: Then rid all of that from the false show of the false showers and the fame seeking of the fame seekers,
segs.tr: THUMMA KHALLIS DHAALIKA KULLAHOO MIN RI'AA'IL MURAA'EENA WA SUM'ATIL MUSMI'EEN

segs.en: lest we associate therein anything with You
or seek therein any object of desire but You!
segs.tr: WA LAA NABTAGHEE FEEHI MURAADAN SIWAAK

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: in it make us attend to the appointed moments
of the five prayers within the bounds You have set,

segs.ar: وَفُرُوضِهَا الَّتِي فَرَضْتَ، وَوَظَائِفِهَا الَّتِي وَظَّفْتَ
segs.en: the obligations You have decreed, the duties You have assigned,
segs.tr: WA FUROODIHAL LATEE FARADTA WA WAZAA'IFIHAL LATEE WAZZAFT

segs.en: and the times You have specified;
and in the prayers make us alight in the station of the keepers of their stations,
segs.tr: WA ANZILNAA FEEHAA MANZILATAL MUSEEBEENA LIMANAAZILIHAA

segs.en: the guardians of their pillars, their performers in their times,

segs.ar: فِي اَوْقَاتِهَا عَلَى مَا سَنَّهٗ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ
segs.en: as Your servant and Your messenger set down in his Sunna (Your blessings be upon him and his Household)
segs.tr: FEE AWQAATIHAA A'LAA MAA SANNAHOO A'BDUKA WA RASOOLUKA SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHI WA AALIH

segs.en: in their bowings, their prostrations, and all their excellent acts,
segs.tr: FEE RUKOO'IHAA WA SUJOODIHAA WA JAMEE'I FAWAADILIHAA

segs.ar: عَلَى اَتَمِّ الطَّهُورِ وَاَسْبَغِهٖ، وَاَبْيَنِ الْخُشُوعِ وَاَبْلَغِهٖ
segs.en: with the most complete and ample ritual purity and the most evident and intense humility!
segs.tr: A'LAA ATAMMIT TAHOORI WA ASBAGHIHEE WA ABYANIL KHUSHOO'I WA ABLAGHIH

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لِاَنْ نَصِلَ اَرْحَامَنَا بِالْبِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ
segs.en: Give us success in this month to tighten our bonds of kin with devotion and gifts,
segs.tr: WA WAFFIQNAA FEEHI LI-AN NASILA ARHAAMANAA BIL BIRRI WAS SILAH

segs.en: attend to our neighbours with bestowal and giving,
segs.tr: WA AN NATA'AAHADA JEERAANANAA BIL IFDAALI WAL A'TIYYAH

segs.en: rid our possessions from claims,
segs.tr: WA AN NUKHALLISA AMWAALANAA MINAT TABI'AAT

segs.en: purify them through paying the alms,
go back to him who has gone far from us,
treat justly him who has wronged us,
make peace with him who shows enmity toward us
(except him who is regarded as an enemy in You and for You,
segs.tr: HAASHAA MAN U'OODIYA FEEKA WA LAK

segs.en: for he is the enemy whom we will not befriend,
the party whom we will not hold dear),

segs.ar: وَاَنْ نَتَقَرَّبَ اِلَيْكَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْاَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَةِ بِمَا تُطَهِّرُنَا بِهٖ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ
segs.en: and seek nearness to You through blameless works which will purify us from sins
segs.tr: WA AN NATAQARRABA ILAYKA FEEHI MINAL A'MAALIZ ZAAKIYATI BIMAA TUTAHHIRUNAA BIHEE MINADH DHUNOOB

segs.ar: وَتَعْصِمُنَا فِيهِ مِمَّا نَسْتَاْنِفُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ
segs.en: and preserve us from renewing faults,
segs.tr: WA TA'SIMUNAA FEEHI MIMMAA NASTA'NIFU MINAL U'YOOB

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا يُورِدَ عَلَيْكَ اَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
segs.en: so that none of Your angels will bring for You
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA YOORIDA A'LAYKA AHADUN MIN MALAA'IKATIK

segs.ar: اِلَّا دُونَ مَا نُورِدُ مِنْ اَبْوَابِ الطَّاعَةِ لَكَ، وَاَنْوَاعِ الْقُرْبَةِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: the kinds of obedience and sorts of nearness-seeking unless they be less than what we bring!
segs.tr: ILLAA DOONA MAA NOORIDU MIN ABWAABIT TAA'ATI LAKA WA ANWAA'IL QURBATI ILAYK

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ
segs.en: O God, I ask You by the right of this month
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BIHAQQI HAADHASH SHAHR

segs.en: and by the right of him who worships You within it
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI MAN TA'ABBADA LAKA FEEH

segs.en: from its beginning to the time of its passing,

segs.ar: مِنْ مَلَكٍ قَرَّبْتَهٗ، اَوْ نَبِيٍّ اَرْسَلْتَهٗ
segs.en: whether angel You have brought nigh to You, prophet You have sent,
segs.tr: MIN MALAKIN QARRABTAHOO AW NABIYYIN ARSALTAH

segs.en: or righteous servant You have singled out,
that You bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاَهِّلْنَا فِيهِ لِمَا وَعَدْتَ اَوْلِيَاءَكَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.en: make us worthy of the generosity You have promised Your friends,
segs.tr: WA AHHILNAA FEEHI LIMAA WA'ADTA AWLIYAA'AKA MIN KARAAMATIK

segs.ar: وَاَوْجِبْ لَنَا فِيهِ مَا اَوْجَبْتَ لِاَهْلِ الْمُبَالَغَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: make incumbent for us what You have made incumbent for those who go to great lengths in obeying You,
segs.tr: WA AWJIB LANAA FEEHI MAA AWJABTA LI-AHLIL MUBAALAGHATI FEE TAA'ATIK

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْمِ مَنِ اسْتَحَقَّ الرَّفِيعَ الْاَعْلَى بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: and place us in the ranks of those who deserve through Your mercy the highest elevation!
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA FEE NAZMI MANIS TAHAQQAR RAFEE'AL A'LAA BIRAHMATIK

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَجَنِّبْنَا الْاِلْحَادَ فِي تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَالْتَّقْصِيرَ فِي تَمْجِيدِكَ
segs.en: turn us aside from deviation in professing Your Unity, falling short in magnifying You,
segs.tr: WA JANNIBNAL ILHAADA FEE TAWHEEDIKA WAT TAQSEERA FEE TAMJEEDIK

segs.ar: وَالشَّكَّ فِي دِينِكَ، وَالْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ، وَالْاِغْفَالَ لِحُرْمَتِكَ
segs.en: uncertainty in Your religion, blindness toward Your path, heedlessness of Your inviolability,
segs.tr: WASH SHAKKA FEE DEENIKA WAL A'MAA A'N SABEELIKA WAL IGHFAALA LIHURMATIK

segs.en: and being deceived by Your enemy, the accursed Satan!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاِذَا كَانَ لَكَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ لَيَالِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا
segs.en: and when in every night of this month's nights
segs.tr: WA IDHAA KAANA LAKA FEE KULLI LAYLATIN MIN LAYAALEE SHAHRINAA HAADHAA

segs.ar: رِقَابٌ يُعْتِقُهَا عَفْوُكَ، اَوْ يَهَبُهَا صَفْحُكَ
segs.en: You have necks which Your pardon will release and Your forgiveness disregard,
segs.tr: RIQAABUN YU'TIQUHAA A'FWUKA AW YAHABUHAA SAFHUK

segs.en: place our necks among those necks

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِشَهْرِنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ اَهْلٍ وَاَصْحَابٍ
segs.en: and place us among the best folk and companions of this our month!
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA LISHAHRINAA MIN KHAYRI AHLIN WA AS-HAAB

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: efface our sins along with the effacing of its crescent moon,

segs.ar: وَاسْلَخْ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا مَعَ انْسِلَاخِ اَيَّامِهٖ
segs.en: and make us pass forth from the ill effects of our acts with the passing of its days,
segs.tr: WASLAKH A'NNAA TABI'AATINAA MA'AN SILAAKHI AYYAAMIH

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَنْقَضِيَ عَنَّا وَقَدْ صَفَّيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
segs.en: until it leaves us behind, while within it You have purified us of offenses
segs.tr: HATTAA YANQADIYA A'NNAA WA QAD SAFFAYTANAA FEEHI MINAL KHATEE'AAT

segs.en: and rid us of evil deeds!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مِلْنَا فِيهِ فَعَدِّلْنَا، وَاِنْ زُغْنَا فِيهِ فَقَوِّمْنَا
segs.en: and should we go off to one side in this month, set us aright; should we swerve, point us straight;
segs.tr: WA IN MILNAA FEEHI FA'ADDILNAA WA IN ZUGHNAA FEEHI FAQAWWIMNAA

segs.ar: وَاِنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَدُوُّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنَا مِنْهُ
segs.en: and should Your enemy Satan enwrap us, rescue us from him!
segs.tr: WA INISH TAMALA A'LAYNAA A'DUWWUKASH SHAYTAANU FASTANQIDHNAA MINH

segs.en: O God, fill this month with our worship of You,
adorn its times with our obedience toward You,
help us during its daytime with its fast,
segs.tr: WA A'INNAA FEE NAHAARIHEE A'LAA SIYAAMIH

segs.en: and in its night with prayer
and pleading toward You, humility toward You,
segs.tr: WAT TADARRU'I ILAYKA WAL KHUSHOO'I LAK

segs.en: and lowliness before You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا يَشْهَدَ نَهَارُهٗ عَلَيْنَا بِغَفْلَةٍ، وَلَا لَيْلُهٗ بِتَفْرِيطٍ
segs.en: so that its daytime may not bear witness against our heedlessness, nor its night against our neglect!
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA YASH-HADA NAHAARUHOO A'LAYNAA BIGHAFLATIN WA LAA LAYLUHOO BITAFREET

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ وَالْاَيَّامِ كَذَلِكَ مَا عَمَّرْتَنَا
segs.en: O God, make us like this in the other months and days as long as You give us life,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAJ'ALNAA FEE SAA'IRISH SHUHOORI WAL AYYAAMI KADHAALIKA MAA A'MMARTANAA

segs.en: and place us among Your righteous servants,

segs.ar: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
segs.en: "those who shall inherit Paradise, therein dwelling forever" (23:11),
segs.tr: ALLADHEENA YARITHOONAL FIRDAWSA HUM FEEHAA KHAALIDOON

segs.en: "those who give what they give, while their hearts quake,
segs.tr: WAL LADHEENA YU'TOONA MAA AATAW WA QULOOBUHUM

segs.en: that they are returning to their Lord" (23:60),

segs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
segs.en: those who "..vie in good works, outracing to them" (23:61)!
segs.tr: WA MINAL LADHEENA YUSAARI'OONA FIL KHAYRAATI WA HUM LAHAA SAABIQOON

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَكُلِّ اَوَانٍ وَعَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
segs.en: in every time, in all moments, and in every state,
segs.tr: FEE KULLI WAQTIN WA KULLI AWAANIN WA A'LAA KULLI HAAL

segs.ar: عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: to the number that You have blessed whomsoever You have blessed
segs.tr: A'DADA MAA SALLAYTA A'LAA MAN SALLAYTA A'LAYH

segs.en: and to multiples of all that, through multiples
segs.tr: WA AD'AAFA DHAALIKA KULLIHEE BIL AD'AAF

segs.en: which none can count but You!
Surely You are Accomplisher of what You desire.

S_45.name: 45. Farewell to Ramadan
S_45.nameUr: ماہِ رمضان کو الوداع کی دعا

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ
segs.en: O God, O He who desires no repayment!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA YAA MAN LAA YARGHABU FIL JAZAA'

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَنْدَمُ عَلَى الْعَطَاءِ
segs.en: O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN LAA YANDAMU A'LAL A'TAA'

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهٗ عَلَى السَّوَاءِ
segs.en: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN LAA YUKAAFI'U A'BDAHOO A'LAS SAWAA'

segs.en: Your kindness is a new beginning, Your pardon gratuitous bounty,
Your punishment justice, Your decree a choice for the best!
segs.tr: WA U'QOOBATUKA A'DLUN WA QADAA'UKA KHIYARAH

segs.ar: اِنْ اَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَاءَكَ بِمَنٍّ
segs.en: If You bestow, You stain not Your bestowal with obligation,
segs.tr: IN A'TAYTA LAM TASHUB A'TAA'AKA BIMANN

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّياً
segs.en: and if You withhold, You withhold not in transgression.
segs.tr: WA IN MANA'TA LAM YAKUN MAN'UKA TA'ADDIYAA

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَاَنْتَ اَلْهَمْتَهٗ شُكْرَكَ
segs.en: You show gratitude to him who thanks You, while You have inspired him to thank You.
segs.tr: TASHKURU MAN SHAKARAKA WA ANTA ALHAMTAHOO SHUKRAK

segs.ar: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَاَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهٗ حَمْدَكَ
segs.en: You reward him who praises You, while though You have taught him Your praise.
segs.tr: WA TUKAAFI'U MAN HAMIDAKA WA ANTA A'LLAMTAHOO HAMDAK

segs.ar: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهٗ
segs.en: You cover him whom, if You willed, You would expose,
segs.tr: TASTURU A'LAA MAN LAW SHI'TA FADAHTAH

segs.ar: وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهٗ
segs.en: and You are generous toward him from whom, if You willed, You would withhold.
segs.tr: WA TAJOODU A'LAA MAN LAW SHI'TA MANA'TAH

segs.en: Both are worthy of Your exposure and withholding,
segs.tr: WA KILAAHUMAA AHLUN MINKA LIL FADEEHATI WAL MAN'

segs.ar: غَيْرَ اَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ اَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segs.en: but You have founded Your acts upon gratuitous bounty,
segs.tr: GHAYRA ANNAKA BANAYTA AF'AALAKA A'LAT TAFADDUL

segs.en: channelled Your power into forbearance,
received him who disobeyed You with clemency,
segs.tr: WA TALAQQAYTA MAN A'SAAKA BIL HILM

segs.en: and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.
segs.tr: WA AMHALTA MAN QASADA LINAFSIHEE BIZ ZULM

segs.ar: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِاَنَاتِكَ اِلَى الْاِنَابَةِ، وَتَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ اِلَى التَّوْبَةِ
segs.en: You await their turning back without haste and refrain from rushing them toward repentance,
segs.tr: TASTANZIRUHUM BI-ANAATIKA ILAL INAABATI WA TATRUKU MU'AAJALATAHUM ILAT TAWBAH

segs.en: so that the perisher among them may not perish because of You
and the wretched may not be wretched through Your favour,
but only after Your prolonged excusing him
and successive arguments against him,
as an act of generosity through Your pardon, O Generous,
and an act of kindliness through Your tenderness, O Clement!
segs.tr: WA A'A'IDATAN MIN A'TFIKA YAA HALEEM
