segs.en: Defend me whence I know not with a defense through which Thou protectest me!

segs.ar: وَافْتَحْ لِىْٓ اَبْوَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رَاْفَتِكَ وَ رِزْقِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
segs.en: Open toward me the gates of Thy repentance, Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and Thy boundless provision!
Surely I am one of those who beseech Thee!
And complete Thy favour toward me!
Surely Thou art the best of those who show favour!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ بَاقِىَ عُمُرِىْ فِىْ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِكَ
segs.en: Place the rest of my life in the hajj and the 'umra seeking Thy face,
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segs.en: And may Allah bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure,

segs.ar: وَالسَّلامُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَبَدَ الاٰبِدِيْنَ.
segs.en: and peace be upon him and them always and forever!

S_48.name: 48. On Eid al-Adha and Friday
S_48.nameUr: عید الاضحیٰ اور جمعہ کی دعا

segs.en: O God, this is a blessed, auspicious day,

segs.ar: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-l-muslimūna fīhi mujtami‘ūna fī aqṭāri arḍik,
segs.en: and the Muslims are gathered in it in the regions of Your earth,

segs.ar: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
segs.tr: yashhadu s-sā’ilu minhum wa-ṭ-ṭālibu wa-r-rāghibu wa-r-rāhibu
segs.en: the petitioner, the seeker, the desirous, and the dreader are present from among them,
and You are the Looker at their needs,

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
segs.tr: fa-as’aluka bi-jūdika wa-karamika wa-hawāni mā sa’altuka ‘alayk
segs.en: so I ask You by Your generosity, Your nobleness, and the ease of what I ask of You upon You,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segs.en: to bless Muḥammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
segs.tr: wa-as’aluka Allāhumm Rabbanā bi-anna laka l-mulka wa-laka l-ḥamd,
segs.en: And I ask You, O God, our Lord, by the fact that the dominion is Yours and the praise is Yours,

segs.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
segs.tr: lā ilāha illā Ant, al-Ḥalīmu l-Karīmu l-Ḥannānu l-Mannān
segs.en: there is no god but You, the Forbearing, the Noble, the Compassionate, the Bestower,

segs.ar: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
segs.tr: dhū l-jalāl wa-l-ikrām, badī‘u s-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ,
segs.en: Possessor of Majesty and Honor, Originator of the heavens and the earth,
whatever You distribute among Your believing servants

segs.ar: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: min khayr aw ‘āfiyatin aw barakatin aw hudā aw ‘amalin bi-ṭā‘atik
segs.en: of good, or well-being, or blessing, or guidance, or action in Your obedience,

segs.ar: أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: aw khayr tamunnu bihī ‘alayhim tahdīhim bihī ilayk
segs.en: or goodness You bestow upon them, by which You guide them to You,
or You raise a rank for them with You,

segs.ar: أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segs.tr: aw tu‘ṭīhim bihī khayran min khayri d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah
segs.en: or You give them through it good from the good of this world and the Hereafter —

segs.ar: أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي وَ نَصِيبِي مِنْهُ.
segs.en: to increase my share and portion of it.
And I ask You, O God, by the fact that
the dominion and the praise are Yours,
there is no god but You,
to bless Muḥammad,
Your servant and Your messenger,
and Your beloved and Your chosen one,
and Your best selection from Your creation,

segs.ar: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
segs.tr: wa-‘alā āli Muḥammad al-abrār iṭ-ṭāhirīn al-akhyār
segs.en: and upon the Household of Muḥammad, the pious, the pure, the excellent,

segs.ar: صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segs.tr: ṣalātan lā yaqwā ‘alā iḥṣā’ihā illā Ant,
segs.en: a blessing that none can enumerate except You,
and to include us in

segs.ar: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
segs.tr: ṣāliḥi man da‘āk fī hādhā l-yawm
segs.en: the good of those who supplicated You on this day
of Your believing servants,
O Lord of the Worlds,

segs.ar: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
segs.en: and to forgive us and them,
truly You have power over everything.
O God, to You I have directed my need,
and in You I have presented my poverty today,
and my destitution and my wretchedness,

segs.ar: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
segs.tr: wa-innī bi-maghfiratik wa-raḥmatik awthaqu minnī bi-‘amalī
segs.en: and I am more confident in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own action,

segs.ar: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.en: and surely Your forgiveness and Your mercy are wider than my sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
segs.tr: wa-tawalla qaḍā’a kulli ḥājatin hiya lī
segs.en: and undertake the fulfilling of every need that is mine,
by Your power over it,
and the ease of that upon You,
and by my poverty toward You,
and Your being free of need for me,

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
segs.tr: fa-innī lam uṣib khayran qaṭṭu illā mink,
segs.en: for I have never attained any good at all except from You,

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
segs.tr: wa-lam yaṣrif ‘annī sū’an qaṭṭu aḥadun ghayruk,
segs.en: and no one has ever averted evil from me at all other than You,
and I do not hope for the matter of
my Hereafter and my world except You.
O God, whoever prepares himself, and equips himself,
and makes ready, and makes preparations,
for a delegation to a creature,

segs.ar: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
segs.tr: rajā’a rifdihī wa-nawāfilihī wa-ṭalaba naylihī wa-jā’izatih,
segs.en: hoping for his gift and his supererogatory grants, and seeking his attainment and his prize,
then to You, O my Master, was today
my preparation and my equipping,
and my readiness and my preparations,
hoping for Your pardon and Your gift,
and seeking Your attainment and Your prize.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
segs.tr: wa-lā tukhayyibi l-yawm dhālik min rajā’ī,
segs.en: and do not disappoint that hope of mine today,
O You whom no petitioner tires,
and whom no bestower diminishes,
for I did not come to You trusting
in a righteous action I presented,
and not the intercession of a creature I hoped for,

segs.ar: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segs.en: except the intercession of Muḥammad and his Household,
upon him and upon them be Your peace,

segs.ar: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
segs.tr: ataytuka muqirran bi-l-jurm wa-l-isā’ati ilā nafsī
segs.en: I came to You confessing the offense and the wrong done to myself,
I came to You hoping for Your great pardon,
by which You pardoned the sinners,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
segs.en: and the prolonged devotion of theirs to the grave offense did not prevent You

segs.ar: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
segs.en: from returning to them with mercy and forgiveness,
so O You whose mercy is vast,
and whose pardon is great,
O Great One, O Great One,
O Noble One, O Noble One,

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
and return to me with Your mercy,
and show me affection with Your favor,
and be vast toward me with Your forgiveness.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm inna hādhā l-maqāma li-khulafā’ika wa-aṣfiyā’ik
segs.en: O God, truly this station belongs to Your Successors (Khulafā’) and Your Chosen Ones (Aṣfiyā’),
and the positions of Your Trustees (Umanā’)

segs.ar: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
segs.tr: fī d-darajati r-rafī‘ati l-latī khaṣṣaṣtahum bihā
segs.en: in the lofty rank You singled out for them,
they have been usurped from it,
and You are the Ordainer of that,
Your command is not to be overcome,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segs.en: and the predetermined of Your governance is not to be transgressed,
how You willed and whenever You willed,
and for what You know best,

segs.ar: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
segs.en: without being accused concerning Your creation or Your will,
until Your chosen ones and Your successors became
defeated, subdued, and usurped,
they see Your judgment changed,
and Your Book abandoned,

segs.ar: وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
segs.en: and Your ordinances distorted from the directions of Your religious laws,
and the practices of Your Prophet abandoned.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm il‘an a‘dā’ahum min al-awwalīn wa-l-ākhirīn
segs.en: O God, curse their enemies from the former and the latter generations,
and those who were pleased with their deeds,
and their followers and their adherents.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
truly You are Praiseworthy (Ḥamīd), Glorious (Majīd),
like Your blessings, and Your benedictions, and Your greetings,

segs.ar: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segs.en: upon Your chosen ones Ibrāhīm and the Household of Ibrāhīm,
and hasten the relief (al-faraj),

segs.ar: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
segs.en: and the comfort (ar-rawḥ), and the help (an-nuṣrah), and the establishment (at-tamkīn), and the support (at-ta’yīd) for them.
O God, and make me
one of the people of Monotheism (at-tawḥīd),
and faith in You,
and belief in Your Messenger,
and the Imams whose obedience You made obligatory,

segs.ar: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segs.tr: mimman yajrī dhālik bihī wa-‘alā yadayh
segs.en: from those by whom and upon whose hands that runs
Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm laysa yaruddu ghaḍabaka illā ḥilmuk,
segs.en: O God, nothing wards off Your anger except Your forbearance,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
segs.en: and nothing wards off Your displeasure except Your pardon,

segs.ar: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
segs.en: and nothing grants refuge from Your punishment except Your mercy,
and nothing saves me from You

segs.ar: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: except humility to You and before You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
segs.tr: wa-hab lanā yā Ilāhī min ladunka farajā
segs.en: and grant us, O my God, from Your presence a relief (faraj),

segs.ar: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
segs.tr: bi-l-qudrati l-latī bihā tuḥyī amwāta l-‘ibād
segs.en: by the power by which You bring the dead of Your servants back to life,
and by which You spread the dead of the lands,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
segs.en: and do not destroy me, O my God, with grief,
until You answer me,
and let me know the answer to my supplication,

segs.ar: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
segs.tr: wa-adhiqnī ṭa‘ma l-‘āfiyati ilā muntahā ajalī
segs.en: and let me taste the savor of well-being (al-‘āfiyah) until the end of my term,
and do not make my enemy gloat over me,
and do not give him power over my neck,
and do not give him authority over me.
My God, if You raise me,
then who is there that can put me down?
And if You put me down,
then who is there that can raise me?
And if You honor me,
then who is there that can disgrace me?
And if You disgrace me,
then who is there that can honor me?
And if You punish me,
then who is there that can have mercy on me?
And if You destroy me,

segs.ar: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segs.tr: fa-man dhā l-ladhī ya‘riḍu lak fī ‘abdik
segs.en: then who is there that can challenge You concerning Your servant,
or ask You about his affair?

segs.ar: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segs.tr: wa-qad ‘alimtu annahū laysa fī ḥukmik ẓulm
segs.en: And I have known that there is no injustice (ẓulm) in Your judgment,
and no haste in Your retribution,

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segs.en: and surely only one who fears loss is hasty,

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
segs.en: and surely only the weak is in need of injustice,
and You have been exalted, O my God,
far above that, a great exaltation.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
and do not make me a target for tribulation (balā’),
and not an object for Your retribution (naqimah),
and grant me respite, and relieve me,
and overlook my slip,
and do not afflict me with a tribulation
upon the heels of a tribulation,
for You see my weakness,
and the fewness of my resource,
and my humility to You.

segs.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segs.tr: A‘ūdhu bik Allāhumm al-yawm min ghaḍabik
segs.en: I seek refuge in You, O God, today from Your anger,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and grant me refuge.

segs.ar: وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segs.en: And I seek protection in You today from Your displeasure,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and protect me.
And I ask You for security from Your punishment,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and grant me security.
And I seek guidance from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and guide me.
And I seek Your help,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and help me.
And I seek Your mercy,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and have mercy on me.
And I seek Your sufficiency,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and suffice me.
And I seek provision from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and provide for me.
And I seek Your aid,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and aid me.

segs.ar: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.en: And I seek Your forgiveness for what has passed of my sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and forgive me.
And I seek infallibility from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and make me infallible.

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
segs.tr: fa-innī lan a‘ūda li-shay’in karihtahū minnī in shi’ta dhālik
segs.en: For I shall not return to anything You dislike from me, if You will that

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
segs.tr: yā Rabb, yā Rabb, yā Ḥannān, yā Mannān,
segs.en: O Lord, O Lord, O Compassionate One, O Bestower,
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor,
bless Muḥammad and his Household,
and answer for me all
that I have asked of You and requested from You,
and desired of You,

segs.ar: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
segs.en: and will it, and decree it, and determine it, and ratify it,

segs.ar: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
segs.en: and choose the best for me in what You determine of it,
and bless me in that,
and favor me with it,
and make me happy with what You give me of it,
and increase me from Your favor,
and the vastness of what is with You,
for truly You are Vast, Noble,

segs.ar: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
segs.en: and connect that with the good of the Hereafter and its bliss,
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segs.ar: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.tr: Tad‘ū bi-mā badā lak, wa-tuṣallī ‘alā Muḥammadin wa-ālihī alfa marratin, hākadhā kāna yaf‘alu ‘alayhi s-salām.
segs.en: You supplicate with whatever seems right to you, and you bless Muḥammad and his Household one thousand times. Thus he (peace be upon him) used to do.
1.O God, this is a blessed and fortunate day,

segs.ar: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
segs.tr: wal-mus-limoona feehee muj-tamiu'wna feee aq-t'aari ar-z''ik
segs.en: 2.within which the Muslims are gathered in the quarters of Your earth.

segs.ar: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
segs.en: 3.Among them are present the asker, the seeker, the beseecher, the fearful,
4.while You art looking upon their needs.

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
segs.tr: faas-aluka bijoodika wa karamika wa hawaani maa saal-tuka a'lay-ka
segs.en: 5.So I ask You by Your munificence and generosity and easy upon You is what I ask You!

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segs.en: 6.- that You blessest Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
segs.tr: wa as-alukal-laahum-ma rab-banaa bi n-na lakal-mul-ka wa lakal-h'am-d
segs.en: 7.And I ask You, O God, our Lord -for Thine is the kingdom and Thine is the praise

segs.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
segs.en: 8.there is no god but Thou,the Clement, the Generous,the All-loving, the All-kind,

segs.ar: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
segs.en: 9.Possessor of majesty and munificence,Originator of the heavens and the earth
10.whenever You apportionest among Your faithful servants

segs.ar: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: min khay-rin aw a'afeeah aw barakatin aw hudana aw a'malim-bit'aaa'tik
segs.en: 11.good, well being, blessing, guidance, works in obedience to You,

segs.ar: ،أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: aw khay-rin tamun-nu bihee a'lay-him tah-deehim biheee ilay-k
segs.en: 12.or good through which You art kind to them by guiding them to You,
13.or raisest them up a degree with You,

segs.ar: ، أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segs.tr: aw tua'-t'eehim bihee khay-ram-min khay-rid-dunyaa wal-akhirah
segs.en: 14.or givest them the good of this world or the next,
15.that You givest me amply my share and allotment of it.
16.And I ask You, O God -
17.for Thine is the kingdom and the praise;
18.there is no god but You -
19.that You blessest Muhammad
20.Your servant and Your messenger,
21.Your beloved and Your selected friend,
22.Your chosen from among Your creation,

segs.ar: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
segs.en: 23.and the Household of Muhammad, the pious, the pure, the chosen,

segs.ar: ,صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segs.tr: s'alaatal-laa yaq-waa a'laaa ih'-s'aaa-ihaaa il-laaa ant
segs.en: 24.with a blessing no one has strength to count but Thou,

segs.tr: wa an tush-rikanaa fee s'aalihee man daa'aka
segs.en: 25.that You associatest us with

segs.ar: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
segs.en: 26.the most righteous of those who supplicate You today
27.of Your faithful servants
28.- O Lord of the worlds!—

segs.tr: wa an tagh-fira lanaa wa lahum-
segs.en: 29.and that You forgivest us and them!
30."Surely You art powerful over everything" (3:26).
31.O God, toward You I aim with my need
32.and before You today I set my poverty,
33.my neediness, my misery,

segs.ar: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
segs.tr: wa in-nee bimagh-firatika wa rah'-matika aw-thaqu min-nee bia'malee
segs.en: 34.for I have more trust in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own works.

segs.ar: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.tr: wa lamagh-firatuka wa rah'-matuka aw-sau' min d'unoobee
segs.en: 35.Your forgiveness and Your mercy are vaster than my sins.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 36.So bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segs.ar: ، وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
segs.tr: wa tawal-la qaz''aaa-a kul-li h'aajatin heea lee
segs.en: 37.and attend to the accomplishment of every need of mine through
38.Your power over it,
39.its easiness for You,
40.my poverty toward You,
41.and Your freedom from need for me!

segs.ar: ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
segs.tr: fa in-nee lam us'ib khay-rana qt'-t'u il-laa mink
segs.en: 42.I will come upon no good whatsoever unless through You,

segs.ar: ، وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
segs.tr: wa lam yas'-rif a'n-nee sooo-ana qat'-t'u ah'adun ghay-ruk
segs.en: 43.no one other than You will turn any evil away from me,
44.and I have hope in none but You for my affair
45.in the next world and in this world.
46.O God, if anyone has ever arranged, made ready,
47.prepared, and drawn himself up
48.to be received by a creature

segs.ar: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
segs.tr: rajaaa-a rif-dihee wa nawaafilih wa t'alaba nay-lihee wajaaa-izatih
segs.en: 49.in hope of his support and awards,
50.then today toward You, my Master,
51.is my arrangement, my making ready,
52.my preparation, and my drawing up
53.in hope of Your pardon and support
54.and in seeking to attain to You and Your prize.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 55.O God, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
segs.en: 56.and disappoint not my hope in that today!
57.O He who is not troubled by those who ask
58.and diminished by those who attain their desire!
59.I come not before You trusting
60.in a righteous work I have sent ahead,
61.nor in the intercession of any creature in whom I have hope,

segs.ar: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segs.en: 62.except the intercession of Muhammad and the Folk of his House
63.(upon him and upon them be Your peace).

segs.ar: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
segs.en: 64.I come to You admitting sin and evildoing toward myself.
65.I come to You hoping for Your abounding pardon
66.through which You hast pardoned the offenders,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
segs.tr: thum-ma lam yam-naa'-ka t'oolu u'koofihim a'laa a'z'eemil-jur-mi
segs.en: 67.while their long persistence in dreadful sin did not prevent You

segs.ar: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
segs.en: 68.from returning toward them with mercy and forgiveness!
69.O He whose mercy is wide
70.and whose pardon is abounding!
71.O All-mighty! O All-mighty!
72.O All-generous! O All-generous!

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 73.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
74.return toward me through Your mercy,
75.be tender toward me through Your bounty,
76.and spread out Your forgiveness upon me!

segs.ar: . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-na had'aal-maqaama likhulafaaa-ika wa as'-feeaaa-ik
segs.en: 77.O God, this station belongs to Your vicegerents, Your chosen,
78.while the places of Your trusted ones

segs.ar: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
segs.en: 79.in the elevated degree which You hast singled out for them
80.have been forcibly stripped!
81.But You art the Ordainer of that -
82.Your command is not overcome,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segs.en: 83.the inevitable in Your governing is not overstepped!
84.However You willest and whenever You willest!
85.In that which You knowest best,

segs.ar: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
segs.tr: ghay-ru mut-tahamin a'laa khal-qika wa laa liiraadatik
segs.en: 86.Thou art not accused for Your creation or Your will!
87.Then Your selected friends, Your vicegerents,
88.were overcome, vanquished, forcibly stripped;
89.they see Your decree replaced,
90.Your Book discarded,

segs.ar: ، وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
segs.tr: wa faraaa-iz''aka muh'ar-rafatan a'n jihaati ash-raai'k
segs.en: 91.Your obligations distorted from the aims of Your laws,
92.and the Sunna of Your Prophet abandoned!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segs.en: 93.O God, curse their enemies among those of old and the later folk,
94.and all those pleased with their acts,
95.and their adherents and followers!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 96.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
97.(surely You art All-laudable, All-glorious)
98.like Your blessing, benedictions, and salutations

segs.ar: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segs.tr: a'laaa as'-feeaaa-ika ib-raaheema wa aaali ib-raaheem
segs.en: 99.upon Your chosen Abraham and the people of Abraham!
100.And hasten for them relief,

segs.ar: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
segs.en: 101.ease, help, strengthening,and confirmation!
102.O God, and make me
103.one of the people who profess Your Unity,
104.have faith in You,
105.and attest to Your Messenger
106.and the Imams toward whom You hast enjoined obedience,

segs.ar: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segs.en: 107.and one of those through whom and at whose hands this takes place!
108.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
segs.en: 109.O God, nothing repels Your wrath but Your clemency,

segs.ar: ، وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
segs.tr: wa laa yarud-du sakhat'aka il-laa a'f-wuk
segs.en: 110.nothing repels Your displeasure but Your pardon,

segs.ar: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
segs.tr: wa laa yujeeru min i'qaabika il-laa rah'-matuk
segs.en: 111.nothing grants sanctuary from Your punishment but Your mercy,
112.and nothing will deliver me from You

segs.ar: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.tr: minka il-laat-taz''ar-ruu' ilay-ka wa bay-na yaday-k
segs.en: 113.except pleading to You before You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 114.so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
segs.tr: wa hab lanaa yaaa ilaahee mil-ladunka farajan
segs.en: 115.and give us on Your part, my God, relief
116.by means of the power through which You bringest the dead servants to life
117.and revivest the dead lands.

segs.ar: . وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
segs.tr: wa laa tuh-lik-nee yaaa ilaahee gham-man
segs.en: 118.Destroy me not through gloom, my God,
119.before You respondest to me
120.and givest me the knowledge of Your response to my supplication!

segs.ar: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
segs.tr: wa ad'iq-nee t'aa'-mal-a'afeeati ilaa muntahaaa ajalee
segs.en: 121.Let me taste the flavour of well-being to the end of my term!
122.And let not my enemy gloat over me,
123.place not my neck in his power,
124.and give him not authority over me!
125.My God, if You raisest me up,
126.who is there to push me down?
127.If You pushest me down,
128.who is there to raise me up?
129.If You honourest me,
130.who is there to humiliate me?
131.If You humiliatest me,
132.who is there to honour me?
133.If You chastisest me,
134.who is there to have mercy upon me?
135.If You destroyest me,

segs.ar: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segs.tr: faman d'aal-lad'ee yaa'-riz''u laka fee a'b-dika
segs.en: 136.who is there to stand up for Your servant against You
137.or ask You about his affair?

segs.ar: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segs.tr: waqad a'lim-tu an-nahoolay-sa fee h'uk-mika z'ul-m
segs.en: 138.But I know that there is no wrong in Your decree
139.and no hurry in Your vengeance.

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segs.en: 140.He alone hurries who fears to miss,

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
segs.en: 141.and only the weak needs to wrong.
142.But You art exalted, my God,
143.high indeed above all that!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: 144.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
145.make me not the target of affliction
146.nor the object of Your vengeance,
147.respite me, comfort me,
148.release me from my stumble,
149.and afflict me not with an affliction
150.in the wake of an affliction,
151.for You hast seen my frailty,
152.the paucity of my stratagems,
153.and my pleading to You!

segs.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segs.en: 154.I seek refuge in You today, my God, from Your wrath,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
segs.en: 155.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge!

segs.ar: ، وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segs.en: 156.I seek sanctuary in You today from Your displeasure,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
segs.en: 157.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me sanctuary!
158.I ask You security from Your chastisement,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
segs.tr: salle ala mohmmadan wa aale muhammad
segs.en: 159.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me security!
160.I seek guidance from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
segs.en: 161.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide me!
162.I seek help from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
segs.en: 163.so bless Muhammad and his Household and help me!
164.I ask You for mercy,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
segs.en: 165.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!
166.I seek sufficiency from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
segs.en: 167.so bless Muhammad and his Household and suffice me!
168.I seek provision from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
segs.en: 169.so bless Muhammad and his Household and provide for me!
170.I seek assistance from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa ai'n-nee
segs.en: 171.so bless Muhammad and his Household and assist me!

segs.ar: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.tr: wa astagh-firuka limaa salafa min d'unoobee
segs.en: 172.I pray forgiveness for my past sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wagh-fir lee
segs.en: 173.so bless Muhammad and his Household and forgive me!
174.I ask You to preserve me from sin,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
segs.en: 175.so bless Muhammad and his Household and preserve me,

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
segs.tr: fa in-nee lan au'wda lishay-in karih-tahoo min-nee in shi-ta d'alik
segs.en: 176.for I will not return to anything You dislikest from me, if You willest that!

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
segs.tr: yaa rab-bi yaa rab yaa h'an-naanu yaa man-naan
segs.en: 177.My Lord! My Lord! O All-loving! O All-kind!
178.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
179.Bless Muhammad and his Household,
180.and grant me everything
181.that I ask from You, seek from You,
182.and beseech from You!

segs.ar: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
segs.tr: wa arid-hoo wa qad-dir-hoo wa aq-z''ihee wa am-z''ih
segs.en: 183.Will it, ordain it, decree it, and accomplish it!

segs.ar: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
segs.tr: wa khir lee feemaa taq-z''ee min-h
segs.en: 184.Give me good in that of it which You decreest!
185.Bless me in that,
186.be gratuitously bountiful toward me through it,
187.make me happy in that of it which You givest to me,
188.and increase me in Your bounty
189.and the plenty of what is with You,
190.for You art Boundless, Generous!

segs.ar: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
segs.tr: wa s'il d'alika bikhay-ril-aaakhirati wa nae'emihaa
segs.en: 191.And link that to the good and the bliss of the next world,
192.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.tr: then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on muhammed and his household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).
segs.en: 193.Then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on Muhammed and his Household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).

S_49.name: 49. In Repelling Enemies' Plots
S_49.nameUr: دشمنوں کے مکر سے بچاؤ کی دعا

segs.en: My God, You guided me, yet I indulged (in heedlessness),
and You admonished, yet I hardened (my heart),
and You showed beautiful favour, yet I disobeyed,
Then I knew what You had issued (the warning)?
When You made me know it, I sought forgiveness, and You overlooked (my fault), yet I returned (to sin),
and You concealed (my fault), so for You, my God, is the praise.
I plunged into the valleys of perdition,

segs.ar: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-ḥalaltu shi‘āba talaf ta‘arraḍtu fīhā li-saṭawātik,
segs.en: and I settled in the passes of ruin, where I exposed myself to Your assaults,
and to the descent of Your punishments by settling in them,
And my means (of approach) to You is Monotheism (at-tawḥīd),

segs.ar: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
segs.tr: wa-dharī‘atī annī lam ushrik bik shay’ā,
segs.en: and my plea is that I did not associate anything with You,
and I did not take any god alongside You,
and I have fled to You with myself,
and to You is the escape of the one who does wrong,
and the refuge of the one who wasted his own portion, the refugee.

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
segs.en: So how many an enemy has unsheathed his sword of enmity against me,
and sharpened the blade of his knife for me,
and made keen the sharpness of its edge for me,
and mixed the deadly poisons of his venom for me,
and aimed the accurate shots of his arrows at me,
and the eye of his guard did not sleep concerning me,

segs.ar: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-aḍmara an yasūmanī l-makrūh wa-yujarri ‘annī zu‘āfa marāratih,
segs.en: and he intended to impose evil upon me and to make me swallow the deadly bitterness of his venom –

segs.ar: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ،
segs.tr: fa-naẓarta yā Ilāhī ilā ḍa‘fī ‘ani ḥtimāli l-fawādiḥ,
segs.en: Then You looked, O my God, at my weakness in bearing the calamities,

segs.ar: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
segs.en: and my incapacity to defend myself against the one who intended to make war on me,

segs.ar: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
segs.en: and my solitude amid the large number of those who showed me hostility

segs.ar: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
segs.tr: wa-arṣada lī bi-l-balā’ fīmā lam u‘mil fīhi fikrī,
segs.en: and lay in wait for me with tribulation in a matter in which I did not employ my thought—
So You began by granting me Your help,
and You strengthened my back with Your power,
Then You blunted his edge for me,

segs.ar: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
segs.en: and You made him, after a large gathering, stand alone,
and You raised my heel above him (gave me victory over him),
and You made what he aimed return upon him,
So You drove him back without his having satisfied his rage,
and without his heat of thirst being quenched,
he bit his lips,
and he turned away in retreat, his expeditions having failed.
And how many an oppressor sought to oppress me with his plots,
and set up the net of his traps for me,
and assigned to me the checking of his vigilance,
and lay in wait for me like a wild beast for its quarry,
waiting to seize the opportunity for his prey,
while he displayed to me the cheerfulness of flattery,
and looked at me with intense wrath—

segs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
segs.tr: fa-lammā ra’ayta yā Ilāhī tabārakta wa-ta‘ālayta daghala sarīratih,
segs.en: So when You saw, O my God—blessed and exalted be You—the corruption of his inner being,

segs.ar: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-qubḥa mā nṭawā ‘alayh, arkastahū li-umm rā’sihī fī zubyatih,
segs.en: and the foulness of what he concealed, You made him fall headlong into his own pit,
and You turned him back into the downfall of his own hole,

segs.ar: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
segs.tr: fa-nqama‘a ba‘da stiṭālatihī dhalīlan fī ribaq ḥibālatih
segs.en: So he was humbled after his aggression, disgraced in the snares of his own trap

segs.ar: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
segs.tr: allatī kāna yuqaddir an yarānī fīhā,
segs.en: in which he intended to see me,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
segs.tr: wa-qad kāda an yaḥulla bī lawlā raḥmatuka mā ḥalla bi-sāḥatih.
segs.en: and what befell his courtyard had nearly fallen upon me, were it not for Your mercy.

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa-kam min ḥāsidin qad shariqa bī bi-ghuṣṣatih,
segs.en: And how many an envier (ḥāsid) has choked on account of me with his grief,

segs.ar: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-shajī minnī bi-ghayẓih, wa-salaqanī bi-ḥaddi lisānih,
segs.en: and suffered on my account with his rage, and stung me with the sharpness of his tongue,
and vexed me by slandering my faults,
and made my honour a target for his aims,
and accused me of qualities that were never absent from him,
and vexed me with his guile, and intended me with his plot—
So I called upon You, O my God, seeking help in You,
confident in the swiftness of Your response,

segs.ar: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
segs.tr: ‘āliman annahū lā yuḍṭahadu man āwā ilā ẓilli kanafika,
segs.en: knowing that no one who takes shelter under the shadow of Your protection will be wronged,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-lā yafza‘u man laja’a ilā ma‘qil intiṣārik,
segs.en: and no one who seeks refuge in the stronghold of Your help will be terrified—
So You fortified me against his malice with Your power.

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
segs.en: And how many clouds of detestable things You cleared away from me,
and clouds of blessings You showered upon me,
and streams of mercy You spread,
and well-being You clothed me in, and eyes of calamities You blinded,
and overpowering distresses You removed,

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
segs.tr: wa-kam min ẓannin ḥasanin ḥaqqaqt, wa-‘adamin jabart,
segs.en: And how many a good expectation You fulfilled, and a lack You remedied,
and a fall You revived, and wretchedness You transformed—
All of that being favour and bestowal from You,

segs.ar: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
segs.en: while in all of it, I was absorbed in Your acts of disobedience,

segs.ar: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
segs.en: My wrongdoing did not prevent You from completing Your benevolence,

segs.ar: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
segs.en: and that did not restrain me from committing Your displeasing acts,

segs.ar: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
segs.tr: lā tus’alu ‘ammā taf‘al, wa-laqad su’ilta fa-a‘ṭayt,
segs.en: You are not questioned about what You do, and You were asked, and You gave,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
segs.tr: wa-lam tus’al fa-btada’t, wa-stumīḥa faḍluk fa-mā akdayt,
segs.en: and You were not asked, and You initiated, and Your favour was sought, and You did not fail—
You refused, O my Master, except to show benevolence,
and bestowal of grace, and granting of favour, and blessing,
and I refused except to plunge into violation of Your sanctities,
and transgression of Your bounds, and heedlessness of Your threat.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
segs.tr: Fa-laka l-ḥamdu Ilāhī min muqtadirin lā yughlab,
segs.en: So for You is the praise, O my God, as the One who is Powerful, Who is not overcome,
and the One Possessing Deliberation, Who does not hasten.

segs.ar: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
segs.en: This is the station of one who acknowledged the fullness of blessings,

segs.ar: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
segs.en: and met them with deficiency, and bore witness against himself of wasting (them).

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm fa-innī ataqarrabu ilayk bi-l-Muḥammadiyyati r-rafī‘ah,
segs.en: O God, truly I draw near to You by the lofty Muḥammadiyyah (the path/status of Muḥammad),
and the radiant ‘Alawiyyah (the path/status of ‘Alī), and I turn to You through them both,

segs.ar: أنْ تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ (كَذَا وَكَذَا) فَإِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ
segs.tr: an tu'īdhanī min sharri [kadhā wa-kadhā] fa-inna dhālik
segs.en: (asking that) You grant me refuge from the evil of [such and such], for truly that
does not strain You in Your richness,
and it does not weary You in Your power,
and You have power over everything,

segs.ar: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
segs.tr: fa-hab lī yā Ilāhī min raḥmatik wa-dawāmi tawfīqik,
segs.en: So grant me, O my God, from Your mercy and the lastingness of Your enabling (tawfīq),

segs.ar: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
segs.tr: mā attakhidhuhū sullaman a‘ruju bihī ilā riḍwānik,
segs.en: that which I may take as a ladder by which I may ascend to Your good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.tr: wa-āmanu bihī min ‘iqābik, yā Arḥama r-Rāḥimīn.
segs.en: and by which I may be safe from Your punishment, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.
1.My God, You guided me but I diverted myself,
2.You admonished me but my heart became hardened,
3.You tried me graciously but I disobeyed.
4.Then, when You caused me to know it, I came to know that from
5.which You hadst turned [me] away, so I prayed forgiveness and You released, and I returned
6.and You covered over. So Thine, my God, is the praise!
7.I plunged into the valleys of destruction

segs.ar: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa h'alal-tu shia'aba talaf taa'r-raz''-tu feehaa lisat'awaatik
segs.en: 8.and settled in the ravines of ruin, exposing myself to Your chastisements
9.and the descent of Your punishments!
10.My mediation with You is the profession of Unity,

segs.ar: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
segs.tr: wa d'areea'teee an-nee lam ush-rik bika shay-aa
segs.en: 11.my way of coming to You that I associate nothing with You,
12.nor do I take along with You a god;
13.I have fled to You with my soul -
14.in You is the place of flight for the evildoer,
15.the place of escape for him who has squandered the share of his soul and seeks asylum.

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
segs.tr: fakam min a'dooin intaz''aa a'lay-ya say-fa a'daawatih
segs.en: 16.How many an enemy has unsheathed the sword of his enmity toward me,
17.honed the cutting edge of his knife for me,
18.sharpened the tip of his blade for me,
19.mixed his killing potions for me,
20.pointed toward me his straight-flying arrows,

segs.tr: wa lam tanam a'n-nee a'y-nu h'iraasatih
segs.en: 21.not allowed the eye of his watchfulness to sleep toward me,

segs.ar: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ ،
segs.tr: wa az''-mara ay-yasoomaneel-mak-rooh wa yujar-ria'nee zua'aqa maraaratih
segs.en: 22.and secretly thought of visiting me with something hateful and making me gulp down the bitter water of his bile!

segs.ar: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ ،
segs.tr: fanaz'ar-ta yaaa ilaaheee ilaa z''aa'-fee a'ni ah'-timaalil-fawaadih'
segs.en: 23.So You looked my God, at my weakness in bearing oppressive burdens,

segs.ar: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa a'j-zee a'nilints'aari mim-man qas'adanee bimuh'aarabatih
segs.en: 24.my inability to gain victory over him who aims to war against me,

segs.ar: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
segs.tr: wa wah'-datee fee katheeri a'dadi man-naawaanee
segs.en: 25.and my being alone before the great numbers of him who is hostile toward me

segs.ar: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
segs.tr: wa ar-s'ada leeal-balaaa-a feemaa lam ua'-mil feehee fik-ree
segs.en: 26.and lies in wait for me with an affliction about which I have not thought.
27.You set out at once to help me
28.and You braced up my back!
29.You blunted for me his blade,

segs.ar: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
segs.en: 30.made him, after a great multitude, solitary,
31.raised up my heel over him,

segs.tr: wa jaa'l-ta maa sad-dadahoo mar-doodana a'lay-h
segs.en: 32.and turned back upon him what he had pointed straight.
33.So You sent him back, his rage not calmed,
34.his burning thirst not quenched!
35.Biting his fingers,

segs.tr: wa ad-bara muwal-leeana qad akh-laf-ta saraayaah
segs.en: 36.he turned his back in flight, his columns having been of no use.
37.How many an oppressor has oppressed me with his tricks,
38.set up for me the net of his snares,
39.appointed over me the inspection of his regard,
40.and lay in ambush for me, the lying in ambush of a predator for its game,
41.waiting to take advantage of its prey,
42.while he showed me the smile of the flatterer
43.and looked at me with the intensity of fury!

segs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
segs.tr: falam-maa raay-ta yaaa ilaahee tabaarak-ta wa taa'alay-t daghala sareeratih
segs.en: 44.So when You saw, my God, (blessed art You and high exalted) the depravity of his secret thoughts

segs.ar: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa qub-h'a mant'awaa a'lay-h ar-kas-tahoo lium-mi raa-sihee fee zub-yatih
segs.en: 45.and the ugliness of what he harboured, You threw him on his head into his own pitfall
46.and dumped him into the hole of his own digging.

segs.ar: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
segs.tr: faanqamaa' baa'-da as-tit'aalatihee d'aleelan fee ribaqi h'ibaalatihi
segs.en: 47.So he was brought down low, after his overbearing, by the nooses of his own snare,

segs.ar: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
segs.en: 48.wherein he had thought he would see me;

segs.ar: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
segs.tr: wa qad kaada ay-yah'ul-la bee law-laa rah'-matuka maa h'al-la bisaah'atih
segs.en: 49.and what came down upon his courtyard - had it not been for Your mercy - was on the point of coming down upon me!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa kam min h'aasidin qad shariqa bee bighus'-s'atih
segs.en: 50.How many an evier has choked upon me in his agony,

segs.ar: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
segs.tr: wa shajeea min-nee bighay-z'ih wa salaqanee bih'ad-d lisaanih
segs.en: 51.fumed over me in his rage, cut me with the edge of his tongue,
52.showed malice toward me by accusing me of his own faults,
53.made my good repute the target of his shots,
54.collared me with his own constant defects,

segs.tr: wa wah'aranee bikaydih wa qas'adanee bimakeedatih
segs.en: 55.showed malice toward me with his trickery, and aimed at me with his tricks!
56.So I called upon You, my God, seeking aid from You,
57.trusting in the speed of Your response,

segs.ar: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
segs.tr: a'aliman an-nah laa yuz''-t'ahadu man awaaa ilaa z'il-li kanafik
segs.en: 58.knowing that he who seeks haven in the shadow of Your wing will not be mistreated,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
segs.tr: wa lay-yaf-zaa' mal-lajaa ilaa maa'-qili antis'aarik
segs.en: 59.and he who seeks asylum in the stronghold of Your victory will not be frightened.
60.So You fortified me against his severity through Your power.

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa kam min- sah'aaa-ibi mak-roohin jal-lay-tahaa a'n-nee
segs.en: 61.How many a cloud of detested things You hast dispelled from me,
62.a cloud of favour You hast made rain down upon me,
63.a stream of mercy You hast let flow,

segs.tr: wa a'afeeatin al-bas-tahaa wa aa'-yuni ah'-daathin t'amas-tahaa
segs.en: 64.a well-being in which You hast clothed me, an eye of mishap You hast blinded,
65.and a wrap of distress You hast removed!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
segs.tr: wa kam min- z'an-nin h'asanin h'aq-qaq-t wa a'damin jabar-t
segs.en: 66.How many a good opinion You hast verified, a destitution You hast redressed,

segs.tr: wa s'ara'tin an-a'sh-t wa mas-kanatin h'aw-wal-t
segs.en: 67.an infirmity You hast restored to health, and a misery You hast transformed!
68.All of that was favour and graciousness from You,

segs.ar: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
segs.tr: wa fee jameei'hee an-himaakam-min-nee a'laa maa'as'eek
segs.en: 69.and in all of it I was occupied with acts of disobeying You.

segs.ar: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
segs.tr: lam tam-naa'-ka isaaa-atee a'n it-maami ih'-saanik
segs.en: 70.My evildoing did not hinder You from completing Your beneficence,

segs.ar: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa h'ajaranee d'alika a'ni ar-tikaabi masaakhit'ik
segs.en: 71.nor was I stopped from committing acts displeasing to You.

segs.ar: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
segs.tr: laa tus-alu a'm-maa taf-a'l wa laqad su-il-ta faaa'-t'ay-t
segs.en: 72.You art not questioned as to what You dost! You wert asked, and You bestowed.

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
segs.tr: wa lam tus-al fab-tadaa-t was-tumeeh'a faz''-luka famaaa ak-day-t
segs.en: 73.You wert not asked, and You began. Your bounty was requested, and You didst not skimp.
74.You refused, my Master, everything but beneficence,
75.kindness, graciousness, and favour,
76.and I refused everything but plunging into what You hast made unlawful,
77.transgressing Your bounds, and paying no heed to Your threat!

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
segs.en: 78.So Thine is the praise, my God, the All-powerful who is not overcome,
79.and the Possessor of patient waiting who does not hurry!

segs.ar: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
segs.en: 80.This is the station of one who confesses to lavishness of favours,

segs.ar: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
segs.tr: wa qaabalahaa bit-taq-s'eer wa shahida a'laa naf-sihee bit-taz''-yeea'
segs.en: 81.counters them with shortcomings, and bears witness to his own negligence.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma fa in-neee ataqar-rabu ilay-ka bil-muh'am-madee-yatir-rafeea'h
segs.en: 82.O God, so I seek nearness to You through the elevated rank of Muhammad and the radiant degree of 'Ali,
83.and I turn to You through them so that You wilt give me

segs.ar: تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ [كَذَا وَكَذَا] فَإنَّ ذَالِكَ
segs.tr: an tue'ed'anee min shar-ri kad'aa wa kad'aa fa in-na d'alika
segs.en: 84.refuge from the evil of [so and so],
85.for that will not constrain You in Your wealth,
86.nor trouble You in Your power,

segs.tr: wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segs.en: 87.and You art powerful over everything!

segs.ar: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
segs.tr: fahab lee yaaa ilaahee mir-rah'-matika wa dawaami taw-feeqik
segs.en: 88.So give me, my God, by Your mercy and Your lasting bestowal of success,

segs.ar: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
segs.tr: mat-takhid'-hoo sul-laman aa'-ruju bih ilaa riz''-waanik
segs.en: 89.that which I may take as a ladder with which to climb to Your good pleasure

segs.ar: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.tr: wa aaamanu bih min i'qaabk yaaa ar-h'am-r-raah'imeen
segs.en: 90.and be secure from Your punishment, O Most merciful of the merciful!
O God, You created me sound (or well-formed),
and You nurtured me when little, and You provided for me sufficiently.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm innī wajadtu fīmā anzalta min kitābik,
segs.en: O God, I found in what You revealed of Your Book,
and with which You gave glad tidings to Your servants,

segs.ar: أَنْ قُلْتَ: (يا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
segs.en: that You said: (O My servants who have transgressed against their own souls

segs.ar: لاَ تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ إنَّ اللهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً)
segs.tr: lā taqnaṭū min raḥmatillāh innallāha yaghfiru dh-dhunūba jamī‘ā)
segs.en: Do not despair of God's mercy; truly, God forgives all sins) [Qur'an 39:53]

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّي مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ،
segs.en: And there has proceeded from me what You already know,
and what You know better than I do,

segs.ar: فَيَا سَوْأَتا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ،
segs.en: So woe to what Your Book has enumerated against me!

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِي أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: And were it not for the opportunities (or stances) in which I hope for Your pardon,

segs.ar: الَّذِي شَمِلَ كُلَّ شَيْء لاَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
segs.tr: alladhī shamila kulla shay’ lā-alqaytu bi-yadī,
segs.en: which encompasses everything, I would have cast myself down (in surrender),
And if anyone were able to flee

segs.ar: مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِالهَرَبِ مِنکَ،
segs.tr: min rabbihī la-kuntu ana aḥaqqu bi-l-harab minka ,
segs.en: from his Lord, I would be the most deserving to flee,

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الاَرْضِ
segs.tr: wa-anta lā takhfā ‘alayk khāfiyatun fī l-arḍ
segs.en: And You, no hidden thing is concealed from You on the earth

segs.ar: وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ إلاَّ أَتَيْتَ بِهَا،
segs.tr: wa-lā fī s-samā’ illā atayta bihā,
segs.en: nor in the heaven, but You bring it forth,

segs.ar: وَكَفى بِكَ جَازِياً، وَكَفى بِكَ حَسِيباً.
segs.tr: wa-kafā bik jāziyā, wa-kafā bik ḥasībā.
segs.en: and You are sufficient as a rewarder, and You are sufficient as a reckoner.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ طَالِبِي إنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm innaka ṭālibī in anā harabt,
segs.en: O God, truly You are my seeker if I flee,
and my captor if I run away,

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ،
segs.tr: fa-hā ana dhā bayna yadayk khāḍi‘un dhalīlun rāghim,
segs.en: So here I am before You, submissive, abased, utterly humbled,
If You punish me, then I am worthy of that,
and it, O Lord, is justice from You,

segs.ar: وَإنْ تَعْفُ عَنِّي فَقَدِيماً شَمَلَنِي عَفْوُكَ،
segs.en: and if You pardon me, then Your pardon has long encompassed me,
and You clothed me in Your well-being.
So I ask You, O God, by the treasured of Your Names,
and by what the veils have concealed of Your splendor,
that You have mercy on this impatient soul,
and this restless, anxious (or frail) body,
which cannot withstand the heat of Your sun,
so how can it withstand the heat of Your fire?
And which cannot withstand the sound of Your thunder,
so how can it withstand the sound of Your wrath?

segs.ar: فَارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَخَطَرِي يَسِيرٌ،
segs.tr: Fa-rḥamnī Allāhumm fa-innī mrū’un ḥaqīr, wa-khaṭarī yasīr,
segs.en: So have mercy on me, O God, for I am a contemptible person, and my affair is insignificant,

segs.ar: وَلَيْسَ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّة،
segs.tr: wa-laysa ‘adhābī mimmā yazīdu fī mulkik mithqāla dharratin,
segs.en: and my punishment is not something that would increase Your dominion by the weight of an atom,

segs.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ
segs.tr: wa-law anna ‘adhābī mimmā yazīdu fī mulkik
segs.en: And if my punishment were something that would increase Your dominion,
I would have asked You for patience for it,
and I would have loved that to be for Your sake,
But Your sovereignty, O God, is greater,

segs.ar: وَمُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيـدَ فِيْهِ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ،
segs.tr: wa-mulkuk adwamu min an tazīda fīh ṭā‘atu l-muṭī‘īn,
segs.en: and Your dominion is more eternal than to be increased by the obedience of the obedient,
or to be diminished by the disobedience of the sinners.
So have mercy on me, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones,

segs.ar: وَتَجاوَزْ عَنِّي يا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
segs.en: and overlook my faults, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor,

segs.ar: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
segs.en: and accept my repentance; truly, You are the Relenting, the Merciful.
1.O God, You created me without fault,

segs.tr: wa rab-bay-tanee s'agheeraa wa razaq-tanee mak-fee-yaa
segs.en: 2.nurtured me when small, and provided me with sufficiency.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nee wajat-tu feemaa anzal-ta min kitaabik
segs.en: 3.O God, I found in the Book which You sent down
4.and through which You gave good news to Your servants,

segs.ar: أَنْ قُلْتَ: (يا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
segs.tr: an qul-ta: (yaa i'baadeeal-lad'eena as-rafoo a'laaa anfusihim
segs.en: 5.that You said, O My servants who hare been prodigal against yourselves,

segs.ar: لاَ تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ إنَّ اللهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً)
segs.tr: laa taq-nat'oo mir-rah'-matil-laah in-nal-laaha yagh-firud'-d'unooba jameea'a)
segs.en: 6.do not despair of God's mercy, surely God forgives all sins,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّي مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ،
segs.tr: waqad t-taqad-dama min-nee maa qad a'lim-ta
segs.en: 7.but there has gone ahead from me what You knowest

segs.tr: wa maaa anta aa'-lamu bihee min-nee
segs.en: 8.(and of which You knowest more than I)!

segs.ar: فَيَا سَوْأَتا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ،
segs.tr: fayaa saw-ataa mim-maaa ah'-s'aahoo a'lay-ya kitaabuk
segs.en: 9.O the shame of what Your Book has counted against me!

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِي أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: 10.Were it not for the places where I expectantly hope for Your pardon,

segs.ar: الَّذِي شَمِلَ كُلَّ شَيْء لاَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
segs.tr: lad'ee shamila kul-la shayil-la al-qay-tu beeadee
segs.en: 11.which enfolds all things, I would have thrown myself down [in despair]!
12.Were anyone able to flee from his Lord,

segs.ar: مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِالهَرَبِ،
segs.en: 13.I would be the most obligated to flee from You!

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الاَرْضِ
segs.tr: wa anta laa takh-faa a'lay-ka khaafeeatun fil-ar-z''i
segs.en: 14.But not a secret in earth and heaven is concealed from You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ إلاَّ أَتَيْتَ بِهَا،
segs.en: 15.except that You bringest it.

segs.ar: وَكَفى بِكَ جَازِياً، وَكَفى بِكَ حَسِيباً.
segs.tr: wa kafaa bika jaazeeaa wa kafaa bika h'aseebaa
segs.en: 16.You sufficest as a recompenser! You sufficest as a reckoner!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ طَالِبِي إنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-nak t'aalibeee in ana harab-t
segs.en: 17.O God, surely You wouldst seek me if I flee
18.and catch me if I run.

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ،
segs.tr: fahaaa ana d'aa bay-na yaday-k khaaz''iu'n d'aleelur-raaghim
segs.en: 19.So here I am before You, abject, lowly, abased.

segs.tr: in tua'd'-d'ib-nee fa in-nee lid'alika ah-loo
segs.en: 20.If You chastisest me, I am worthy of that,

segs.tr: wa huwa yaa rab-bi minka a'd-l
segs.en: 21.and it would be, my Lord, an act of justice from You.

segs.ar: وَإنْ تَعْفُ عَنِّي فَقَدِيماً شَمَلَنِي عَفْوُكَ،
segs.tr: wa in taa'-fu a'n-nee faqadeemana shamalanee a'f-wuk
segs.en: 22.But if You pardonest me, anciently has Your pardon enfolded me
23.and Your well-being garmented me!
24.So I ask You, O God, by Your names stored in Your treasury
25.and Your splendour masked by the veils!
26.If You hast no mercy upon this anxious soul
27.and these uneasy, decaying bones -
28.he cannot endure the heat of Your sun,
29.so how can he endure the heat of Your Fire?
30.He cannot endure the sound of Your thunder,
31.so how can he endure the sound of Your wrath?

segs.ar: فَارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَخَطَرِي يَسِيرٌ،
segs.tr: far-h'am-neel-laahum fa in-nee am-roo-un h'aqeer wa khat'aree yaseer
segs.en: 32.So have mercy upon me, O God, for I am a vile man and my worth is little.

segs.ar: وَلَيْسَ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّة،
segs.tr: wa lay-sa a'd'aabee mim-maa yazeedu fee mul-kika mith-qaala d'ar-rah
segs.en: 33.Chastising me will not add the weight of a dust mote to Your kingdom.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ
segs.tr: wa law an-na a'd'aabee mim-maa yazeedu fee mul-kik
segs.en: 34.Were chastising me something that would add to Your kingdom,
35.I would ask You for patience to bear it
36.and would love for it to belong to You;
37.but Your authority, my God, is mightier,

segs.ar: وَمُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيـدَ فِيْهِ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ،
segs.tr: wa mul-kuka ad-wam min an tazeeda feehee t'aaa'tul-mut'eee'en
segs.en: 38.and Your kingdom more lasting, than that the obedience of the obeyers should increase it
39.or the disobedience of the sinners diminish it!
40.So have mercy upon me, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: وَتَجاوَزْ عَنِّي يا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
segs.tr: wa tajaawaz a'n-nee yaa d'aal-jalaali wal-ik-raam
segs.en: 41.Show me forbearance, O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segs.ar: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
segs.en: 42.And turn toward me, Surely You art Ever-turning, All-compassionate!

segs.ar: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
segs.en: My God, I praise You — and You are worthy of praise —

segs.ar: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
segs.en: for Your excellent work toward me, and the fullness of Your blessings upon me,
and Your plentiful gift with me,
and for what You favored me with of Your mercy,
and for what You perfected upon me of Your bounty.

segs.ar: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
segs.tr: Fa-qadi ṣṭana‘ta ‘indī mā ya‘jizu ‘anuhu shukrī, wa-lawlā iḥsānuka, ilayy
segs.en: You have indeed done for me what my thanks are incapable of reaching, and were it not for Your benevolence toward me,
and the fullness of Your blessings upon me,

segs.ar: مَا بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
segs.tr: mā balaghtu iḥrāza ḥaẓẓī, wa-lā iṣlāḥa nafsī,
segs.en: I would not have attained the securing of my portion, nor the rectifying of my soul,
But You initiated me with benevolence,
and You provided me with sufficiency in all my affairs,
and You turned away from me the burden of tribulation,
and You averted from me the feared decree.

segs.ar: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segs.tr: Ilāhī fa-kam min balā’in jāhidin qad ṣarafta ‘annī,
segs.en: My God, how many an arduous tribulation You have turned away from me,

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segs.tr: wa-kam min ni‘matin sābighatin aqrarta bihā ‘aynī,
segs.en: and how many a full blessing You have delighted my eye with,

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segs.en: and how many a noble favour You have with me.

segs.ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segs.en: You are the One Who answered my prayer when I was in dire need,
and You overlooked my slip when I stumbled,
and You took my due from the enemies for my being wronged.

segs.ar: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segs.tr: Ilāhī mā wajadtuka bakhīlan ḥīna sa’altuk,
segs.en: My God, I have not found You stingy when I asked You,
and not holding back when I desired You,

segs.ar: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segs.tr: bal wajadtuka li-du‘ā’ī sāmi‘an, wa-li-maṭālibī mu‘ṭiyā,
segs.en: Rather, I found You hearing my prayer, and granting my requests,
and I found Your bounty upon me full,

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segs.tr: fī kulli sha’nin min sha’nī, wa-kulli zamānin min zamānī,
segs.en: in every affair of mine, and every time of my time,

segs.ar: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segs.en: so You are praised by me, and Your work is approved by me.

segs.ar: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segs.tr: taḥmaduk nafsī wa-lisānī wa-‘aqlī ḥamdan yablughu l-wafā’a wa-ḥaqīqata sh-shukr,
segs.en: My soul, my tongue, and my intellect praise You with a praise that reaches fulfillment and the reality of thanks,
a praise that is the extent of Your good pleasure with me.

segs.ar: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segs.tr: fa-najjinī min sakhaṭika yā kahfī ḥīna tu‘yīnī l-madhāhib,
segs.en: So deliver me from Your displeasure, O my refuge when the paths weary me,
and O One Who overlooks my slip,

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segs.en: for were it not for Your concealment of my fault, I would have been among the disgraced,
and O One Who strengthens me with help,

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segs.tr: fa-lawlā naṣruk iyyāya la-kuntu mina l-maghlūbīn,
segs.en: for were it not for Your helping me, I would have been among the overcome,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segs.tr: wa-yā man waḍa‘at lahu l-mulūku nīra l-madhallati ‘alā a‘nāqihā,
segs.en: and O You for whom the kings have placed the yoke of humiliation upon their necks,

segs.ar: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segs.tr: fa-hum min saṭawātihī khā’ifūn, wa-yā Ahl at-Taqwā,
segs.en: so they are fearful of His assaults, and O You who are worthy of reverent fear (Taqwā),

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa-yā man lahu l-asmā’u l-ḥusnā as’aluka an ta‘fuwa ‘annī,
segs.en: and O You to whom belong the Beautiful Names (al-Asmā’ al-Ḥusnā), I ask You to pardon me,
and to forgive me, for I am not innocent, so that I may excuse myself,
nor am I possessed of strength, so that I may triumph,

segs.ar: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segs.en: nor is there a way for me to escape, so that I may flee. And I ask You to overlook my slips,

segs.ar: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segs.tr: wa-atanassalu ilayk min dhunūbī l-latī qad awbaqatnī,
segs.en: and I disavow to You my sins that have surely ruined me,
and surrounded me so that they destroyed me.
From them I have fled to You, Lord, repenting—
so accept my repentance; seeking refuge, so grant me refuge; seeking protection—

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segs.tr: fa-lā takhdhulnī sā’ilan, fa-lā taḥrimnī mu‘taṣiman,
segs.en: so do not forsake me; a petitioner, so do not deprive me; holding fast—

segs.ar: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segs.tr: fa-lā tuslimnī dā‘iyan, fa-lā taruddanī khā’iban,
segs.en: so do not abandon me; a caller, so do not turn me back disappointed.
I called upon You, O Lord, as one destitute, humbled,

segs.ar: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segs.tr: mushfiqan, khā’ifan, wajilā, faqīran, muḍṭarran, ilayk
segs.en: anxious, fearful, apprehensive, poor, compelled (to turn) to You—

segs.ar: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: ashkū ilayk yā Ilāhī ḍa‘fa nafsī
segs.en: I complain to You, O my God, of the weakness of my soul
to hasten to what You promised Your friends,
and to shun what You warned Your enemies against,
and the abundance of my worries and the whispering of my soul.
My God, You have not disgraced me because of my hidden sin,
and You have not destroyed me because of my crime; I call You, and You answer me
even though I am slow when You call me.
And I ask You for all that I wish of my needs,

segs.ar: وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segs.en: and wherever I was, I placed my secret with You,

segs.ar: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: fa-lā ad‘ū siwāk, wa-lā arjū ghayrak,
segs.en: so I do not call upon anyone other than You, nor do I hope for anyone other than You.

segs.ar: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: Labbayk, labbayk, tasma‘u man shakā ilayk,
segs.en: At Your service, at Your service! You hear the one who complains to You,
and You meet the one who relies on You,
and You deliver the one who holds fast to You,
and You bring relief to the one who seeks shelter in You.

segs.ar: إلهِي فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segs.tr: Ilāhī fa-lā taḥrimnī khayra l-ākhirati wa-l-ūlā li-qillati shukrī,
segs.en: My God, do not deprive me of the good of the Hereafter and the first life (the world) because of the fewness of my thanks,

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segs.tr: wa-ghfir lī mā ta‘lamu min dhunūbī,
segs.en: and forgive me what You know of my sins.
If You punish, then I am the wrongdoer, the negligent,
the waster, the sinner, the failing, the one lying down (in neglect),
the one heedless of his soul's portion,
and if You forgive, then You are the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segs.ar: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
segs.tr: ilaaheee ah'-maduk wa anta lil-h'am-di ah-lun
segs.en: 1.My God, I praise You, - and You art worthy of praise -

segs.ar: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: a'laa h'us-ni s'aneei'ka ilay wa subooghi naa'-maaa-ika a'lay
segs.en: 2.for Your benefaction toward me, the lavishness of Your favours toward me,
3.and Your plentiful bestowal upon me,
4.and for showing bounty toward me through Your mercy
5.and lavishing Your favour upon me.

segs.ar: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
segs.tr: faqadi as'-t'anaa'-ta i'ndee maa yaa'-jizu a'n-hoo shuk-ree wa law-laaa ih'-saanuka ilay
segs.en: 6.You hast done well toward me and I am incapable of thanking You. Were it not for Your beneficence toward me
7.and the lavishness of Your favours upon me,

segs.ar: مَا بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
segs.tr: maa balagh-tu ih'-raaza h'az'-z'ee wa laaa is'-laah'a naf-see
segs.en: 8.I would not have reached the taking of my share nor would my soul have been set right,
9.but You began with beneficence toward me,
10.provided me sufficiency in all my affairs,
11.turned away from me the toil of affliction,
12.and held back from me the feared decree.

segs.ar: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segs.tr: ilaahee fakam mim-balaaa-in jaahidin qad s'araf-ta a'n-nee
segs.en: 13.My God, how many a toilsome affliction which You hast turned away from me!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segs.tr: wa kam min-nia'-matin saabighatin aq-rar-ta bihaa a'y-nee
segs.en: 14.How many a lavish favour with which You hast gladdened my eye!

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segs.tr: wa kam min s'aneea'tin kareematil-laka i'ndee
segs.en: 15.How many a generous benefaction of Thine which is present with me!

segs.ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segs.en: 16.It is You who responded to my supplication at the time of distress,
17.released me from my slip in stumbling,
18.and took my enemies to task for doing wrong to me.

segs.ar: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segs.tr: ilaahee maa wajat-tuk bakheelana h'eena saal-tuk
segs.en: 19.My God, I did not find You a miser when I asked of You
20.nor a withholder when I desired from You.

segs.ar: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segs.tr: bal wajat-tuka lidua'aa-ee saamia'a wa limat'aalibee mua'-t'eeaa
segs.en: 21.No, 1 found You a hearer of my supplication and a bestower of my requests;
22.I found Your favours toward me

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segs.tr: fee kul-li shaa-nim-min shaa-nee wa kul-li zamaanim-min zamaanee
segs.en: 23.lavish in my every situation and in my every time.

segs.ar: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segs.tr: faanta i'ndee mah'-mood wa s'aneeu'ka laday-ya mab-roor
segs.en: 24.So You art praised by me and Your benefaction honoured.

segs.ar: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segs.tr: tah'-maduka naf-see walisaanee wa a'q-lee h'am-day-yab-lughul-wafaaa-a wa h'aqeeqatash-shuk-r
segs.en: 25.My soul, my tongue, and my intelligence praise You, a praise that reaches fulfilment and the reality of thanksgiving,
26.a praise that attains to Your good pleasure with me -

segs.ar: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segs.tr: fanaj-jinee min sakhat'ik yaa kah-fee h'eena tua'-yeeneel-mad'aahib
segs.en: 27.so deliver me from Your displeasure! O my cave when the ways thwart me!
28.O He who releases me from my stumble!

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segs.en: 29.Were it not for Your covering my shameful defects, I would be one of the disgraced.
30.O my confirmer through help!

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segs.en: 31.Were it not for Your helping me, I would be one of the overcome!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segs.tr: wa yaa maw-waz''aa't lahul-mulwku neeral-mad'al-lati a'laaa aa'-naaqihaa
segs.en: 32.O He before whom kings place the yoke of lowliness around their necks,

segs.ar: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segs.tr: fahum min sat'awaatihee khaaa-ifoon wa yaaa ah-lat-taq-waa
segs.en: 33.fearing His penalties! O worthy of reverent fear!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-lahul-as-maaa-ul-h'us-naa as-aluka an taa'-fuwa a'n-nee
segs.en: 34.O He to whom belong the names most beautiful! I ask You to pardon me

segs.tr: wa tagh-fira lee falas-tu baree-ana faaa'-tad'ir
segs.en: 35.and to forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should offer excuses,
36.nor a possessor of strength that I should gain victory,

segs.ar: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segs.tr: wa laa mafar-ra lee faafir wa as-taqeeluka a'tharaatee
segs.en: 37.nor have I any place of flight that I should flee! I ask You to release me from my stumbles,

segs.ar: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segs.tr: wa atanas'-s'alu ilay-ka min d'unwbeeal-latee qad aw-baqat-nee
segs.en: 38.and before You I disavow my sins, which have laid me waste,
39.encompassed me, and destroyed me!
40.I flee from them to You, my Lord, turning repentantly,
41.so turn toward me, seeking refuge, so grant me refuge, asking sanctuary,

segs.ar: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segs.tr: falaa takh-d'ul-nee saaa-ilana falaa tah'-rim-nee mua'-tas'imana
segs.en: 42.so abandon me not, requesting, so deprive me not, holding fast,

segs.ar: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segs.tr: falaa tus-lim-nee daae'eana falaa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segs.en: 43.so leave me not, supplicating, so send me not back disappointed!
44.I have supplicated You, my Lord, as one miserable, abased,

segs.ar: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segs.tr: mush-fiqana khaaa-ifaa wajilana faqeeraa muz''-t'ar-ran ilay-k
segs.en: 45.apprehensive, fearful, quaking, poor, driven to have recourse to You!

segs.ar: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: ash-kw ilay-ka yaaa ilaahee z''aa'-fa naf-see
segs.en: 46.I complain to You, my God, of my soul - which is too weak
47.to hurry to that which You hast promised Your friends
48.or to avoid that against which You hast cautioned Your enemies -

segs.tr: wa kath-rata humoomee wa was-wasata naf-see
segs.en: 49.and of the multitude of my concerns, and of my soul's confusing thoughts.
50.My God, You hast not disgraced me through my secret thoughts

segs.tr: wa lam tuh-lik-nee bijareeratee ad-u'wka fatujeebunee
segs.en: 51.or destroyed me because of my misdeeds! I call upon You, and You respondest,

segs.tr: wa in kuntu bat'ee-ana h'eena tad-u'wnee
segs.en: 52.even if I am slow when You callest upon me.

segs.tr: wa as-aluka kul-lamaa shi-tu min h'awaaa-ijee
segs.en: 53.I ask You everything I want of my needs,

segs.ar: وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segs.tr: wa h'ay-thu maa kuntu waz''aa'-tu i'ndaka sir-ree
segs.en: 54.and I deposit with You my secret wherever I may be.

segs.ar: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: falaaa ad-u'w siwaak wa laaa ar-joo ghay-rak
segs.en: 55.I supplicate no one besides You, and I hope for no one other than You.

segs.ar: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: lab-bay-ka lab-bay-k tas-mau' man shakaaa ilay-k
segs.en: 56.At Your service! At Your service! You hearest him who complains to You!
57.You receivest him who has confidence in You!
58.You savest him who holds fast to You!
59.You givest relief to him who seeks shelter in You!

segs.ar: إلهِي فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segs.tr: ilaahee falaa tah'-rim-nee khay-ral-akhirati wal-oolaa liqil-lati shuk-ree
segs.en: 60.My God, so deprive me not of the good of the last world and the first because of the paucity of my thanksgiving

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segs.tr: wagh-fir lee maa taa'-lamu min d'unoobee
segs.en: 61.and forgive me the sins of mine which You knowest!
62.If You chastisest, I am the wrongdoer, the neglecter,
63.the negligent, the sinner, the derelict, the sluggard,
64.the heedless of the share of my soul!
65.And if You forgivest - You art the Most Merciful of the merciful!
O God, bless Muḥammad and his family (ālih),

segs.ar: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: O God, from Whom nothing is concealed

segs.ar: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segs.tr: shay’un fī l-arḍi wa-lā fī s-samā’,
