segs.en: in the earth nor in the heaven,

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segs.tr: wa-kayfa yakhfā ‘alayka yā Ilāhī mā Anta khalaqtah?
segs.en: And how can what You created be concealed from You, O my God?

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segs.tr: wa-kayfa lā tuḥṣī mā Anta ṣana‘tah?
segs.en: And how can You not enumerate what You have fashioned?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segs.tr: aw kayfa yaghību ‘anka mā Anta tudabbiruh?
segs.en: Or how can what You administer be absent from You?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segs.tr: aw kayfa yastaṭī‘u an yahruba minka man lā ḥayāta lahū illā bi-rizqik?
segs.en: Or how can he who has no life except through Your provision be able to flee from You?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
segs.tr: aw kayfa yanjū minka man lā madhhaba lahū fī ghayri mulkik?
segs.en: Or how can he escape from You who has no resort other than Your dominion?

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segs.tr: Subḥānak! Akhshā khalqika lak a‘lamuhum bik,
segs.en: Glory be to You! The most fearful of Your creation toward You is the one who knows You best,
and the most submissive of them to You is the one who acts most upon Your obedience,

segs.ar: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: wa-ahwanuhum ‘alayk man anta tarzuquhū wa-huwa ya‘budu ghayrak,
segs.en: and the least significant of them to You is the one whom You provide for while he worships other than You.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segs.tr: Subḥānak! Lā yunqiṣu sulṭānak man ashraka bik, wa-kadhdhabu rusulak,
segs.en: Glory be to You! He who associates partners with You, and denies Your Messengers, does not diminish Your sovereignty,

segs.ar: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segs.tr: wa-laysa yastaṭī‘u man kariha qaḍā’ak an yarudda amrak,
segs.en: and he who dislikes Your decree cannot repel Your command,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-lā yamtanu‘u minka man kadhdhaba bi-qudratik,
segs.en: and he who denies Your power cannot withhold himself from You,
and he who worships other than You will not escape You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segs.tr: wa-lā yu‘ammaru fī d-dunyā man kariha liqā’ak.
segs.en: and he who disliked meeting You will not be given long life in the world.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segs.tr: Subḥānak! Mā a‘ẓama sha’nak, wa-aqhara sulṭānak,
segs.en: Glory be to You! How immense is Your dignity! And how overwhelming is Your sovereignty!
And how severe is Your power! And how penetrating is Your command!

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segs.en: Glory be to You! You decreed death upon all Your creation:
both he who affirms Your oneness and he who disbelieves in You,
and everyone is a taster of death,
and everyone is bound for You, so blessed and exalted are You!

segs.ar: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
segs.tr: Lā ilāha illā Ant, waḥdak lā sharīka lak, āmanutu bik,
segs.en: There is no god but You, alone, without a partner, I believe in You,
and I affirmed Your Messengers and accepted Your Book,
and I disbelieved in every deity other than You,
and I disassociated myself from whoever worshipped anything other than You.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
segs.tr: Allāhumm innī uṣbiḥu wa-umsī mustaqillan li-‘amalī,
segs.en: O God, truly I begin my day and enter my evening regarding my deed as small (or insufficient),
confessing my sin, acknowledging my mistakes,
I am humiliated by my transgression against my soul,
My deed has destroyed me, and my caprice has led me to ruin,
and my desires have deprived me.

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
segs.tr: Fa-as’aluka yā Mawlāya su’āla man nafsūhū lāhiyatun li-ṭūli amalih,
segs.en: So I ask You, O my Master, the asking of one whose soul is heedless due to the length of his hope,
and whose body is neglectful due to the stillness of his veins,
and whose heart is captivated by the abundance of blessings upon him,

segs.ar: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa-fikruhū qalīlun li-mā huwa ṣā’irun ilayh,
segs.en: and whose thought is meager concerning what he is heading toward,

segs.ar: سُؤَالَ مَن قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segs.en: The asking of one over whom hope has surely prevailed,
and caprice has tempted him, and the world has gotten a strong hold over him,

segs.ar: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segs.tr: wa-aẓallahu l-ajal, su’āla mani stakthara dhunūbah,
segs.en: and the term (of death) has overshadowed him, the asking of one who considered his sins many,

segs.ar: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَن لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segs.tr: wa-a‘tarafa bi-khaṭī’atih, su’āla man lā Rabba lahū ghayruk,
segs.en: and acknowledged his mistake, the asking of one who has no Lord other than You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wa-lā waliyya lahū dūnak, wa-lā munqidhā lahū minka,
segs.en: and no protector besides You, and no deliverer from You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segs.tr: wa-lā malja’a lahū minka illā ilayk.
segs.en: and no refuge from You except to You.

segs.ar: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
segs.tr: Ilāhī as’aluka bi-ḥaqqika l-wājibi ‘alā jamī‘i khalqik,
segs.en: My God, I ask You by Your right which is incumbent upon all Your creation,

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-bi-smika l-‘aẓīm illadhī amarta rasūlak an yusabbiḥak bih,
segs.en: and by Your Mighty Name with which You commanded Your Messenger to glorify You,

segs.ar: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
segs.en: and by the Majesty of Your Noble Face which does not waste away,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segs.tr: wa-lā yataghayyar, wa-lā yaḥūlu wa-lā yafnā,
segs.en: and does not change, nor move, nor perish,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.en: that You bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segs.en: and that You make me independent of everything by Your worship,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segs.en: and that You console my soul from the world with my fear of You,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-an tuthniyanī bi-l-kathīr min karāmatik bi-raḥmatik,
segs.en: and that You grant me in return much of Your generosity by Your mercy.

segs.ar: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segs.tr: Fa-ilayk affirr, wa-minka akhāf, wa-bika astaghīth,
segs.en: So to You I flee, and from You I fear, and in You I seek aid,

segs.ar: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
segs.tr: wa-iyyāka arjū, wa-lak ad‘ū, wa-ilayk alja’u,
segs.en: and You I hope for, and to You I call, and to You I seek refuge,

segs.ar: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
segs.tr: wa-bika athiq, wa-iyyāka asta‘īn, wa-bika u’minu,
segs.en: and in You I trust, and Your help I seek, and in You I believe,
and upon You I rely,
and upon Your bounty and Your generosity I depend.

segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad wa ālihi
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segs.ar: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: 1.O God, from whom nothing is concealed

segs.ar: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segs.en: 2.in earth or heaven!

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segs.tr: wa kay-fa yakh-faa a'leeka yaaa ilaahee maaa anta khalaq-tahu?
segs.en: 3.How should what You hast created, my God, be concealed from You?

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segs.tr: wakay-fa laa tuh'-s'ee maaa anta s'anaa'-tahu?
segs.en: 4.How shouldst You not number what You hast made?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segs.tr: aw kay-fa yagheebu a'nka maaa anta tudab-biruhu?
segs.en: 5.How should what You governest be absent from You?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segs.tr: aw kay-fa yas-tat'eeu' ay-yah-ruba minka mal-laa h'ayaata lahooo il-laa biriz-qika?
segs.en: 6.How should one who has no life except through Your provision have the ability to flee from You?

segs.ar: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
segs.tr: aw kay-fa yanjoo minka mal-laa mad'-haba lahoo fee ghay-ri mul-kika?
segs.en: 7.How should one who has no road except in Your kingdom escape from You?

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segs.tr: sub-h'aanak akh-shaa khal-qika laka aa'-lamuhum bik
segs.en: 8.Glory be to You! He among Your creatures who fears You most knows You best,
9.he among them most bent in humility is most active in obeying You,

segs.ar: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segs.tr: wa ah-wanuhum a'lay-ka man anta tar-zuquhoo wa huwa yaa'-budu ghay-rak
segs.en: 10.and he among them whom You providest while he worships another is most contemptible before You!

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segs.tr: sub-h'aanak laa yanqus'u sul-t'aanaka man ash-raka bika wakad'-d'aba rusulak
segs.en: 11.Glory be to You! He who associates others with You and denies Your messengers diminishes not Your authority.

segs.ar: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segs.tr: wa lay-sa yas-tat'eeu' man kariha qaz''aaa-aka ay-yarud-da am-rak
segs.en: 12.He who dislikes Your decree cannot reject Your command.

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa yam-taniu' minka man kad'-d'aba biqud-ratik
segs.en: 13.He who denies Your power keeps himself not away from You.

segs.tr: wa laa yafootuka man a'bada ghay-rak
segs.en: 14.He who worships other than You escapes You not.

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa yua'm-maru fid-dunyaa man kariha liqaaa-ak
segs.en: 15.He who dislikes meeting You will not be given endless life in this world.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segs.tr: sub-h'aanak maaa aa'-z'ama shaa-nak wa sq-hara sul-t'aanak
segs.en: 16.Glory be to You! How mighty is Your station, overpowering Your authority,

segs.tr: wa sshad-da qoo-watak wa anfad'a am-rak
segs.en: 17.intense Your strength, penetrating Your command!

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segs.en: 18.Glory be to You! You hast decreed death for all Your creatures,
19.both him who professes Your Unity and him who disbelieves in You;
20.each one will taste death,

segs.tr: wa kul-lu s'aaa-irun ilay-ka fatabaarak-ta wataa'alay-t
segs.en: 21.each one will come home to You. Blessed art You and high exalted!

segs.ar: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
segs.tr: laaa ilaha il-laaa anta wah'-daka laa shareeka lak aaamantu bik
segs.en: 22.There is no god but Thou, You alone, who hast no associate. I have faith in You,

segs.tr: wa s'ad-daq-tu rusulak wa qabil-tu kitaabak
segs.en: 23.I attest to Your messengers, I accept Your Book,
24.I disbelieve in every object of worship other than You,
25.I am quit of anyone who worships another!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee us'-bihoo wa um-see mus-taqil-lal-lia'malee
segs.en: 26.O God, I rise in the morning and enter the evening making little of my good works,
27.confessing my sins, admitting my offenses;
28.I am abased because of my prodigality against myself.
29.My works have destroyed me, my caprice has ruined me,
30.my passions have deprived me.

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
segs.tr: faas-aluka yaa mawlaaya soo-aala man naf-suhoo laaheeatul-lit'ooli amalih
segs.en: 31.So I ask You, my Master, the asking of him whose soul is diverted by his drawn out expectations,
32.whose body is heedless because of the stillness of his veins,
33.whose heart is entranced by the multitude of favours done for him,

segs.ar: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa fik-ruhoo qaleelul-limaa huwa s'aaa-irun ilay-h
segs.en: 34.whose reflection is little concerning that to which he is coming home;

segs.ar: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segs.en: 35.the asking of him whom false expectation has overcome,
36.caprice has entranced, and this world has mastered,

segs.ar: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segs.tr: wa az'al-lahul-ajal soo-aala man is-tak-thara d'unoobah
segs.en: 37.and over whom death has cast its shadow; the asking of him who makes much of his sins

segs.ar: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segs.tr: wa aa'-tarafa bikhat'ee-atih soo-aala mal-laa rab-ba lahoo ghay-ruk
segs.en: 38.and confesses his offense; the asking of him who has no Lord but Thou,

segs.ar: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa walee-ya lahoo doonak wa laa munqid'a lahoo mink
segs.en: 39.no friend besides You, no one to deliver him from You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segs.tr: wa laa mal-jaa lahoo minka il-laaa ilay-k
segs.en: 40.and no asylum from You except in You.

segs.ar: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
segs.en: 41.My God, I ask You by Your right incumbent upon all Your creatures,

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa bis-mikal-a'z'eemil-lad'eee amar-ta rasoolaka ay-yusab-bih'aka bih
segs.en: 42.by Your mighty name with which You commanded Your messenger to glorify You,

segs.ar: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
segs.en: 43.and by the majesty of Your generous face, which ages not,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segs.tr: wa laa yataghay-yar wa laa yah'oolu wa laa yaf-naa
segs.en: 44.nor changes, nor alters, nor passes away,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.tr: an tus'al-leea a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaali muh'am-mad
segs.en: 45.that You blessest Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa an tugh-neeanee a'n kul-li shay-im-bii'baadatik
segs.en: 46.that You freest me from need for all things through worshipping You,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa an tusal-leea naf-see a'nid-dunyaa bimakhaafatik
segs.en: 47.that You distractest my soul from this world through fear of You,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيْرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa an tuth-neeanee bil-katheeri min karaamatika birah'-matik
segs.en: 48.and that You turnest me back toward Your abundant generosity through Your mercy!

segs.ar: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segs.tr: faalay-ka afir wa minka akhaaf wa bika as-tagheeth
segs.en: 49.To You I flee, You I fear, from You I seek aid,

segs.ar: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
segs.tr: wa ee-yaaka ar-joo wa laka ad-u'w wa ilay-ka al-jaa
segs.en: 50.in You I hope, You I supplicate, in You I seek asylum,

segs.ar: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
segs.tr: wa bika athiq wa ee-yaaka as-tae'en wa bika oo-min
segs.en: 51.in You I trust, from You I ask help, in You I have faith,
52.in You I have placed my confidence,
53.and upon Your munificence and Your generosity I rely.
My Lord, my sins have rendered me speechless, and my speech is cut short,

segs.ar: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segs.tr: fa-lā ḥujjata lī, fa-ana l-asīru bi-baliyyatī,
segs.en: so I have no argument (or plea), for I am the captive of my affliction,
the one held in pledge by my deed, the one faltering in my mistake,
the bewildered one away from my purpose, the one cut off (with no way out),

segs.ar: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segs.tr: Qad awqaftu nafsī mawqifa l-adhillā’i l-mudhnibīn,
segs.en: I have surely made myself stand in the station of the humiliated sinners,

segs.ar: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segs.en: the station of the wretched ones who dared against You, those who took Your promise lightly.
Glory be to You! What daring did I dare against You?
And what deception did I deceive myself with?
My Master, have mercy on my fall (down) upon my noble face,

segs.ar: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segs.en: and the slip of my foot, and return with Your forbearance upon my ignorance,

segs.ar: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segs.en: and with Your benevolence upon my wrongdoing, for I am the one confessing my sin,
the one acknowledging my mistake, and here is my hand and my forelock,
I humble myself to be led by myself (to submit to punishment).
Have mercy on my gray hair, and the running out of my days,
and the nearness of my term (of death), and my weakness,
and my wretchedness, and the fewness of my resourcefulness.

segs.ar: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segs.tr: Mawlāya wa-rḥamnī idhā nqaṭa‘a mina d-dunyā atharī,
segs.en: My Master, and have mercy on me when my trace is cut off from the world,
and my mention is wiped away from the creatures,

segs.ar: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segs.tr: wa-kuntu fī l-mansiyyīn, ka-man qad nusī.
segs.en: and I am among the forgotten, like one who has been forgotten.
My Master, and have mercy on me when my form changes

segs.ar: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segs.tr: wa-ḥālī idhā baliya jismī, wa-tafarraqat a‘ḍā’ī,
segs.en: and my state, when my body wears out, and my limbs disperse,

segs.ar: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segs.tr: wa-taqaṭṭa‘at awṣālī, yā ghaflatī ‘ammā yurādu biya.
segs.en: and my joints are severed. Oh, my heedlessness concerning what is intended for me!
My Master, and have mercy on me at my gathering and resurrection,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segs.tr: wa-j‘al fī dhālika l-yawmi ma‘a awliyā’ika mawqifī,
segs.en: and make my station on that Day with Your friends,
and my proceeding (or return) with Your beloved ones,

segs.ar: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segs.tr: wa-fī jiwārik maskanī yā Rabba l-‘Ālamīn.
segs.en: and my dwelling place in Your vicinity, O Lord of the Worlds.
1.My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

segs.ar: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segs.en: 2.I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction,
3.the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense,
4.the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

segs.ar: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segs.en: 5.I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners,

segs.ar: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segs.en: 6.the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Your promise.
7.Glory be to You! What insolence I have insolently shown toward You!
8.What delusion with which I have deluded myself!
9.My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face

segs.ar: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segs.tr: wa zal-lata qadamee wa u'd bh'il-mika a'laa jah-lee
segs.en: 10.the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Your clemency,

segs.ar: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segs.tr: wa biih'-saanika a'laaa isaaa-atee faanaal-muqir-ru bid'ambee
segs.en: 11.and my evildoing through Your beneficence, for I admit my sin

segs.tr: al-mua'-tarifu bikhat'ee-atee wa hd'ihee yadee wa naas'eeatee
segs.en: 12.and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!
13.I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!
14.Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days,
15.the nearing of my term, my frailty,
16.my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

segs.ar: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segs.tr: maw-laaya war-h'am-neee id'aa anqat'aa' minad-dunyaaa atharee
segs.en: 17.My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world,
18.my mention is effaced among the creatures,

segs.ar: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segs.tr: wa kuntu fil-mansee-yeena kaman qad nusee
segs.en: 19.and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!
20.My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state

segs.ar: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segs.tr: wa h'aalee id'aa baleea jis-mee wa tafar-raqat aa'-z''aaa-ee
segs.en: 21.when my body decays, my limbs are scattered,

segs.ar: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segs.tr: wa taqat'-t'aa't aw-s'aalee yaa ghaf-latee a'm-maa yuraadu bee
segs.en: 22.and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

segs.tr: maw-laaya war-h'amnee fee h'ash-ree wa nash-ree
segs.en: 23.My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising

segs.ar: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segs.tr: waj-a'l fee d'alikal-yawmi maa' aw-leeaaa-ika maw-qifee
segs.en: 24.and on that day, appoint my standing place with Your friends,
25.my place of emergence with Your beloveds,

segs.ar: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segs.tr: wa fee jiwaarika mas-kanee yaa rab-bal-a'alameen
segs.en: 26.and my dwelling in Your neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!

S_54.name: 54. For the Removal of Worries
S_54.nameUr: رنج و غم دور ہونے کی دعا

segs.en: O Reliever of anxiety and Remover of sorrow!
O Most Compassionate of this world and the Hereafter, and the Most Merciful of both!
Bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad,
and relieve my anxiety, and remove my sorrow!

segs.ar: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segs.tr: Yā Wāḥidu, Yā Aḥadu, Yā Ṣamad,
segs.en: O the One, O the Single, O the Eternal Refuge (a-Ṣamad),

segs.tr: Yā man lam yalid wa-lam yūlad,
segs.en: O You Who neither begot nor was begotten,
and there is none comparable to Him (Qur'an 112:3-4),
Protect me and purify me, and take away my affliction!

segs.ar: 1. آية الكرسي (سورة البقرة 2: 255): اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
segs.tr: Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa, al-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm. Lā ta’khudhuhu sinatun wa-lā nawm. Lahū mā fī s-samāwāti wa-mā fī l-arḍ. Man dhā l-ladhī yashfa‘u ‘indahu illā bi-idhnih. Ya‘lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa-mā khalfahum, wa-lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shay’in min ‘ilmihi illā bi-mā shā’. Wasi‘a kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa, wa-lā ya’ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā. Wa-Huwa l-‘Aliyyu l-‘Aẓīm.
segs.en: God – there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī (Throne) extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. (Qur'an 2:255)

segs.ar: 2. سورة الإخلاص (112): قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.
segs.tr: Qul Huwa l-Lāhu Aḥad. Allāhu ṣ-Ṣamad. Lam yalid wa-lam yūlad. Wa-lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad.
segs.en: Say, "He is God, [Who is] One. God, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is begotten, Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Qur'an 112:1-4)

segs.ar: 3. سورة الفلق (113): قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ.
segs.tr: Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa-min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa-min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-‘uqad. Wa-min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
segs.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (Qur'an 113:1-5)

segs.ar: 4. سورة الناس (114): قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ.
segs.tr: Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi n-nās. Maliki n-nās. Ilāhi n-nās. Min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri n-nās. Mina l-jinnati wa-n-nās. Allāhumm innī as’aluka su’āla mani shtaddat fāqatuh,
segs.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers in the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind." (Qur'an 114:1-6) أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ، O God, truly I ask You the asking of one whose destitution has intensified,
and whose strength has weakened, and whose sins have multiplied,

segs.ar: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segs.tr: su’āla man lā yajidu li-fāqatihī mughīthan,
segs.en: the asking of one who finds no helper for his destitution,
and no strengthener for his weakness,
and no forgiver for his sin other than You,
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor!

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segs.en: I ask You for a deed with which You love the one who performs it,

segs.ar: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segs.tr: wa-yaqīnan tanfa‘u bihī mani stayqana bihī
segs.en: and a certainty (conviction) with which You benefit the one who is certain by it,
the truth of certainty (conviction) in the execution of Your command.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.en: O God, bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad,
and take my soul upon truthfulness (sincerity),
and cut off my need from the world,
and place my desire in what is with You,
out of yearning for meeting You,
and grant me the sincerity of reliance upon You.

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segs.tr: As’aluka min khayri kitābin qad khala wa-a‘ūdhu bik
segs.en: I ask You from the good of a Book that has passed (or been decreed) and I seek refuge in You
from the evil of a Book that has passed (or been decreed),
I ask You for the fear of those who worship You,
and the worship of those who are humble before You,
and the certainty of those who rely upon You,
and the reliance of the believers upon You.
O God, make my desire in my petition
like the desire of Your friends in their petitions,
and my dread like the dread of Your friends,
and employ me in Your pleasure,

segs.ar: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segs.tr: ‘amalan lā atruku ma‘ahu shay’an min dīnik
segs.en: with a deed by which I do not abandon anything of Your religion,
out of fear of anyone from Your creation.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segs.tr: Allāhumm hādhihī ḥājatī, fa-a‘ẓim fīhā raghbatī,
segs.en: O God, this is my need, so magnify my desire in it,

segs.ar: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segs.tr: wa-aẓhir fīhā ‘udhrī, wa-laqqinī fīhā ḥujjatī wa-‘āfi fīhā jasadī.
segs.en: and show forth my excuse in it, and put my argument (or plea) into my mouth in it, and grant well-being to my body in it.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm man aṣbaḥa lahū thiqatun aw rajā’un ghayruk,
segs.en: O God, whoever begins his day having a trust or hope other than You,
then I have begun my day with You being my trust,
and my hope in all affairs,
so decree for me the best outcome for them,
and save me from the misguiding trials (or temptations),
by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segs.tr: Wa-ṣallā Allāhu ‘alā Sayyidinā Muḥammad Rasūli llāhi l-Muṣṭafā,
segs.en: And may God bless our Master Muḥammad, the Chosen Messenger of God,
and upon his pure family.
1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!

segs.ar: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segs.tr: yaa waah'idu yaaa ah'adu yaa s'amad
segs.en: 5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!
6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma in-neee as-aluka soo-aala man ishtad-dat faaqatuh
segs.en: 10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,

segs.tr: wa z''au'fat qoo-watuh wa kathurat d'unoobuh
segs.en: 11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

segs.ar: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segs.en: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,
13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segs.tr: as-aluk a'malana tuh'ib-bu bihee man a'mila bih
segs.en: 16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

segs.ar: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segs.tr: wa yaqeenana tanfau' bihee mani as-tay-qana bihee
segs.en: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain
18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segs.en: 19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segs.tr: as-aluka min khay-ri kitaabin qad khalaa wa au'wd'u bika
segs.en: 25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You
26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works

segs.ar: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segs.en: 35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion
36.fearing any of Your creatures!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma hd'ihee h'aajatee faaa'-z'im feehaa ragh-batee
segs.en: 37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

segs.ar: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segs.tr: wa az'-hir feehaa u'd'-ree wa laq-qinee feehaa h'uj-jatee wa a'afi feehaa jasadee
segs.en: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma man as'-bah'a lahoo thiqatun aw rajaaa-un ghay-ruk
segs.en: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.
40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segs.en: 45.And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen,
46.and his Household, the pure!
My God, offenses have clothed me in the garment of my lowliness,
separation from You has wrapped me in the clothing of my misery!
My dreadful crimes have deadened my heart,

segs.ar: فَأَحْيِه بِتَوْبَةٍ مِنْكَ يا أَمَلِي وَبُغْيَتِي،
segs.tr: faah'-yihee bitaw-batim-minka yaaa amalee wa bugh-yatee
segs.en: so bring it to life by a repentance from You! O my hope and my aim!
O my wish and my want!

segs.ar: فَوَعِزَّتِكَ ما أَجِدُ لِذُنُوبِي سِواكَ غافِراً،
segs.tr: fawai'z-zatik maaa ajidu lid'unoobee siwaaka ghafiraa
segs.en: By Your might, I find no one but You to forgive my sins

segs.tr: wa laaa araa likas-ree ghay-raka jaabiraa
segs.en: and I see none but You to mend my brokenness!
I have subjected myself to You in repeated turning,
I have humbled myself to You in abasement.

segs.ar: فَإنْ طَرَدْتَنِي مِنْ بابِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَلُوذُ؟
segs.tr: fa in t'arat-tanee mim-baabika fabiman alood'
segs.en: If You cast me out from Your door, in whom shall I take shelter?

segs.ar: وَإنْ رَدَدْتَنِي عَنْ جَنابِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَعُوذُ؟
segs.tr: wa ir-radat-tanee a'n janaabika fabiman au'wd'
segs.en: If You repell me from Your side, in whom shall I seek refuge?

segs.tr: fawaaa asafaahoo min khaj-latee wa af-tiz''aah'ee
segs.en: O my grief at my ignominy and disgrace!

segs.ar: وَوا لَهْفاهُ مِنْ سُوءِ عَمَلِي وَاجْتِراحِي.
segs.tr: wa waa lah-fahoo min sooo-i a'malee wa aj-tiraah'ee
segs.en: O my sorrow at my evil works and what I have committed!
I ask You, O Forgiver of great sins,
O Mender of broken bones,
to overlook my ruinous misdeeds
and cover my disgraceful secret thoughts!

segs.ar: وَلا تُخْلِنِي فِي مَشْهَدِ الْقِيامَةِ مِنْ بَرْدِ عَفْوِكَ وَغَفْرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa laa tukh-linee fee mash-hadil-qeeaamati mim-bar-di a'f-wika wa ghaf-rik
segs.en: At the witnessing place of the Resurrection, empty me not of the coolness of Your pardon and forgiveness,

segs.ar: وَلا تُعْرِنِي مِنْ جَمِيلِ صَفْحِكَ وَسَتْرِكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa tua'-rinee min jameeli s'af-h'ika wa sat-rik
segs.en: and strip me not of Your beautiful forbearance and covering!

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي ظَلِّلْ عَلَىٰ ذُنُوبِي غَمامَ رَحْمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: ilaahee z'al-lil a'laa d'unoobee ghamaama rah'-matika
segs.en: My God, let the cloud of Your mercy cast its shadow upon my sins

segs.tr: wa ar-sil a'laa u'yoobee sah'aaba raa-fatik
segs.en: and send the billow of Your clemency flowing over my faults!

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي هَلْ يَرْجِعُ الْعَبْدُ الأَبِقُ إلاَّ إلَىٰ مَوْلاهُ
segs.tr: ilaahee hal yar-jiu'l-a'b-dul-aaabiqu il-laaa ilaa maw-laahoo
segs.en: My God, does the fugitive servant return to anyone other than his Master?

segs.ar: أَمْ هَلْ يُجِيرُهُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ أَحَدٌ سِواهُ؟
segs.tr: am hal yujeeruhoo min sakhat'iheee ah'dun siwaah
segs.en: Or does anyone grant him sanctuary from his Master’s wrath other than his Master Himself?

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي إنْ كانَ النَّدَمُ عَلَىٰ الذَّنْب تَوْبَةً،
segs.en: My God, if remorse for sins is a repentance,
I - by Your might - am one of the remorseful!

segs.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ الاسْتِغْفارُ مِنَ الْخَطيئَةِ حِطَّةً،
segs.en: If praying forgiveness for offenses is an alleviation,
I am one of those who pray forgiveness!
To You I return that You may be well pleased!
My God, through Your power over me, turn toward me,
through Your clemency toward me, pardon me,
and through Your knowledge of me, be gentle toward me!

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي أَنْتَ الَّذِي فَتَحْتَ لِعِبادِكَ بَابَاً إلَىٰ عَفْوِكَ سَمَّيْتَهُ التَّوْبَةَ،
segs.tr: ilaaheee antal-lad'ee fatah'-ta lii'baadika baaban ilaa a'f-wika sam-may-tahut-taw-bata:
segs.en: My God, You are He who has opened a door to Your pardon and named it 'repentance',

segs.ar: فَقُلْتَ: ( تُوبُوا إلَىٰ اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحَاً )،
segs.en: for You said, Repent to God with unswerving repentance.

segs.ar: فَما عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ الْبابِ بَعْدَ فَتْحِهِ.
segs.tr: famaa u'd'-ru man agh-fala dukhoolal-baabi baa'-da fat-h'ih
segs.en: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering the door after its opening?

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي إنْ كانَ قَبُحَ الذَّنْبُ مِنْ عَبْدِكَ
segs.tr: ilaaheee in kaana qabuh'ad'-d'ambu min a'b-dika
segs.en: My God, though the sins of Your servant are ugly,
Your pardon is beautiful.

segs.ar: إِلـٰهِي ما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ مَنْ عَصاكَ، فَتُبْتَ عَلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: ilaahee maaa ana biw-wali man- a's'aaka fatub-ta a'lay-h
segs.en: My God, I am not the first to have disobeyed You, and You turned toward him,
or to have sought to attain Your favour, and You were munificent toward him.
O Responder to the distressed!
O Remover of injury!
O Great in goodness!
O Knower of everything secret!
O Beautiful through covering over!
I seek Your munificence and Your generosity to intercede with You,

segs.tr: wa tawas-sal-tu bijanabika wa tarah'-h'umika laday-ka
segs.en: I seek Your side and Your showing mercy to mediate with You,
so grant my supplication,
disappoint not my hope in You,
accept my repentance,
and hide my offense,
through Your kindness and mercy,
O Most Merciful of the merciful
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful
My God, to You I complain of a soul
commanding to evil,
rushing to offenses,
eager to disobey You,
and exposing itself to Your anger.
It takes me on the roads of disasters,
it makes me the easiest of perishing ones before You;
many its pretexts,
drawn out its expectations;
when evil touches it, it is anxious,
when good touches it, grudging;
inclining to sport and diversion,
full of heedlessness and inattention,
it hurries me to misdeeds
and makes me delay repentance.
My God, I complain to You
of an enemy who misguides me
and a devil who leads me astray.
He has filled my breast with tempting thoughts,
and his suggestions have encompassed my heart.
He supports caprice against me,
embellishes for me the love of this world,

segs.tr: wa yahulu bayni wa bayna atta`ati wazzulfa
segs.en: and separates me from obedience and proximity!
My God, to You I complain
of a heart that is hard,
turned this way and that by tempting thoughts,
clothed in rust and the seal,

segs.ar: وَعَيْناً عَنِ ٱلْبُكَاءِ مِنْ خَوْفِكَ جَامِدَةً
segs.en: and of an eye too indifferent to weep in fear of You
and eagerly seeking that which gladdens it!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa biqudratika
segs.en: My God, there is no force and no strength except in Your power,

segs.ar: وَلاَ نَجَاةَ لِي مِنْ مَكَارِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa la najata li min makarihi addunya illa bi`ismatika
segs.en: and no deliverance for me from the detested things of this world save through Your preservation.
So I ask You by Your far-reaching wisdom
and Your penetrating will

segs.ar: أَنْ لاَ تَجْعَلْنِي لِغَيْرِ جُودِكَ مُتَعَرِّضاً
segs.tr: an la taj`alni lighayri judika muta`arridan
segs.en: not to let me expose myself to other than Your munificence
and not to turn me into a target for trials!
Be for me a helper against enemies,
a coverer of shameful things and faults,
a protector against afflictions,
a preserver against acts of disobedience!
By Your clemency and mercy,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي أَتَرَاكَ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيـمَانِ بِكَ تُعَذِّبُنِي
segs.tr: ilahi ataraka ba`da al-imani bika tuaadhdhibuni
segs.en: My God, will You chastise me after my faith in You,
drive me far away after my love for You,

segs.ar: أَمْ مَعَ رَجَائِي لِرَحْمَتِكَ وَصَفْحِكَ تَحْرِمُنِي
segs.tr: am ma`a raja'i lirahmatika wa safhika tahrimuni
segs.en: deprive me while I hope for Your mercy and forgiveness,
forsake me while I seek sanctuary in Your pardon?
Far it be from Your generous face to disappoint me?
Would that I knew—Did my mother bear me for wretchedness?
Did she nurture me for suffering?

segs.tr: falaytaha lam talidni wa lam turabbini
segs.en: Would then that she had not borne me and had not nurtured me!
Would that I had knowledge—
Have You appointed me one of the people of felicity?
Have You singled me out for Your nearness and neighborhood?
Then would my eyes be gladdened,
and in that my soul reach serenity.

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي هَلْ تُسَوِّدُ وُجُوهاً خَرَّتْ سَاجِدَةً لِعَظَمَتِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi hal tusawwidu wujuhan kharrat sajidatan li`azamatika
segs.en: My God, do You blacken faces which fall down in prostration before Your mightiness?

segs.ar: أَوْ تُخْرِسُ أَلْسِنَةً نَطَقَتْ بِٱلثَّنَاءِ عَلَىٰ مَجْدِكَ وَجَلاَلَتِكَ
segs.tr: aw tukhrisu alsinatan nataqat biththana'i `ala majdika wa jalalatika
segs.en: Do You strike dumb tongues which speak in laudation of Your glory and majesty?

segs.ar: أَوْ تَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ ٱنْطَوَتْ عَلَىٰ مَحَبَّتِكَ
segs.en: Do You seal hearts which harbor Your love?

segs.ar: أَوْ تُصِمُّ أَسْمَاعاً تَلَذَّذَتْ بِسَمَاعِ ذِكْرِكَ فِي إِرَادَتِكَ
segs.tr: aw tusimmu asma`an taladhdhadhat bisama`i dhikrika fi iradatika
segs.en: Do You deafen ears which take pleasure in hearing Your remembrance according to Your will?

segs.ar: أَوْ تَغُلُّ أَكُفّاً رَفَعَتْهَا الآمَالُ إِلَيْكَ رَجَاءَ رَأْفَتِكَ
segs.tr: aw taghullu akuffan rafa`at-ha al-amalu ilayka raja'a ra'fatika
segs.en: Do You manacle hands which expectations have raised to You in hope of Your clemency?

segs.ar: أَوْ تُعَاقِبُ أَبْدَاناً عَمِلَتْ بِطَاعَتِكَ حَتَّىٰ نَحِلَتْ فِي مُجَاهَدَتِكَ
segs.tr: aw tu`aqibu abdanan `amilat bita`atika hatta nahilat fi mujahadatika
segs.en: Do You punish bodies which worked to obey You until they grew thin in struggling for You?

segs.ar: أَوْ تُعَذِّبُ أَرْجُلاً سَعَتْ فِي عِبَادَتِكَ
segs.en: Do You chastise legs which ran to worship You?

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي لاَ تُغْلِقْ عَلَىٰ مُوَحِّدِيكَ أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi la tughliq `ala muwahhidika abwaba rahmatika
segs.en: My God, lock not toward those who profess Your Unity the doors of Your mercy,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تحْجُبْ مُشْتَاقِيكَ عَنِ ٱلنَّظَرِ إِلَىٰ جَمِيلِ رُؤْيَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa la tahjub mushtaqika `an annazari ila jamili ru'yatika
segs.en: and veil not those who yearn for You from looking upon the vision of Your beauty!
My God, a soul which You have exalted by its professing Your Unity—
how will You humiliate him by leaving him?
My God, a heart which has been knotted by its love for Your—
how will You burn it in the heat of Your fires?
My God, give me sanctuary from Your painful wrath
and Your mighty anger!
O All-loving, O All-kind!
O Compassionate, O Merciful!
O Compeller, O Subduer!
O All-forgiver, O All-covering!
Deliver me through Your mercy from the chastisement of the Fire
and the disgrace of shame
when the good are set apart from the evil,
forms are transformed,
terrors terrify,
the good-doers are brought near,
the evildoers taken far,

segs.tr: wa wuffiyat kullu nafsin ma kasabat
segs.en: “and every soul paid what it has earned,
and they shall not be wronged!”
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ إِذا سَأَلَهُ عَبْدٌ أَعْطَاهُ
segs.en: O He who gives to a servant who asks from Him,

segs.ar: وَإِذَا أَمَّلَ مَا عِنْدَهُ بَلَّغَهُ مُنَاهُ
segs.tr: wa idha ammala ma `indahu ballaghahu munahu
segs.en: takes him to his wish when he expectantly hopes for what is with Him,

segs.tr: wa idha aqbala `alayhi qarrabahu wa adnahu
segs.en: brings him near and close when he approaches Him,

segs.ar: وَإِذا جَاهَرَهُ بِٱلْعِصْيَانِ سَتَرَ عَلَىٰ ذَنْبِهِ وَغَطَّاهُ
segs.tr: wa idha jaharahu bil`isyani satara `ala dhanbihi wa ghattahu
segs.en: covers over his sin and cloaks it when he shows it openly,

segs.tr: wa idha tawakkala `alayhi ahsabahu wa kafahu
segs.en: and satisfies and suffices him when he has confidence in Him!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي مَنِ ٱلَّذِي نَزَلَ بِكَ مُلْتَمِساً قِرَاكَ فَمَا قَرَيْتَهُ
segs.tr: ilahi man alladhi nazala bika multamisan qiraka fama qaraytahu
segs.en: My God, who is the one who has come before You seeking hospitality, and whom You have not received hospitably?

segs.ar: وَمَنِ ٱلَّذِي أَناخَ بِبَابِكَ مُرْتَجِياً نَدَاكَ فمَا أَوْلَيْتَهُ
segs.tr: wa man alladhi anakha bibabika murtajiyan nadaka fama awlaytahu
segs.en: Who is the one who has dismounted at Your door hoping for magnanimity, and to whom You have not shown it?

segs.ar: أَيَحْسُنُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَ عَنْ بَابِكَ بِٱلْخَيْبَةِ مَصْرُوفاً
segs.tr: ayahsunu an arji`a `an babika bilkhaybati masrufan
segs.en: Is it good that I come back from Your door, turned away in disappointment,

segs.ar: وَلَسْتُ أَعْرِفُ سِوَاكَ مَوْلًىٰ بِٱلإِحْسَانِ مَوْصُوفاً
segs.tr: wa lastu a`rifu siwaka mawlan bil-ihsani mawsufan
segs.en: while I know of no patron qualified by beneficence but You?

segs.ar: كَيفَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ وَٱلْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدِكَ
segs.tr: kayfa arju ghayraka walkhayru kulluhu biyadika
segs.en: How should I have hope in other than You, when the good—all of it—is in Your hand?

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ أُؤَمِّلُ سِوَاكَ وَٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلأَمْرُ لَكَ
segs.tr: wa kayfa u'ammilu siwaka walkhalqu wal-amru laka
segs.en: How should I expect from others, when Yours are the creation and the command?
Should I cut off my hope for You,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ أَوْلَيْتَنِي مَا لَمْ أَسْأَلْهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: wa qad awlaytani ma lam as'alhu min fadlika
segs.en: when You have shown me of Your bounty that for which I have not asked?
Would You make me have need for my like?
But I hold fast to Your cord!
O He through whose mercy the strivers reach felicity
and through whose vengeance the seekers of forgiveness are not made wretched!

segs.tr: kayfa ansaka wa lam tazal dhakiri
segs.en: How should I forget You, while You never cease remembering me?

segs.tr: wa kayfa alhu `anka wa anta muraqibi
segs.en: How should I be diverted from You while You are my constant watcher?
My God, I have fastened my hand to the skirt of Your generosity,
I have stretched forth my expectation toward reaching Your gifts,
So, render me pure through the purest profession of Your Unity,
and appoint me one of Your choice servants!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ كُلُّ هَارِبٍ إِلَيْهِ يَلْتَجِئُ
segs.tr: ya man kullu haribin ilayhi yaltaji'u
segs.en: O He who is the asylum of every fleer,
the hope of every seeker!
O Best Object of hope!
O Most Generous Object of supplication!

segs.tr: wa ya man la yuraddu sa'iluhu
segs.en: O He who asker is never rejected
And whose expectant is never disappointed!
O He whose door is open to His suppliants
and whose veil is lifted for those who hope in Him!
I ask You by Your generosity to show kindness toward me

segs.ar: مِنْ عَطَائِكَ بِما تَقَرُّ بِهِ عَيْنِي
segs.en: through Your gifts, with that which will gladden my eye,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ رَجَائِكَ بِما تَطْمَئِنُّ بِهِ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: wa min raja'ika bima tatma'innu bihi nafsi
segs.en: through hope in You, with that which will give serenity to my soul,

segs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ بِما تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ مُصِيبَاتِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
segs.tr: wa min alyaqini bima tuhawwinu bihi `alayya musibati addunya
segs.en: and through certainty with that which will make easy for me the afflictions of this world

segs.ar: وَتَجْلُو بِهِ عَن بَصِيرَتِي غَشَوَاتِ ٱلْعَمَىٰ
segs.tr: wa tajlu bihi `an basirati ghashawati al`ama
segs.en: and lift from my insight the veils of blindness!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي إِنْ كَانَ قَلَّ زَادِي فِي ٱلْمَسِيرِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: ilahi in kana qalla zadi filmasiri ilayka
segs.en: My God, though my stores for traveling to You are few,
my confidence in You has given me a good opinion.

segs.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ جُرْمِي قَدْ أَخَافَنِي مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa in kana jurmi qad akhafani min `uqubatika
segs.en: Though my sin has made me fear Your punishment,

segs.ar: فَإِنَّ رَجَائِي قَدْ أَشْعَرَنِي بِٱلأَمْنِ مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ
segs.tr: fa inna raja'i qad ash`arani bil-amni min naqimatika
segs.en: my hope has let me feel secure from Your vengeance.

segs.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ ذَنْبِي قَدْ عَرَّضَنِي لِعِقَابِكَ
segs.tr: wa in kana dhanbi qad `arradani li`iqabika
segs.en: Though my misdeed has exposed me to Your penalty,
my excellent trust has apprised me of Your reward.

segs.ar: وَإِنْ أَنامَتْنِي ٱلْغَفْلَةُ عَنِ ٱلاِسْتِعْدَادِ لِلِقَائِكَ
segs.tr: wa in anamatni alghaflatu `an alisti`dadi liliqa'ika
segs.en: Though heedlessness has put to sleep my readiness to meet You,

segs.tr: faqad nabbahatni alma`rifatu bikaramika wa ala'ika
segs.en: knowledge has awakened me to Your generosity and boons.

segs.ar: وَإِنْ أَوْحَشَ مَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ فَرْطُ ٱلْعِصْيَانِ وَٱلطُّغْيَانِ
segs.tr: wa in awhasha ma bayni wa baynaka fartu al`isyani wattughyani
segs.en: Though excessive disobedience and rebellion have estranged me from You,
the glad tidings of forgiveness and good pleasure have made me feel intimate with You.

segs.tr: as'aluka bisubuhati wajhika wa bi-anwari qudsika
segs.en: I ask You by the splendors of Your face and the lights of Your holiness,
and I implore You by the tenderness of Your mercy
and the gentleness of Your goodness,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُحَقِّقَ ظَنِّي بِمَا أُؤَمِّلُهُ مِنْ جَزِيلِ إِكْرَامِكَ
segs.tr: an tuhaqqiqa zanni bima u'ammiluhu min jazili ikramika
segs.en: to verify my opinion in expecting Your great generosity
and Your beautiful favor, through nearness to You,
proximity with You,
and enjoyment of gazing upon You!

segs.ar: وَهَا أَنا مُتَعَرِّضٌ لِنَفَحَاتِ رَوْحِكَ وَعَطْفِكَ
segs.tr: wa ha ana muta`arridun linafahati rawhika wa `atfika
segs.en: Here am I, addressing myself to the breezes of Your freshness and tenderness,

segs.tr: wa muntaji`un ghaytha judika wa lutfika
segs.en: having recourse to the rain of Your generosity and gentleness,
fleeing from Your displeasure to Your good pleasure
and from You to You,
hoping for the best of what is with You,
relying upon Your gifts,
utterly poor toward Your guarding!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي مَا بَدَأْتَ بِهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ فَتَمِّمْهُ
segs.tr: ilahi ma bada'ta bihi min fadlika fatammimhu
segs.en: My God, Your bounty which You have begun; complete it!

segs.ar: وَمَا وَهَبْتَ لِي مِنْ كَرَمِكَ فَلاَ تَسْلُبْهُ
segs.tr: wa ma wahabta li min karamika fala taslubhu
segs.en: Your generosity which You have given me; strip it not away!

segs.ar: وَمَا سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَيَّ بِحِلْمِكَ فَلاَ تَهْتِكْهُ
segs.tr: wa ma satartahu `alayya bihilmika fala tahtik-hu
segs.en: Your cover over me through Your clemency; tear it not away!

segs.ar: وَمَا عَلِمْتَهُ مِنْ قَبِيحِ فِعْلِي فَٱغْفِرْهُ
segs.tr: wa ma `alimtahu min qabihi fi`li faghfirhu
segs.en: My ugly acts which You have come to know; forgive them!
My God, I seek intercession from You with You,
and I seek sanctuary in You from You!
I have come to You craving Your beneficence,
desiring Your kindness,
seeking water from the deluge of Your graciousness,
begging rain from the clouds of Your bounty,
requesting Your good pleasure,
going straight to Your side,
arriving at the watering-place of Your support,
seeking exalted good things from Your quarter,
reaching for the presence of Your beauty,
wanting Your face,
knocking at Your door,
abasing myself before Your mightiness and majesty!

segs.ar: فَافْعَلْ بِي ما أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ،
segs.tr: faf-a'l bee maaa anta ah-luhoo minal-magh-firati war-rah'-mati
segs.en: So act toward me with the forgiveness and mercy of which You are worthy!

segs.ar: وَلا تَفْعَلْ بِي ما أَنَا أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْعَذابِ وَالنّـِقْمَةِ
segs.tr: wa laa taf-a'l bee maaa ana ah-luhoo minal-a'd'aabi wan-niq-mati
segs.en: Act not toward me with the chastisement and vengeance of which I am worthy!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي أَذْهَلَنِي عَنْ إِقَامَةِ شُكْرِكَ تَتَابُعُ طَوْلِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi adhhalani `an iqamati shukrika tatabu`u tawlika
segs.en: My God, the uninterrupted flow of Your graciousness hast distracted me from thanking You!

segs.ar: وَأَعْجَزَنِي عَنْ إِحْصَاءِ ثَنَائِكَ فَيْضُ فَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: wa a`jazani `an ihsa'i thana'ika faydu fadlika
segs.en: The flood of Your bounty has rendered me incapable of counting Your praises!

segs.ar: وَشَغَلَنِي عَنْ ذِكْرِ مَحَامِدِكَ تَرَادُفُ عَوَائِدِكَ
segs.en: The succession of Your kind acts has diverted me from mentioning You in laudation!

segs.ar: وَأَعْيَانِي عَنْ نَشْرِ عَوَارِفِكَ تَوَالِي أَيَادِيكَ
segs.en: The continuous rush of Your benefits has thwarted me from spreading the news of Your gentle favors!

segs.ar: وَهٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ ٱعْتَرَفَ بِسُبُوغِ النَّعْمَاءِ
segs.tr: wa hadha maqamu man i`tarafa bisubughi anna`ma'i
segs.en: This is the station of him who confesses to the lavishness of favors,
meets them with shortcomings,
and witnesses to his own disregard and negligence.
You are the Clement, the Compassionate,
the Good, the Generous,
who does not disappoint those who aim for Him,
nor cast out from His courtyard those who expect from Him!
In Your yard are put down the saddlebags of the hopeful
and in Your plain stand the hopes of the help-seekers!
So, meet not our hopes by disappointing and disheartening

segs.tr: wa la tulbisna sirbala alqunuti wal-iblasi
segs.en: and clothe us not in the shirt of despair and despondency!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي تَصَاغَرَ عِنْدَ تَعَاظُمِ آلائِكَ شُكْرِي
segs.en: My God, my thanksgiving is small before Your great boons,

segs.ar: وَتَضَاءَلَ فِي جَنْبِ إِكْرَامِكَ إِيَّايَ ثَنَائِي وَنَشْرِي
segs.tr: wa tada'ala fi janbi ikramika iyyaya thana'i wa nashri
segs.en: and my praise and news-spreading shrink beside Your generosity toward me!

segs.ar: جَلَّلَتْنِي نِعَمُكَ مِنْ أَنْوَارِ الإِيـمَانِ حُلَلاً
segs.tr: jallalatni ni`amuka min anwari al-imani hulalan
segs.en: Your favors have wrapped me in the robes of the lights of faith,

segs.ar: وَضَرَبَتْ عَلَيَّ لَطَائِفُ بِرِّكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِزِّ كِلَلاً
segs.tr: wa darabat `alayya lata'ifu birrika min al`izzi kilalan
segs.en: and the gentleness of Your goodness have let down over me delicate curtains of might!

segs.tr: wa qalladatni minanuka qala'ida la tuhallu
segs.en: Your kindnesses have collared me with collars not to be moved
and adorned me with neck-rings not to be broken!
Your boons are abundant;
my tongue is too weak to count them!
Your favors are many;
my understanding falls short of grasping them,
not to speak of exhausting them!
So, how can I achieve thanksgiving?

segs.tr: wa shukri iyyaka yaftaqiru ila shukrin
segs.en: For my thanking You requires thanksgiving.
Whenever I say, ‘To You belongs praise!’

segs.ar: وَجَبَ عَلَيَّ لِذٰلِكَ أَنْ أَقولَ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ
segs.tr: wajaba `alayya lidhalika an aqula laka alhamdu
segs.en: it becomes thereby incumbent upon me to say, ‘To You belongs praise!’
My God, as You have fed us through Your gentleness
and nurtured us through Your benefaction,
so also complete for us lavish favors,
repel from us detested acts of vengeance,
and of the shares of the two abodes,
give us their most elevated and their greatest, both the immediate and the deferred!
To You belongs praise for Your good trial
and the lavishness of Your favours,
a praise conforming to Your good pleasure
and attracting Your great goodness and magnanimity.
O All-mighty, O All-generous!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful
O Allah, inspire us to obey You,
turn us aside from disobeying You,

segs.tr: wa yassir lana bulugha ma natamanna
segs.en: make it easy for us to reach that which we wish
from the seeking of Your good pleasure,
set us down in the midst of Your Gardens,
dispel from our insights the clouds of misgiving,

segs.ar: وَٱكْشِفْ عَنْ قُلُوبِنَا أَغْشِيَةَ ٱلْمِرْيَةِ وَٱلْحِجَابِ
segs.en: uncover from our hearts the wrappings of doubt and the veil,
make falsehood vanish from our innermost minds,
and fix the truth in our secret thoughts,

segs.tr: fa inna ashshukuka wazzununa lawaqihu alfitani
segs.en: for doubts and opinions fertilize temptations
and muddle the purity of gifts and kindnesses!
O Allah, carry us in the ships of Your deliverance,
give us to enjoy the pleasure of whispered prayer to You,
make us drink at the pools of Your love,

segs.tr: wa adhiqna halawata wuddika wa qurbika
segs.en: let us taste the sweetness of Your affection and nearness,
allow us to struggle in You,
preoccupy us with obeying You,
and purify our intentions in devoting works to You,
for we exist through You and belong to You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ وَسيلَةَ لَنَا إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segs.tr: wa la wasilata lana ilayka illa anta
segs.en: and we have no one to mediate with You but You!
My God, place me among the chosen, the good,
join me to the righteous, the pious,
the first to reach generous gifts,
the swift to come upon good things,
the workers of the enduring acts of righteousness,
the strivers after elevated degrees!
You are powerful over everything
and disposed to respond!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful
Glory be to You!

segs.ar: مَا أَضْيَقَ ٱلطُّرُقَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ دَلِيلَهُ
segs.tr: ma adyaqa atturuqa `ala man lam takun dalilahu
segs.en: How narrow are the paths for him whom You have not guided!

segs.ar: وَمَا أَوْضَحَ ٱلْحَقَّ عِنْدَ مَنْ هَدَيْتَهُ سَبِيلَهُ
segs.tr: wa ma awdaha alhaqqa `inda man hadaytahu sabilahu
segs.en: How plain the truth for him whom You have guided on his way!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي فَٱسْلُكْ بِنَا سُبُلَ ٱلْوُصُولِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: ilahi fasluk bina subula alwusuli ilayka
segs.en: My God, so make us travel on the roads that arrive at You

segs.ar: وَسَيِّرْنَا فِي أَقْرَبِ ٱلطُّرُقِ لِلْوُفُودِ عَلَيْكَ
segs.tr: wa sayyirna fi aqrabi atturuqi lilwufudi `alayka
segs.en: and set us into motion on the paths nearest to reaching You!
Make near for us the far,
and make easy for us the hard and difficult!

segs.ar: وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِعِبَادِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ بِٱلْبِدَارِ إِلَيْكَ يُسَارِعُونَ
segs.tr: wa alhiqna bi`ibadika alladhina hum bilbidari ilayka yusari`una
segs.en: Join us to Your servants, those who hurry to You swiftly,
knock constantly at Your door,
and worship You by night and by day,
while they remain apprehensive in awe of You!
You have purified their drinking places,
taken them to the objects of their desire,
granted their requests,

segs.tr: wa qadayta lahum min fadlika alma'ariba
segs.en: accomplished their wishes through Your bounty,

segs.tr: wa mala'ta lahum dama'irahum min hubbika
segs.en: filled their minds with Your love,
and quenched their thirst with Your pure drink.
Through You have they reached the pleasure of whispered prayer to You,
and in You have they achieved their furthest goals.

segs.ar: فَيَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمُقْبِلِينَ عَلَيْهِ مُقْبِلٌ
segs.en: O He who comes toward those who come toward Him
and grants gifts and bestows bounty upon them through tenderness!
He is compassionate and clement toward those heedless of His remembrance
and loving and tender in drawing them to His door!

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ أَوْفَرِهِمْ مِنْكَ حَظّاً
segs.tr: as'aluka an taj`alani min awfarihim minka hazzan
segs.en: I ask You to place me among those of them who have the fullest share from You,
the highest station with You,
the most plentiful portion of Your love,
and the most excellent allotment of Your knowledge,
for my aspiration has been cut off from everything but You
and my desire has turned toward You alone.
You are my object, none other;

segs.tr: wa laka la lisiwaka sahari wa suhadi
segs.en: to You alone belongs my waking and my sleeplessness.
Meeting You is the gladness of my eye,
and joining You is the wish of my soul.
Toward You is my yearning,
in love for You my passionate longing,
in inclining toward You my fervent craving.
Your good pleasure is the aim I seek,
vision of You my need,
Your neighborhood my request,
and nearness to You is the utmost object of my asking.

segs.tr: wa fi munajatika rawhi wa rahati
segs.en: In whispered prayer to You, I find my repose and my ease.
With You lies the remedy of my illness,
the cure for my burning thirst,
the coolness of my ardor,
the removal of my distress.
Be my intimate in my loneliness,
the releaser of my stumble,
the forgiver of my slip,
the accepter of my repentance,
the responder to my supplication,
the patron of preserving me from sin,
the one who frees me from my neediness
Cut me not off from You
and keep me not far from You
O my bliss and my garden
O my world and my hereafter
O Most Merciful of the merciful
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي مَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي ذَاقَ حَلاوَةَ مَحَبَّتِكَ فَرَامَ مِنْكَ بَدَلاً
segs.tr: ilahi man dhalladhi dhaqa halawata mahabbatika farama minka badalan
segs.en: My God, who can have tasted the sweetness of Your love, then wanted another in place of You?

segs.ar: وَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي أَنِسَ بِقُرْبِكَ فَٱبْتَغَىٰ عَنْكَ حِوَلاً
segs.tr: wa man dhalladhi anisa biqurbika fabtagha `anka hiwalan
segs.en: Who can have become intimate with Your nearness, then sought removal from You?

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي فَٱجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنِ ٱصْطَفَيْتَهُ لِقُرْبِكَ وَوِلايَتِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi faj`alna mimman istafaytahu liqurbika wa wilayatika
segs.en: My God, place us with him whom You have chosen for Your nearness and Your friendship,
purified through Your affection and Your love,
given yearning for the meeting with You,
made pleased with Your decree,
granted gazing upon thy face,
shown the favor of Your good pleasure,

segs.tr: wa a`adhtahu min hajrika wa qilaka
segs.en: given refuge from separation from You and Your loathing,

segs.tr: wa bawwa'tahu maq`ada assidqi fi jiwarika
segs.en: settled in a sure sitting place in Your neighborhood,
singled out for true knowledge of You,
made worthy for worship of You,
whose heart You have captivated with Your will,
whom You have picked for contemplating You,
whose look You have made empty for You,
whose breast You have freed for Your love,
whom You have made desirous of what is with You,
inspired with Your remembrance,
allotted thanksgiving to You,
occupied with obeying You,
turned into one of Your righteous creatures,
chosen for whispered prayer to You,

segs.ar: وَقَطَعْتَ عَنْهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ يَقْطَعُهُ عَنْكَ
segs.en: and from whom You have cut off all things which cut him off from You!

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ دَأْبُهُمُ ٱلاِرْتِيَاحُ إِلَيْكَ وَٱلْحَنِينُ
segs.tr: allahumma ij`alna mimman da'buhum alirtiyahu ilayka walhaninu
segs.en: O Allah, place us among those whose habit is rejoicing in You and yearning for You,
whose time is spent in sighing and moaning!
Their foreheads are bowed down before Your mightiness,
their eyes wakeful in Your service,
their tears flowing in dread of You,
their hearts fixed upon Your love,
their cores shaken with awe of You.

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ أَنْوَارُ قُدْسِهِ لأَبْصَارِ مُحِبِّيهِ رَائِقَةٌ
segs.tr: ya man anwaru qudsihi li-absari muhibbihi ra'iqatun
segs.en: O He the lights of whose holiness induce wonder in the eyes of His lovers,
the glories of whose face arouse the longing of the hearts of His knowers!
O Furthest Wish of the hearts of the yearners!
O Utmost Limit of the hopes of the lovers!

segs.tr: as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka
segs.en: I ask from You love for You, love for those who love You,

segs.ar: وَحُبَّ كُلِّ عَمَلٍ يُوصِلُنِي إِلىٰ قُرْبِكَ
segs.tr: wa hubba kulli `amalin yusiluni ila qurbika
segs.en: love for every work which will join me to Your nearness,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا سِوَاكَ
segs.tr: wa an taj`alaka ahabba ilayya mimma siwaka
segs.en: and that You make Yourself more beloved to me than anything other than You

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ حُبِّي إِيَّاكَ قَائِداً إِلَىٰ رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.tr: wa an taj`ala hubbi iyyaka qa'idan ila ridwanika
segs.en: and make my love for You lead to Your good pleasure,
and my yearning for You protect against disobeying You!
Oblige me by allowing me to gaze upon You,
gaze upon me with the eye of affection and tenderness,
turn not Your face away from me,

segs.ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلإِسْعَادِ وَٱلْحُظْوَةِ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: and make me one of the people of happiness with You and favored position!
O Responder, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي لَيْسَ لِي وَسِيلَةٌ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ عَوَاطِفُ رَأْفَتِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi laysa li wasilatun ilayka illa `awatifu ra'fatika
segs.en: My God, I have no mediation with You but the tender acts of Your clemency,

segs.ar: وَلاَ لِي ذَرِيعَةٌ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ عَوَارِفُ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa la li dhari`atun ilayka illa `awarifu rahmatika
segs.en: nor any way to come to You but the gentle favors of Your mercy
and the intercession of Your Prophet, the prophet of mercy,
who rescued the community from confusion.

segs.ar: فَٱجْعَلْهُمَا لِي سَبَباً إِلَىٰ نَيْلِ غُفْرَانِكَ
segs.tr: faj`alhuma li sababan ila nayli ghufranika
segs.en: Make these two my tie to attaining Your forgiveness

segs.ar: وَصَيِّرْهُمَا لِي وُصْلَةً إِلَىٰ ٱلْفَوْزِ بِرِضْوَانِكَ
segs.tr: wa sayyirhuma li wuslatan ila alfawzi biridwanika
segs.en: and let them take me to triumph through Your good pleasure!

segs.tr: wa qad halla raja'i biharami karamika
segs.en: My hope has dismounted in the sacred precinct of Your generosity,
my craving has alighted in the courtyard of Your munificence.
So, actualize my expectation from You,
seal my works with good,

segs.ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِنْ صَفْوَتِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْلَلْتَهُمْ بُحْبُوحَةَ جَنَّتِكَ
segs.tr: waj`alni min safwatika alladhina ahlaltahum buhbuhata jannatika
segs.en: and place me among Your selected friends, those whom You have set down in the midst of Your Garden,
and settled in the abode of Your honor,

segs.ar: وَأَقْرَرْتَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ بِٱلنَّظَرِ إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ لِقَائِكَ
segs.tr: wa aqrarta a`yunahum binnazari ilayka yawma liqa'ika
segs.en: whose eyes You have gladdened by gazing upon You on the day of meeting You,

segs.tr: wa awrathtahum manazila assidqi fi jiwarika
segs.en: and whom You have made heirs to the sure stations in Your neighborhood!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَفِدُ ٱلْوَافِدُونَ عَلَىٰ أَكْرَمَ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: ya man la yafidu alwafiduna `ala akrama minhu
segs.en: O He none more generous than whom is reached by the reachers

segs.tr: wa la yajidu alqasiduna arhama minhu
segs.en: and none more merciful than whom is found by the aimers!

segs.ar: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ خَلا بِهِ وَحِيدٌ
segs.tr: ya khayra man khala bihi wahidun
segs.en: O Best of those with whom the lonely are alone!

segs.ar: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ طَرِيدٌ
segs.tr: wa ya a`tafa man awa ilayhi taridun
segs.en: O most Tender of those with whom outcasts seek haven!
Toward the expanse of Your pardon have I extended my hand,
upon the skirt of Your generosity have I fastened my grasp!
Show me no deprivation
and afflict me not with disappointment and loss!
O Hearer of supplications!
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي كَسْرِي لاَ يَجْبُرُهُ إِلاَّ لُطْفُكَ وَحَنَانُكَ
segs.tr: ilahi kasri la yajburuhu illa lutfuka wa hananuka
segs.en: My God, nothing will mend my fracture but Your gentleness and loving care,

segs.ar: وَفَقْرِي لاَ يُغْنِيهِ إِلاَّ عَطْفُكَ وَإِحْسَانُكَ
segs.tr: wa faqri la yughnihi illa `atfuka wa ihsanuka
segs.en: free me of my poverty but Your affection and beneficence,

segs.tr: wa raw`ati la yusakkinuha illa amanuka
segs.en: still my fright but Your security,

segs.tr: wa dhillati la yu`izzuha illa sultanuka
segs.en: exalt my abasement but Your sovereignty,

segs.tr: wa umniyati la yuballighuniha illa fadluka
segs.en: take me to my hope but Your bounty,

segs.tr: wa khallati la yasudduha illa tawluka
segs.en: remedy my lack but Your graciousness,
accomplish my need other than You,

segs.tr: wa karbi la yufarrijuhu siwa rahmatika
segs.en: relieve my distress other than Your mercy,

segs.tr: wa durri la yakshifuhu ghayru ra'fatika
segs.en: remove my injury other than Your clemency,

segs.tr: wa ghullati la yubarriduha illa wasluka
segs.en: cool my burning thirst but reaching You,

segs.tr: wa law`ati la yutfiha illa liqa'uka
segs.en: quench my ardor but meeting You,

segs.ar: وَشَوْقِي إِلَيْكَ لاَ يَبُلُّهُ إِلاَّ ٱلنَّظَرُ إِلَىٰ وَجْهِكَ
segs.tr: wa shawqi ilayka la yabulluhu illa annazaru ila wajhika
segs.en: damp my yearning but gazing upon Your face,

segs.ar: وَقَرَارِي لاَ يَقِرُّ دُونَ دُنُوِّي مِنْكَ
segs.tr: wa qarari la yaqirru duna dunuwwi minka
segs.en: settle my settling place without closeness to You,

segs.tr: wa lahfati la yarudduha illa rawhuka
segs.en: allay my worry but Your repose,

segs.tr: wa saqami la yashfihi illa tibbuka
segs.en: cure my illness but Your medicine,

segs.tr: wa ghammi la yuziluhu illa qurbuka
segs.en: eliminate my grief but Your nearness,

segs.tr: wa jurhi la yubri'uhu illa safhuka
segs.en: heal my wound but Your forgiveness,

segs.ar: وَرَيْنُ قَلْبِي لاَ يَجْلُوهُ إِلاَّ عَفْوُكَ
segs.tr: wa raynu qalbi la yajluhu illa `afwuka
segs.en: remove the rust on my heart but Your pardon,

segs.ar: وَوَسْوَاسُ صَدْرِي لاَ يُزِيحُهُ إِلاَّ أَمْرُكَ
segs.tr: wa waswasu sadri la yuzihuhu illa amruka
segs.en: banish the confusing thoughts from my breast but Your command
O Utmost Hope of the hopers!
O Ultimate Demand of the askers
O Furthest Request of the requesters!
O Highest Desire of the desirers
O Patron of the righteous
O Security of the fearful
O Responder to the supplication of the distressed
O Storehouse of the destitute
O Treasure of the pitiful
O Help of the help-seekers

segs.tr: wa ya qadiya hawa'iji alfuqara'i walmsakini
segs.en: O Accomplisher of the needs of the poor and the miserable
O Most Generous of the most generous
O Most Merciful of the merciful
To You is my humble subjection and request,
to You my pleading and imploring

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُنِيلَنِي مِنْ رَوْحِ رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.tr: as'aluka an tunilani min rawhi ridwanika
segs.en: I ask You to let me attain the repose of Your good pleasure,
and to make constant toward me the favors of Your kindness

segs.tr: wa ha ana bibabi karamika waqifun
segs.en: Here am I, standing before the gate of Your generosity,
opening myself up to the breezes of Your goodness,
holding fast to Your strong cord,
clinging to Your firm handle!
My God, have mercy upon Your lowly slave
of silent tongue
and few good works,
obligate him through Your plentiful graciousness,
shelter him under Your plenteous shade!
O Generous, O Beautiful,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي قَصُرَتِ ٱلأَلْسُنُ عَنْ بُلُوغِ ثَنَائِكَ
segs.en: My God, tongues fall short of attaining praise of You
proper to Your majesty,

segs.ar: وَعَجَزَتِ ٱلْعُقُولُ عَنْ إِدْرَاكِ كُنْهِ جَمَالِكَ
segs.en: intellects are incapable of grasping the core of Your beauty,

segs.ar: وَٱنْحَسَرَتِ ٱلأَبْصَارُ دُونَ ٱلنَّظَرِ إِلَىٰ سُبُحَاتِ وَجْهِكَ
segs.tr: wanhasarat al-absaru duna annazari ila subuhati wajhika
segs.en: eyes fail before gazing upon the glories of Your face,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تَجْعَلْ لِلْخَلْقِ طَرِيقاً إِلَىٰ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
segs.tr: wa lam taj`al lilkhalqi tariqan ila ma`rifatika
segs.en: and You have assigned to Your creatures no way to know You
save incapacity to know You

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي فَٱجْعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَرَسَّخَتْ أَشْجَارُ ٱلشَّوْقِ
segs.tr: ilahi faj`alna min alladhina tarassakhat ashjaru ashshawqi
segs.en: My God, place us among those within the trees of yearning for You
taken firm root in the gardens of their hearts

segs.tr: wa akhadhat law`atu mahabbatika bimajami`i qulubihim
segs.en: and the assemblies of whose hearts seized by the ardor of Your love!
They seek shelter in the nests of meditation,

segs.tr: wa fi riyadi alqurbi walmukashafati yarta`una
segs.en: feed upon the gardens of nearness and disclosure,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حِيَاضِ ٱلْمَحَبَّةِ بِكَأْسِ ٱلْمُلاطَفَةِ يَكْرَعُونَ
segs.tr: wa min hiyadi almahabbati bika'si almulatafati yakra`una
segs.en: drink from the pools of love with the cup of gentle favor,
and enter into the watering-places of warm affection.
The covering has been lifted from their eyes,

segs.ar: وَٱنْجَلَتْ ظُلْمَةُ ٱلرَّيْبِ عَنْ عَقَائِدِهِمْ وَضَمَائِرِهِمْ
segs.en: the darkness of disquiet has been dispelled from their beliefs and their innermost minds,

segs.ar: وَٱنْتَفَتْ مُخَالَجَةُ ٱلشَّكِّ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَرَائِرِهِمْ
segs.tr: wantafat mukhalajatu ashshakki `an qulubihim wa sara'irihim
segs.en: the contention of doubt has been negated from their hearts and their secret thoughts,
their breasts have expanded through the verification of true knowledge,

segs.ar: وَعَلَتْ لِسَبْقِ ٱلسَّعَادَةِ فِي ٱلزَّهَادَةِ هِمَمُهُمْ
segs.en: their aspirations have ascended through precedent good fortune in renunciation,
their drinking is sweet from the spring of devotion to good works,

segs.tr: wa taba fi majlisi al-unsi sirruhum
segs.en: their secret thoughts are delicious in the sitting-place of intimacy,

segs.tr: wa amina fi mawtini almakhafati sirbuhum
segs.en: their minds are secure in the place of terror,

segs.ar: وَٱطْمَأَنَّتْ بِٱلرُّجُوعِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلأَرْبَابِ أَنْفُسُهُمْ
segs.tr: watma'annat birruju`i ila rabbi al-arbabi anfusuhum
segs.en: their souls are serene through the return to the Lord of lords,
their spirits have reached certitude through triumph and prosperity,

segs.tr: wa qarrat binnazari ila mahbubihim a`yunuhum
segs.en: their eyes have been gladdened through gazing upon their Beloved,

segs.ar: وَٱسْتَقَرَّ بِإِدْرَاكِ ٱلسُّؤْلِ وَنَيْلِ ٱلْمَأْمُولِ قَرَارُهُمْ
segs.tr: wastaqarra bi-idraki assu'li wa nayli alma'muli qararuhum
segs.en: their settling place has been settled through reaching the request and attaining the expectation,

segs.ar: وَرَبِحَتْ فِي بَيْعِ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلآخِرَةِ تِجَارَتُهُمْ
segs.tr: wa rabihat fi bay`i addunya bil-akhirati tijaratuhum
segs.en: and their commerce has profited through the sale of this world for the next

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي مَا أَلَذَّ خَوَاطِرَ ٱلإِلْهَامِ بِذِكْرِكَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْقُلُوبِ
segs.tr: ilahi ma aladhdha khawatira al-ilhami bidhikrika `ala alqulubi
segs.en: My God, how agreeable for hearts are the thoughts inspiring Your remembrance,

segs.ar: وَمَا أَحْلَىٰ ٱلْمَسِيرَ إِلَيْكَ بِٱلأَوْهَامِ فِي مَسَالِكِ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
segs.tr: wa ma ahla almasira ilayka bil-awhami fi masaliki alghuyubi
segs.en: how sweet traveling to You through imagination upon the roads of the unseen worlds,
how pleasant the taste of Your love is!
How delightful the drink of Your nearness is!

segs.tr: fa a`idhna min tardika wa ib`adika
segs.en: So, give us refuge from Your casting out and Your sending far,
and place us among the most elect of Your knowers,
the most righteous of Your servants,
the most truthful of Your obedient,
the most sincere of Your worshipers!
O All-mighty, O Majestic,
O Generous, O Endower!
By Your mercy and kindness,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي لَوْلاَ ٱلْوَاجِبُ مِنْ قَبُولِ أَمْرِكَ
segs.tr: ilahi lawla alwajibu min qabuli amrika
segs.en: My God, were it not incumbent to accept Your command,
I would declare You far too exalted for me to remember You.

segs.ar: عَلَىٰ أَنَّ ذِكْرِي لَكَ بِقَدْرِي لاَ بِقَدْرِكَ
segs.tr: `ala anna dhikri laka biqadri la biqadrika
segs.en: However, I remember You in my measure, not in Your measure,

segs.ar: وَمَا عَسَىٰ أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مِقْدَارِي حَتَّىٰ أَجْعَلَ مَحَلاًّ لِتَقْدِيسِكَ
segs.tr: wa ma `asa an yablugha miqdari hatta aj`ala mahallan litaqdisika
segs.en: and my scope can hardly reach the point where I may be a locus for calling You holy!

segs.ar: وَمِنْ أَعْظَمِ ٱلنِّعَمِ عَلَيْنَا جَرَيَانُ ذِكْرِكَ عَلَىٰ أَلْسِنَتِنَا
segs.tr: wa min a`zami anni`ami `alayna jarayanu dhikrika `ala alsinatina
segs.en: Among Your greatest favors to us is the running of Your remembrance across our tongues

segs.tr: wa idhnuka lana bidu`a'ika wa tanzihika wa tasbihika
segs.en: and Your permission to us to supplicate You, declare You exalted, and call You holy!

segs.ar: إِلٰهِي فَأَلْهِمْنَا ذِكْرَكَ فِي ٱلْخَلاءِ وَٱلْمَلاءِ
segs.tr: ilahi fa alhimna dhikraka filkhala'i walmala'i
segs.en: My God, inspire with Your remembrance alone and in assemblies,
by night and day,
publicly and secretly,
in prosperity and adversity!
Make us intimate with silent remembrance,
employ us in purified works
and effort pleasing to You,
and reward us with the full balance!
My God, love-mad hearts are enraptured by You,
disparate intellects are brought together by knowing You,
hearts find no serenity except in remembering You,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَسْكُنُ ٱلنُّفُوسُ إِلاَّ عِنْدَ رُؤْيَاكَ
segs.tr: wa la taskunu annufusu illa `inda ru'yaka
segs.en: and souls find no rest except in seeing You.
You are the glorified in every place,
the worshiped at every time,
the found at every moment,
the called by every tongue,
and the magnified in every heart!

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ لَذَّةٍ بِغَيْرِ ذِكْرِكَ
segs.tr: wa astaghfiruka min kulli ladhdhatin bighayri dhikrika
segs.en: I pray forgiveness from You for every pleasure I could find other than remembering You,

segs.tr: wa min kulli rahatin bighayri unsika
segs.en: every ease but intimacy with You,

segs.tr: wa min kulli sururin bighayri qurbika
segs.en: every happiness but nearness to You,

segs.tr: wa min kulli shughlin bighayri ta`atika
segs.en: every occupation but obeying You!

segs.tr: ilahi anta qulta wa qawluka alhaqqu
segs.en: My God, You have said—and Your word is true—

segs.ar: (يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ٱذْكُرُوا ٱللَّهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً
segs.tr: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu idhkura allaha dhikran kathiran
segs.en: “O you who have faith, remember Allah with much remembrance
and glorify Him at dawns and in the evening!”
You have also said—and Your word is true—
“Remember Me, and I will remember you!”
You have commanded us to remember You,
and promised us that You will remember us thereby,

segs.tr: tashrifan lana wa tafkhiman wa i`zaman
segs.en: in order to ennoble, respect, and honor us.

segs.tr: wa ha nahnu dhakiruka kama amartana
segs.en: Here we are, remembering You as You have commanded us!
So, accomplish what You have promised,
O Rememberer of the rememberers!
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, O Shelter of the shelter-seekers!
O Refuge of the refuge-seekers!
O Deliverer of the perishing!
O Preserver of the pitiful!
O Merciful toward the miserable!
O Responder to the distressed!
O Treasure of the utterly poor!
O Mender of the broken!
O Haven of the cut off!
O Helper of the abased!
O Granter of sanctuary to the fearful!
O Aide of the troubled!
O Fortress of the refugees!

segs.ar: إِنْ لَمْ أَعُذْ بِعِزَّتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَعُوذُ
segs.tr: in lam a`dh bi`izzatika fabiman a`udhu
segs.en: If I seek not refuge in Your might, in whom shall I seek refuge?

segs.ar: وَإِنْ لَمْ أَلُذْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَلُوذُ
